articleTitle: Optimal Channel Tracking for OFDM Systems in Double-Selective Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An algorithm which uses the Kalman filter to estimate the time-varying fading coefficients in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems is addressed. The algorithm is based on a parametric channel model where the channel response is characterized as a collection of sparse propagation paths. We investigate into how to estimate the channel by the Kalman filter in the pilot-aided OFDM wireless system. To reduce the complexity of the high-dimensional Kalman filter for channel estimator, we consider a low-dimensional Kalman filter for the channel estimation. It is shown that the algorithm is effective for the estimation of the OFMD time-varying fading channels when the performance of the channel estimation is presented in terms of the mean-square error (MSE).

articleTitle: An Extended TPB Model to Explain Potential Respondents' Intention to Participate in Web-Based Surveys
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study proposes an extended TPB model integrating two constructs: trust and personal Web innovativeness (PWI) to explain the intention of potential respondents to participate in web-based surveys. Structural equation analysis reveals 1) that attitude, perceived behavior control, trust, and personal innovativeness have significant influence on potential respondents' intention, whereas the correlations between the social norm and intention and between trust and perceived behavior control are insignificant, and 2) that the extended model improves the power of behavior prediction significantly. The results, on the one hand, verify the usefulness of the TPB to understand (non) participation in web-based survey, and on the other hand demonstrate the necessity to integrate the Trust and PWI into the TPB model in order to induce the prediction power of the model applied to the realm of Web-based survey. The paper concludes with some important implications for both theory research and implementation strategies.

articleTitle: Research and Performance Simulation on a Carrier Recovery Phase Error Detection Algorithms in Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In high-speed satellite communications, carrier recovery technique is a pivotal technique in demodulator. The algorithms of carrier recovery influence the capability of the receiver directly. This paper first studies and deduces the general architectures of carrier recovery loop in details, which is based on the maximum a posteriori estimation. It introduces and analyses the characteristic of the carrier phase error detection algorithms. The Phase discrimination characteristic is a dominating capability index of the loop, so the paper gives the result of the capability analysis of the loop. The result shows that under the low signal-to-noise ratio situation, QPSK is more appropriate to this carrier recovery loop.

articleTitle: Research on Total Contributions of Power Industry to the Economy in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Power industry is the foundation of national economy. Its contributions to the economy are reflected not only in the value added of its own, but more reflected in the drawing and impetus functions on other sectors. Based on input-output (I-O) method and the comparable PO tables from 1981 to 1992 in China, the paper quantifies the drawing and impetus functions and the total contribution from power industry to other sectors in China. From the results, it concludes that evaluating the contributions of power industry to the economy should adopt the index of total contributions. The sectors with larger drawing functions from power industry include coal and coking industry, oil and gas industry, transportation and telecommunication industry, mechanical industry, etc. The sectors with larger impetus functions from it include other non-material production sectors, mechanical industry and agriculture. The sectors with larger total contributions include mechanical industry, agriculture and other non-matter production sectors.

articleTitle: An E-Commerce Solution Based on eTong for Small Retailers of China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Small retailers of China are a strong group in number but have many difficulties in e-commerce applications nowadays. In this paper we propose a system named eTong which can help small retailers implement their e-commerce strategies. eTong whose terminal entity resembles a telephone is an e-commerce platform linking product producers and retailers. It can reduce the redundant courses between the producers and retailers and also can act as an efficient medium, providing service for both of them. The test results of eTong indicate that it creates a new win-win e-commerce model for producers and small retailers of China. We also analyze the development obstacles and challenges of eTong finally.

articleTitle: Using Combinative Proposal Distribution in Particle Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Particle filtering has gained special attention in various fields due to its capacity to handle nonlinear/non-Gaussian dynamic problems. One crucial issue in particle filtering is the selection of the proposal distribution that generates particles. In this paper, the particle filtering algorithm is improved by using more than one proposal distributions. Firstly, divide-conquer strategy is taken, and the particles used are divided into several parts. Then, they are drawn from different proposal distributions. Users can adjust the number of the particles drawn from specific proposal distributions according to their special requirements. We provide simulation results that show the efficiency and performance.

articleTitle: A New Acquisition Search Scheme for DS-UWB
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In direct-sequence ultra-wideband (DS-UWB) systems, the usage of long spreading sequences and the fine timing resolution will result in a large search space during acquisition stage that will need a lot of time to achieve acquisition state. Besides, the low power of UWB signal makes the acquisition of UWB signal is a more challenging task. In this paper, we propose an improved two-stage search scheme for rapid and reliable UWB signal acquisition. The difference, between the proposed search scheme and the other two-stage search schemes, is that the two different steplengths and two thresholds are employed for each stage in the proposed search scheme. Analytical and numerical results show that the proposed acquisition scheme greatly reduces the acquisition time, which is much smaller than that of the conventional algorithm. Additionally, the proposed acquisition scheme effectively improves the acquisition performance with regard to mean miss detection rate.

articleTitle: A Study on the Comprehensive Evaluation on the Investment Benefits of Shenzhen Land Fund
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A study on the comprehensive evaluation of the social, environmental and economic benefits of the land fund expenditure in Shenzhen was made based on fuzzy mathematics. To be more objective and more effective, the benefit evaluation procedure was improved in the following aspects. Firstly, the index system of comprehensive evaluation was established according to the main usage of the land fund in Shenzhen over the years. Secondly, with the assumption that the direct benefits and indirect benefits are different in proportion, the paper confirmed the weights of the main indexes according to the actual expenditure situation of the land fund. Finally, this paper regarded the relevant standard of developed country and urban construction in our country as the standard to confirm the grades of the indexes. The calculation result showed that there are 13 indexes regarded as excellent among the 24 indexes selected; the proportion changes of direct and indirect benefits have little influence on the total evaluation result; weights and evaluation grades of the social benefit were the highest in the 3 types of benefits, the economic benefit was the lowest; the weights and evaluation grades of municipal engineering were the highest, and accessory facility was the lowest.

articleTitle: Scenario Forming and Evaluation Analyzing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Meta-synthesis approach (MSA) proposed by Prof. Qian is an oriental system methodology for complex problem solving. The essential idea of MSA can be simplified as "confident hypothesizing, rigorous validating", i.e. quantitative knowledge arises from qualitative understanding. Accordingly, creative thinking as a useful and practical technique for complex problem solving, is the unity of divergent thinking and convergent thinking which appear alternatively in the whole creative process of human thinking. In this paper, a computational scheme based on MSA is applied to solve the complex problems. Firstly, group argumentation environment (GAE) as a computerized tool is used to facilitate expert divergent thinking process (meeting) on the concerned topics and form scenario or hypotheses based on qualitative MSA. Then, a quantitative evaluation model had been building to analyze the centralization of the different scenarios, which can used to measure the efficient of different argumentation scenario.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Housing Purchasing Power of Urban Households
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In terms of housing issues, the primary focus of economists has been the ratio of housing price to income. Argument about its applicability has not held up. Entropy weight and optimal point approach is employed to evaluate household housing purchasing power by income classes in this article. Entropy weight is more prominent in expressing the impact of the factor than subjective weight. Optimal point method uses the distance between the real value and the optimal to present the quality of order. Indices, including current, future income and asset, are introduced to comprehensively analyze housing affordability of household. The results show that the household asset has the most effect on housing purchasing power of household. With increase of household income, affordability of housing is getting stronger and stronger. Entropy weight and optimal point approach is simple and intuitive to estimate housing affordability of household by income groups. The results offer an important lesson for policymaker.

articleTitle: Reducing Specious Recovery of End-to-End Failover for Stream Control Transport Protocol
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using the application of bulk data transfer, we investigate current failover mechanism and permanent failover mechanism for SCTP. We surprisingly find that both failover mechanisms have a hidden danger of spurious recovery that occur on the primary path, which cause traffic sending to the alternate path migrate back to the primary path rashly, this aggressive migration throttles the sending rate. In order to avoid this sending rate slowdown, we first present a major potential change to SCTP - the concept of "failover's robust recovery" using a primary recovery threshold (PRT) and a new failover mechanism called SCTP's robust failover mechanism (SRFM) based on a two-level threshold (i.e., PMR and PRT) to reduce spurious recovery and to further improve performance of failover mechanism.

articleTitle: A Case Study of the Role of Agricultural Knowledge Broker
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper addresses the identification of the rote of field knowledge broker in ICT based knowledge transfer practice in the perspective of knowledge transfer study. A case study is undertaken based on a Chinese agricultural extension project for the expert system applications implemented nationally in various agricultural production fields. This paper reveals that the field knowledge broker can have five roles for a successful implementation of knowledge transfer in the agriculture sector. The roles include: an infrastructure provider for local availability of expert system; a tailored expert system developer for usability of the expert system; a knowledge transfer conduit for transferring non-codified knowledge; a knowledge sharing organizer for facilitating local farmer's knowledge exchange; and a new knowledge creator for innovating new knowledge package in responding the local conditions.

articleTitle: 'Digital China' Geo-Spatial Framework Construction: Situation, Problems and Suggestions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Under the background of 'Digital China' geo-spatial framework construction(DCGSF), the paper elaborates on the fundamental data system, data clearinghouse and web service system, law/policy/standard system and organization system. National geodetic datum plays an important role in keeping geo-spatial information onto a unified base, while national geographic databases are the main body of DCGSF. Data clearinghouse and web service system is not only an important component of DCGSF, but also an important component of National Spatial Data Infrastructure (NSDI). In order to secure and promote DCGSF process, law, policy, and standard system and organization system should be paid enough emphasis. As to some problems concerning geo-spatial framework construction emerged, five suggestions are given.

articleTitle: A Trust Model of Web Services Based on Individual Experience
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In Web services, the identical node may have different trust values in the different services domain because of the network complexity and the node's asymmetry. The node's individual difference is studied, and then one Web services trust model is proposed based on the individual experience by establishing quantitative and appraisal system. The Web services are divided into the different groups, and therefore the problem is solved that one node may have different reputation values in different services domain. The analysis indicates that the new model has improved the algorithm of feedback trust value very much.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Design in Multiuser MIMO-OFDM Systems Based on Space-Time Block Coding for IEEE 802.16
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the cross-layer design of packet scheduling and adaptive resource allocation in multiuser MIMO-OFDM systems based on STBC. First we group different types of service into four types according to 802.16 protocol. Then we use a two-layer scheduling architecture to shape traffic at medium access (MAC) layer: the first layer schedules packets for different users of the same service type and the second layer schedules packets of different service types. At last, we propose a resource allocation algorithm that allocates wireless resource efficiently at physic (PHY) layer according to the scheduling results of the MAC layer. Compared with [8], simulation results show that our proposed algorithm can achieve significant improvement in packet drop rate, packet delay, and system throughput.

articleTitle: Stock Price, Equity Dependence and Corporate Investment: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Empirical findings from Baker, Stein and Wurgler(2003) for the sample of U.S. firms and Wei, Yuanto (2006) for an international sample of 42 countries (except China) suggest that corporate investment is positively correlated with stock prices. Following Baker et al. (2003), we investigate the relationship between corporate investment and stock prices in the capital market in China on a sample period of 10 years. However, we get a surprising finding that stock prices have little effect on corporate investment, which is different from Baker (2003) and Wei (2006)'s, but similar to the performance of U.S. in 1920s, and supports the notion that the stock market is just a sideshow. It's probably an interim phenomenon in course of reformation in China. Simultaneously, we corroborate the positive effect of cash flow on corporate investment, which is consistent with the result of Baker et al. (2003).

articleTitle: An Optimization Transmission Algorithm in MIMO Multiuser Downlinks and Application in TD-SCDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper investigates an optimization transmission algorithm in MIMO multiuser downlinks and applies it in TD-SCDMA. A generalized optimization criterion of the JT total transmit signal and optimization of spatial characteristics of the total transmit signal in the case of the omnidirectional uniform distribution of direction of departure are introduced respectively, which can directly eliminate intersymbol interference and intracell multiple access interference. Simulation proves its performance in the TD-SCDMA system.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: An Ambiguous Decision Tree Model Based on Nonadditive Probabilities
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Decision tree method is a common approach in classic decision theory. Its major advantage resides in provides a powerful formalism for representing comprehensible decision problems often easy to interpret. However, the theoretic foundations of it are v-N-M utilities and Savage's subjective probabilities, which are uneasy to cope with data pervaded with uncertainty both at the construction and computation phase. This paper extends the standard decision tree technique to an ambiguous environment where the subjective probability about nature is represented by nonadditive probability, which we name as ambiguous decision tree model. First, we analyze the reason why we introduce nonadditive probabilities into traditional decision tree technique, then, introduce some preliminaries of nonadditive probabilities. Finally, we present the modeling procedure and the algorithm of it. By this model we can describe the ambiguous decision problems more rationally.

articleTitle: Trusted Computing Enabled System for Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: While bringing great flexibility to us, wireless networks also make active intrusions to be carried out a lot more conveniently. It is mainly because of the loose linkage between the hardware and virtual identity. In this paper, we adopt Trusted computing (TC) technology with tamper-resistant hardware, to establish a trusted path for secure communication in wireless networks. We propose and design a TCG-compliant (trusted computing group) system and apply it to a mutual authentication scenario. In support of our work, we illustrate how TCG specifications features can be used to implement our approach in mobile environment.

articleTitle: A Forewarning Research on Individual Disaster-Affected Population of Disaster Emergency Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The forewarning of disaster-affected population is an important issue related to the national economy development and national public security. To develop the research of the forewarning of disaster-affected population is the foundation of safeguarding public security and policy-making. This article is aimed at the characteristics of multiple uncertainty including fuzziness and random presented by disaster-affected population, proposing a new gray Markov GM(1,1) forewarning model by combining the advantages of both gray GM(1,1) model and Markov chain theory. Gray GM(1,1) model is used to imitate the original data of the individual disaster-affected population, then Markov chain theory is applied to presume the shifting rule among the conditions of disaster-affected population. Finally, the model is applied to make a forewarning analysis to the population hit by floods in a certain province. The results show that the new model has relatively high precision in the forewarning of individual disaster-affected population.

articleTitle: A 2.4GHz CMOS VCO Design
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A single resistor was used between the drain node of the bias transistor and the source node of the differential transistors. The wide-band nature of resistance can suppress the 2nd harmonic as well as other even harmonics leaking from the LC tank across the full period of oscillation. A fully integrated 2.4 GHz all PMOS LC VCO was implemented in a 0.35 mum CMOS process. The simulation results show the achieved phase noise of -121dBc/Hz@600 kHz.

articleTitle: Research on the Defect and Solution of the Technological Innovation in Tianjin Binhai New Area
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Technological innovation is the main power of the district economy development. Tianjin Binhai New Area has been the third capsheaf in the development of Chinese economy. The author illustrates the situation about the technological innovation of the enterprises in Tianjin Binhai New Area to analyze the basic status and the important effect of the technological innovation in the economy development in Binhai New Area firstly, then the article makes a deep analysis on the problems of the technological innovation of the enterprises in Tianjin Binhai New Area and points out that the bottleneck in it. Finally the article puts forward the detailed measures and directions to the problems on the basis of personnel, fund, recourse, regulation and culture combined the fact of Tianjin Binhai New Area.

articleTitle: Cooking the Enterprise-Scale Solutions: An Integrated Modeling Approach for Business Process and System Objectives
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Business process modeling assists an enterprise to achieve strategic objectives by providing methodology and tools to develop integrated business process models, however there is little discussion on how to integrate the strategic objectives into the IT system and how process and functional objectives link to the PIM. One of the primary challenges to be addressed in developing enterprise-scale solutions is to connect the domain specific requirements expressed by business analysts with the technology-specific solutions designed by IT architecture. This paper, by discussing the definition of business process and system objectives and analyzing the relationship between different levels of objectives based on the proposal modeling methodology, presents a new modeling method about the business process based on the analysis of the notion-activity and the objectives used in enterprise. It is also addressed that how a neutral linkage model between process objectives and system objectives is defined to construct the PIM, and how business process and system modeling approaches interact with each other in order to provide an overall solution for enterprises. Finally, the enterprise-scale model integrated architecture is described.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of VHF Slow FH Communication Under Jamming Environment Using the Signal Processing WorkSystem
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Research scheme of frequency hopping (FH) communication system using signal processing worksystem (SPW) is presented. A VHF slow frequency-hopping communication system is designed and modeled using SPW. Then the designed system is tested under broadband noise and partial-band noise interference channel for its bit error rate performance. At last, the performance of synchronize algorithm in this system is analysis and simulated. The results showed that this scheme is helpful in FH communication system design.

articleTitle: Reflection Upon Present Competition-Oriented Corporate Culture: In Knowledge Management Perspective
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Within nowadays highly competitive external environment, the efficiency of knowledge management (KM) determines corporations' performance and competitiveness especially for those knowledge-intensive organizations. KM is not only a matter about information technology application but requires a human-oriented corporate culture as its essential supporter. From KM spiral theory, some key environmental factors correlated with KM are discussed, and then the obstacles arising from the popular corporate culture are analyzed. At last, through analysis of connotation system of human-oriented culture, this paper gives some suggestions about how to reconstruct corporate culture.

articleTitle: Study on Integration Model Based on Two-Stage Transformation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Data importing and exporting are essential processes in data integration. Although the present tools of data integration could efficiently extract and transform data, they could hardly handle data aggregation in the establishment of database. Therefore, the paper advances two-step transformation integration model to resolve the problem. The model could automatically determine order conversion and efficiently integrating data such as accumulate plus and subtract without users programming. The model is convenient to use with the GUI interface. It is realized with XML script with portability and extensive application field. Moreover, aiming at the transformation failure caused by transformation order, the paper presents algorithms for automatically determining transformation order conversions.

articleTitle: Study on Management Model of Cluster Supply Chain Based on Time-Competition
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cluster supply chain is an organizational type of industrial cluster and supply chain combined. This paper illustrates significances and its merits of implementing of cluster supply chain, particularly based on time-competition. On the basis of the above, we also analyze the time structure of process of cluster supply chain management and its operational flow based on time competition.

articleTitle: Tranche Technology of Loan Securitization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Loan securitization is a sophisticated financial tool of funding and risk management for financial institutions. Since different investors have different risk preferences, bonds of different risk classes are issued and a given risk class is called tranche. In order to maximize profit, the thickness and rating level of each tranche must be determined optimally. By utilizing a normal inverse distribution function to simulate pool cash flow and the loss distribution of the portfolio, we put forward an economic capital model. In the model, portfolio economic capital is defined as a certain percentile of the portfolio loss distribution, and different strategies are accompanied by different conference levels for solvency, which generate different economic capital costs. Obviously, the strategy that total cost is smallest is the optimal one.

articleTitle: Study on Ex-Post Verifiable Adverse Selection in Supply Chain with Long-Term Cooperation Prospect
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The thesis firstly studies how to coordinate a one-off supply chain involving decision-maker's adverse selection which is described under common hypothesis, and finds a Second-Best coordination model which is the best choice on such an occasion. Thereafter, extending the one-off relationship to a long-term cooperation, the thesis reveals that repeated Stackelberg Games between the upper and the lower have influence on supply chain coordination with adverse selection in a long-term background: if the agent's (retailer's) private information of one season is associated with that of others, and is likely to be verified in next season, then whether the supply chain can be optimally coordinated depends on the probability of the private information being post-verified, the retailer's information rent, reservation utility which is yielded when without the cooperation, and his income in symmetry information background. The thesis provides corresponding quantitative descriptions for these conclusions respectively.

articleTitle: BGP Attacks and Countermeasures in Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the explosive growth of new communication services and the widespread proliferation of multimedia data, the network management system is expected to provide diversified traffic services and enhance network performance simultaneously. To support for the multimedia services efficiently, traffic engineering technique is used to control the flow of IP packets. For the interdomain routing, traffic engineering relies on configurations of the border gateway protocol (BGP). However, BGP has proven to be highly vulnerable to a variety of attacks. In this paper, we first discuss interdomain traffic engineering techniques.Then we describe the vulnerabilities of traffic engineering under BGP, and how attackers to be disable or disrupt interdomain traffic engineering. We also introduce the goals, constraints, and assumptions that apply to the proposed countermeasures.

articleTitle: Applying Incomplete Linguistic Preference Relations to a Selection of ERP System Suppliers
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study provides a method to solve the incomplete linguistic preference relations under multi-criteria decision making. The method uses simple calculation and can speed up the process of comparison and selection of alternative. Decision-making experts obtain the matrix by choosing a finite and fixed set of alternatives and set a pairwise comparison based on their different preferences and knowledge. The method considers only n-1 judgments, whereas the traditional analytic hierarchy approach takes n(n -1)/2 judgments in a preference matrix with n elements. By using the method described above, this study evaluates the ERP system suppliers.

articleTitle: Internet Visibility of Localized Websites of Twelve Global Brands in Japan, Korea and Hong Kong: An Evaluation with Web Impact Factor (WIF)
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The localized Web sites of twelve global brands were evaluated via Web impact factor (WIF), a measurement of the number of inlinking pages in a Web site divided by the number of indexed pages of that Web site in the databases of a search engine. The highest and the lowest WIF, and the mean WIF were identified and compared for each of the twelve global brands to reveal their visibility and impact on the Internet. The WIF of the brand Web sites was also compared between six pair of direct competitors in six industries. No correlation was found between the rank of a global brand and the value of its Web site's WIF.

articleTitle: A Two-Dimension Simplified Subcarrier Allocation for Multiuser MIMO-OFDM Transmission
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a real-time subcarrier allocation algorithm based on simplification at both antenna dimension and frequency dimension in multiuser MIMO-OFDM downlink transmission. By knowing the channel characteristic of all users, our goal is to reduce computational complexity with the requirement of minimizing the overall transmit power. And the simplification can make the transmission more suitable for real-time environment without obvious performance loss. Simulation results show that our proposed algorithm outperforms none antenna-dimension employed multiuser MIMO-OFDM transmission with significant computational complexity reduction.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining in Manufacturing Quality Data
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge on product quality is one of the most important knowledge sources throughout the product lifecycle for the efficiency and effectiveness of product design decisions. To provide quality related knowledge, this paper proposed one data mining based knowledge discovery approach. This approach can extract knowledge on product quality from large volume of quality related manufacturing data. The effectiveness of this approach is illustrated and validated by an example adapted from literature. Finally, some conclusions and future works are discussed.

articleTitle: A Blind Detection Algorithm for Frequency Selective V-BLAST System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A space-time symbol group-coding scheme is presented for the frequency selective Vertical Bell labs layered Space-Time (V-BLAST) system. This scheme constructs a rotational invariant property in the receive data and ESPRIT- like method can be used to detect the symbols blindly. Simulation results demonstrate the validity of this method.

articleTitle: The Game Analysis on Product Quality Position of the Market First Mover
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Under the premise of the competitive enterprise existing a cost difference, this article utilizes Hotelling model analyzing the product quality position of the market first mover systematically. We will find by analysis: The market first mover does not certainly have the first moving advantages than the market follower, it need to consider the cost advantage of enterprise product sufficiently to ascertain the issue. When the market first mover has cost advantage, it may take the lead to position product quality in comparatively ideal location; when the market first mover has cost inferior position, the market first mover can not position product quality in comparatively ideal location on his own wish, otherwise will compete with the market follower fiercely, now the market first mover should make their product quality position keeping certain distance with the follower in order to avoid over- competition.

articleTitle: Leader Firm and the Technological Learning in Chinese Clusters
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzed the technological learning in the cluster from the aspects of player, environment and characters of targeted technologies. This paper argued that the firms in Chinese clusters should learn technologies outside the cluster and leader firms can be the "gate keepers", which is different from the typical technological learning mode in developed countries clusters, because of the poor technological capability, incomplete market economy system and pluralized targeted technologies' sources. The empirical study based on Dongguan and Taizhou clusters supported the authors' arguments well.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Center's Location-Allocation Problem with Flexible Allocation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper sets up a two-stage stochastic programming model with recourse for dealing with the DCs location problem with uncertain demand. The model takes into account the influence of flexible allocation strategy on DCs location decision. The SAA (sample average approximation scheme) algorithm is applied and simulation experiment process has been designed for the model.

articleTitle: Construction of LDPC Codes with Cycles Hold in Tanner Graph
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a algebraic method for constructing LDPC codes. It uses a parity-check matrix of a short LDPC code with given degree distribution as mother matrix, upon which a long LDPC code is constructed by circulant permutation matrices. The number of cycles of given length in the Tanner graph of constructed codes is equal to or less than that of the short codes. Simulation results show that the error floor of constructed LDPC codes can be suppressed to a very low level.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Load Balancing Routing Algorithm for Distributed Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless sensor networks where nodes operate on limited battery energy, some other unique characteristics make these nodes impossible to be replaced or recharged, so the efficient utilization of the energy is very important. There are many papers proposed in order to reduce energy consumption, but at the same time another problem emerged, i.e., for each node with limited energy the cumulative load of data traffic from its neighbor nodes will become heavier and the energy of such nodes will deplete more quickly than before. So we have formulated the routing problem as maximizing the network lifetime. Firstly we split these nodes into to some domains, and then we balance load among each domain dynamic. Considering this we describe a dynamic load balancing routing algorithm based on each node's energy, through which we trying to maximize the lifetime of each node as well as the whole lifespan of the sensor networks. Through our models and algorithms, the simulation results showed our algorithms are more dynamic and mobility efficient, nodes can change their domains if necessary.

articleTitle: The Validation for Profit Opportunity of Securities Investment Funds through Hurst Exponent
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper has made a detailed analysis of the arbitrage opportunity which appears on the basis of the characteristics of 'mean reverting' in securities investment funds. On the basis of fractal theory, one of the nonlinear theories, the author studied the validity of Chinese fund market fractal time sequence through Hurst exponent, calculated the H value and proposed a new securities investment funds mean reversion model calculation. Meanwhile, the present paper proposes the profit opportunity which appears based on the characteristics of 'mean reverting' in the Chinese market condition and its relevant rules and regulations.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Rents, Power and Rents: Thought to Gain Competitive Advantage in Global Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Decision Directed Autocorrelation Receivers for Multiantenna UWB Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ultra wideband (UWB) transmissions use low transmit power and have rich multipath diversity. But UWB is also equally stringent in the timing requirements when conventional RAKE receivers are employed. Decision Directed Autocorrelation (DDA) receiver is suggested in the open literature as a low complexity alternative for the Rake receivers where, the present channel is estimated for correlation based on previous decisions and received waveforms. DDA are asymptotically optimal when compared to a Rake receiver and simple to implement. However due to the low transmit power of UWB, diversity schemes should be used to improve the performance of DDAs. In this paper we develop a DDA receiver scheme for Multiantenna UWB system employing Analog Space Time Coding. Simulations show that the Multiantenna DDA receiver schemes are also asymptotically optimal.

articleTitle: Study of the Housing Product Demand Exploitation Based on Value Innovation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since long ago, the competition always has been the enterprise strategy core thought, the traditional strategy management theory emphasized throughout the enterprise should strengthen and use own fully competitive advantage. However, the value innovation strategy emphasized the customer demand, but not the competitor. This article has elaborated in detail the value innovation theory connotation, has carried on the comparison to the value innovation strategy and the traditional competition strategy characteristic, and has researched the housing product implicit demand excavation and exploitation applied the value innovation strategy theory. We can discover from the research process that the housing product implicit demand exploitation has guided the function positively regarding molds the new life style and the value idea.

articleTitle: Recognition Method of Core Process and Critical Process in Medical Treatment Service Institution
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recognizing core process and critical process was an precondition of implementing process management. Through the complicacy research of process in medical treatment service, the process recognition method of multi-attribute decision-making on Interval Maths was put forward, which was applied to core process and critical process. The recognition methods for these two processes were investigated in this paper.

articleTitle: Implementing Three-factor Model: Empirical Analysis of the Fuel Oil Futures Price at Shanghai Futures Exchange
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: China's futures market is an emerging market which has only existed for more than 10 years. In recent years, this market steps into a quick development period and proposes enormous challenge for the academics and practitioners, such as futures pricing model, trading strategy, risk management and government regulation. This paper introduces an excellent three- factor future pricing model and analyzes the model empirically by employing the fuel oil future price data. From the empirical results, we find that this model fits the data well. We aim to provide a good and simple pricing tool for institution and individual investors and promote the pricing model application in China's futures market.

articleTitle: A Transmit Preprocessing Technique for the Multi-User MIMO System Downlink
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel transmit preprocessing technique for the multiuser multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) downlink is presented in this paper. Combined with the signal to jamming and noise ratio maximization method (SJNR), this proposed method can suppress the multi-user interference (MUI) effectively. More importantly, the multi-stream per-user interference can also be cancelled simultaneously at the transmitter, and the post-processing matrix in traditional methods is not required. Therefore, the new scheme has reduced the receiver's complexity.

articleTitle: IIMM: An Interest Induced Mobility Model for the Simulation of Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Realistic models for node movement are essential in simulating mobile ad hoc networks. We observe that convergence motion occurs frequently in ad hoc networks, and introduce a novel constrained entity mobility model -interest induced mobility model (IIMM) - to represent the interactional relationship among mobile hosts. IIMM can be readily used in simulations of several MANET scenarios. Moreover, we simulate HMM with Random Waypoint and Group Mobility and have evaluated network performance using various protocol independent metrics. As expected, the preliminary results indicate that the various mobility models will affect the performance of Ad Hoc network in different ways.

articleTitle: Spatial Information Services Discovery Based on Semantics
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: rdquoThe increasing Web service in spatial information domain, demands us to discovery service precisely and efficiently. However traditional Web service discovery provides keywords based search method, which would lead to rough search results, can't satisfy our request. Besides Web services lack of semantic description, unable to be interpreted by computers, it is difficult to realize services automatically selected and dynamically assembled. This paper introduces semantic web to spatial information services and embeds OWL-S in UDDI, applying semantic description in Web services discovery. Authors introduce semantic description and publishing mechanism of Web service based on OWL-S and UDDI, propose a algorithm of semantic similar degree based semantic distance, discuss services matching algorithm between request and advertisement based ontology similar degree, designs a preliminary spatial information Web service discovery system framework.

articleTitle: Minimum Rate Distortion Based Scheduling over UDP for Single Nested Streaming Media
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: TCP seems helpless, facing fast-growing high bit-rate Internet applications like streaming media. But UDP, the alternative choice, lacks congestion control and does not guarantee packets arrival. We study the UDP transmission situation by experiments, and build the mathematic and physical models. Then we propose minimum rate distortion based scheduling for streaming media. Considering the structure of the single nested streaming and the packet lost rate curve of the UDP transmission, we estimate the minimum rate distortion to determine the max retransmission of a packet and the max traffic within a GOP which can be sent through the Internet, finally we gain good transmission performance, but without UDP's natural behavior of sacking the bandwidth unfairly.

articleTitle: Associated Constraint Based Non-Binary Arc Consistency for Non-Binary CSP
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Arc consistency has been successfully applied to binary constraint satisfaction problem but cannot be generalized to effectively preprocess non-binary constraint satisfaction problem (NCSP). Associated constraint based non-binary arc consistency (nACBA) for preprocessing NCSP was proposed in this paper. Some NCSP instances generated by random NCSP generator were first preprocessed by nACBA and non-binary arc- consistency (nAC) respectively, and then solved by backtracking algorithm. Performances of backtracking, nACBA based backtracking and nAC based backtracking were evaluated and compared. The experimental results indicate that nACBA based backtracking is even more robust than the other two algorithms, which means associated constraint based non-binary arc-consistency can more effectively eliminate inconsistent values from the domains of variables or redundant constraint tuples from constraints than non-binary arc consistency.

articleTitle: Research and Performance Analysis of Space-Time Block Codes in MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The instantaneous SNR (signal to noise ratio) of the receiver of STBC (space-time block codes) over Rayleigh fading channels is illustrated, based on this, the closed impression of STBC's BER (bit error rate) is deduced with M-PSK modulation. Based on the model of STBC in MIMO (multiple-input multiple-output) system, the numerical simulation and the analysis are presented.

articleTitle: Diversification and R&D Intensity: An Empirical Analysis of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study seeks to explore the relationship between product diversification and R&D investment in diversified firms. We analyzed the diversification efforts of 189 Chinese listed companies from 11 industries to test explanations, using M-form adoption and technological opportunity as proxies for organizational controls and potential scope economies. Our analysis finds greater degrees of diversification and technological opportunity had an increasingly negative effect on relative R&D intensity. These findings suggest that R&D investment decisions in Chinese listed diversified firms may be driven by R&D efficiencies, and not by short-term risk preferences.

articleTitle: Connected Area Coverage Sets in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks consist of small sensor nodes with limited battery and processing capability. During any time, a number of sensor nodes must be kept active to sense the covered area and maintain the connectivity to the base station. This paper addresses the minimum connected area coverage set problem with equal sensing and communicating radii. With location information of its neighbor, each node selects minimum number of its neighbor nodes as sensing and forwarding nodes to cover the sensing area of itself and all its neighbors and guarantee the connectivity to all its two-hop neighbors. After exchanging the sensing and forwarding node set with its neighbors, each node decides whether it should be active. The active sensor nodes together guarantee area coverage and connectivity. The proposed algorithm is fully localized with O(n log n) time complexity and O(n) message complexity where n is the maximum number of neighbors.

articleTitle: Two Phases Algorithm of Transport Network Design Problem
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The transport network design problem deals with how to add or improve some edges on an existing transport network using quantitative analysis method. This paper put forward two phases algorithm of transport network design based on network optimization, which concludes enumerating all cut sets and resolving single-side domination set problem of weighted bipartite graph. Firstly, a single-side domination set problem of weighted bipartite graph is defined, along with the corresponding algorithm. Then two phases algorithm of transport network design is constructed by combining the algorithm mentioned above with the algorithm enumerating all cut sets. Further, the complexity of algorithm is analyzed, and it is proved that the algorithm could end in finite step. Finally, a numerical example is presented to show the efficiency of algorithm.

articleTitle: An Empirical Evaluation of the Effectiveness of E-Business Strategic Planning
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an evaluation framework for the effectiveness of e-business strategic planning (EBSP). From the e- business implementation process perspective, the evaluation indicators system of the framework consists of four levels corresponding to four stages of the e-business strategic implementation process. These four levels are: strategic objective level, resource analysis level, implementation level, and benefit evaluation level. Based on a survey of 95 Chinese firms' e- business practices, the evaluation indicators system is used to assess the effectiveness of EBSP and to explore the characteristics of each stage of the e-business implementation process. This dynamic evaluation method provides a new management tool for forecasting, monitoring and evaluating e-business implementation at the firm level.

articleTitle: Study on the Application Strategies and Process Design of BTO:A Bus Manufacturing Case in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper explores the application strategies and processes that BTO must have based on case investigation. The research results include: (1) the ultimate directions for BTO to implement and upgrade is to expand the customization degree and scope, and reduce the order-to-delivery time continually on the base of building standard products to order; (2) setting up order analysis process and adaptability development process as well as enlarging their functions are important supportive instruments for BTO to succeed; (3) customer participation will benefit the operation of BTO and satisfy the customers; (4) in current market environment, the sales strategy of BTO needs to combine the direct sales mode and distribution; (5) IT system is the basic platform for BTO to work. The survey results and conclusions are helpful to the decisions on operations paradigm transformation and order fulfillment strategy selecting for enterprises.

articleTitle: The Acceptance of a Clinical IT Innovation by the Care Givers in Residential Aged Care 11-Weeks After the Software Implementation in Australia
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: End user acceptance and satisfaction with a new IT innovation is the pre-requisite for the successful introduction of this IT solutino into an organization. More than 70 per cent of health IT projects have failed to a certain extent because of its failure to satisfy the functional or non-functional requirements of the end users and thus were not accepted by them. To date, there is no sound evidence to suggest that clinical IT solutions will bring in benefits for a residential aged care facility. This is a real concern for aged care management in investment in clinical IT solutions in Australia. Therefore, successful cases about the acceptance and benefits of the introduced clinical IT solutions by care givers in aged care services are essential for supporting the IT investment decisions of the aged care management and government policy makers. This is an essential first step towards the diffusion of clinical IT solutions into aged care sector.

articleTitle: Application of Fuzzy Set Theory in Evaluation of E-Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of e-commerce, electronic service quality (E-SQ) is increasingly recognized as an important aspect of e-commerce. To deliver superior service quality, managers of companies with Web presences should understand how customers perceive and evaluate E-SQ. But E-SQ is a composite of various attributes, among them many intangible attributes are difficult to measure. This characteristic introduces the difficulties for respondent in replying to the survey. In order to overcome the difficulty, we invite set fuzzy set theory into the measurement of performance of criteria. By applying AHP to obtain criteria weight and using grey situation decision theory to rank the service quality provided by Web sites, we get satisfied results.

articleTitle: A New Way of Blind Multiuser Channel Identification Using Cyclic Complex Cepstrum
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel approach is presented for the multiuser channel identification. The approach makes use of the modulation-induced cyclostationarity (MIC), capable of identifying individual channels of different users. By means of the complex cepstrum of cyclic autocorrelation the blind estimation of the channel can be achieved. The identifiability condition is also presented in the paper. And finally the simulation of identification algorithm is given.

articleTitle: On the Orthogonality of Signal Tones in FH/MFSK Systems Over Multipath Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the effect of multipath fading on the orthogonality of FH/MFSK communication systems is analyzed. A general expression of the orthognality loss factor D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">jn</sub> is derived for the case of multipath Rayleigh fading. Based on the expression, it is shown that the D<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">jn</sub> is determined not only by the multipath delays, signal strength fading and synchronization time error, but also by the phase variations caused by multipath time delays. Numerical results demonstrate that the effects vary with different phase variations. This result will further affect BER performance of FH/MFSK systems.

articleTitle: B/C/S Based Remote Condition Monitoring and Diagnostic Support System of Generating Unit
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The necessity, significance and benefits of the research was analyzed, and the frame work and implementation scheme of the remote condition monitoring and diagnostic support system (RCMDSS) presented based on B/C/S. The distributed monitoring, diagnosis and information integration was realized by establishing the condition monitoring subsystem based on the field bus technology, and the difference among the soft-hardware platform, database and network protocol was shielded. The intelligent expression and interaction of knowledge were materialized through virtual reality technology. The multi-agent system (MAS) was incorporated, making the system more intelligent and independent in the remote condition monitoring and diagnostic decision. The system shows its integration, opening, safe and extension, etc.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Variation of the Treasury Bond Yield Curve Based on the Principal Component Analysis in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to study the yield curve of treasury bond based on principal component analysis, this thesis attempts to describe the behavior of correlated random variables in terms of a small number of uncorrelated principal components. After it is used to study the variation characteristic of the yield curve, we find that there are several factors effecting on the variation of the yield curve. Three principal components can explain about 90% of the variation of the curve, and the explanation in China is low comparing with the abroad research. We find the principal components' change with sample period and frequency. Because the main factors are more than one parallel movement, the traditional immunization method is inefficient to manage the interest rate risk. So we should use different method to manage the different risk sources.

articleTitle: Coordination Tactic of Downstream Capacity Expansion in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We model a supply chain consisting of a supplier and a retailer, where the mean demand rate has relation to the guaranteed delivery time offered by the retailer to the customers and the market price, where the price itself is determined by the length of the delivery time. A mathematical framework is proposed to understand the interrelations among delivery time guarantee, pricing and order processing capacity of the retailer. The model and numeral analysis illustrate that the demand is higher and the retailer needs larger order processing capacity in the integrated decision than in the decentralized decision. We then show that the supplier can encourage the retailer to expand the capacity and to maximize the profits of whole supply chain by sharing in incremental profit to the retailer.

articleTitle: A Set of Cooperative Schemes in Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To satisfy future demands of wireless systems, one of key technologies is to improve the robustness of wireless transmission. In this paper, three cooperative schemes are proposed with the antennas sharing among multiple nodes to achieve cooperative diversity in wireless networks. The proposed schemes could be applied in two practical relay scenarios in which each node has one antenna or two antennas respectively. The simulations show that these schemes can achieve better performance to combat the channel corrupt. And the techniques can be applied in wireless cooperative communications.

articleTitle: Using Voluntary Activity of Peer To Peer to Distribute Digital Content Facing Information Asymmetry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We set up a game theoretic model with local and global network externality and information asymmetry, and explore the optimal price schedule to sell content using voluntary peer-to-peer activity. With information asymmetry and network externality, the content distributor, as a monopolist, should prepare a price menu for the content including low price with few copies available and high price with more copies available. This promotes the introducing activity of the peers with local network externality at first. As sales grow, the pricing should be changed dynamically. After global network effects become large enough, the need to use the peers' introduction disappears and only one menu with a high price and fewer copies should be adopted to raise the profit.

articleTitle: Novel Blind Channel Equalization Iterative Algorithm Based on Decorrelation Method
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In digital wireless communications, blind equalization without training sequence or any priori knowledge of the channel dynamics has become a topic problem, and one of its most important performance criterions is the convergence speed. Traditional constant modulus algorithm (CMA) with many advantages is a popular blind equalization approach, but its slower convergence rate is unsuitable for the compensation of the multipath fading wireless channels. In this paper, a novel blind channel equalization algorithm is presented by introducing a decorrelation factor into the equalization process. The improvement in convergence rate as well as residual MSE of the proposed algorithm is confirmed by computer simulation results.

articleTitle: Joint Channel Estimation and Side Information Scheme for Adaptively Selected OFDM Signals
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is a special form of multi-carrier modulation which is robust against the multipath effect and inter symbol interference (ISI). However, it is very sensitive to nonlinear effects due to the high peak-to- average power ratio (PAPR) owned by the transmitted signals. To reduce PAPR and improve the error performances of the OFDM signals over fading channels, an OFDM system in which adaptive symbol selection scheme (ASSS) and channel estimation are combined together can be used. The data rate is reduced somewhat in the conventional transmission method because the side information is transmitted with the data information. In order to increase data rate, we propose a new technique to transmit the side information separately in the pilot tones. We demonstrate that the proposed technique can give reasonable bit error rate (BER) performance over fading channels while effectively reducing the PAPR.

articleTitle: Risk Management under Extreme Loss
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper empirically analyzes tail behavior of rice loss due to typhoon. One of the issues of risk management is the choice of the distribution of loss data. Using peak-over-threshold approach to extreme value modeling, we fitted generalized Pareto distribution to agriculture natural disaster loss data of Taiwan from 1971 to 2005. By comparing with standard parametric loss modeling based on lognormal and gamma distributions, the appropriateness of the upper tail fitting to loss data and find generalized Pareto distribution outperforms classical parametric fits was evaluated. Finally, we computed tail risk measures and draw some implication of risk management.

articleTitle: Improvement Study on Six Sigma Mechanical Design Tolerancing with Design of Experiment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Six sigma as an approach of business improvement has become a long strategy for many famous international enterprise. Six sigma mechanical design tolerancing proposed by Motorola Inc. is an effective method to achieve six sigma level. Although the approach has many advantages, it depends on many hypotheses and has some limitations. Then studies on how to improve it with the methodology of design of experiment are performed. The improved method overcomes the weakness of the original method. A cost function is developed to evaluate and show that the optimized results not only are robust to natural sources of manufacturing and material variation but also without cost increase. In order to validate its validity, an application study is demonstrated. On the basis of comparative analysis, it can be concluded that the improved method is more effective than itself and the total cost is reduced.

articleTitle: A New Approach to Blind Multiuser Detection Based on Affine Projection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The computational complexity of the blind adaptive multiuser detection algorithm with multipath fading channel is usually high. By combining Rake receiver and blind multiuser detection based on the affine projection algorithm (APA), an adaptive receiver which can be used in multipath fading channel is presented in this paper. As the APA can provide a good capability to tradeoff convergence speed and computational complexity, the proposed receiver has much improved convergence speed and tracking properties compared to the LMS-based receiver with much reduced computational cost compared to the one based on RLS algorithm, and also the new receiver is extremely near-far resistant. Simulation results are presented to compare our APA-based receiver with the blind LMS and RLS-based schemes and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed receiver.

articleTitle: A Kind of Inventory Policy Model under the Financial Budget
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The existed inventory models hardly consider the impact effect on the price of stock item by the inventory actions of enterprises. On the assumption that the supply of stock item is fixed, the paper analyses the impact effects of inventory actions and gets the optimal dynamic inventory policy under the financial budget. The result of simulations illustrates that the inventory actions of enterprises has certain affections on the price of item. Under the continuous changes of item price and residual inventory bankroll, the optimal inventory policy is a process of dynamic adjustment, and the optimal purchase quantity in every stock period increases by degree.

articleTitle: Value Chain Coordination with Contracts for Virtual R&D Alliance Towards Service
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Value chain of virtual R&D alliance (VR&DA) towards service has taken on more and more important role in present manufacturing era. This paper considers the coordination problem of value chain of VR&DA towards service with contracts. Firstly, key concepts on value chain of VR&DA towards service are introduced. Then, the framework for coordinating the value chain of VR&DA towards service with contract is developed, and the preliminary model to depict the contract relationship between the agents of VR&DA is presented. Finally, future study suggestions are advanced.

articleTitle: Carrier Phase Recovery for Turbo Codes in Rayleigh Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A carrier phase recovery scheme suited for turbo- coded systems in Rayleigh fading channels with AWGN is proposed in this paper. This scheme involves Rayleigh fading channel estimation with pilot symbol assisted modulation (PSAM) and iterative carrier phase estimation with the joint phase recovery and turbo-decoder. Simulation results show that the proposed method with small system expense can significantly improve the performance of carrier phase recovery for turbo- coded systems in Rayleigh fading channels.

articleTitle: Financial Modeling and Credit Scoring with Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the backpropagation algorithm-the multilayer feedforward network structure is described . The proposed approach is experimented, tested to classify corporate financial performance using data with financial ratios Financial modeling for classification algorithms based on neural network is established. The study found that Levenberg Marque training error is smallest among 4 learning algorithms and its performance is better.

articleTitle: Study on Customer Satisfaction of House Property Management Based on Customization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the increasing and changing of the owner's individual demand, this paper sets up a model which optimizes the property management enterprise's interior resources and a function which is used to weigh the owner's satisfaction, in order to achieve the optimization of the owner's satisfaction within its capacity. Then a case is offered to prove the validity of this method, which puts forward an effective approach to improve the owner's satisfaction and offers a new training of thoughts for the property management enterprise.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis of IR-UWB with Different Monocycles in the Presence of UMTS Interference
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the performance of IR-UWB (impulse radio ultra wide-band) with different monocycles in the presence of interference generated by the UMTS/WCDMA systems. The bit error rate is derived for the IR-UWB with n-order derivative Gaussian monocycle in the presence of UMTS/WCDMA interference. The relationship between the anti-UMTS interference ability of IR-UWB and the derivative order of Gaussian monocycle is revealed. Numerical computation results are shown for validating the proposed analysis.

articleTitle: The Third Contribution of Knowledge Management to Business Process
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge and business processes are "symbiotically" related. A large number of Chinese enterprises make great use of knowledge management to establish documents of project management process. Through the observation to this kind of knowledge management practice, we find that knowledge management makes the third contribution to business process, namely, forming the standard process. In this article, we will summarize this special type of knowledge management practice as an "action-knowledge-process" model, and demonstrate how the knowledge leads to the formation of process by case study.

articleTitle: Distributed Fixed-Step Power Control of Cellular Mobile Systems via Window Concept
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the open literature, it is shown that the received carrier-to-interference ratio (OR) in cellular mobile systems can be maintained within the desirable range provided that the path gain remains approximately constant over a number of consecutive power control steps. However, when channels suffer short-term fading, it is not clear whether existing power control algorithms remain convergent. This paper proposes a distributed fixed-step power control algorithm with binary feedback via window concept for cellular mobile systems. The performance of the proposed scheme is analyzed in short-term fading channels. A sufficient condition for system stability is derived using a simple received CIR model and a power control window. It is shown that the bound of the received CIR of each user varies as a function of the target CIR, the size of the power control step, and the link gain.

articleTitle: Improvement on the Method of Service Quality Gap Measurement
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: SERVQUAL is a gap method in service quality measurement and is often recommended in classical textbooks, or cited by many literatures. But there have always been some papers persisting that SERVQUAL gap is not a good method to service quality measurement because of the problems of reliability, discriminant validity, spurious correlations, and variance restriction etc. Considering SERVQUAL is a good instrument for service quality diagnosis, and for the above issues, we attempt to improve the SERVQUAL gap method from three facets, that is, choosing operational definition of expectation; importing self-confidence to expectation in service quality measurement; and adopting the formative service quality measurement model. Finally we test the modified gap model empirically in 2006 Shenyang International Horticultural Exposition (EXPO).

articleTitle: The Impact of Supply Shocks on the Fluctuation of Steel Industry Output
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We investigate the impact of three different kinds of disturbance on steel industry output in China. They originate, respectively, in aggregate demand, technology, the labor and the asset supply. Based on the real business-cycles approach, the paper finds that the shocks of supply elements in steel industrial are the major source of Steel Industry Output fluctuation, and analyses these propagation mechanisms affect on output by impulse response function and VECM. Meanwhile we detect the contribution of the supply component by variance decomposition. It seems plausible that changes in technology have a significant permanent component; In this case, the innovation raises the expected path of the level of technology permanently. The increase 1% of the fixed assets investment in one period has been leading to rise of steel output until 10 years; The labor supply disturbances are relevant, but play little role on steel output fluctuations. Therefore, the short-run behaviors of Steel Industry Output and long-run behaviors of Steel Industry Output is largely explained by supply side shocks.

articleTitle: A Scheme for Secure Services Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based the concept of trusted chain introduced by TCG (trusted computing group), integrating the operation system bootstrap process, we propose a scheme for security management in services, which should be implemented in a secure operation environment. That is to say, we should first establish a trusted computing platform through a trusted startup process. Then check the integrity of services before their starting and monitor them when they are running in this secure operation environment. So we can ensure the integrity of services whenever we use them.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Directorate Characteristics on Earnings Management Based on Chinese Market Data
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the center of corporate governance, board of directors plays an important role in constraining earnings management. This paper examines the relationship between the composition, ownership and activity of board and earnings management. The empirical results based on 6832 data sample of listed Chinese firms show that the extent of earnings management is negatively related to the proportion of the independent directors, and is positively related to its square and the activity of the board measured by the board meetings frequency. By analysis the quadratic curve determined by independent directors, the optimal proportion is approximately 50%. On the other hand, the board size and board ownership are not significantly related to the earnings management. The findings provide empirical evidence for corporate governance reform and benefit improvement of financial reporting quality.

articleTitle: The Grey Comprehensive Evaluation Model for Safety of Construction Sites
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
