abstract: Safety evaluation technology is the new method in the field of safety management. It made safety management from remedy after the accident to prevention beforehand. So safety management has the function that can control the way of accident. But now safety evaluation methods that adapt construction project are not mature. In this paper, integrating the current safety evaluation technologies and the traits of construction project, a new grey comprehensive evaluation model is proposed. At first, the index system is constructed on safety evaluation of construction sites. Then using the hierarchy grey evaluation method, the process and evaluating grade are established to evaluate the safety of construction sites. The new model is also verified in three construction sites of Qingdao Construction Group.

articleTitle: Simplified Joint Iterative Detection and Decoding in BICM MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Joint iterative detection and decoding scheme is exploited for a bit interleaved coded modulation (BICM) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) Orthogonal-Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system. A simplified channel estimation utilizing channel frequency-domain correlation is used to decrease FFT order and provide channel state information for the demapper. An improved list sphere-decoding (ILSD) SISO demapper without the requirement of initial radius is also adopted. The computation complexity of ILSD can be further reduced by the simplified channel estimation method. Simulations show that the BICM MIMO-OFDM scheme is robust to the timing-vary frequency selective fading channels. Performance degradation caused by simplification can be compensated by increasing the iterative number of the receiver.

articleTitle: Assuring Process Quality with a Preset Confidence Probability via Quality-Oriented Statistical Tolerancing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The statistical tolerancing models and design approach for assuring a preset process quality target are presented. A set of standardized process quality indices (PQIs) is introduced for meeting the measurement and evaluation to process yield, process centering and quality loss. Quality-oriented statistical tolerancing technique is introduced to concurrent design for assuring process target. The comprehensive application of this new approach is shown by a case study. The main advantages of this new approach are that PQIs can be assured with a desired confidence probability under four different cases. Process quality, statistical tolerances (STs) and SPC parameters can be concurrently designed, coordinated planned and quantitively analyzed.

articleTitle: The Influence of Innovativeness Compatibility on Consumers' Online Purchase Intention on the Creative Product: A Case Study of Fashion
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Innovativeness is the key concept included in the creation process and sale process of creative product and innovativeness compatibility decides whether consumers would accept creative product. Based on the technology acceptance model (TAM), surveying 651 consumers in the Internet environment, this paper found that product innovativeness compatibility positively forecasted consumers' online purchase attitude and intention on creative product and consumers' perceived usefulness and ease took as the mediators, but there wasn't distinct relationship between product innovativeness compatibility and consumers' perceived safe in the internet environment; Internet innovativeness compatibility positively forecasted consumers' online purchase attitude and intention on creative product and consumers' perceived usefulness, ease and safe took as the mediators.

articleTitle: The Application of Principal Component Analysis in Evaluating of Financial Risks of Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the market economy, the financial risk that the enterprise faced is becoming increasingly diversification and complication, and the influence also deepen increasingly. Researching on evaluating of financial risks play an important role in promoting enterprise value and making enterprise develop healthily. At first the paper analyses and summarizes the current ways of evaluating financial risks, and then introduces the principal component analysis model to evaluate financial risks. At last, the paper verified the feasibility of the model in actual case.

articleTitle: Market Pattern and Trend Analysis of China C2C E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: After a few years of development, China C2C e-commerce has already formed an oligopsonistic market where mainly include Taobao Website, Ebay-Eachnet Website and Paipai Website. Through the current situation and the forming reason analysis, we indicated a few question in China C2C e-commerce market developing. Meanwhile, combined owning materials and the experience of advanced C2C e-commerce countries; we predicted the future trend of China C2C market pattern.

articleTitle: Middleman's Choosing Flow Based on SVMs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Choosing diversiform middlemen is urgent demand that enterprise meets growing consumer's individuation needs. So we designed a middleman's choosing flow for enterprise. Firstly, reduce the dimension of product's attributes by factor analysis, get the main factors, clustering analysis for the products according to the main factors, and get the type of products. Secondly, make sure the target market of kinds of products by segmentation. Thirdly, construct the middleman's customer value evaluation system. Finally, make feature extraction to the evaluation system by SVC and get the tidy evaluation system by which construct the middleman's customer value evaluation model based on SVM, and regard the model as the technology rule of choosing a middlemen. With the example of mobile operator choosing middlemen, results show that the flow is reliable and this evaluation model corresponding to the 3rd service can be applied to choose new middlemen.

articleTitle: A 1.2V High Performance Mixer for 5.8GHz WLAN Application
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on traditional Gilbert Cell prototype, a 5.8 GHz down-conversion mixer which conclude CMOS gm Cell and LC tank is demonstrated in this paper. The RF, LO and IF port frequencies are 5.8 GHz, 5.75 GHz and 50 MHz, respectively. With SMIC 0.18 um process, simulation results show 3.2dB of conversion gain,-0.8dBm of P-1dB compression point and 7.9 dBm of IIP3 with -5dBm LO power and 1.2 V supply voltage.

articleTitle: SDAM: A New Data Aggregation Approach for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a novel scalable scheme, scalable data aggregation monitoring (SDAM), is proposed for efficient data gathering with aggregation (fusion) in wireless sensor networks (WSN). Different from existing schemes, SDAM not only optimizes data transmission cost, but also incorporates the function of data fusion, which is crucial for emerging sensor networks with data management and high availability requirements. Employing a randomized algorithm that allows fusion points to be chosen by nodes' data amount, SDAM can achieve high availability for sensor nodes, which results the optimal solution for nowadays system setup. Simulation results demonstrate that SDAM scheme can reflect the node status promptly, and save the network throughput of sensor nodes. Therefore, the lifetime of WSN is significantly extended.

articleTitle: Synchronizing the Market Entry, Production, and Pricing Strategies for Co-Products
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We model a situation in which the manufacturer generates two co-products in a single process with fixed ratio. The overall production quantity is based on the prime (high profit margin) product. However, the sales of the by-product would alleviate the average production cost and generate more profit. Prior to the selling season, he determines the two strategies: 1. the production quantity for the co-products; 2. the number of alternative markets to enter for the by-product. After that, he allocates the by-product in each market. During the season when both demands are realized, he supplies the demand of the prime product with the on-hand inventory, enduring possible overage and underage cost while he would sell the by-product in each market with a market clearing price. Our paper aims to analyze the optimal strategies in such an environment. We find the production quantity and the optimal market number are uniquely determined. Finally, we demonstrate the effects of various parameters on these strategies.

articleTitle: A Low Pass Filter Traffic Shaping Mechanism for the Arrival of Traffic
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To decrease the traffic burstiness, general method of traditional shaping mechanisms is to smooth the traffic rate or the packet interarrival time of existing flows. However, traffic burstiness is also induced by the gusty arrivals of new flows. According to our knowledge, there is no research which attempts to decrease the burstiness caused by the arrivals of new flows. To cope with this, a shaping mechanism to the interarrival of flow named interarrival low pass filter (ILPF) fore-shaping mechanism is proposed in this paper. By the low pass filter, the ILPF fore-shaping mechanism smoothes the flow interarrival time so as to decrease the traffic burstiness. The ILPF fore- shaping mechanism is well suitable for the real-time applications which can endure some delay for accessing. According to theoretic analysis and computer simulation, it is proved that the ILPF fore-shaping mechanism significantly improves the utilization of the network as well as providing QoS guarantees in terms of probability.

articleTitle: A Research on Enterprise IT Governance and Its Framework
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information technology is the important resource for enterprises to adapt the change of current management circumstance. To insure the effective exploitation and use of enterprise IT resource, the paper analyses the meaning of IT governance from the point of view of strategic management. In addition, it discusses the implementation framework of IT governance and researches the implementation process, key successful factors and key performance guideline and mature degree.

articleTitle: Handoff Strategy Analysis by Stackelberg Model Over HSDPA
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: HSDPA (high speed downlink packet access) is self disturbance system restrained by many performance targets and conditions. According to the tradition the handoff traffic is in higher grade than access ones. But it gets more unintolerant in the delay or rejection of the access multimedia packet services while a little handoff delay is relatively forgivable. It separates the synthesis of system security and capability, unsatisfied with future multimedia services fusion tendency. Breakthrough the preserved or divided propriety handoff strategies, we induced sub game perfect Stackelberg handoff model through two periods of pure strategy Nash closed loop equilibrium based on interactive handoff traffic utility cost. It operates in distributed and independently control mode. The simulation result looks optimistic.

articleTitle: Locating Precision Analysis for the Airborne and Passive Region Navigation System Based on the Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the region passive locating system named Beidou, which nowadays is under extensive research, this article puts forward a proved algorithm by using Kalman filter to reject dynamic fault tolerant. This method upgrades the tracing ability of the filter under the airborne environment. The real-time character is improved because of the decrease in the dimension numbers of the state equation. Verified from the trying out data, the locating precision of the system can reach up to 92 meters, filtered by the algorithm. Thus it can meet the general needs of the users in the air.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prevention of Credit Risk in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The cooperation of organizations in supply chain is based on a good credit system. With more and more credit contracts being signed between enterprises, the credit risk has become a main default risk for the suppliers. As a kind of potential threat, the credit risk will influence the normal operation of supply chain. It's no doubt that the occurrence of credit risk will lead to a deviation from the prospective earnings, and make the members of supply chain less competitive. So it's necessary to analyze the causes which result in credit risk in supply chain and find out appropriate and specific ways to solve these problems. This paper defines the concept of credit risk in supply chain, and then analyzes the influencing factors in credit trade by game theory. Lastly the corresponding precautions are put forward to minimize the credit risk and strengthen the credit consciousness of each member in supply chain.

articleTitle: Value Proposition of Mobile Instant Messaging
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The popularity of instant messaging (IM) has escalated dramatically in recent years. This service is becoming more prolific not merely due to the convenience of the instant communication it offers, but the increased deployment of broadband has led to a rise in the availability of movies, music ,and other media for download. The use of IM on the move enables location-based services by making use of the current position of a user. To further add value to the use of mobile IM (MIM), the deployment of bots as interactive agents that respond to IM requests appeal to users. This paper evaluates the market potential of IM and bots as the next big thing in messaging on the move. The paper also looks into user segmentation and target markets, competitors in the field, factors spurring the growth of MIM and discusses a number of usage scenarios.

articleTitle: Differential Transceiver Design for Quasi-Orthogonal Space-Time Block Codes
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we report a general and simple differential modulation scheme that can be applied to both partial-diversity quasi-orthogonal space-time block codes and full-diversity quasi-orthogonal space-time block codes for four transmit antennas. The differential encoding and decoding can be simplified to differential Alamouti codes by grouping the signals in the transmitted matrix and decoupling the detection of data symbols, respectively. For the codes with partial transmit diversity, the new scheme can achieve constant amplitude of transmitted signals, and avoid signal constellation expansion, and it has a linear signal detector with very low complexity. Simulation results show that these partial-diversity codes can provide very useful results at low SNR for current communication systems. For the codes with full transmit diversity achieved by constellation rotation, our scheme has performance equal to the best full-rate quasi-orthogonal schemes previously described in the literature with a simpler detector.

articleTitle: Self-Organization Mechanics of Knowledge Diffusion in a Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A network is a structural form of knowledge diffusion and elementary interaction state among organizations' knowledge, and knowledge self-organization is an embedded principle of knowledge interactions in a network, the researches on knowledge self-organization mechanics in a network are very important in theories and practices. In the paper, we consider an organization's knowledge reaction cycle, self-catalyzing cycle, and knowledge cross-cycle among organizations, and then a hyper-cycle structure of a knowledge network is presented. Secondly, the self-organization theories are introduced to study the network knowledge self-organization mechanics, and the models are established according to the basic equation of synergetic theories. Lastly, two simulative analyses of knowledge diffusions are given by the analysis of the models, our results tend to support the conclusions that an organization knowledge growth is related to his knowledge level and is restricted by his frontal and latter agents in a network.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Eco-Economic Benefits of Rural Energy Construction Project in West Qinling Mountains Region, China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Excessive consumption of firewood is the important driving factor of forest degeneration in west Qinling Mountains region, China. Based on the investigated data, this paper evaluated the eco-economic benefits of rural energy construction project in this region. The results show: the ecological and economic benefits that using the solar stove and the biogas is remarkable. The quantity of heat, a household with 5 persons obtaining from one 1.5 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> solar stove and one 8 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> biogas digester in each year, is equal to 773 kgce or 1353 kg fuelwood, whose net income is 278 Yuan. The quantity of fuelwood substituted in a year comes up to the growth quantity of 0.338 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> forest land in each year, which could protect 0.042 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> woodland against cutting. Sloping Land Conversion to Forest Program (SLCP) intending to expand the forest increment should be taken as a medium and long-term strategy and brought into effect steadily. Using the solar stove and the biogas takes to protect existent forest as the goal, is a trenchancy instrument of consolidated effect of SLCF and ecological constructing, and should be increase invested and constructed.

articleTitle: Entrepreneurial Orientation, Market Orientation and Firm Performance: The Mediator Role of Organizational Learning
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Within the literature of marketing and management, little attention has focused on market orientation, entrepreneurial orientation and the performance through the mediator role of different types of organizational learning. This study argues that entrepreneurial orientation is positively related to the double loop learning and market orientation is positively related to the single loop learning, which affect the performance together. Different types of organizational learning have different effects on the efficiency, effectiveness and adaptability dimensions of performance. Organizational learning mediates the relationship between firm's business orientation and performance. The framework model is given and the managerial implication is discussed.

articleTitle: Frequent Query Patterns Guided XML Caching and Materialization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Query caching and view materialization are two possible approaches to improve the performance of XML management systems. Mining frequent query pattern is a technique to discover the most frequently occurring query pattern trees from a large collection of XML queries. In this paper, we describe an efficient mining algorithm to discover the frequent query pattern trees from a large collection of XML queries. And then we examine how the frequent query patterns can be used to guide the view materialization and cache replacement.

articleTitle: The Performance Analysis and Simulation of Hierarchical Mobile IPv6
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Internet engineering task force (IETF) has proposed hierarchical mobile IPv6 (HMIPv6) in order to reduce a frequent location registration of a mobile node in mobile IPv6 (MIPv6). HMIPv6 reduces the amount of signaling and improves the performance of MIPv6 in terms of handover latency. However, less comparative studies have been done to study the performance of the hierarchical Mobile IPv6 protocol. In this paper, we propose an evaluation model containing four access routers and up to 50 mobile nodes that move randomly and communicate. The proposed network model is then simulated in an open source simulator NS-2. The study provides quantitative results of the improvements provided by HMIPv6 with respect to handoff latency, packet loss, signaling load and bandwidth per station.

articleTitle: A Low-Complexity Adaptive Moving Target Tracking Algorithm Over Time-Varying Scattering Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless communication environment, the time-varying channel and angular spreads caused by multipath fading and the mobility of mobile stations (MS) degrade the performance of the conventional direction-of arrival (DOA) tracking algorithms. On the other hand, although the DOA estimation methods based on the maximum likelihood (MI) principle have higher resolution than the beamforming and the subspace based methods, prohibitively heavy computation limits their practical applications. In this paper, we first propose a new suboptimal DOA estimation algorithm that combines the advantages of the lower complexity of subspace algorithm and the high accuracy of MI based algorithms, and then propose a Kalman filtering based tracking algorithm to model the dynamic property of directional changes for mobile terminals in such a way that the association between the estimates made at different time points is maintained. At each stage during tracking process, the current suboptimal estimates of DOA are treated as measurements, predicted and updated via a Kalman state equation, hence adaptive tracking of moving MS can be carried out without the need to perform unduly heavy computations. Computer simulation results show that this proposed algorithm has better performance of DOA estimation and tracking of MS than the conventional MI or subspace based algorithms in terms of accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: The Impact of Forecasting with Kalman Filter on the Bullwhip Effect
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The distortion of demand information is the source of bullwhip effect. It is caused by demand forecast bias. Furthermore it is enhanced by the improper inventory management policy. Combining with causality analysis, Kalman filter can forecast demand under a non-stationary demand process. The paper focuses on the mechanism of bullwhip effect produced, and gives the infimum for bullwhip effect coefficient expression using Kalman filter forecast with respect to different lengths of lead times. Finally, we draw a conclusion that the bullwhip effect is not necessarily produced via Kalman filter forecast in the case of L les 2.

articleTitle: Integrated Production Planning Model and Method for Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A supply chain up and down stream integrated model is established for supply chain production planning. The factors such as price, inventory etc. are considered in the model. Lagrangian relaxation technology is used to optimize the supply chain integrated planning model. The model and technology provide theoretical foundation for up and down stream enterprises to realize "win-win" objective on the condition of information sharing. The number results prove the effectiveness of the model and algorithm.

articleTitle: The Application of EVT-Copula in Operational Risk Quantification
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the operational risk of Chinese banks becomes increasingly outstanding, we need urgently to find out a accurate measurement method. This article takes one commercial bank as an example, analyses the tails' characteristics of three types of operational risk loss event. It measures the fat-tail and light-tail loss by the POT model of EVT and logarithm normal model. Since the operational risk sample is small, it estimates with Bayesian inference based on MCMC, meanwhile it uses t-Copula and normal Copula function to aggregate each kinds of operational risk and gets the distribution of total operational risk It turns out that, when estimate in this way, the result is more stable, smaller and reliable.

articleTitle: Modeling the Anti-Collision Process of RFID System by Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years RFID technology has become very popular in many service industries, purchasing and distribution logistics, industry, manufacturing companies and material flow systems. In RFID system, one of the problems that we must solve is the collision between tags which lowers the efficiency of the RFID system. Framed Slotted ALOHA is a common used algorithm in anti-collision field. In this paper, we use Markov Chain to model the identification process of FSA algorithm. Then method to improve the system efficiency is proposed. According to analysis, the method shows better performance than conventional algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of SDH Digital Cross-Connect Matrix
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: SDH digital cross-connect (SDXC) is one of the most important network elements in SDH optical transport network. It can realize the effective network management, reliable network protection/recovery, automatic connection layout and realtime check and control of the SDH network. And the SDXC matrix is the core module of the SDXC system, so the design of 2 times 2 SDXC matrix is introduced. The exchange principle of the SDXC matrix is described first, then the exchange process is analyzed. Based this, the design scheme, functional configuration and circuit realization of the matrix are discussed mainly. Finally, the tool of VCS of Synopsys verifies the correctness of the design and Design-vision of Synopsys synthesizes it. The functional testing and synthesis results show that the 2 times 2 cross-connect matrix is an optimized design with perfect function and that it is realizable.

articleTitle: Study and Transplant of Operating System for Wireless Sensor Network Node
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the embedded operating system TinyOS, including its event-driven mechanism, schedule strategy mechanics, power management mechanism, and etc. Then, the component-based architecture of TinyOS is analyzed. Based on these, the transplant scheme, the design principle of the layer of hardware description and the selection principle of processor are provided. Finally, this paper gives some conclusions and foresight.

articleTitle: Multivariate Nonlinear Prediction of Shenzhen Stock Price
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, an attempt is made to predict stock price movement on Shenzhen stock market of China with nonlinear dynamical theory. Multivariate nonlinear prediction method based on multidimensional phase space reconstruction is considered. We propose a multivariate nonlinear model in forecasting stock price, and compare the prediction accuracy of our model with univariate nonlinear prediction model. The results show that multivariate nonlinear prediction model outperforms univariate nonlinear prediction model. Multivariate nonlinear prediction model is a useful tool for stock price prediction in emerging markets.

articleTitle: Evaluating Information Technology Investment Under Multiple Sources of Risks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information technology investments are characterized by the nature of high risk level. Despite enormous expenditure of IT applications in most organizations, the relationship between IT investment value and risk factors have rarely been fully explored. This paper develops a comprehensive methodology, which has incorporated risk assessment and real options analysis, to evaluate IT investment that are subject to multiple sources of uncertainties. Applying this method in practice would help managers make better decisions on IT investment in an uncertain environment.

articleTitle: A Research on the Open MAS Cooperative Control Mechanism based on Multi-Fieldbus Environment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Analysis thinking of MAS is introduced to the complex process control system composed of multi-fieldbus in this paper. Agent classes with different functions are abstracted from the control system, and the distributed MAS model with parallel algorithm characteristic based on OPC protocol is established. The collaboration control mechanism is expressed using logical relationships such as Sequence, AND, OR etc. in logical mathematics. Similarity is found between the running mechanism of MAS and the parallel and competitive characteristics in multi- processes programming method after comparison. The main function of agents with MAS idea are developed by C++ language and COM technology in an actual project. Also some discussion is given on the opening characteristic of the multi-fieldbus MAS.

articleTitle: Ocean Observing Data Web Service and Application in Shipwreck Salvation of Taiwan Strait
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the ocean dynamical environment real-time observing system of Taiwan Strait and adjacent maritime region, multiple observing data such as remote sensing data, structured data and so on are produced by the observing net from airspace, ocean surface, underwater space and ocean bottom. The data sharing and Web service is a key part to influence the application efficiency of the whole system. According to the characteristics of the oceanic dynamical environment of Taiwan Strait, the construction scheme of the observing net is introduced in this paper firstly. Then the architecture of the observing data sharing and Web service system is introduced, which includes four parts, i.e. the observing data acquiring module, the data integration module, the data processing and information production development module, the data sharing and web service module. Next, the user classification system and service content classification are introduced. The users are divided into five classes and the service content is divided into 4 layers. At last, the technology realization strategy and application in shipwreck salvation decision-making support system is introduced.

articleTitle: Masquerade Detection Using String Kernels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the field of computer security, one of the most serious threats is masquerade attack, in which an attacker uses a legitimate user's account in system. In this paper, we propose a new method for masquerade detection based on string kernel. String kernel is an inner product in the feature space generated by all subsequences of length k. By using string kernel, OCSVM (one-class support vector machine) algorithm can directly process the UNIX command sequences, which are the input data of masquerade detection. Experimental comparisons of the performance of our method with previous work show the following results: For PU dataset, the detection rate of our method is improved by 15% compared with the other unsupervised methods, given the same false positive rate; For SEA dataset, our method can achieve about the same detection rate as the best supervised method; Compared with the RBF-OCSVM, our detection rate is improved by about 13%.

articleTitle: Joint Bayesian the Number of Active Users Estimation and the Signatures Detection in DS-CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The estimation of the number of users and detection of the signatures in the unknown colored noise is considered. We exploit the Reversible Jump Markov Chain Monte Carlo (RJMCMC) method to solve the problem. Through introducing subspace algorithm and converting condition state spaces of the posterior distribution, the method based on Bayesian inference achieves the joint posterior probability density function of desired parameters by integrating out the nuisance. Simulation results support the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Integrated FFT-Based Interpolation Frequency Estimator and its Application to Feature Extraction of FM Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Feature extraction of FM signal is the first and most important step in modern automatic communication signal recognition. Based on the real-world collected FM signal, a systematic method for feature extraction of FM signal is presented after an intensive experiment modeling analysis, which includes Hilbert Transform and the key single-tone parameter estimation technique-integrated FFT-based interpolation frequency estimator (IIFE) by integrating the contribution of more FFT coefficients than traditional FFT-based estimators in the frequency estimation of single tone through a novel normalized frequency offset estimation model and maximum likelihood estimation. Computer Monte-Carlo simulations show the proposed IIFE outperforms traditional FFT-based ones with little addition of computation time, which is very effective in its application to feature extraction of FM signal.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Approximation

articleTitle: SASO: Security Adaptive Self-Organization for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Secure communication is very important in computer networks and authentication is one of the most eminent preconditions. This paper proposes Session-key derivation, decentralize key management for wireless sensor networks covering the aspects of key deployment, key refreshment, and key establishment to achieve a high-level security for WSNs.

articleTitle: Performance Appraisal on Supply Chain Based on Value Engineering and Multistage Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a new management model, supply chain is an effective way that the enterprise can obtain a competitive advantage and improve economic benefit. Performance evaluation of supply chain plays an increasingly important role as a comprehensive feedback control activity in the business management. So, how to evaluate the performance of supply chain has become the hot research topic in the supply chain enterprise. In this paper, Value Engineering (VE) is introduced, on which basis new index systems of performance evaluation of supply chain are worked out, and then AHP-multistage fuzzy comprehensive appraisal method is adopted to analyze them, in order to offer the basis for evaluating the supply chain and improving its management level.

articleTitle: Integrating HDRI into Google Maps with Ajax
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Google Maps is a free Web mapping service application and technology provided by Google that offers Web map service. Ajax is a new technology based on asynchronous communication between a client Web browser and a back-end server, allowing Web applications to request and receive data without ever reloading the page. Google Maps is the popular application that uses Ajax technology. With Ajax, this paper develops an extension of Google Maps which integrates high dynamic range images into Google Maps. People can take advantage of high dynamic range images annotation features to provide more inform regarding particular points of the area.

articleTitle: A Research about Spatial Association Rule Mining Based on Concept Lattice
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper puts forward an algorithm about spatial association rule mining which is based on concept lattice. Firstly, spatial data and their relationships are abstracted into a generic relationship database. Then we can build the spatial concept lattice by the method of mining association rules in the relationship database. At last an improvement algorithm of spatial association rule mining based concept lattice was offered. In the end, the experimental result is given and it is proven that it is effective.

articleTitle: Canonical Framework for ATI and DPCA
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The topic of moving-target detection in clutter has been extensively studied, there are many methods, such as along-track interferometric (ATI) phase, displaced phase center antenna (DPCA) method, space-time adaptive processing (STAP), or some other metrics. A canonical framework is proposed that encompasses ATI and DPCA. The statistical test metric for ATI and DPCA is established in an simple form, via the definition of the complex central Wishart distribution, deduces the statistics of the test metric, the probability distribution of the test metric for ATI and DPCA have the complex central Wishart distribution of 1times1 case, namely the chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>- distribution. The theory foundation offers the possibility to construct the united multi-channel SAR GMTI detector, and derive the constant false-alarm rate (CFAR) detector tests for separating moving targets from clutter.

articleTitle: An Event Aware Anycast Rooting Protocol in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Anycast is a mechanism that sends the data to the nearest node, which have the same anycast address. For those event-driven wireless sensor network application, anycast mechanism is effective. Event Aware Anycast (EAA) is proposed, which uses the complete or part data fusion according to the relativity of the data. The EAA algorithm preferably solve the construction of the routing in WSNs driven by events, decrease the spending of the route re-construction because of the moving of the Sensor nodes, and it remains the event location information during the data fusion. Compared with the traditional algorithm, EAA algorithm has been proved to be a better solution in the cost of energy and time.

articleTitle: Research on the Black-Scholes Stock Put Option Model Based on Dynamic Investment Strategy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the Black-Scholes option pricing theory , this paper considers the investors' behavior of keeping away risk and the Investment strategy of reducing the lost when building the put option model. The investors can reduce risk through selling stocks while the stock price droping .Using the case, it is shows that in order to keep away the same risk, the price of the option based on the investment strategy pricing model is lower than the put option based on the standard Black-Scholes put option pricing model.

articleTitle: Innovative Capabilities in the Process of Knowledge Sharing to Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To explore the relationships among knowledge sharing, innovative capabilities and firm performance, Chinese enterprises participated in this investigation. We found that knowledge sharing influenced innovative capabilities while innovative capabilities influenced firm performance positively, but knowledge sharing didn't have a direct influence on firm performance. As anticipated, the intervening effect of innovative capabilities between knowledge sharing and firm performance was significant. Implications, limitations and future research directions for the study are discussed.

articleTitle: The Perceived Attributes of Wi-Fi Technology Among University Faculty Members in the United States
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The purpose of this qualitative study is to investigate and understand the perceived attributes of Wi-Fi technology among university faculty members. Rogers' diffusion theory provides the theoretical framework to guide the qualitative study. Multiple sources of information were used to collect data: in-depth semi-structured interviews, observations, and documentation analysis. Qualitative data analysis techniques were used to analyze data. The participants were 16 faculty members from six colleges at a large Midwestern state university. Findings from this study show that that there are differences between early adopters and non-adopters (the mainstream). They are different in these aspects: knowledge and skill of technology, teaching practices, teaching philosophy, and technology needs. They have different perceptions toward the Wi-Fi technology and they are at different diffusion stages. Therefore, these differences lead to a diffusion "gap" between early adopters and the mainstream. This diffusion gap implies that a different support infrastructure is needed for mainstream faculty to integrate technology for teaching and learning.

articleTitle: A Study of Growth Evaluation System for SMEs Considering Credit Risk
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is helpful to set an efficient growth evaluation system of SMEs for their development in the future, and there are some existing researches trying to set a growth evaluation system of SMEs from several different aspects. This paper intends to add a factor of credit risk to the existing mature evaluation system, and then through an empirical research on Chinese listed SMEs we find that the new evaluation system is more reliable and efficient than the existing ones.

articleTitle: Chinese Employee's Turnover Intentions in Relation to Organizational Identification, Work Values, Job Satisfactions in Service Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study investigated relationships between Chinese employee's turnover intentions and organizational identification (OI), work values and job satisfactions in a sample of 330 from 25 firms in service industry. All of subjects are distributed from service industries. The service firms include professional service firms and traditional service firms. The study aims to discuss mediating effect of job satisfaction, and moderating effect of work values between job satisfaction and turnover intentions. The result shows that OI (beta=-.27***, P<.001), job satisfactions (beta=-.47***, P<.001) are robust predictors of turnover intentions; Job satisfaction completely mediated relationship between OI and turnover intentions. Work values include payment value, social status value, intrinsic value and promotion value. Social status value positively moderates relationship between job satisfaction and turnover intentions (beta=.26***, P<.001).

articleTitle: The Use of Knowledge Value Added to Weigh the Performance of Information Technology Outsourcing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to obtain the advantageous position in the environment with keen competition, information technology outsourcing is one of the models that the enterprises usually adopt; generally, the enterprises also believe that information technology outsourcing is the best method to save the cost and lower the overall expenditure. In the previous studies, there are not many related literatures or studies that would confer each of the procedures after information technology outsourcing, and whether there is any change on its knowledge amount and rate of return. Therefore, this study uses knowledge value added (KVA), which is addressed by Housel & Bell, to quantify the knowledge that is contained in each procedure before and after information technology outsourcing, and then the differences are being compared in order to regard as the performance assessment of information technology outsourcing. The learning time and procedure description of KVA are used for the estimation of knowledge amount within the procedures, where in-depth interviews are carried out with three listed companies and their public financial statements are used to assist with the cost analysis, so as to obtain every department's KVA value, and return of knowledge (ROK) can then be obtained. The result of the study found that besides cost saving and lowering of the overall expenditure, the information technology outsourcing can gradually raise the knowledge amount and rate of return that are included in each procedure year by year with regard to the enterprises.

articleTitle: An AHP Model on Appraising Electricity Material Bidders
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In China, it is known that as a subordinate of state owned electricity power company, a typical electricity material company provides almost all kinds of electricity material to the construction and maintenance of nation wide or local electricity power grid, and its fund for procurement of electricity material must be subjected to governmental fiscal budget. Therefore it is highly necessary for an electricity material company to select the supplier cautiously before it signs a procurement contract with one of bidders. In this paper, the authors conduct a research in optimizing the method of selecting the best candidate in a bidding process, namely, how to establish a perfect mechanism to make reasonable or proper appraisal for the bidders. AHP theory is considered to set up a scientific model in doing this. At first, the AHP theory and its newest research fruits are reviewed; secondly, the fundamental framework of appraising bidders is brought up based on the example of a local Electricity Material Company in Hubei Province, China. At last the discussion and conclusions about this study are put forward.

articleTitle: The Influence of Smart Phone's Mobility on Bluetooth Worm Propagation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we analyze the influence of the smart phone's mobility on virus spreading for two states: inter-cluster and intra-cluster. Considering the characteristics of mobile network with Bluetooth communication, we build a SIS epidemic model that characterizes the propagation dynamics of Bluetooth worms. Through the analysis of this model, we study the influence of phone moving velocity on virus spreading further.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of QR+Tree Index Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a solution of QR+Tree spatial index structure and algorithms is proposed. Our aim is to meet the requirements of large-scale GIS database application and overcome the insufficiency of existing spatial index technology. Compared to other spatial index, this solution is more efficient. In this paper, we analyze about the performances of QR+Tree in insertion, deletion, and especially searching, and the experiments show that this hybrid index solves the efficiency problem of the traditional space index availably.

articleTitle: Adaptive Dual-Cross-Diamond-Hexagon Search Algorithm for Fast Block Motion Estimation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Motion estimation (ME) is the cardinal technique of video coding standard, since it could significantly affect the output quality of a coding system. Based on the analyses of the limitation on the SAD matching and the allocation for encoding bits, this paper proposes the adaptive dual-cross-diamond-hexagon algorithm according to three main factors affecting the efficiency of ME, namely, the prediction of initial search center, matching criteria and searching strategy. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs faster than MVFAST and PMVFAST, whereas similar prediction quality is still maintained.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Two-Hop-Relay WCDMA Cellular Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article firstly introduces a new architecture of two-hop-relay WCDMA cellular system, and builds the analytical model of this system. Then based on this model, we get the average downlink transmission rate and the call blocking probability of packets of the system respectively. Finally, through numerical calculation, we analyze the impact of the various parameters on the performance of the two-hop-relay WCDMA cellular systems, and compare the system's performance with the traditional WCDMA cellular systems without relaying and the two-hop-relay WCDMA cellular systems with congestion control. Our results show that the two-hop-relay WCDMA cellular outperforms the traditional WCDMA cellular systems in terms of the average downlink transmission rate, but increases the call blocking probability of packets of the system simultaneously, and the two-hop-relay WCDMA cellular systems with congestion control can decrease the call blocking probability further, while preserve the improvement for the average downlink transmission rate.

articleTitle: Transformation Trends of the Organization Structures of Enterprises Based on Informatization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Informatization is an inevitable demand when an enterprise faces a new competitive environment. The transformation of the organization structure of an enterprise is an efficient approach that the enterprise makes fully use of information technology to enhance its competitiveness. In this paper, the trends that an enterprise is transforming its organization structure for adapting to the development of modern enterprises are described firstly. And then how information technology promotes the transformation of the organization structure of an enterprise is analyzed. Finally, it is proposed that the organization structure of an enterprise have to be transformed for conforming to the applications and development of information technologies.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of SNMP in ForCES Framework
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: ForCES (forwarding and control element separation) and associated protocols introduce a new architecture for construction of a distributed network element (e.g., distributed routers). ForCES makes requirements for the support of network management protocols like SNMP, while does not specify how the requirements are implemented. In this paper, design and implementation of SNMP-based network management in ForCES architecture are introduced. Several implementation modes of SNMP agent that are possible to be applied to ForCES architecture are proposed, and their individual features and the ability to meet ForCES requirements are analyzed. The modes include the monolithic agent mode, the proxy agent mode, and the AgentX mode. Moreover, a SNMP agent based on AgentX mode is implemented in a ForCES-based router. Experiments based on the implementation show that the AgentX agent satisfies all the ForCES network management requirements. It reaches a conclusion that the AgentX mode is the most feasible SNMP-based network management mode for ForCES architecture. Experiments also show the feasibility of ForCES MIB, which is under discussion in IETF ForCES work group. As a result, the implementation validates the feasibility for ForCES architecture to support SNMP, and helps the validation of related IETF ForCES protocols, hence contributes to the completion of the protocols.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Programming and Multi-Objectives Evaluation Model in the Supplier Relationship Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the fuzzy variation coefficients programming is discussed, and the multi-objectives evaluation method is put forward in the supplier relationship management, the major thoughts are: First choosing n different suppliers evaluation criterion to be a n-dimensions space, every suppliers information is a point in this space, then we can calculate the Euclid distance between these points and the best or worst point. Finally we sort the suppliers by the distance.

articleTitle: A Flexible Bit Allocation Algorithm Based on Adaptive Method for OFDM Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a new bit and power allocation scheme for OFDM systems with low computational complexity in which the overall transmission power is minimized by constraining the fixed data rate and bit error rate. The algorithm and simulation include two stages. The first stage involves the application of a target BER and SNR of each sub-carrier for a variable-rate bit pre-allocation. The second stage applies greedy and Campello approach to achieve constant channel rate of bit allocation. In a word, bit allocation with constant rate performs variable rate bit allocation first, and then modifies the overall bits to a constant. The simulation results demonstrate that the scheme has significant computational advantages over the conventional algorithms while providing optimal performance. It also provides considerable universality and flexibility for both the fixed rate voice data and variable rate multimedia data of the broadband wireless communication.

articleTitle: A Reliable Routing Protocol for Multi-Hop Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With improvements in communication, computer and embedded technology, ad hoc networks are becoming more popular for an ever increasing range of applications. Since 2002 there has been increased popularity of commercial applications based on ultra wideband. This has ignited interest in the use of this technology for ad hoc networks and research in the area. UWB technology has excellent characteristics such as wider band, higher speed rate, lower power spectrum density and stronger anti-jamming. The routing protocol based on UWB is designed and presented in order to increase the performance of wireless ad hoc network. It utilizes orientation of UWB and tries to get enough route information and guarantee reliable dissemination to all nodes in the network. Simulation results show that proposed protocol outperforms DSR and SPIN protocols.

articleTitle: Dynamic Information Integration of Virtual Enterprises Based on Web Services and J2EE
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on open XML standards, Web Services are service- oriented architecture that allows for creating an abstract definition of a service, providing a concrete implementation of a service, publishing and finding a service, service instance selection, and interoperable service use. In attempting to account for the integrated virtual enterprises solution based on Web Services, the author specifies the concept and the integrated demands of virtual enterprises. Next, the integrated concepts and theory of Web Services are illustrated, and the dynamic integration of virtual enterprises is further studied with the focus on a typical integrated example. Finally a summary is given of the advantages of Web Services-based integrated architecture.

articleTitle: Technology Innovation Stratagem and Role Played by MNCs: Evidence from Chinese Pharmaceutical Sector
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is widely regarded that the pharmaceutical sector is quite different from other manufactures for its character in innovation activities. This paper analyzed the nature of innovation activities by multinational companies (MNCs) which stand for foreign capital, focusing on two parameters named: size and scope of innovation through investigating patent data from 1985 to 2005. The paper reveals the role of the foreign capital and identifies their technology stratagem by developing a tool named Double-S Matrix. Research finding indicates that foreign capitals play an important role on overall national innovative competitiveness in this sector. Implications from this research can be used as reference to policy makers and business companies in China.

articleTitle: Mining Weighted Association Rules with Lucene Index
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Discovery of association rules has been found useful in many applications. With large database, the process of mining association rules is time consuming. The efficiency becomes crucial factor. Weighted association is more meaningful in some application. This paper implements a fast and stable algorithm to mining weighted association rules base on the open source library Lucene. The methods to create index in Lucene and utilization of the index to find weighted frequent itemsets are introduced. Based on apriori algorithm, a weighted association rule mining algorithm is implemented. All the rules can be recommended to customer by searching Lucene Index. Experiment shows that this method is more efficient than general apriori algorithm.

articleTitle: The Heterogeneity and "Learning by Working" Mode of Teachers in Universities
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: China's foundation of an innovation-oriented country needs numbers of innovation-oriented persons with abilities. Universities should take charge of fostering innovation-oriented persons with abilities. Moreover, the assignments above require making the teacher lecturer be an innovation-oriented teacher. This paper analyzes the form of the teacher lecturers' heterogeneity and categories the teacher lecturers as normal teacher, scientific research marketing teacher, scientific research accomplishing teacher and compound teacher. The paper discusses the cause of generation of heterogeneity, and analyzes heterogeneities caused by education and the "learning by working" mode. Finally, the paper puts forward the increment path of teacher lecturers: "learning by teaching" model, "learning by researching" model, "learning by team work" model.

articleTitle: An Effective-Traffic Based Dual-Threshold Queue Control Scheme in Shared Memory Switch
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper investigates the queue control or buffer management problem in shared memory switches. Traditional methods such as dynamic threshold and the newly proposed such as decay function threshold take decision largely based on the current total queue length. The dual threshold method proposed by this paper considers the traffic scenario as the main factor to decide a per-port threshold. Each port maintains a common traffic intensity, which is accounted for by the traffic rate and the allotted buffer. The traffic intensity takes shape from the classical effective bandwidth theory, yet the formula devised by the theory is too complex to implement. This paper reduces the formula to a simple form that is eligible in the runtime environment with little loss of accuracy. Keeping the common traffic intensity by dynamically adjust the per-port threshold can maintain the system equilibrium and reach a global optimality. Simulation shows the proposed scheme outperforms the tradition dynamic thresholds significantly.

articleTitle: A Low Delay Energy Equalizing Routing Scheme in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In many applications of wireless sensor networks, the sensed data must be gathered and transmitted to a comparatively remote base station periodically. Here we propose a low delay energy equalizing routing scheme (LDEERS), which ensures long network lifetime and gathers data quickly. LDEERS introduces a dynamic route selecting scheme based on weight-value and height-value to form a tree and a mechanism similar to token passing to elect the root of the tree in each round. Underpinned by these schemes, LDEERS can simply and fast organize all the nodes with low overhead and is robust enough to the topology changes. Compared with HEED and GSEN, simulation results show that LDEERS achieves its goals of consuming less energy, equalizing the energy consumption of all the nodes, balancing the energy and delay metrics, as well as extending the network lifetime perfectly.

articleTitle: An Alternative Agent Approach for Managing Materials Purchasing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The existing agent based inventory management approaches are heavily skewed toward just-in-time (JIT) purchasing. Specifically, a model for comparing the inventory costs of purchasing under the economic order quantity (EOQ) system and the JIT order purchasing system in existing literature concluded that JIT purchasing was virtually always the preferable inventory ordering system especially at high level of annual demand. This paper develops an EOQ-JIT cost indifference point function. The function shows that it is possible for the EOQ system to be more cost effective than the JIT system once the inventory demand approaches the EOQ-JIT cost indifference point. Based on the function, an alternative agent based inventory management system is developed. A case study demonstrates how the equation affects the purchasing approach of a material.

articleTitle: An Efficient Rekeying Approach for Secure Multicast Communication
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To provide communication confidentiality in multicasting applications, traffic data in secure multicast is encrypted with a session key known only by certificated group members. Whenever there is a change in the group membership, the session key must be updated dynamically. Previous work has been focused on individual rekeying, there are two problems with individual rekeying: inefficiency and an out of sync problem between keys and data. This paper devises a batch rekeying scheme based on iterated hash function which can improve efficiency of the key server,and analyzes the key server's processing cost for batch rekeying.The simulation results show that our batch scheme,which is based on iterated hash function, compared to individual rekeying, saves server cost efficiently.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Differential and Non-Differential Synchronous Downlink MC-CDMA Systems with Random Spreading
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The BER performances of differential and non- differential synchronous downlink multi-carrier code division multiple access (MC-CDMA) systems that employ random spreading are studied and compared using Standard Gaussian Approximation (SGA) in AWGN channel. Furthermore, Monte-Carlo simulations were carried out to compare the BER performances of these systems in AWGN and in frequency selective Rayleigh fading channels considering a various number of interferers in the system. Various modulation schemes were considered namely, BPSK, QPSK, OQPSK, DBPSK, and DQPSK modulation schemes.

articleTitle: Efficient Call Admission Control Algorithm for the Next Generation Mobile Communications Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to ensure that the interference-limited multimedia code division multiple access mobile communication systems operate stably and reliably, a novel fast adaptive call admission control (FACAC) algorithm for wide-band code division multiple access air interface is introduced. The proposed algorithm operates a threshold comparison, which integrates many factors that affect the decision accuracy of a call admission control such as system load, quality of service, channel quality, interference level and so on. The proposed FACAC algorithm cooperates subtly with a power control and data rate adjustment scheme making able fast, accurate, adaptive threshold, simple and feasible decision-making about incoming calls. Simulation results verify the correctness of theoretic derivations and show that the proposed FACAC algorithm outperforms previous call admission control schemes in terms of overall system dropping probability and service blocking properties, respectively. It is believed that FACAC is a requisite algorithm for the next generation mobile communications systems.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Choquet Integral Approach to Evaluate the Capability of Supplier
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a fuzzy Choquet integral approach which is used to evaluate the capability of supplier and then to deal with the supplier selection problem. Firstly, the basic of fuzzy measures and Choquet integral are introduced. Secondly, linguistic terms expressed in trapezoidal fuzzy numbers are used to assess the ratings for the suppliers' quality and the importance of criteria. Then, an evaluation model based on the fuzzy measure and Choquet integral theory is proposed, and we give the detailed procedure with an example. This paper shows that the proposed model is very well suited as an evaluation tool for supplier selection decisions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Assessment of IFAD Project Sustainability For Rural Poverty Reduction in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: GIS Evaluation on Groundwater Resources of Sanjiang Plain, China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By employing GIS data management and spatial analysis, established spatial database for groundwater and combined with dynamic balance method, accomplished 3D visualization of groundwater level, evaluated the spatial distribution of groundwater resources and the dynamic variation of groundwater level; The result shows that groundwater level continuously descended since 1997; the serious decadence of groundwater level is 5.8 m , and waned 6.89times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> to 2005. Relevant measures should be taken to mitigate the pressure in the region.

articleTitle: Macroblock Layer Rate Control in MPEG-2 to AVS-M Transcoder for Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The advanced audio video coding standard-mobile version (AVS-M) is established by AVS Working Group of China for mobile multimedia applications. To meet demands for communication between multimedia source and mobile system, transcoding from MPEG-2 to AVS-M is a key technology. In this paper, we propose a macroblock layer rate control algorithm for MPEG-2 to AVS-M transcoding with the consideration of the influence of new techniques adopted in AVS-M. Analyzing the relation between the mean absolute differences (MADs) of the transcoded and preceded frame, we establish a linear prediction model for MAD prediction when new techniques are used. Utilizing the macroblock layer bit allocation based on MAD, we establish a quadratic R-D model based on frame MAD. The experiment results show that the proposed algorithm based on two models can meet the target bitrate more accurately and achieve a better performance than the reference algorithm in AVS-M encoder.

articleTitle: Improved Channel Estimation Method Based on Time-Domain Processing for OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Channel impulse response (CIR) can be estimated by time-domain processing (TDP) based on cyclic correlation in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems. We propose an improved generalized TDP method to reduce the estimation error by taking the average of different CIR values which are derived according to the different starting points of cyclic correlation. Moreover, an effective channel length estimation method which is performed by reverse detection processing to search the last effective CIR is also proposed. The whole proposed method is more efficient to OFDM systems with long cyclic prefix (CP) because the CP information is sufficiently utilized during the CIR estimation. The analysis and the simulation results verify that the mean square error (MSE) performance of the proposed method is 4-5 dB better than the conventional method under the same conditions.

articleTitle: Clustering Algorithm Based on Sparse Feature Vector for Interval-Scaled Variables
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A two-step algorithm, clustering algorithm based on sparse feature vector for interval-scaled variables (CABOSFV_I), is proposed for high dimensional sparse data clustering in this paper. It decomposes a high dimensional problem into several low dimensional ones in first step and then gets the final clusters by second clustering. Because the irrelevant attributes are removed from each cluster in first step, it diminishes the dimensions effectively. Furthermore, the algorithm compresses data effectively by using 'Sparse Feature Vector'. Data scale is reduced enormously, but clustering quality is not affected. Because of the effective dimension deduction and data compression, the algorithm finds clusters in high dimensional large datasets effectively and efficiently.

articleTitle: Ship Security Assessment Based on Information Entropy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The ship sailing line is composed of five information processes in this paper. Conception of Safety Entropy of ship, which is based on the principle of information entropy, is also put forward, we can calculate the entropy of ship Safety, taking advantage of entropy weight to ensure the proportion of five information units and the factors of safety. So efficient assessment of the safety of ship can be made and testified by theory and example based on the model of discussion, which is a new exploration to estimate the safety of ships.

articleTitle: Stability-Guaranteed Clustering in Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to the nature of satellite networks, clustering for low earth orbit satellite networks is different from wireless ad hoc networks in which clustering is performed node by node. A stability-guaranteed clustering algorithm in satellite networks is proposed in this paper. Since two nodes with the furthest distance must be positioned in different clusters, a set of triplets consisting of the pair of nodes and the distance between them can be constructed, and clustering can be performed by searching for the pair of nodes with the furthest distance. Stability of the clusters is guaranteed by providing the redundant paths within and among clusters at an appropriate degree. The correctness of the algorithm is proved. Simulation results indicate it is efficient and convenient.

articleTitle: Optimal Number of Energy Efficient Cooperative Nodes Selection in Wireless Sensor Networks- In Ricean Fading Environment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an energy efficient selection of cooperative nodes with respect to their geographical location and the number of nodes participating in cooperative communications in wireless sensor networks. The cooperative communication in wireless sensor networks (WSN) gives us leverage to get the inherent advantages of its random node's locations and the direction of the data flow. Depending on the channel conditions and the transmission distances, the number of cooperative nodes is selected, that participate in an energy efficient transmission/reception. Simulation results show that increasing the cooperative receive diversity, decreases the energy consumption per bit in cooperative communications. It has also been shown that the network backbone capacity can be increased by controlled displacement of antennas at base station at the expense of energy per bit.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of MIMO Channel Capacity
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces the computing method of channel capacity in MIMO Wireless Channel. It mainly analyzes and compares the ergodic capacity of independent and identically distributed (iid) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) [1] Rayleigh flat fading channels when channel state information (CSI) is unknown and known to the transmitter but perfectly known at the receiver. Moreover, a computer simulation with Matlab is implemented. The simulation result indicate that the performance of channel capacity with the optimal power allocation outperform the average power allocation. And, it also shows that the capacity is asymptotically linear in the logarithm of SNR and the minimum of the number of transmit and receive antennas with the growth of SNR.

articleTitle: Assurance Evaluation for Test of Communication-Based Train Control System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes an autonomous train control system based on inter-train communication. In this new system, there is no logical central device and trains can communicate with each other autonomously. The train itself produces the position and calculates the permitted track speed. Therefore, the distance between trains can be shortened and a smooth brake pattern can be obtained. For building this system without hindering the current system operations, the gateway-based replacement technology and its test methods are explained. The assurance of test methods has been evaluated by comparing the on-line/off-line properties of the proposed technology.

articleTitle: Applying an Improved BP Network to Risk Assessment of Performance for Expressway Management Corporations
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the process of operating an expressway project for a management corporation, there are a large number of uncertainty factors influencing the management performance. Based on the detailed analysis of the internal and external factors and the influencing route, an index system of risk assessment of performance was built for expressway management corporations. The numerical value of various risky factors can be confirmed by utilizing fuzzy integrative assessment. Furthermore, a neural network model was designed and its algorithm was improved to be suitable to multi-dimension inputs in this study. The evaluation system based on the model can comprehensively and effectively assess the probability of management risk, and then an anticipated risk-alarm system was developed. As an example, the model was used to assess the risks of performance for expressway management corporations, and the evaluation was comparatively objective. The model can effectively avoid the subjectivity of confirming the risky factors' weight. A new method, which can effectively solve the problem about the integrative assessment of management risks, was proposed for the managers and superintendents of expressway management corporations.

articleTitle: Enterprise Knowledge, Organizational Learning and Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
