abstract: This paper probes into the relationship among knowledge, learning and innovation at the level of enterprise and it holds that the organizational learning is the precondition for the knowledge accumulation of the enterprise, the most important process of innovation as well as the best approach to cultivation of the core capability. There exists learning curve and Bayes learning effect in the process of innovation of enterprise, many different learning styles interact and inter-infiltrate with each other. This paper analyzes two different enterprise learning-innovation modes and points out that the enterprise should effectively integrate and utilize these two modes so as to improve the innovation performance.

articleTitle: Empirical Study on Innovation Competence Based on Tacit Knowledge
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Many researchers approve the influence of tacit knowledge on innovation and performance. But these researchers' studying on tacit knowledge rarely involve influencing interior factors, and treat it as black box. However, these factors directly restrict the effect of organizational innovating, and impact on their performance. Therefore, the cause of innovation capability was unveiled by studying on these factors. We propose that tacit knowledge serve improving organizational innovation capability and performance by reviewing study on knowledge management and innovation. We must research the relationship of tacit knowledge and performance if we desire to improve organizational innovation capability. So we employ knowledge fermenting model of organizational learning as a mean of analyzing innovation capability. Knowledge fermenting model is composed of knowledge bacterial strain, knowledge body, knowledge enzyme, knowledge environment, knowledge tools, and knowledge fermenting bar. They are divided into disparate indexes. According to these indexes, we investigated 51 companies by which we research the relationship of tacit knowledge and innovation. We applied SPSS to data analysis and researching on the relativity of these indexes and innovation capability. On the basis of our investigating, we find that the companies which are in high level of innovation have better effect of tacit knowledge, and low level ones are worse. We conclude that there is the positive correlation between tacit knowledge and innovation capability.

articleTitle: Using Document Weight Combining Method for Enterprise Expert Mining
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Locating people with specific expertise on a given topic is crucial for the success of projects in enterprise. Rather than using the common method which needs to generate expert profiles, in this paper we present an alternative method, document weight combing, for the expert mining task. This method is much easier to implement and more flexible for the dynamic data sets than the common method. Our experiment and evaluation on the effectiveness of our method by using W3C corpus show that this method is practical and promising.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of 2-D-RAKE Receivers with Imperfect Channel Estimation in Nakagami Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the closed-form expressions of signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) and the bit error rate (BER) are derived for a maximal ratio combining (MRC) two-dimensional (2-D)-RAKE receiver with imperfect channel estimation in frequency-selective Nakagami fading channels. The impact of Doppler frequency shift, the low pass filters (LPF) and the spatial-temporal diversity on the channel estimation and the performance of the receiver has been analyzed. Theoretical analysis and computer simulation results indicate that the performance degradation of 2-D-RAKE receivers due to imperfect channel estimation can be improved by using appropriate LPF taps and increasing the antenna numbers.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Approach of Link Adaptation in IEEE 802.16 Broadband Wireless Access Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: IEEE 802.16 Broadband Wireless Access system (BWA) is a promising emerging technology. In the IEEE 802.16 standard, multiple data transmission rates are defined by employing different modulation and channel coding schemes. How to select a proper mode affects the system performance significantly. In this paper, an efficient link adaptation scheme with QoS support is proposed. The proposed scheme takes both QoS demand and channel condition into consideration to determine a proper transmission mode. The QoS demand of a connection is represented as an expected packet error rate (PER). Based on this expected PER, the BS calculates the required signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) threshold of each mode. By comparing the measured SNR and all modes' SNR thresholds, the BS then suggests the SS a proper transmission mode. We evaluate the proposed scheme by simulations. The simulation results show that the link adaptation scheme improves the average system throughput and guarantees each connection's QoS demand.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis of E-Commerce Trust Seal Promoting Website Sale
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One of the important functions of e-commerce trust seal is promoting Web site sale. This paper mainly discuss the meaning and economy function of e-commerce trust seal and analyze the typical effect mechanism of e-commerce trust seal promoting website sale. We think that the trust of e-commerce website can be promoted by exposing trust seal in the website and attract the consumer forward in order to implement the business and extend the business size online.

articleTitle: A New Method for Generator Polynomial Estimation of Period (ql-1)/n LFSR Sequence
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A finite field discrete Fourier transform is used for studying the properties of linear feedback shift register (LFSR) sequence with period (ql-1)/n, and the relation of sequence's linear complexity and the nonzero-points in frequency-domain is given in this paper. Then a new algorithm is introduced to estimate the generator polynomial and initial state of m-sequence and gold-sequence. Based on the principle of FFT, a fast algorithm is also explored.

articleTitle: Analysis on Spatial Correlation Related with Antenna Array of MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the spatial correlation analysis was based on a circular antenna arrays. The antenna was placed on the circle equably. So, the distance between antenna elements was considered in the analysis. At the same time, the formula of spatial correlation at the receiver was educed, which was aimed at circular antenna arrays. The correlation between antenna elements changed due to the changed antenna distance, the angle spread and the average angle of arrival direction of the signal. The antenna correlation changed with the angle spread changed. At this paper, the equality distributing of angle spread was considered. Each parameter that influenced spatial correlation was analyzed, the simulation figure demo the results derived by the formula. It was important to the analysis of the MIMO systems estimation and design.

articleTitle: An Empirical Examination of Competitive Advantage and Corporate Social Responsibility: A Chinese Banking Industry Investigation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By using companies listed in both Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2005, this study investigates the relationship between competitive advantage and corporate social responsibility (CSR) of Chinese banking industry. The contribution of this paper is the development of an empirical model with employing eight criteria as the competitive advantage measurements of commercial banks and content analysis method to assess CSR. Results from the panel analysis of this study present the initial findings that the competitive advantage of companies in Chinese banking industry is positively related to CSR. This study also finds that the competitive advantage of companies is negatively but not very strongly relative to loan losses.

articleTitle: Study on the Evolution from Industrial Clusters to Innovative Clusters
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the evolution from industrial clusters to innovative clusters under OECD paradigm. This is done by, first, reviewing the literature in this field, trying to summarize it in a few major themes. Second, by studying the regional industry development, we find that innovation occurs both in traditional and new industries .Finally, a series of propositions are developed as follows: there are elements of innovation in traditional industrial clusters ; traditional industrial clusters could evolve into innovative clusters under proper conditions. Then we attempt to make a detailed analysis of the internal mechanism, driver and mode of the evolution, and build a complex network model for this evolution based on the complex network theory, which then provides further explanation on the room of government role in the evolution, and the meaning of the policy to promote this evolution.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Optimizing Skype Peer-to-Peer System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With conspicuous properties such as NAT traversal and better voice quality, Skype is explosively developed. Despite of the great popularity, little is known about the traffic characteristics and network architecture of Skype peer-to-peer system attributed to proprietary protocol. We devote to shed light on Skype by parsing the protocol on basis of corresponding experiments and locate the most crucial problems of Skype system: the searching delay and end-to-end delay. In order to improve the system performance, we firstly present novel algorithm for ONs to join super node with awareness of the underlying geographical distance and relationship proximity. Secondly, we build routing-efficient SN overlay network based on small-world model by selecting the short and long links dependent on distance measured by location and relationship proximity. From mathematical analysis, the proposal is proved to be preferable and the searching delay in SN network can be decreased by tuning the number of long distance links.

articleTitle: Lead-Time-Contingent Pricing Under Time and Price Sensitive Demand in Electronic Markets
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to determine delivery time pricing in electronic market to increase demand and benefit is very important for the network marketing firms. This paper develops a model of lead-time-contingent pricing, in which to maximize profits is considered as the firm's objective and to achieve the required level of service is considered as major constraints. Through numerical examples, we examine the optimal pricing strategies for network marketing firms when the consumers are price sensitive or time sensitive.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Joint Replenishment Problem for Slow Moving Spare Parts in a Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In most circumstances, the stock-out cost of spare parts can't be confirmed exactly because of the special characters of continuous production. Service level constrained (s, c, S) inventory model with continue review policy for joint replenishment is analyzed in a nuclear power plant. Comparing with (s, S) policy, its advantage is tested through practical case. At the same time, sensitivity analysis is accomplished and the corresponding means for inventory optimality are put forward for this kind of spare part. The proposed model is successful in decreasing inventories holding costs significantly by modifying the unreasonable purchase applications while maintaining the predefined service level.

articleTitle: Evolvement of Malmquist Index Study: The Case of Chinese Iron and Steel Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Many methods can be used to measure the efficiency of companies, among which DEA-based Malmquist productivity index is the one that can measure the productivity change over different periods. This paper not only presents a new interpretation along with the managerial implication of each Malmquist component and identifies the strategy shifts of individual DMU based upon isoquant changes, but also further generalizes the known study. Traditional study mostly focus on the conditions that one decision making unit lies on the productivity frontier; omitting the case several units are efficient. The present study advances the known method, and evaluates the cases several units lie on the productivity frontier. Furthermore, this paper studies productivity growth, efficiency change, and technical progress of a sample of 23 iron and steel enterprises which are all listed companies and included in top 500 corporations of China after 2000. The results indicate that different iron and steel corporations, although in different magnitudes, have recorded significant productivity gains driven mostly by scale efficiency increases rather than technical progress. Efficiency increases, however, were mostly owing to improved scales rather than improved resource management practices.

articleTitle: Cost-Reducing Innovation Collaboration in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In a supply chain environment, one supply chain member may invest in its upstream partner to develop innovations for cost reduction. However, in order to sustain such innovation collaboration, all the firms in this chain should be able to profit from the collaboration. This paper considers a particular collaboration in which the buyer invests in its supplier's innovation works that can eventually lead to reduction of the production cost of the supplier. In this paper, we have established a cost-reducing innovation model and analyzed it in a game theory setting. We find that although the collaboration may improve the supply chain's profitability as a whole, it might not be successful due to the prisoner's dilemma when the market demand stays constant. However, when the cost reduction will ultimately increase the market demand, such innovation collaboration may benefit both in certain ways. Numerical examples are employed to illustrate the situation.

articleTitle: An Application of System Identification Method on a Regional Economic System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to realize fuzzy control in regional economy. This paper presents a new idea of system identification based on fuzzy evaluation. It applies with parametric estaimation to analyze data of the input and the output in the unlinear system, then selects a regional economic system model from lots of unlinear models by means of system identification method. The result is that ARX117 model is the best one and the IV Estimation Method is suggested to be used. Since this ARX model can reflect the complex feature of regional economic system by integration of experts' knowledge. We can design the most reasonable fuzzy controller for the regional system.

articleTitle: Notification Protocol of Sensing Information in Cognitive Radio System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, the cognitive radio (CR) has been receiving a great attention to overcome spectrum scarcity. Up to now, many authors have proposed CR core technologies such as protocols, spectrum sharing method and sensing techniques. In this paper, we focus on notification protocol to exchange sensing information in the network. Since every node in CR network should send its sensing results to the gathering center, it takes long time to complete the notification process. So, in this paper, we design new notification protocol to minimize the number of notifications. It operates dynamically in accordance with prior informed reporting data. We demonstrate its superiority by Monte Carlo simulation.

articleTitle: Applying Quality Design in Project Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Quality design is defined as the quantitative description of quality objective distribution using three dimensions: product, lifecycle, and finding methods. Applying this method in product development, the quality of product components can be controlled respectively during the initial phases of the project lifecycle so as to achieve high quality product after assembling within the project attributes constraints. Besides the definition, factors that affect the distribution, such as size, type, complexity, technology accepted, and human resource status are analyzed, distribution rules are given and application framework, IDDMC model, is introduced.

articleTitle: Spiritual Quotient Effects on Research Performance of Ph. D. Candidates: A Demonstration Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Spiritual quotient is emerging as a new concept of spiritual ability. It is obvious different with material ability. As a kind of brainwork, research needs more personal spiritual ability not material ability than physical work. This paper focuses on Ph. D candidates who play important role in university research work but without drawing much academic attention. In this research, we first construct the character dimensions of spiritual quotient and design the research performance evaluation system of Ph. D candidates. Then we try to explore the impact of spiritual quotient on research performance through case interviews and statistical analysis. In the end of this paper, we draw the conclusion: except spontaneity, other 11 dimensions of spiritual quotient all have positive relationship with research performance which includes task performance and contextual performance.

articleTitle: A Pre-Extension of TOPSIS for Belief Group Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper extends TOPSIS (technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution) by the approach of evidence combination to aggregating group preferences, in order to solve multiple attribute decision analysis (MADA) problems in the situation of belief group decision making (BGDM), where the attribute evaluation of each decision maker (DM) is represented by the bba (basic belief assignment), the applied foundation of Dempster-Shafer theory (DST). Corresponding to the approach, the extended TOPSIS model, named as the pre-extended model, is elaborated step by step, used to find the solution to BGDM. Furthermore, a numerical example clearly illustrates the procedure of pre-extended model for BGDM.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Analysis Framework of Customer Cluster Value of Dynamic B2C E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To calculate and evaluate the customer cluster value of dynamic B2C e-commerce, this paper analysis the relation of service consumption and customer cluster visit quantity based the customer behavior model graph, and the customer cluster value is researched based on the method, and a case study is introduced in the end.

articleTitle: A Spectrum Sharing Algorithm Based Asymmetric-Nash-Bargain-Solution in Cognitive Radios
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new scheme to distributed share spectrum employing MIMO-OFDMA-based Cognitive Radio is proposed. First an asymmetric-Nash-bargain-solution-based utility function is developed. And a new spectrum sharing algorithm based on sensing contribution weighted proportional fairness is implemented through multi-user optimal matching and two users bargaining. The experimental results show that the approach not only realizes efficient and fair sharing of the spectrum resources but also maximizes the potential of the spectrum sensing.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Intellectual Property Protection Mechanisms in Innovation Joint Venture
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Application of Mixed Multinomial Logit Models in Urban Traffic Split of Hefei City
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, logit models as well as mixed multinomial logit models(MMNL) were established to model traffic split. The properties of Johnson distribution bounded on both sides distribution was analyzed fisrt and it was found that Johnson distribution which are bounded on both sides can describe uniform preference factors better than normal and log- normal distribution. Based the residents' daily travel survey of Hefei city, a logit model and two distribution mixed logit model(MMNLl and MMNL2) with different restriction condition were established to model traffic mode split of a certain area, and the results indicats that MMNL2 is more fitable to explain the original data and more reasonable to describe uniform preference factors such as travel time. The sensitivity of the mixed logit model to transit travel time factor was also discussed in the paper, and the results shows that the implementation of bus priority policy make the passenger flow share of the bus get some increase which mainly comes from the bike users. Furthermore, mixed logit model is more reasonable to model traffic mode split due to its reasonable to describe uniform preference factors and no possession of IIA limitation.

articleTitle: 3D Digital Library Service System for Engineering Components
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although 3D engineering component models are becoming widely available due to the recent technological advancement and modeling tools, we lack engineering component models library service system where they can be searched and retrieved efficiently. This paper described the architecture and function modules of 3D engineering components library that enables users to navigate large sets of 3D engineering models. Critical service system issues such a representation of components, the similarity measure between two 3D models are addressed. We use feature vectors and parametric feature relation graph to abstract a large set of 3D models to a small set of representative models. The two-stage similarity assessment scheme that combines feature vectors and parametric feature relation graph graphs provides an indirect measure of similarity between 3D engineering models.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Regions Comparative Analysis: Development of KIBS and Inspiration
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Incentive Contract Design to Improve the Service Quality in Third Party Logistics: a Moral Hazard Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The problem of how a buyer (principal) incites her logistics supplier (agent) to improve the service quality is studied. Taking account of three pay mechanisms, i.e., the gain-sharing scheme, the penalty scheme and the fixed payment scheme, we applied the principal-agent theory to our analysis and developed a moral hazard model. The results reveal that the optimal contract includes only a fixed initial payment under symmetric information. But, it is the combination of the above three mechanisms under asymmetric information. Furthermore, if the gain-sharing is bigger, the fixed payment and the penalty are lower; otherwise, if the penalty is more severe, the fixed payment is more and the gain-sharing is lower. In addition, the agent's risk aversion is bigger, the principal pays more agency costs. Finally, our analysis shows the buyer losses partial profits under asymmetric information owing to the lack of information and trading efficiency reduces because of asymmetric information.

articleTitle: A Genetic Algorithm Approach for Security Authentication in the Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One of risky problems in ad-hoc environments is the unsafe nodes. The unsafe nodes could eavesdrop or juggle the packets, or even cause damage to the communication of the whole network. Normally, it is common to use key authentication to preclude unsafe nodes. However, key distribution method seems not practical in the ad-hoc environment. We propose a genetic algorithm approach to solve this problem. By applying the multi-objective optimization, we devise a mechanism to guarantee each node's authentication. Our experiment shows this mechanism provides a good capability in the ad-hoc environment.

articleTitle: Analysis of Bidding Collusion Problem Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Collusion problem is very severe in bidding activities in China. It does great harm to engineering quality, market mechanism construction and country benefit. It is the problem which has to be resolved in consummating the bidding mechanism in China. In this paper, We analyze this problem based on game theory. There are two kinds of collusion, collusion between tenderer and tenderee, and collusion among tenderers. We just analyze the latter. Firstly we make an once game analysis. And then a multiple games analysis is given. On the foundation of the analysis result, corresponding measures to reduce the collusion behaviors are proposed.

articleTitle: A Forewarning Study of China's Coal Energy Safety Based on Entropy Weight Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy safety is an important and strategic problem, which relates to the economic development and national defense. Carrying on the research of energy safety forewarning is the basic of energy safety. Aiming at the uncertainty characteristic: fuzzy and random. This paper quoted entropy of the uncertainty system state into the Markov chain, and brings the entropy Markov chain model forward. At last, it evaluates the unborn coal energy safety state in our country by this model.

articleTitle: Impact of Signaling Constraints on the MAC Level Performance of OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Frequency adaptive scheduling in OFDMA systems requires accurate channel state information at the transmitter. In this paper we investigate the performance degradation in the downlink of a WiMAX based OFDMA system under the assumption of signaling constraints in the uplink. The active mobile terminals are not allowed to transmit the channel state information of all available subchannels to the associated base station but only a subset which is defined by a maximum number of subchannels. The impact of this constraint on the system behavior is discussed with the help of simulative performance evaluations. These are mainly focused on the interaction between physical layer and medium access control and therefore provide specific insight into the characteristics of broadband OFDMA systems.

articleTitle: A High Accuracy Signal Conditioning Method and Sensor Calibration System for Wireless Sensor in Automotive Tire Pressure Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) is used to detect when one or more of the vehicle's tires is 25 percent or more below the manufacturer's recommended inflation pressure. A TPMS system consists of four wireless sensors, a high frequency (HF) antenna and a central receiver. In this paper, a high accuracy sensor incorporated with a sensor signal conditioning chip is presented. A new TPMS wireless signal conditioning method for automotive applications is developed. The signal conditioning method consists of a signal conditioning chip and a calibration algorithm. The calibration algorithm has been established by relating to measured voltage, temperature and pressure ADC reading at three different temperature ranges. Twenty-five relating coefficients are obtained from characterization test before sensor signal conditioning is applied to TPMS wireless sensor calibration. The test results show that the signal conditioning method provides higher accuracy performance for wireless sensor within a battery supply voltage range from 2.1 V to 3.6 V and a temperature range from -40degC to 125degC. The signal conditioning method also reduces the cost of wireless sensor. Moreover, a presented sensor calibration system helps to improve production efficiency and lower production costs.

articleTitle: Research on Design of the Logistic System of the Old Northeastern Industrial Base
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The promotion of the Old Northeastern industrial base needs logistic industry which has low cost, high efficiency, specialized and integration as support. But each links between the logistic systems of the entire Old Northeastern industrial base has weak linking, inefficient operation and has not formed into a unified market. So need a unified and efficient logistic system to satisfy with the need of the development of the Old Northeastern industrial base. This thesis aims to construct a better logistic system of the Old Northeastern industrial base, uses mainly the method of the systems analysis, and designs the aggregated frame of the logistic system of the Old Northeastern industrial base to offer decision-making support to government and enterprises and make service to the promotion and development of the Old Northeastern industrial base.

articleTitle: Reshaping Service Recovery System Based On Customer Satisfaction
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Under the framework of resource exchange theory, this article develops a model of customer satisfaction after service recovery. The model integrates different service failure attributes and service recovery methods to explain the forming process of customer satisfaction after service recovery. The survey was conducted at restaurant and hotel industry in China. We compare the different impact mechanisms of customer satisfaction after service recovery in the two industries. At last, we advance some solution and advices to reshape service recovery system according the characteristic of the two industries.

articleTitle: Study on the Popularizing Process of Freight Information Exchange Network Based on Evolutionary Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In today's information age, the perfect freight information market is a basis to promote the development of freight industry steadily and effectively. This paper reviews some advice on setting up information network and analyzes the existing circumstances of freight information market in China. It brings forward the idea and project to construct freight information exchange network (FIEN) with the participation of government. The popularizing process of FIEN is simulated with replicator dynamic equation of evolutionary game theory. It can be concluded that the distinct evolutionary results arise from different user charge of FIEN. That is to say, the charging standard would directly influence the popularizing effect of FIEN. In the beginning, the government should adopt subsidy policy in order to encourage information agencies to join in it. When the number of users amounts to a certain value determined by the evolutionary game, the government may permit the proprietor of FIEN to collect user charge and limit the charging standard within a given range. In the long run, the FIEN will be extended throughout the freight information market.

articleTitle: Research of Electricity Customer Satisfaction Evaluation Based on Service Blueprint
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Effective customer satisfaction investigation is a very important precondition for power supply enterprise to win in the market competition. It is the problems need to be solved for power supply enterprise how to use advanced and practiced method to evaluate electricity customer satisfaction and how to use the evaluation result to improve the service. This paper designed an electric customer satisfaction evaluation index system based on the service blueprint theory, which covered every process of the electric customer service. In order to avoid the problem of weight identity and consider the affection of information quality to weight, authors constructed a model of customer satisfaction comprehensive evaluation based on the entropy-weighting method. In the end authors performed a simulation to show the validity.

articleTitle: Limited Resources Project Management Research Based on Critical Paths
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The researches of project management almost focus on the critical paths. However, there are few researches on the limited resources based on the critical paths. This paper gets the processes of the limited resources distributions based on the critical paths and sets a proposal for distributions of the limited resources. It introduces a penalty function to solve the limited resources distribution of the uncritical paths as a quantitative method. There is an example to show the use of the method and relevant measures to make sure the Time or minimize the impact to the Time. This method can solve the problem of the limited resources distributions in small corporations, which has practical values.

articleTitle: The Research of Supply Chain Contract Under the Uncertainty of Demand Based on Inventory Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper mainly researched the coordinate problem about the supply chain contract under the uncertainty of demand based on inventory management, and discussed the necessary condition of achieving coordination of supply chain system under the uncertainty of demand and the specific impact that the corresponding contracts have brought. The paper constructed the profit model of vendors of supply chain contract under the uncertainty of demand, and used the reverse reasoning method of dynamic planning to study the profit model. The research findings indicated that the supply chain contract under the uncertainty of demand based on inventory management will help to achieve the Pareto optimization and can realize the best overall performance and the perfect coordination of the supply chain system under the uncertainty of demand.

articleTitle: The New Label Design for Hierarchical MPLS Network Based on Uni-Interface
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of hierarchical MPLS network. According to the existing network structure model, the paper gives concept of hierarchical MPLS network based on uni-interface. The paper simulates the routing and data switching of such network based on an instance and discusses three label switching technologies. The paper firstly discusses the uni-label technology based on hierarchical routing. Label stack technology is a tunnel technology to solve MPLS-acrossed problem, and the paper only proposes double layer label. The last way to solve hierarchical MPLS network is double label which is not stacked. Such technology is originated from the former two technologies. After discussing the three technologies, the paper gives comparison and analysis which cover the conclusion.

articleTitle: A New Weighted Nu-Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: v-Support vector machine(v-SVM) is one of the most widely used support vector machines for providing a way to control the classification precision of training. However, its different classification precision of the two training classes with different sizes and neglect of the important level of training samples prevent it from being applied to some applications in which the training classes' sizes are uneven and the importance of samples is different from each other. In this paper, a class and sample weighted v-SVM is proposed. It introduces class weights and sample weights into the error penalty part of the objective function. Theoretical analysis shows that class weights can be used to control the classification precision of each class, and sample weights can be used to increase the probability of correct classification of some samples.

articleTitle: The Study of Password Authentication System Based on Elliptic Curve Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at the security problems of the password authentication systems in existence, this paper studies the elliptic curve cryptosystem basic principle, and then proposes a new password authentication scheme based on the elliptic curve cryptosystem. The particular implementation of this scheme is presented. And the security is analyzed finally. In this scheme, user's passwords are difficult to be explained in the process of storage and transmission. Authentication information keep dynamic, so replay attack can be prevented effectively. In addition, veritable users can detect the illegal uses who misappropriate the passwords, so information divulges or resources embezzlement can be refrained. This scheme is secure, effective ,easy to implement and hopeful for application.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Link Adaptation Strategy for IEEE 802.11 Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The multi-rate capability provided by the IEEE 802.11 physical layer requires that the MAC layer adapts the transmission rate according to the receiver-side channel conditions. Many link adaptation schemes for a multi-hop wireless ad hoc network have been proposed so far where most of them probe the receiver's channel condition using RTS/CTS handshake and select the highest attainable data rate at which the receiver can decode successfully. A key problem with such schemes is that they do not consider the interference from hidden nodes in multi-hop and multi-rate environments, and hence, they may not work properly since the higher rate also increases the probability of interference. In this paper, we investigate the relation between interference and transmission rates and show that a transmitter can achieve higher performance by transmitting at the decreased rate in multi-hop ad hoc networks. Based on the observation, we present a new effective link adaptation scheme that integrates the receiver-based and sender- based techniques and determines the best transmission strategy taking the interference as well as the receiver's channel quality into consideration.

articleTitle: The Development and Strategic Implementation of Information Systems in Small-Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the global competitive business market, the adoption of Information Systems (IS) is one of the key factors affecting the behavior of conducting business in small-sized enterprises (SSEs). If a well-planned IS is developed, it definitely enables a corporation to share information resources effectively and efficiently. The purpose of this paper is to present a literature review on the development of IS and how IS is used strategically in SSEs. It also examines the evolution of IS architecture, and the current trend of IS in SSEs. At the end, we adopt an IS model to discuss how it is used strategically to support strategic decision-makers, and help SSEs differentiate themselves from competitors in the competitive market.

articleTitle: Empirical Research Based on TAM in Acceptance of Mobile Homecare Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the factors of Canadian homecare professionals' acceptance of mobile homecare systems (MHS) was investigated according to Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and Task-technology Fit (TTF). Firstly, a hypothetical model which was derived from the integration of TAM, TTF, Social Norm (SN) and Proficiency (P) was proposed for the homecare professionals' acceptance of MHS based on literatures about user acceptance of information technology (UAIT).Secondly, a questionnaire was designed for examination of proposed model according to previous related researches. Moreover, the reliability and validity of questionnaire were verified by collected data, and the hypothetical model was tested and coefficients among latent variables were estimated using linear structural equation. At last, discussion and explanation about the result was put forward.

articleTitle: A New Carrier Frequency Offset Estimation Method for OFDM Based on Time Oversampling
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Whether the advantages of OFDM can be made full use of depends to a large extent on the performance of synchronization. After analyzing the received OFDM signal, this paper proposes a new frequency offset estimation method based on time oversampling for OFDM (orthogonal frequency division multiplexing). The proposed method is a blind estimation algorithm and also uses a slip window. From the results, it is shown that the accuracy of the proposed algorithm, as well as the resistance to frequency selective fading and noise, is much better than that of the algorithm based on cyclic prefix.

articleTitle: Contract Design in Mortgage Loans under Asymmetric Information: The Analysis When Firms are Short of Mortgage Assets
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By focusing on how the contracts are influenced by the client firms' mortgage assets, the paper develops a principal-agent model to analyze the contracts of mortgage loans under moral hazard framework, and then characterizes the optimal contract. The results show that there exists credit rationing under moral hazard as well as adverse selection. Furthermore, there exists a threshold value of mortgage assets under asymmetric information: when firms' mortgage assets are more than this threshold value, the loans are constant; however, when firms' mortgage assets are lower than this threshold value, the loans have positive correlation with the mortgage assets. It gives an explanation why the small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) often face the credit rationing.

articleTitle: Study on the Building of the Information Platform Aimed at Upgrading Human Resource Ability in Institutes of National Defense Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to upgrade the human resource ability in institutes of national defense industry has been an involved problem for a long time. In this paper, the propose of building personnel training 'product line' is brought out. Through building a set of information platform of human resource aimed at ability upgrading, which is adapt to the characters of national defense industry, the effect and the efficiency of the personnel training are improved greatly.

articleTitle: Operational Model of the Reconfiguration of Corporate Technology Strategy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper reviews the correlative theories of technology strategy, puts forward a proposition of technology strategy reconfiguration, constructs a model of firm's technology strategy reconfiguration, analyzes its basic types, operational mechanism of reconfiguration, and finds a decision support system which be used to make use of some mathematical methods to identify and inspect strategic reconfiguration. Moreover, the model that reflects strategic performing process can help many companies to reconfigure their technological strategy. According to the empirical study on 30 large Chinese corporations in manufacture industry, this paper also presents analysis of descriptive statistics and pairwise correlations for some variables that be used to inspect reconfiguration of technology strategy. So the research provides a feasible road to advance corporate Indigenous Innovation in China.

articleTitle: Rejection of Frequency Sweeping Interference in DSSS Systems Using Improved Polar Exciser Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An improvedCoefficient of Variation (CV) criterion suppression scheme against frequency sweeping interference named improved Polar Exciser (IMPE) is proposed in DSSS communication systems. The IMPE introduces Coefficient of Variation (CV) criterion to select the PE suppressor or matched filter (MF) correlator. In contrast to original PE, IMPE overcomes the disadvantage of the performance degradation when the power of interference is low. The BER performance has been simulated in suppressing a broadband constant envelope frequency sweeping interference with arbitrary power using proposed IMPE algorithm. Simulation results show the CV is a good metric for selecting PE or MF and the proposed IMPE algorithm is capable of overcoming the threshold effect of original PE.

articleTitle: Convergence and Stability of Conflict in Corporate Top Management Team
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on the analysis of convergence and stability of conflict problems in corporate top management team. Based on a matrix of payoffs, we establish the replicator dynamics equations of two player asymmetric evolutionary games under the bounded rationality, and present the evolutionary stable strategies in conflict games. Afterwards, we assume a kind of conflict choice and regulation matrix, study the player's dissymmetric behavior of the replicator dynamics, and examine the evolutionary phase diagrams and stabile states of conflict games under the regulation in company. Finally, we come to some useful conclusions.

articleTitle: Simplified Receiver Design for WLAN Systems with Packet Binary Convolutional Coding (PBCC) Transmission
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For WLAN systems that adopt PBCC modulation, the receiver is composed of two parts: the pre-filter and the reduced- state equalizer. Whitened matched filter (WMF) is usually designed as the pre-filter, but the calculation of the coefficients is complex. In order to reduce the computation burden of the pre- filtering process, a new pre-filter design method is proposed, which uses the zero-forcing rule to calculate the pre-filter coefficients. M-algorithm is adopted to finish the following equalization, which only chooses M best nodes among all the possible states. Computer simulation results indicate that when such receiver design is adopted, the complexity of the receiver is decreased greatly, while the receiver performance is comparative with the traditional design method.

articleTitle: A Multilink Parallel Video Transmission Algorithm Based on Narrowband Wireless Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An adaptive multilink selection mechanism for motion picture based on transmission quality of wireless channel is presented. The mechanism includes four components. One is the simple retransmission algorithm depending on video stream encoding which can improve the reliability of wireless channel. The second is the flow control technology based on packet loss ratio so as to increase the availability of wireless bandwidth during congestion preventing. The third is the video quality self- adjustment which can improve the real-time ability and continuity of video stream. The last one is a scheduling algorithm of wireless multilink which improves the transmission quality and the reliability. Some simulation experiments show that the mechanism can linearly increase the transmission rate of video stream, and enhance its stability.

articleTitle: Chaos Control of an Dynamic Output Game Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the assumption of limited rationality, the dynamic output game model between the two duopoly enterprises is established. There are four fixed points in this model. But three fixed points are unstable and the stability of the other fixed point is related to the marginal cost and output adjustment speed of the two duopoly enterprises. The analytic condition of local stability has been gained through the famous Jury condition. The numerical simulations show that the output adjustment speed has important effects on the local stability region. The bifurcation diagram of outputs versus output adjustment speed shows that the solutions of the model have chaotic behavior. To control chaos, the variable feedback controller is designed. The controller can not only suppress the chaotic state of the outputs, but also freely realize the switch of the outputs among 1-period, 2-period and 4-period through the adjustment of the feedback gain intensity.

articleTitle: Uniform Energy Consumption through Adaptive Rate Communications in Cooperative MIMO based Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We present an adaptive rate communication in conjunction with cooperative MIMO for uniform energy load distribution in wireless sensor networks (WSN). The inherent data flow structure of WSN causes uneven load distribution in the network. The transit nodes and the nodes near the base station (BS) carry more network traffic load than the other nodes in the network. We have analyzed the cooperative MIMO based WSN and found that transmission rate and constellation size can effectively control the energy consumption without violating the required bit error rate (BER). Simulation results show that cooperative MIMO in conjunction with adaptive transmission rate in multi hop communication renders a uniform network load in all hops.

articleTitle: Study on Knowledge Mining of the Business Intelligence System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper analyzes knowledge mining of the business intelligence system, it mainly studies in knowledge evaluation system of knowledge acquisition and give solutions of solving the data acquisition of redundancy problem and consistency problem. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of knowledge acquisition, it establishes a knowledge mining model based on Shannon information theory, combined with Bayesian estimation algorithm, it gives a specific calculate model, which gives real example deduction to the main part of the model.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Multicarrier LAS-CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multicarrier technology can be integrated into LAS-CDMA system. Based on the non-orthogonal multicarrier LAS-CDMA system, the orthogonal LAS-CDMA system is introduced in this paper. As different subcarriers get the diversity gain but not the multiplexing gain, the performance is good enough for high bit rate transmission. By suitably designing the spread spectrum codes, we can eliminate the intersymbol interference and multiple access interference because of the good correlation property of LAS codes. So that it is very useful in wireless or mobile communications.

articleTitle: A Pareto-Based Research on Optimum Freight Tariff Ratio between the Waterway and the Railway
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Assessing the optimal freight tariff relationship appropriately is significant for the revolution of freight tariff and the development of transportation. According the theory of welfare economy, based on maximization social welfare, the paper constructs an optimal ratio relationship model in waterway and railway and solves the optimal one by means of graphic. What's more, the paper makes several meaningful conclusions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Tentative Study on Venture Capital Investment in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Study on Influential Factors of Supply Chain Alliance Relationship of Chinese Corporations
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Alliance is regarded as the most advanced and best form of supply chain relationships. With regard to the studies on influential factors of supply chain relationship, the academic world mainly focuses on commitment, trust, communication and cooperation. In this paper, empirical research is used to study the factors, which influence the supply chain alliance relationship of Chinese firms, and their influential levels, especially personal relationship and administrative factors.

articleTitle: Optimal Investment in Alternative Energy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An optimal control model is established for the alternative energy investment strategy with the objective function of cumulative net social welfare. The investment rate is constrained by an inequality. Cumulative alternative energy production has an impact on cost and world oil price through supply on oil market. The interdependency of cost and oil price on optimal investment rate makes the problem inherently dynamic and is fully investigated. In some special cases, the optimal solution can be derived, while in general it oscillates between zero and maximal allowed value.

articleTitle: Research on Load Balanced Algorithm for Grid based on Nash Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The management of resources and scheduling computations is a challenge problem in a campus grid. The article has given a new load-balanced-algorithm for grid. The algorithm decide the load which will transfer according to the Nash-equilibrium theory and the processing node's computing ability in the grid, in order to overcome the common algorithms which exit the fault of the heavy load of communicating and the message not in time when implement the algorithms.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis in Energy Consuming of Packets Collision Resolution Schemes Based on Virtual MIMO Techniques
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the traditional schemes, the collided packets will be discarded and retransmitted, which results in depression of performance and waste of energy. The packets collision resolution (PCR) schemes based on virtual-MIMO techniques could resolve collision by selecting cooperative nodes to form virtual parallel channels and hence can deal with the collisions easily. In this article, we analyze the performance in energy consuming of PCR schemes in terms of the first death time and energy cost in Rayleigh fading channel and put stress on impact of RCM on PCR schemes.

articleTitle: An Improved Entity Authentication Mechanism for HF Digital Communication
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Identity authentication is normally used in the control of safe accession to network in wireless systems, which is the base of security of the entire system. Identity authentication base on challenge/respond is widely utilized in traditional wireless systems, private-key cryptosystem is used in it, which has a complex procession of updating key and easy being attacked. Aim at this problem, corporate with traits of HF communication, this article brings forward to utilize on time password identity authentication base on RSA digital signature. Test result shows that the performances of this authentication protocol covered the security requirement of HF digital communication; it also greatly improves the security of HF network.

articleTitle: Research on Collaboration and Management in Grid Based CAD
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The importance of collaboration to typical grid computing applications is becoming widely recognized. This paper explores how to add collaborative capabilities to standalone CAD applications in grid computing environment. The method uses internal encapsulation and external encapsulation to wrapper legacy standalone CAD applications. The basic issues for collaborative applications, such as task management, data management and interface management are discussed. The proposed method is implemented with case study of prototype tools to integrate standalone CAD applications for collaborative applications.

articleTitle: Data Synchronization Infrastructure with Middleware
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Networked applications with non-HTTP protocol are not universally supported by CLDC/MIDP. Infrastructure deployed with middleware services these MIDlets via HTTP protocol, implements isomerous data consistency between mobile and Web database, and the security is achieved by basic and digest access authentication in HTTP authenticate response. Finally, a prototype is established verified the feasibility of framework, and the security is achieved concretely through base64 and md5.

articleTitle: Coordination and Optimization of Distribution System Under Correlated Uncertain Demand
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the coordination and optimization of a distribution system, consisting of one manufacturer and multiple retailers, is researched. Both the uncertainty and the correlation of the market demand are fully considered, according to the observation and analysis of an actual distribution system. Correlated random number is introduced into Monte Carlo method to simulate the correlated uncertain demand so as to offer the system more real sample data. A simple, effective approach is proposed to solve the model. The coordination mechanism is also given for cooperative pricing. The numerical experiment shows that the wholesale price and order quantities are optimized by our approach. In addition, the important parameters' influence on the wholesale price is also analyzed in the work.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity Channel Estimation Method for MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A method of channel estimation based on training sequences is proposed for MIMO-OFDM systems. Moreover, the criterion is derived by simplified means for optimum training sequences construction. Based on the criterion, two methods are proposed for construction of optimum training sequences. Computer simulations are conducted to evaluate the channel estimation and optimum training sequences construction methods for TU and HT delay profiles. Simulation results show that the proposed channel estimation method has the same estimation accuracy as the traditional methods. However, the computational complexity is reduced greatly. It is also shown that the optimum training sequences constructed by the Hadamard matrix enhance channel estimation with the estimation accuracy improvement by 2dB.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Influence of the Equity Structure on the Listed SMEs Growth
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The growth is an important indicator measuring the operation and prospect of listed enterprises. We study the influence of large shareholders on the growth of small-and-medium listed enterprises(listed SMEs) from the aspect of the equity structure based on a sample of 189 A-market listed SMEs. We establish an indicator system using main factor analysis to get a comprehensive growth score for evaluating the growth. Through regression analysis we study the influence of the largest equity ratio under the condition of different equity nature. Moreover, we study the influence of the equity balance on the growth under the condition of different equity nature and different control types through grouping analysis.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach for Developing E-Commerce System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The advance of Internet and Web technologies has boosted the development of electronic commerce. The paper proposes a framework that integrates various advanced information technologies for developing e-commerce system. It includes: (1) Intelligent agent, which is used to execute the particular task in the online-trading; (2) Multi-attribute decision method, which calculates the commodity optimality to evaluate the commodities; (3) Ontology, which is used to support sharable information format and representation for the agents to communicate with one another. (4) Web technology, which is used to provide agents integration and application design. We present a prototype using Java agent development framework (JADE). It shows the potential toward the future electronic market.

articleTitle: Research on Construction of the Enterprise's Core Competitiveness from the View of Complex Scientific Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Confronted with the "change or perish" dilemma, enterprises have realized that creative destruction should be carried out and the core competitiveness should be build and developed. From the perspective of complex scientific management, creative destruction is made on the basis of innovation about the business operating mode by constantly exploiting the core resources and then integrating them to construct the core competitiveness. In this paper, the theories of complex scientific management are briefly introduced. And from the perspective of innovation based on the resources' integration, the definition of management is reshaped and the five basic theories of complex scientific management are logically reconstructed. Then, from the perspective of complex scientific management, the content of the enterprise's core competitiveness is analyzed and its construction ideas are proposed in details in this article.

articleTitle: A Random Number Generator Based Software Channel Simulator for Land Mobile Satellite Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A two-state statistical channel model is proposed for predicting the propagation characteristics of land mobile satellite channel (LMSC) according to propagation scattering theory. The underlying channel model takes for granted non- frequency-selective fading but considers the effects caused by shadowing. For such a channel model, a software channel simulator is designed. The simulator is based on a random number generator (RNG) that generates data sets to compute fading statistics of the propagation channels. Compared with the filter method and the Rice method, the RNG method can be realized precisely in engineering. Furthermore, the operating frequency band of the simulator is not restricted to any particular frequency band, for the random numbers used in the simulator are independent of frequency. The validity of the simulator is confirmed by comparing fading statistics from the analytical model and the measured data.

articleTitle: Distributed Power Control Based on Average BER in MIMO-CDMA Systems: A Game Theoretic Approach
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We consider a distributed power control scheme based on average BER using game theoretic approach and prove the existence and uniqueness of the Nash Equilibrium for the proposed scheme. Then a synchronous distributed algorithm for this scheme is presented. The simulation results of the algorithm reveal that the proposed algorithm outperforms the average power distributed algorithm.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on the Relationship between IT Outsourcing R&D and Innovation Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With competition is more intensive than ever, more and more IT enterprises take outsourcing R&D to be engaged in the technological innovation activity. In the condition, the factors of IT outsourcing R&D is analyzed by using exploratory factor analytical method, the structural model between IT outsourcing R&D and innovation performance is set up in this paper. And using 102 enterprises' effective data prove the relevant relations. Finally, it points out future direction.

articleTitle: Designing a Reverse Logistics Network Considering Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the complexity and risk of the reverse logistics, the main objective of this paper is to propose a multistage methodology for designing a reverse logistics network from the risk management perspective. Firstly, we applied fuzzy DEA model to assess the candidate reverse logistics suppliers based on the risk management. Furthermore, we founded a mixed integer programming model by considering the risk measure of every reverse logistics supplier. Lastly, we designed a hybrid genetic algorithm to solve the mixed integer programming model to allocate the reverses logistics needs and select the optimal reverse logistics supplier combination. Moreover, we analyzed a numerical example to illustrate the feasibility of the methodology studied in this paper to consider the risk management. The research will improve the traditional location-allocation model to satisfy the risk environment, and develop the risk management theory in the reverse logistics fields.

articleTitle: High Dynamic Formation Target Detection and Parameter Estimation Using Wavelets
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The Doppler frequency difference and regularity among the formation targets are firstly analyzed, and then the basic principles of the Morlet wavelet transform and its time-frequency analysis are described. After that, how to precisely get the amount and the Doppler frequency of the targets using the results of the Morlet wavelet transform is discussed in detail. After comprehensively considering the engineering operation and valid simulation results, a conclusion is drawn that the wavelet transformation method is optimal not only to get high resolution performance, but also to implement the realtime signal processing for multi-objects in formation because of its characteristics of high resolution, quick calculation, small amounts of data to deal, and noise interference rejection. In the end, the computer simulation and the data tests are shown to validate its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Relationship Between Development of Chinese Non-State Owned Enterprises and Cultivation of Scientific and Technological Competence: An Empirical Study by Granger Causality Test
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the data from 1987 to 2003 released by the China Statistical Bureau, this paper analyzes the correlation between the two variables of development of Chinese non-state owned enterprises and cultivation of scientific and technological (S&T) competence by the soft of SPSS, and then according to the non-stationary characteristic of macroeconomic variables, stationary test is done by Eviews 3.0, and adjusts the two variables to be difference stationary. After that, the relationship between development of Chinese non-state owned enterprises and cultivation of S&T competence is analyzed by means of Granger causality test, the result indicates that there is bilateral Granger causality the two variables mentioned above.

articleTitle: Capacity Analysis of Optimal Chaotic Sequence Cyclic Code Phase Multiple Access
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cyclic code phase multiple access (CPMA) is the multiple access technique for VSAT satellite systems. In this paper, a new method of optimal chaotic sequences CPMA is proposed firstly, then a chaotic sequences CPMA system is presented. Finally the performance analysis for the chaotic sequences CPMA is given and the BER calculating is obtained. The theoretical analysis and the results of simulation show that the optimal chaotic sequences CPMA is better than the DS/CPMA in capacity of user.

articleTitle: Substitution Scheduling of Human Resources in Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Substitution scheduling of human resources is an important and factual problem in project management. The problem is presented as a mix integer programming model with the objective of minimizing total cost of project considering reward of early completion and delay penalty. A heuristics is developed to solve the model, in which the main framework is an enumeration procedure embedded a serial scheduling schema for solution of project scheduling problem with the same objective, and its time complexity is analyzed. The result of a computational example shows that the approach is feasible.

articleTitle: Reducing Traffic of Messages in Distributed Editing Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the embedded mobile devices greatly proliferating, the communications under ubiquitous environment are welcomed in terms of collaborative work. For the limited bandwidth of wireless network and the limited size of screen on palmtop computer, tailored communication and data exchanges between desktop and mobile sites was studied in our research. We proposed a grouping scheme together with sending on demand policy to reduce traffic of messages in distributed collaborative editing systems implemented by various types of devices. Consistency maintenance relevant to grouping was studied out with a linked history buffer. The scheme had been implemented in our prototype system that can work well in heterogeneous environments.

articleTitle: An Approach for Production Planning Optimization Under Correlated Uncertain Demand
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Production planning optimization is one of the most important issues for manufactures and scholars. Production is planned to meet the future demand. Under the uncertainty of demand, profit is maximized and opportunity loss is minimized. In real case, however, the demands of products are usually correlated. Hence, in this paper, a method is proposed for production planning optimization under the correlated and uncertainty demand. Correlated random numbers are introduced to Monte Carlo simulation to meet the real case. The production planning is multi-objective, thus genetic algorithm is employed. In order to search the optimal solutions effectively and efficiently, GENOCOP system is utilized to initialize population. The algorithm is tested on real data, and a wonderful performance is shown.

articleTitle: Multilevel Model of Factors Influencing Employee Turnover Intention: Professional and Technical Staff in China as an Exemplar
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although a great deal of employee turnover models have been well established, previous study on employee turnover has focused on either organization- or individual-level analysis; no framework exists for simultaneously examining individual variables and organizational characteristics. In an effort to fill this theoretical gap, the present investigation proposed a multilevel model which integrated factors at both individual- and organization-level, and then distinguished their different influencing mechanisms on employee turnover intention. Applying structural equation modeling (SEM) and hierarchical linear models (HLM) techniques, empirical examination was conducted. The results based on 959 employees' responses from 26 organizations in four industries, indicated that individual-level determinants were significantly associated with employee turnover intention mediated by job satisfaction and organizational commitment; in addition, organizational culture and climate as two organization-level factors moderated the relationship between individual-level variables and influenced employee turnover intention through the individual-level mediators. Finally, the implications for organizational research and managerial practice were discussed.

articleTitle: Application of Customer Resource Management in Agricultural Development Bank of China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As foreign banks' application get nod in China, better financial service from these banks gives local lenders unprecedented competitions and challenges. As a financial institution under the direct leadership of the State Council, the Agriculture Development bank of China (ADBC) has the responsibility of implementing the policies of the governments while running business management. Given the ever-increasing competition for every consumer dollar, attaching importance to the management of customer resource will be an essential part of today's financial business for ADBC and the implementation of the customer resource management based on data mining can be used to strictly separate policy from commercial business, strengthen internal control, prevent and control credit risks, reduce operating cost, offer efficient mechanism and obtain strong sustainability.

articleTitle: The Effect and Strategy of High-Priced Level Premium Brand Products Price Reduction: An Empirical Research to Auto Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the market level of high-priced products, firms that own premium brand, when they are trying to compete with other firms in the industry using price strategy, the implication of price strategy, if from the long run, is a positive or negative signal? This paper use testable empirical research method and systematically investigate the price reduction effect of premium brand. We find that using when premium brands using price strategy to compete with others, the effect is negative to the profitability of premium brands from the long run, as it reduces the profitability and premium ability of the brands that firms have built for a long time. That is, it is necessary for firms that own premium brands to deal with the competition from a totally new insight.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence on Intercepting Effectiveness of Fighter by the Radio Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the position line error and positioning error of short-range navigation positioning system have been analyzed. The relationship between positioning precision of the radio navigation system and detection probability of fighter for intercepting is established. The curve of relationship on the detection probability with the radio navigation system operating range and the explorative distance of airborne radar is set up for the first time. The influence on the intercepting effectiveness of fighter by the navigation system is presented. So it is of great value to tactic research and application of radio navigation system, and also provides a good idea for widening application area of the system.

articleTitle: E-Commerce for Revenue Management Based on Incentive Compatible Online Auctions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We formally embed a new-style of E-commerce into a dynamic framework that is typical of the revenue management problem. Full characterize classical results of incentive compatible online auctions.
