abstract: Propose a concurrent bottom up high level synthesis design flow based on fuzzy set theory to improvement the circuit performance. It treats unscheduled operations as having uncertain schedules, and then applies fuzzy set theory to quantify these uncertainties during allocation. At last synthesis circuit based on concurrent evolutionary technique. Experimental results are presented to demonstrate the strength of this approach.

articleTitle: Particle Filtering For Decoding Of MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we introduce particle filtering for detection of BLAST systems. We propose at first a procedure to build prior distributions. Then, we establish an equivalent whitening filter output system model which enables to apply sequential Monte Carlo sampling, or particle filtering for detection. The proposed algorithm achieves near optimum performance due to the fact that it greatly reduces error propagation. Compared to MMSE-VBLAST cancellation technique, simulation results show that our proposed particle filtering detector significantly improves the overall system performance.

articleTitle: Chaos Analysis on Series of Groundwater Depth in Sanjiang Plain, China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sanjiang Plain is the largest swamp area of freshwater and an important production base of commodity food grain in China. The groundwater resource plays an important role in the development of well-irrigation paddy. The groundwater system is a kind of complicated nonlinear system. Based on the power spectral analysis on groundwater depth series in Sanjiang Plain qualitatively, the several characteristic quantities, which are the Kolmogorove entropy, the correlative dimension and the Lyapunov index of groundwater depth series, have been calculated through reconstruction of state space. Results of the analysis and calculation show that there is an obvious chaos characteristic in groundwater depth series in Sanjiang plain. The results offer theoretical basis for building prediction model of groundwater depth in Sanjiang plain in the future.

articleTitle: A Timing Synchronization Scheme for SC-FDE System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The SC-FDE(single carrier-frequency domain equalizer) is a field that gathers more and more interest as a modulation scheme for the broadband wireless communications, for simple channel equalization ,SC-FDE systems perform equalization in frequency domain instead of time-domain using FFT, IFFT and CP (cyclic prefix) like it user for example in OFDM (orthogonal frequency division multiplexing). In this paper, A new timing algorithm is proposed that can estimate the timing offset using only one training frame. Compared with conventional methods, the proposed algorithm has much better precision and fewer computations. This algorithm is intrinsically robust to multi-path channel.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Temporal and Spatial Dynamics of the Relative Carrying Capacity of Resources in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on a great deal of statistic data, this paper studies relative carrying capacity of natural resources, economical resources, social resources and their changing processes in Beijing. The results indicate: the carrying capacity of economical resources in Beijing is in the status of margin, but the carrying capacity of natural resources is in the state of overloading; the relative integrative carrying capacity of resources in Beijing is slowly on the rising stage, but if the reference region is the whole nation, the integrative carrying capacity in Beijing is a little in the status of margin. Aiming at the above characteristics, this article suggests that with the development of economy in Beijing, we should develop resources reasonably and exploit them efficiently, upgrade carrying capacity of natural resources, and control the increase of population.

articleTitle: Correlation between Cognition and Performance of E-Government
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We construct and test a theoretical model to investigate relativity between the cognition and performance of e-government. The hypothesis was tested using survey data from governments that have implemented e-government. Result from canonical correlation analysis suggests that cognition is related strongly with performance of e-government. So we conclude that cognition is one of the most notable factors influencing e-government result.

articleTitle: Service Scheduling and Network Selection in Cellular and Broadcasting Cooperative Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of selecting the optimum network for multicast services in the overlapping coverage of mobile and broadcasting networks. This algorithm considers various factors that impact on the final decisions. It comprises two steps: firstly, an analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method is applied to schedule the service queue according to user preference and different service applications; secondly, network resources are allocated and the appropriate network is selected. Simulation results show that compared with the method of only single factor considered, this algorithm can optimize objectives better.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Throughput Analysis on Opportunistic Cophasing System with Single-Beam Transmission
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Different from the opportunistic beamforming system (OBS) that randomizes both amplitude and phase of its beamforming vector, the opportunistic cophasing system (OCS) randomizes the phase only, which significantly reduces the demands on the dynamic range of power amplifiers. Focusing on the multi-user case of the OCS system, we give an asymptotic analysis on the system throughput under Rayleigh fading channels, based on the theory of extreme order statistics. Numerical and simulation results are presented to compare the OCS with the OBS system in throughput.

articleTitle: A Novel Routing Algorithm for Network-on-Chip
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we suggest a novel routing algorithm for network-on-chip (NoC) based on multilevel congestion control (MLCC). MLCC improves the routing efficiency when NoC is in moderate or severe congestion level. MLCC decides how to do congestion control depending on the different congestion level of the routers. Our experimental results show that MLCC achieves significant better performance than other traditional routing algorithms under uniform and transpose traffic.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Entropy-Based Rough Set Approach for Extracting Decision Rules
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Rule extraction is an important theme in data mining. Fuzzy set theory (FST) and Rough set theory (RST) are two common technologies frequently applied to data mining tasks. Decision induction is one of common approaches for extracting rules in data mining. Integrating the advantages of FST and RST, this paper proposes a hybrid system to efficiently extract decision rules from a decision table. Through fuzzy sets, numeric attributes can be represented by fuzzy numbers, interval values as well as crisp values. Second, the paper proposes to utilize information gain for distinguishing importance among attributes. Then, by applying rough set approach, a decision table can be reduced by removing redundant attributes without any information loss. Finally, decision rules can be extracted from the equivalence classes. An experiment result is also presented to show the applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Innovation Oriented Selection for Shanghai Business Process Outsourcing Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Power Distribution Algorithm for Multi-User Downlink of JT System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For the downlink of MIMO TDD/CDMA mobile radio systems joint transmission (JT) which has low receiver complexity is recently proposed. First investigations concerned linear transmitter algorithms and nonlinear transmitter algorithms based on the principle of THP. The nonlinear transmitter algorithms studied by M. Meurer have preferable energy efficient but restricted by coding complexity. In this paper we present a power distribution algorithm in multi-user downlink of linear JT in MIMO system (JT MIMO). First, a model of JT MIMO downlink and interference is introduced, then, we present a joint power distribution algorithm for JT MIMO downlink. By distributing the transmission power of users rationally, under achieving the SINR, minimizes the total transmitted power.

articleTitle: Study on the Service Failure and Service Recovery in the Communication Service Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is important to retain customer satisfaction in communication services. When a service failure occurs, companies need to take service recovery action to recover their customer satisfaction. Although companies cannot avoid all problems and complaints, they should try to make up. Therefore, service failure and service recovery have become an important and challenging issue for companies. In this paper, we reviewed the literature and summarized the problem in the communication services. An integrated model of profit driven for the service failure and service recovery was established in view of the benefit of customer and enterprise. Moreover, we studied the interaction between service failure and service recovery strategy, the result of which verified the matching principles of the service recovery strategy and the type of service failure. In addition, we analyzed the relationship between the cost of service recovery and customer's cumulative value of service after recovery with the model. This result attributes to managers in deciding on appropriate resource allocations for recovery strategies.

articleTitle: Stochastic Cost-Volume-Value Model with Economic Demand and Cost Functions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper has set forth and developed a stochastic cost-volume-value (CVV) model with economic demand and cost functions. The model describes the relationship among cost, volume and value under uncertainty; and helps company managers conduct breakeven analysis in management decision-making and planning. Compared with the cost-volume-profit (CVP) model, the function of CVV model is EVA but not profits. Therefore, the model offset the limitation of the conventional CVP model which does not take the capital costs into consideration, and is more suitable for managers to make decisions in value creation. In reality, product prices and unit costs are related with volume. The model herein incorporates a linear demand function and a quadratic cost function. According to the stochastic CVV model, l.Explicit solution is found for the quantity which maximizes expected EVA. 2. The probability expression of expected EVA is found. 3. A specific expression which can be used for determining fixed cost is found, and then managers can choose activities which really create value for enterprises.

articleTitle: A Cross Layer Design of Fair Resource Allocation Algorithm for Downlink OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A basic problem in wireless network optimization is the inapplicability of the layered structure. This paper examines a cross layer resource allocation algorithm for downlink OFDM system. The tradeoff of fairness and efficiency is well balanced with cross layer interaction by considering the traffic parameter and fairness among users in link layer as well as the influence of channel state and power transmission limitation. The experimental results reveal the guarantee on steadiness and fairness for users improves a lot while using the cross layer method with a little loss on power efficiency compared with pure physical adaptive counterpart.

articleTitle: Research on the Governance of Creditor's Rights and Growth of SMEs: An Empirical Analysis Based on Structure Equation Modeling
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the basis of Listed small and medium enterprise's(SMEs) empirical datum in China, this paper applying structure equation model (SEM) to research four dimensions of creditor's rights governance mechanism: solvency, debt financing level, assets maturity structure, debt maturity structure. And we do research on both theory and empirical analysis on the relationship between governance of creditor's rights, enterprise characteristics and growth of SMEs. The result indicates that, the governance mechanism of creditor's rights for SMEs do not have a proper business growth promoting effect, which the solvency do a negative impact on business growth; the maturity structure of assets have no significant impact; debt financing and debt maturity structure of a role in promoting the growth of enterprise, but the debt maturity structure isn't rational enough; debt financing have single type and bank borrowings financing have absolute position; heterogeneous characteristics of enterprise have a significant impact on the governance of creditor's rights and enterprise growth.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Corporate Cash Holdings of Chinese Listed Firms
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using a substantial panel data of publicly listed Chinese firms over the period of 1997 through 2006; we attempt to examine the factors influencing corporate cash holdings in one of the emerging markets in the world. In this study, we recognized the institutional structure and legal systems in which Chinese firms operate. We used the panel regression model and the results indicate that corporate cash level increases with payout to investors in the form of dividends, growth opportunities, and large cash flows, and decreases with size of the firm, leverage, debt structure and level of liquid assets. Further, the result suggests that neither the trade-off theory, pecking-order theory nor agency theory has the strongest incentive on corporate cash holdings of Chinese listed firms.

articleTitle: Game Analysis for Audit and Supervision of Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper applies game theory to analyze the behavior between auditors and operators in construction projects, studies the chosen behavior and interaction of each individual, pose a balanced game model between auditors and operators in construction projects, and propose specific measures and suggestions to strengthen audit and supervision for construction projects.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the Outsourcing Network Evolution Pathway: in the Perspective of Social Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The evolution of outsourcing network is realized through the co-act by enterprise's social capital and structural hole. The role of enterprise's social capital is passing through by using the trust as a medium. While the role of structural hole lies in its positional advantage, including: information advantage and control advantage. Implementing with social network theory, the paper analyses the outsourcing network's characteristics and working mechanism from the viewpoint of enterprise's social capital and structural hole, and finally examine this mechanism with case studies of Toyota.

articleTitle: Production Scheduling with Finite Output Buffers for Make-To-Order Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In make-to-order manufacturing environments, optimized production schedules are crucial. In this paper, we present a model for production scheduling in make-to-order environment with limited capacity and finite output buffers by using integer programming approach. In a system consist of several stages, various types of products are produced responding directly to customer orders which are characterized by their quantity, arrival date and due date. The orders completed before the due date will be held in an output buffer until they are delivered to the customer. The orders completed after the due date are considered late and a tardiness penalty incurs. The objective of the model is to maximize the profits by considering the limited capacity, order due dates, finite output buffers and related penalty cost. Numerical examples modeled after real-world make-to-order environment are provided and some computational results with the proposed model are reported.

articleTitle: The Research of Active Network Congestion Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a new congestion control algorithm (MFACC) designed on the basic of FACC. MFACC applies different processing methods to different kinds of operational data (such as video data, audio data, file data and message data) because of the different characteristics and request on network resources, introduces the active detection and the passive indication mechanism, and adopts the cooperation of the load balanced management algorithm and RED queue management algorithm. It promotes the efficient usage of network resources, succeeds in avoiding the algorithm invalidation caused by the indication messages loss. A computer simulation is given to analyze the performance of the algorithms. With the analysis of performance between FACC and MFACC, it shows that MFACC not only resolves some problems in FACC, but also improves the OoS of different kinds of operational data, reduces the package loss rate and decreases the processing delay of packets.

articleTitle: Research on Project Scale Efficiency Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The disadvantages of two project scale efficiency paradigms: Production function and data envelopment analysis (DEA) model was pointed out after it were analyzed. Because of the disadvantages and the trend that ecology and management combine one another, project scale efficiency under project portfolio was presented to satisfy the requirements of project management practice, and this paradigm was established with production function and mathematical model in two population mutual effect.

articleTitle: A New Method to Protect Privacy in RFID based on Object Deputy model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently RFID has been applied in many different areas such as supplying chain management and inventory control. While the RFID system has many advantages, however, it may create new problems to the user's privacy. In this paper, we propose a new architecture of RFID system which designs a special data privacy protection module in traditional RFID system for protecting users' privacy. And the new privacy protection module is based on Object Deputy Model .Simulation and Performance analysis indicates that: the new method is safer and has higher throughput compared to the Randomized Hash-lock protocol.

articleTitle: Spatial Informations of Underground Water Level Based on Applied Geostatistics
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The statistical method is one of most effective tools to describe many phenomena qualitatively or quantitatively from sampling. However,the information containing in spatial locations of samples is not considered and used in most of statistical procedures. In geostatistics, the traditional statistical method is utilized and the spatial information is taken into account. Geostatistical methods have been expanded to many other scientific fields for their unique statistical and interpolating advantages. In this paper, we applied ordinary kriging technique, one of the geostatistical methods, to analyze the spatial variability and gain the spatial informations of annual underground water level at 203 observation wells for Yellow River watershed during the period from 1997~2001.The result revealed that the semi-variograms of water level were best described by spherical variogram model. The final parameters attained indicated that the range of every year presented geometry anisotropy. Underground water level is one most important factor of water balance. So gaining the spatial informations of underground water level accurately is invaluable for understanding water cycle process.

articleTitle: The Speculative Real Estate Bubble's Feature and Early-Warning Research
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The real estate bubble resulted from the over speculation is the most usual, threatening and most hard to prevent and control real estate bubble in the real estate market. Based on the analysis of the speculative real estate bubble's feature, the thesis has classified the speculative real estate bubble, established the index system to measure the degree of the speculative real estate bubble, constructed the model for the speculative real estate bubble's early warning, and take warrant analysis in process combined with our country's reality. The thesis' research result may provide somewhat consult value for the speculative real estate bubble's supervision.

articleTitle: Study on Crisis Management from the SK-II Case in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In September 2006, it was discovered that SK-II, one of Proctor & Gamble's (P&G) cosmetic products manufactured in Japan and sold in China contained prohibited components. P&G did not respond to this crisis proactively, however, and temporarily withdrew the product only after a series of confrontations with consumers. This paper discusses how a routine government inspection in Shanghai became a crisis in China for a well-recognized American firm. P&G miscalculated the extent to which quality concerns about its SK-II product line could seriously harm its image in China. Suggestions and examples for P&G and firms in similar predicaments are provided.

articleTitle: Analysis of China Special Transportation Network Websites
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of social economy, special transportation has been becoming more and more important in China. Many websites have integrated special transportation services as a key part of logistics services. But there are still many problems in China's special transportation services. This paper described firstly the special transportation and existing problems in China. Then, it presents the key ideas of China special transportation network (CSTN) and value-added services.

articleTitle: Based on Double-Log Model to Analyzing the Dairy Products Supply and Demand in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The dairy supply and demand is a very important problem in China. It is a long-term and strategic task also. According to static trade off theory, the authors adopted double-log model and panel estimation to forecasting and analyzing the relation between dairy products supply and demand in China. The results showed that the balance of dairy products supply and demand would be destroyed in the future. In order to stimulating the dairy products consumption, the reasonable supply and demand structure of livestock products should been set up as soon as possible in China. Through studying, the authors want to provide some references for readers.

articleTitle: The Study of Discretional Monetary and Fiscal Policies Based on Linear Quadratic Approximation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: When monetary authority and fiscal authority make their decisions independently, either tries to maximize the overall welfare level subject to the implementation condition and resource constraint. After extending both the objective function and constraints to 2nd order around the steady states, this nonlinear optimal problem is transformed into a pure linear quadratic one. Under this framework we study the discretional fiscal and monetary policies, where they are so tightly integrated that even the feasible sets for monetary and fiscal instruments are greatly restricted. The findings are the following: (1) when both policies are discretional, there is no dominant strategy for the monetary authority, thus both the Nash equilibrium and the fiscal leader equilibrium do not exist, with the monetary leader equilibrium ruled out by the unbounded path of government debts; (2) the equilibrium with fiscal commitment and monetary discretion is also ruled out by the explosive path of government debts.

articleTitle: Maneuvering Emitter Tracking by a Single Passive Observer Using SRUKF Based IMM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The interacting multiple model (IMM) algorithm is combined with the square root unscented Kalman filter (SRUKF), and explored to track maneuvering emitter with a single passive observer, which processes Doppler frequency changing rate and angle measurements concurrently, thus the observer maneuver is not required. Computer simulations are performed to compare the SRUKF based IMM(SRUKF-IMM) tracker with the traditional extended Kalman filter based IMM (EKF-IMM) tracker. Simulation results reveal that the SRUKF-IMM tracker is more stable and effective.

articleTitle: Research on the Fractal Properties of China's Capital Market
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the past two decades, fractal theory, one of the scientific branches of the nonlinear study, thus has become a frontier field of economics research and application. The paper here has reviewed the fundamental properties of fractal time series and the calculations of Hurst Exponent, described the general methods used to calculate the Hurst Exponent of time series. The R/S analysis has also been applied to analyze the fractal properties of China's capital market. Finally, the basic fractal theories regarding the capital market are summarized on the basis of positive analysis.

articleTitle: A New Power-Controlled MAC for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In a wireless Ad Hoc network, the node energy is often supplied by battery with limited capacity. Power control is an effective way to save energy and decrease collision in the Ad Hoc networks based on IEEE 802.11x. In this paper, we analyze the power control mechanisms and propose schemes to solve the asymmetric link problem. Simulation results demonstrate the system performance improvements in goodput, delay, and power consumption.

articleTitle: Designing Guidable Bus Transit Database for Chinese Cities
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In a complicated bus system, bus passenger guidance requires consistent database. Effective guidance needs to provide information on trip origin, destination and transfer. The transfer component is the major concern, which can only be facilitated with a carefully designed hierarchical data model. A three-tier structure of the model is presented. Some practical issues of managing a bus transit database with this model are examined. For effective guidance, the detailed directional level of bus features must be incorporated into the bus transit database.

articleTitle: An Alternative Model for Assessing the Sustainable Development of a Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The concept of sustainable construction has become popular in research. However, there is little existing work providing methods to assess the degree of the contribution of developing a construction project to the attainment of sustainable development. This paper thus proposes an alternative quantitative model to address this issue. The model, developed based on the general principle of sustainable development, is proposed for the application at project feasibility stage. A case study is provided to demonstrate the application of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Perception Gaps Between IS Students and Recruiters About the Entry-Level Skill Requirement
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Dramatic changes in the U.S economy and offshore outsourcing trends in the IT (Information Technology) industry have affected the IS (Information Systems) job market and recruiters with regard to IS knowledge/skills that their new hires should possess. Facing these changes presents a challenge to IS recruiters and students. There is an urgent need for a study that exams the perception gaps between IS recruiters and students about the knowledge/skill sets required for a new entry-level IS hire. This study presents the findings from a survey of IS recruiters and IS students in the U.S., detailing the differences of their understanding about the knowledge/skills requirement.

articleTitle: A New Agent-Based Artificial Stock Market with Short-Term Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Agent-based computational finance is attracting significant interest in many disciplines. But most artificial stock markets (ASM) was built in a complex manner and not suited for studying the short-term dynamics of stock market. This activated us to build a new model different from literatures in three main parts of designing an artificial stock market: economic environment, agent's behavior and price formation. The results of simulation show that our model can reproduce the stylized facts of short-term dynamics.

articleTitle: QoS in Node-Disjoint Routing for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A mobile ad hoc network (MANET) is a collection of mobile nodes that can communicate with each other without using any fixed infrastructure. To support multimedia applications such as video and voice MANETs require an efficient routing protocol and quality of service (QoS) mechanism. Node-Disjoint Multipath Routing Protocol (NDMR) is a practical protocol in MANETs: it reduces routing overhead dramatically and achieves multiple node-disjoint routing paths. QoS support in MANETs is an important issue as best-effort routing is not efficient for supporting multimedia applications. This paper presents a novel adaptation of NDMR, QoS enabled NDMR, which introduces agent-based SLA management. This enhancement allows for the intelligent selection of node-disjoint routes based on network conditions, so fulfilling the QoS requirements of Service Level Agreements(SLAs).

articleTitle: Iterative Group Detection Schemes for STTC and LST Combined System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The transmission scheme of multilayered space-time trellis codes (ML-STTC) achieves tradeoff between diversity gain and multiplexing gain by combining space-time trellis code (STTC) and layered space-time (LST) structure in multiple-input and multiple-output (MIMO) systems. In this paper, iterative minimum mean square error (MMSE) group detection and iterative MMSE interference cancellation (IC) group detection schemes are proposed to improve the performance of ML-STTC. Moreover, the iteration can reduce the influence of the detection order on performance, and compensate for the performance loss of the firstly detected layer instead of power allocation in the iterative MMSE IC group detection scheme.

articleTitle: The Coefficient Determination of Multivariate Quality Loss Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The quality loss model was proposed by Genichi Taguchi in the early 1970s, and it was the core of his three-stage design theory, system design, parameter design and tolerance design. The quality loss model was based on one index of absolute quality deviants. However, in actual production process, the total quality is usually influenced by several quality indices, so the interaction of the quality indices should be considered. First, a 2-order product quality model, which was based on several indices of relatively quality deviation, was built. Then, the model was successfully extended to 3 or even higher orders. After this, the 2-order mode was simplified to build a multivariate quality loss model. Finally, a useful method of the coefficient determination was brought forward to determinate all the coefficients in the multivariate quality loss model and the workflow of it was also described.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Model for Independent Innovation of New Drug in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The imitation is the main means to produce new drugs in China at present. Upgrading doorsill of new drug and changing of new drug protection make it very difficult to develop the new drug in China. It's necessary to study on mode for new drug independent innovation. A conceptual model for new drug independent innovation which has the Chinese characters is presented, based on empirical research undertaken with a leading Anti-tumor new drug H101 producing (Sunway Biotech Co., Ltd) and based on a review of some key literature in this area. The model acts as a toolkit aiding research and development of new drugs. In the result, some suggestions are given. A public medicine information platform should be established. Venture capital should be encouraged. Systematic way should be made to assure the benign interaction relations between short-term benefit and the long-term investment. Preferential talented person policy should be measured.

articleTitle: Capacity of Training-Based V-BLAST System with LMMSE Receiver in Continuously Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A closed-form solution for the information- theoretical capacity of vertical bell-laboratories-layered-space-time (V-BLAST) system over continuously flat-fading MIMO channels with training-based channel estimation and linear minimum-mean-square-error (LMMSE) receiver is derived. Since large system analysis via the distribution law of random matrix is used in the analysis, our analysis and results are asymptotic in nature. Simulation results show that the analytical capacity expression is still valid for limited-scale V-BLAST system. Furthermore the optimal training length that maximize the capacity is found numerically as functions of the Doppler frequency and signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Model Parent-Child Relationships between Lines and Parcels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Optimization of Top-k Query in Sensor Networks with Limited Memory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the increasing events monitored in sensor networks, it generates a vital amount of data which have to be stored for further retrieval and data analysis. Since sensor nodes are battery-powered and memory-constraint, it is necessary to design energy and storage efficient algorithms for query processing. In this paper, we propose a limited-cache approach to optimizing the storage problem. We apply the approach to top-k query problem and design new algorithms. Storage costs can be reduced by limiting cache of each node. Simulation results show that the storage cost can be reduced significantly while only little energy is consumed. This approach can be generalized for other query problems.

articleTitle: A New Graphical Game Model Based on MAIDs and AIDs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new graphical model called asymmetric multi-agent influence diagrams (AMAEDs) is proposed in the paper, which is based on multi-agent influence diagrams (MAIDs) and asymmetric influence diagrams (AIDs). Firstly, we indicate that using MAIDs to represent asymmetric games may cause representation explosion and inefficient solving. Then, AMAIDs is proposed to deal with this problem, and an example is introduced to show the application of AMAIDs.

articleTitle: A Fast Algorithm for Packet Classification with Reasonable Memory Usage
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Packet classification is one of the basic techniques for many applications such as routers, firewalls, and intrusion detection systems and so on. With the development of the Internet, however, packet classification has already become a performance bottleneck in network infrastructures. A great many algorithms for packet classification have been proposed. Although most of these algorithms run fast, they consume very large amount of memory. This paper presents a fast algorithm for packet classification with reasonable memory usage called RCC (rule component cuttings). Similar to HiCuts (Hierarchical Intelligent Cuttings) which is one of the best-known algorithms for packet classification, RCC is also based on a decision tree to categorize an incoming packet. In spite of this, there exists one important difference between them. That is, HiCuts divides a dimension into equal-sized intervals yet RCC cuts it into unequal-sized intervals, which gives rise to decreasing the amount of memory. Experimental results show that the time of HiCuts is smaller than RCC's but the amount of memory HiCuts consumes is much larger.

articleTitle: V Code : An Efficient Coding Scheme for Correcting Twice Storage Node Failures
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Proper data placement schemes based on erasure correcting code are one of the most important components for a highly available data storage system. In this paper,a new class of array codes are introduced which is called the V codes. The V codes are an binary maximum distance separable (MDS) codes and correct various double node failures,i.e. minimum column distance 3 and thus is optimal in terms of node failure recovery capability for a given data redundancy. We provide detailed v code's decoding algorithms for correcting various double node failures. We show that the decoding complexity of the V codes is much lower than those of the existing comparable codes, thus the V codes are practically very meaningful for storage systems that need higher reliability.

articleTitle: Performance of Arbitrary Interference Rejection Based on Decision Feedback Filers in DSSS Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The aim of this paper is to establish upper bounds of SNR improvement factors for the maximum attainable performance of a system when the interference has an arbitrary spectral density using any realizable decision feedback filter. In contrast to conventional results for a first-order autoregressive interference based on decision feedback filters, we allow the jammer to have an arbitrary rational spectral density. The quality of the approximation of upper bounds is also investigated, which is exponentially tight. The significance of the analysis result is that the expression for upper bound is simple, closed-form, and valid for arbitrary jammer 's spectral densities.

articleTitle: A Research of Tacit Knowledge Externalization Based on Dynamical Fuzzy Cognitive Maps
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The conversion of tacit knowledge into explicit knowledge is one of the most important content of knowledge management. After studying the existing state of tacit knowledge externalization both in domestic and overseas, this paper is concerned with fuzzy cognitive map methodology. On the basis of tacit knowledge representation with fuzzy cognitive maps which proposed by Kun Chang Lee etc., in this paper a dynamical fuzzy cognitive maps model to the quantification representation of the causal type of tacit knowledge. Finally, the experiments verify the superiority of quantification model.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Evaluation on the Allocation Capability of Science and Technology Resource
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, based to the present science and technology condition of Zhejiang province and present research achievements on the allocation capability of science and technology resources, the content of science and technology resources is elaborated, and further more, the model of hierarchical evaluation index system of science and technology resources is set up. The comparative analysis of allocation situation of science and technology resources between Ningbo and Hangzhou using fuzzy hierarchy evaluation can help us find the problems. The result can also offer the science foundation for optimization of the allocation capability of science and technology resources..

articleTitle: Joint MIMO Channel Estimation and Equalization in Doubly-Selective Fading Environments
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A improved algorithm to perform channel estimation and equalization for multiple input multiple output(MIMO) systems in frequency and time-selective fading environments is put forward. lt contains two steps: training and tracking. In training phase, improved Kalman filtering, namely robust Kalman filtering(RKF), is exploited to estimate channel impulse response(CIR). After that, in tracking stage,the RKF and minimum mean-square error feedback decision equalizer (MMSE-DFE) cooperate to track the time-varying channel. The RKF recursions is presented and a closed-form solution for baud rate MIMO MMSE-DFE under perfect knowledge of CIR and correct past decisions conditions is derived. In addition, it regards unknown dc-offset due to zero intermediate frequency(IF) at the receiver as the mean of measurement noise, which is estimated as a byproduct through robust Kalman filters. Finally, it is compared with well-known ones,such as least mean-square (LMS), recursive least square (RLS), Kalman filtering (KF). All these show that the proposal exhibits better performance.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Latent Demand Activation by Business Model Innovation: A Case Study of Tourist-Transport Center
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to elaborate the mechanism of latent demand activation by business model innovation. The business model innovation from traditional travel agency to tourist-transport center (TTC) includes two kinds of innovation: one is dramatic innovation or disruptive innovation, the other is incremental innovation based on new business model platform. These two kinds of innovation together have dramatically changed the structure of tourism industry by activating and transforming more latent demand into effective demand. By analyzing the case of TTC, the mechanism of latent tourism demand activation is explored. The paper outlines the general mechanism of latent demand activation by business model innovation. The main mechanism of latent demand activation by business model includes "hard power" and "soft power". Two types of power together activate and transform latent demand into effective demand by touching different levels of latent demand.

articleTitle: Iterative Detection of OFDM Signals in Sparse Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An iterative detection method of OFDM signals for sparse channels is proposed in this paper. Pilot based channel estimation is used as the initialization of the detection, expectation maximization algorithm is then used to detect OFDM signals iteratively. The path delay information, noise power and the covariance matrix of the channel response are needed in this method, so the methods of estimating all these channel parameters are also given. The simulation results prove the efficiency of the iterative algorithm, and also prove that by using the estimation parameters of the channel, the performance can nearly approximate the performance of a system with perfect channel state information.

articleTitle: Linear Time Encoding of Low-Density Parity Check Codes and its Performance in Weak Atmospheric Turbulent Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A major drawback of low-density parity -check (LDPC) Codes is their apparently high encoding complexity and consequent encoding delay. A linear time encoding method proposed by Richardson and Urbanke can effectively reduce the encoding complexity to only linear encoding complexity. In this paper, LDPC codes based on the linear time encoding method is adopted for improving the bit-error rate (BER) performance of an on-off keying (OOK) modulated optical signal through a weak atmosphere turbulence channel. The optical atmosphere channel is modeled as a stationary ergodic channel with lognormal intensity fading. We simulate and analyze the BER performance of the channel using the linear time encoding method. Simulation results show that the presented encoding method can be greatly reduce the BER Moreover, as the code length increases or code rate decreases, the coding gain of LDPC codes over the uncoded system becomes large. Therefore, the presented encoding method with both large code length and low code rate obtain high encode gain for the optical atmosphere turbulence channel.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Explorations of Improvisational Learning in Innovation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: On the Channel Capacity of MIMO Systems Under Correlated Rayleigh Fading
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to study the impacts of channel model parameters on the channel capacity of a multiple input multiple output (MIMO) system, a novel method is proposed to explore the channel capacity under Rayleigh flat fading with correlated transmit and correlated receive antennas. The optimal transmitting direction which can achieve maximum channel capacity is derived in detail using random matrices theory. At high SNR, the closed-form expression for the channel capacity of MIMO system is given by using the properties of Wishart distribution. Computer simulation results show that the channel capacity is maximized when the antenna spacing increases to a certain point. At high SNR, the estimation of channel capacity is close to its true value. And when the same array configuration is adopted both at the transmitter and the receiver, the UCA yields higher channel capacity than ULA.

articleTitle: A Stability-Oriented Overlay Multicast for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Stable multicast data delivery structure contributes high data delivery ratio and low control overhead in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks (MANETs). Due to the dynamic topology of MANETs, to construct a stable multicast data delivery structure becomes a challenge in ad hoc environment. In this paper, we propose a stability-oriented overlay multicast protocol for MANETs based on a modified Delayed Forwarding mechanism. In this protocol, each member node precalculates its stability according to residual battery and its local mobility. A source rooted overlay multicast tree is created if source has to send data packets. The overlay construction follows the stability of each member node. By using a modified Delayed Forwarding mechanism, a member node with relatively high stability will have highly populated subtrees, SOOMP improves multicast routing stability by trying to push the unstable member nodes to the edge of the multicast tree. Data packets are transmitted via IP-in-IP tunnels between member nodes in the overlay tree.

articleTitle: Secure AES Coprocessor Against Power Analysis for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cryptographic coprocessors for wireless sensor nodes are resource-constrained devices, which require low power and a small size. Besides, with the advent of side channel attacks, resistance to such attacks becomes another major requirement. This paper describes a low-cost and high-security Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) coprocessor implementation and an optimization scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) systems. The compact architecture of AES is applied to optimize the size of AES circuits. Its impact on the security against power analysis attack is analyzed, which is important for many WSN applications. A novel method, using inhomogeneous S-Boxes instead of fixed S-Boxes, is proposed to resist power analysis attacks. The AES coprocessor was implemented with UMC 0.25 mum 1.8v CMOS standard cell library and power analysis experiments were conducted. The results demonstrate that our proposed design has very low hardware cost and enhances the AES secure characteristics effectually.

articleTitle: Research on Several Problems in BP Neural Network Application
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Four problems existing in BP neural network practical application are discussed in this paper: slow converging speed, converging at local minimum, overtraining and poor extrapolating capacity. Comparing advantages and disadvantage of several acceleration algorithms, the paper provides the suggestions of solving those problems. The paper also advances a forecasting model of monthly irrigation return flow based on BP neural network is advanced as a case study.

articleTitle: System Reliability Analysis Based on Virtual Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Analyses the entity unit of virtual enterprise (VE) based on task. Defines the VE system reliability, and contrasts it with the engineering system reliability. List the factors that affect the VE system reliability, analyses the reliability of the serial VE system, the parallel VE system and the netlike VE system.

articleTitle: Bluetooth Base Band Unit Design Based on Platform Architect
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, system-level verification/validation techniques based on SystemC were used to build a transaction- level model of the Bluetooth base band unit. The model was verified in a simulation platform we present, named Platform Architect, being developed in Coware Company. With the diagram produced by the platform, the soft program and hardware modules have been revised until the key factors of the design were satisfied. Based on the above, this model was progressively refined until a synthesizable RTL model was obtained. Such design flow on the platform architect not only speed up the developing progress, but also improve the system's performance.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: P-O Fit as an Alternative Predictor of Employee Service Performance: Do Shared Cognitions Matter?
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Innovative Solution for E-Commerce Marketing: eTong
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The eTong is an e-commerce platform aimed at facilitating information exchange and electronic transactions among producers, suppliers and retailers by exploiting cost effective information technology. Through its innovative design, the eTong system replaces the complex intermediate sales links in distribution channels and integrates all the retailers to eTong to form a highly effective community. The "producers- eTong-retailers" model proposed by eTong is considered an innovative solution for traditional marketing and could potentially contribute to the enhancement of e-commerce in China. This paper first addresses the background of eTong and its system solution. Then, we describe two test beds to demonstrate the application of eTong in tobacco and non-tobacco industries. At last, we conclude the paper with perspectives on future development of eTong and also the challenges it faces.

articleTitle: High Quality OFDM Communication System Based on Carrier Interferometry and Digital Linearization of HPA
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For this nonlinear compensation, we address the PAPR reduction method and linearization of HPA at the same time. High quality OFDM communication system is our goal, which can be possible to use the carrier interferometry in the OFDM system and to digitally linearize the nonlinear HPA. The first method is a CI/OFDM (carrier interferometry OFDM) for PAPR reduction of the OFDM signal and the second is the predistortion of HPA for the linearization. In this paper, CI/OFDM system is implemented in the DSP board and RF communication board. Also, polynomial-based predistorter is used for the linearization of the HPA. The CI/OFDM uses full frequency diversity and is robust to the narrow band interference. CI/OFDM lowers down the high PAPR and we can compensate the HPA non-linear distortion by digital predistorter. It is shown that the designed CI/OFDM system has better BER performance and higher power efficiency than the ordinary OFDM system.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation of Enterprise Informationization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Enterprise informationization (EI) is a system engineering. In fact, the process of its constructing is also a process of evaluation and perfection. The paper analysis how to evaluate EI, on the grounds of a three-dimensioned evaluation model and its index system of informationization level, finance and competitive ability, it reflects the level of informationization, economic potential of constructing informationization and the degree of informationizing effectiveness on management. These can actually direct the construction of EI.

articleTitle: The Calculation Method of the Completeness of Information Under the Information Asymmetric Circumstance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the calculation method of the completeness of information is put forward under the information asymmetry circumstance. The information in game can be broadly divided into three types: the information of opponents' action set; the information of opponents' actions been actually selected and the the information of opponents' strategies. In order to estimate the completeness of these types of information, the calculation method is advanced, which is named as the information degree of the action set; the information degree of the actual action and the information degree of the strategies. This is the bran-new viewpoint to describe the information in game, which is meaningful in theory.

articleTitle: The Research on the Knowledge Characteristics of Chinese Large and Medium Size Industrial Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper presents the index system guiding the research on the characteristics of Chinese large and medium size industrial enterprises based on the in-depth study of their present situations. With the assistance of the SPSS software, the paper further studies on the level of scientific and technological progress and regional innovation capacity of some large and medium-size enterprises in 30 different regions in China on the basis of the principal component analysis and cluster analysis to identify the relation between knowledge characteristics, regional scientific and technological progress and innovation capacity.

articleTitle: Uplink-Downlink Heterogeneous Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes and implements a wireless sensor network system with UDHR (uplink-downlink heterogeneous routing) protocol according to the characteristic of data flows in WSN. The proposed routing protocol can be applied to multi-purpose mode such as time- driven mode, event-driven mode and query mode. The simulation results show that the protocol is effective, scalable and robust. Finally the routing protocol is realized in the self- development testbed platform, which can monitor the entire network topological changes, network overhead, energy consumption of each node, data collection and so on.

articleTitle: The Research of Ontology-Based Personalized Query Approach from Heterogeneous Distributed Data Resource
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Now, many enterprises accumulated a mass of data, which is distributed and heterogeneous. But most search engine and some integrated software, treating the query of heterogeneous and distributed data, often could not play biggest role. The query result also often had only "scope" but no "depth" and exited plenty of rubbishes. Traditional query mechanism was inflexible and hadn't point. So a kind of personalized query platform for heterogeneous data was given. In the research and implementation course, ontology technology was led into; as a domain model, ontology provides a common comprehension about the domain concepts and the hierarchy of the concepts; at the same time, its utilization also reduces the dependence on the comprehension technology of natural language. Firstly gave a definition of ontology, and denoted a conception object by a quintuple group, constructed domain ontology and then designed a personalized query platform based on ontology, in the following content, introduced the working process of the platform and characteristics detailedly, finally drew an conclusion that personalized query platform we designed not only assured the recall and accuracy of query but also satisfied different users' demands.

articleTitle: The Validation for China's Securities Investment Funds through Mean Reversion Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Discount transaction of Securities Investment Funds is a normal phenomenon of domestic and international fund markets. On the basis of nonlinear fractal theory, this paper uses Hurst exponent to validate the fractal time sequence of China's fund market, calculates H value and chooses connective 54 weeks' data of fund market to inspect the mean reversion time sequence. Because the traditional arbitrage methods are not feasible in China, the paper takes the Chinese market condition and law system into account and proposes a new arbitrage methods based on "mean reversion" character of fund discount. The author designs the optimal fund investment model and proposes the relative investment suggestion.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Political Risks and MNCs' Misconducts in International Business
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Minimization of BER and Interference Power through Optimal Deployment of WSNs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Power conservation is an issue which is to be dealt in sensor networks. The nature of sensor networks and their deployment makes it difficult for the optimal transmit power to be modified after they are deployed so a common transmit power has to be selected in such a way that makes the deployment more feasible and easier. An optimal transmit power can ensure better connectivity and longer battery life. Excessive interference can also be eliminated by choosing a common and minimal transmit power for all nodes. In this paper we have investigated the interference powers introduced due to the different ways of deployments of wireless sensor networks over a certain area and we also used the graphical approach to look at the effects of distance from the central receiving node and densities on the BER and the interference powers while also changing the transmission data rates. We have also investigated the phenomena through simulations and the main aim is to optimize the performance of sensor networks by observing their behavior in various regularly placed deployments.

articleTitle: Vehicle Recognition Based on Least Squares Support Vector Machine Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the paper, a vehicle recognition model based on least squares support vector machine(LSSVM) is presented. LSSVM can solve the problem of nonlinear well, avoiding some difficulties including high dimensional and local minimum. In the model, the non-sensitive loss function is replaced by quadratic loss function and the inequality constraints are replaced by equality constraints. Consequently, quadratic programming problem is simplified as the problem of solving linear equation groups, and the SVM algorithm is realized by least squares method. It is presented to choose the parameter of kernel function by dynamic way, which enhances preciseness rate of recognition. The simulation results show the model can effectively distinguish vehicle type.

articleTitle: A Preprocessing Technique for Downlink of Multi-User LDC and SM Combined System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We introduce a transmit preprocessing technique for the downlink of multi-user LDC (Linear Dispersed Code) and SM (Spatial Multiplexing) combined system, in which complete channel state information is available to the base transceiver station (BTS). The preprocessing technique can not only effectively cancels co-channel interference (CCI) thus enabling simple single user decoding, but also improves the performance of the multi-user LDC and SM combined system with the use of post-processing SNR. Simulation results provided demonstrate the potential of our technique in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Research on FH Synchronous Network Signal Separating
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the analysis of FH Synchronous networking principle, a separating algorithm is put forward, a separating model is given and the performance is simulated. The result indicates that the algorithm based on multi-parameters confusing is effective.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Study on the Improvement of Human Capital Measurement and Management with Activity Based Costing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation Combining DOA in TD-CDMA Mobile Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes an improved channel estimation method based on B. Steiner low cost channel estimator used in TD-SCDMA (time division-synchronous code division multiple access) cellular mobile radio systems known as third-generation mobile system. Our method introduces a threshold filter combining DOA information of adaptive antennas, which can significantly reduce the interference resulting from B. Steiner's channel estimation approach. The simulation demonstrates that the exploitation of threshold filter with the knowledge of the direction can lead to significant system performance enhancement by 3.5 dB.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Analysis on Economic Fluctuations and Coordination in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the coordination theory, this paper is aimed at analyzing the issues of China's economic fluctuations and coordination during 1954-2004. It has got two important results. Firstly, it has identified the total 13 economic cycles in China's economy during the 51 years. It has shown that 5 long economic fluctuations lasted more than 5 years, 4 short economic fluctuations lasted only two years, whereas other 4 middle economic fluctuations lasted 3 or 4 years. Secondly, it has defined two concepts of coordination coefficient and non-coordination coefficient. From comparing the ratios of the growth rate of the primary, second and tertiary industries to the aggregate GDP, the paper has discussed whether the China's economic growth is coordination or non-coordination between industries. It has found that the coordination between industries is significant for the development of China's economy. It suggests that the economic decision making is to maintain the coordination between industries.

articleTitle: Design of a Optimization Cutting Stock I³DSS Base on MAS for a Manufacturing Company
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In enterprise the cutting stock is a complex decision problem, so a intelligent, integrated and interactive decision support system is needed to support the cutting stock decision. This article describes the optimization models of a cutting stock problem for a manufacturing company, and puts forward a multi-agent based optimization cutting stock I<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>DSS. A five-layer structure is designed. The communication and cooperation mechanism among agents as well as the system's work procedure is discussed too.

articleTitle: The Decision Model of Staged Financing in Venture Capital
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Staged financing is a basic operational form of venture capital, so that it is very important to research decision problems of staged financing. The thesis applies multi-objective decision and nonlinear programming approach to establish the optimal model of stage financing chain, and then the optimal investment proportion and money of stage financing is made by simplifying and resolving model with fixed total investment of venture capitalists.

articleTitle: Organizational Knowledge Architecture: in the Perspective of Knowledge Ecology
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study aims at suggesting an integrative methodology for knowledge architecture in organizations. First, we investigate the different views and perspectives given by various researchers and put them together to give a holistic architecture of knowledge ecology. Knowledge ecology provides a conceptual framework to consider knowledge resources, the process of knowledge, and the space of knowledge within a multidimensional context. To establish the platform for the practice of knowledge architecture, we propose the application of knowledge portal in organizations.

articleTitle: The Diversity and Multiplexing Tradeoff of Joint Transceiver Design Performance Using GMD Decomposition for MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: GMD-VBLAST algorithm proposed recently can decomposition a MIMO channel into multiple identical parallel sub-channels with same SNR. In this paper it derives the diversity and multiplexing tradeoff curve for GMD-VBLAST scheme. Then compare it to the optimal tradeoff curve and the other two VBLAST schemes. The results in a complete view show that the GMD scheme is superior to the other two VBLAST schemes, but is sub-optimal according to the optimal curve.

articleTitle: Convergence in Communications Industry: Regulatory Challenges, Issues and Trends
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The radical restructuring of the communications industry is underway. Many set rules and standards have become obsolete. Convergence requires new ways to cope with this reality. The fast technological changes are forcing policy makers and regulators to review their policies, challenge for the policy makers and regulators is how to promote competition for this radically changing market structure and what is the best framework to encourage investment and innovation while keeping in mind the public interest? What is the right form of intervention, if any, and where it should be applied? This paper discusses these issues by considering the practical examples from the developed countries. The role of ex ante regulations is becoming minimal; instead ex post regulations are increasingly becoming the choice. However, the role of regulator will always be there, at least, for social issues and spectrum allocation.

articleTitle: Optimal Portfolio Management in a CIR Framework
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The optimal portfolio problem for a bank account, single risky stock and a rolling horizon bond is developed. The stochastic short-term interest rate with the Cox-Ingersoll-Ross (CIR) dynamics affects the prices of the stock and rolling horizon bond. The investment objective is maximizing expected CRRA utility of terminal wealth. The problem has been solved by the stochastic dynamic programming principle and the completion of squares technique. The closed-form optimal trading strategy is obtained. A numerical example illustrating the results is presented.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation in MIMO-OFDM Systems by Tracking the Delay-Subspace
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A time domain channel estimation method in MIMO- OFDM systems by tracking the delay-subspace is proposed. The time impulse response is estimated by transmitting known pilot symbols, and the estimation performance is improved by the Givens rotation based delay-subspace tracking and amplitudes tracking based on the LMS filtering. The simulations prove that the time domain channel estimation by tracking the delay- subspace can track faster fading channels, and is more accurate with low complexity.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on purchasing strategy based on supplier relationship
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A Point Sets Smoothing Algorithm Using Curvature Flow
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We present a method for anisotropic fairing of point sets, which based on the covariance analysis and the efficiently constructed curvature. We use principal curvatures to detect features such as edges. Anisotropic curvature flow allows prominent surface features and other details of the objects to be treated in different ways. It is able to retain and even enhance important features such as edges and corners on the surface. We define such a diffusion flow which allows the point moving along the normal with a speed equal to the curvature. Since the point is moved along the normal direction, the proposed curvature flow will not introduce undesirable points drifting over the surface.

articleTitle: Loosely Synchronous Code in Selected Mapping OFDM
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The peak-to-average ratio (PAPR) of orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) system is one of the most important drawbacks that limit the performance of OFDM. Selected mapping (SLM) performs very well in PAPR reduction and the optimality condition for SLM has been proposed. A large number of vectors meet this condition, one of which is loosely synchronized (LS) code. Moreover, OFDM must be coded in practice, as is called coded OFDM (COFDM), which cannot meet the hypothesis of independent elements of each data block Thus, we investigate the case of SLM using LS code as the phase vectors (called LS-SLM), and show the outstanding performance by empirical simulations in COFDM.

articleTitle: An Efficient Method to Estimate the Broadcast Cycle Length in the Data Broadcast in Wireless Mobile Environments
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Data broadcast is an efficient method to disseminate information in wireless mobile environments to a large number of mobile clients. Data are transmitted on the channel periodically; clients listen to the channel where they download what they are interested. The response time is one of the most important metrics for the performance evaluation in data broadcast. In this paper we discuss the effect of the broadcast cycle length (BCL) on the response time, present both theoretical result and practical method to estimate the BCL. Broadcast scheduling algorithms using this BCL can achieve a near optimal response time.

articleTitle: Application of Multilayered Multi-Agent Data Mining Architecture to Bank Domain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper outlined a multilayered multi-agent architectural theory of data mining, mainly focuses on the application of multilayered multi-agent data mining architecture to the banking domain. It describes the necessity of data mining in banking and illustrates mapping of problem solving ontology of the multilayered multi-agent data mining architecture to the CRM manager's problem solving process in the banking domain.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement of Layered Mimo OFDM System Using Turbo Codes
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presented comparison of vertical and horizontal Layered MIMO OFDM system. The results are simulated in both Rayleigh and AWGN channels. In this paper, vertical and horizontal Layered MIMO OFDM system is simulated for two and three number of transmit and receive antennas and their performance is analyzed in terms of bit error rate (BER). We evaluate that the performance of turbo coded vertical layered MIMO OFDM system is better than that of horizontal layered MIMO OFDM system.

articleTitle: Modeling and Implement of Dynamic Monitor System in High-Speed Railway Soft Soil Foundation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper investigates the key technical problems in designing the construction monitoring system of railway soft soil foundation. The database structure of the monitoring system, which plays an important role in data management, is discussed first. Then the ways to build the platform of data collection, navigation and analysis system are presented, which is based on the treatments of multiple-inheritance of data access document classes. Finally the Realization of software system is reported, and the engineering application in Kunshan experimental site of Beijing-Shanghai high-speed Railroad demonstrates that the monitoring system can improve the efficiency of data process greatly and satisfy the requirements of the large-scaled soft soil subgrade construct with high class railway.

articleTitle: Evaluating Service Performance of Higher Education Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
