abstract: By analysis on service production theories and characteristics of high education system in China, this paper expands the intensity of application of service production theories in higher education systems and provides a feasible substitution-elasticity-based input-output model for evaluating service performance of high education system and efficiently and effectively utilizing higher education resources. The results of a typical case analysis in one higher education system prove the relatively high validity and reliability of the model proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Medicine E-Business Platform Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the economic and technical development, e-business has been taking up an important position in different fields, not to say the medicine distribution industry. E-business model has brought along a new breaking point for the innovation of medicine distribution industry, namely, through the analysis of this industry, seven requirements for its innovation can be obtained. Under the guidance of these requirements and also the Value-chain and Value-net theories, the paper builds up three medicine e-business platform models, after carefully examining the unique characteristics of China's medicine distribution industry. These three models will not only be conducive to winning more advantages and profits for companies but also sets an example for the future development of medicine distribution industry.

articleTitle: Computing Shortest Path Problem with Subtractive Weight Based on Tableau Method
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Dijkstra algorithm is regarded as the most classical method to settle the shortest path problem. But its ability would be not equal to case where subtractive-weight exists. This thesis raises an improved algorithm based on Dijkstra, but treats P-sign as an alterable sign as T-sign. The algorithm can commendably achieve the calculation assignment, but not form subtractive cycles or zero cycles in graph. It is based on tableau method to make the graph cleaner than graphic method, and calculate subtractive weight problems more effectively.

articleTitle: Blind Channel Identification and MMSE Equalization Algorithm based on FIR Multirate Filterbank Precoders
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is well-known that interbank precoders can be applied in blind identification and equalization of finite impulse response (FIR) channels. In this paper, a blind channel identification algorithm based on nonmaximally decimated FIR multirate filterbank precoders is proposed. The proposed algorithm is not sensitive to the characteristics of unknown channel and performs well even with nonminimum phase channels. Using the identification algorithm, a minimum mean square error (MMSE) FIR equalizer is proposed. It is shown that, the proposed equalizer outperforms zero forcing (ZF) equalizer. It can mitigate the intersymbol interference (ISI) and depress the noise amplification effect simultaneously, and subsequently maximizes the signal to noise ratio of the system at the receiver. Simulation examples demonstrate their good performance.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Approach for Speaker Transformation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A probabilistic approach of speaker transformation is proposed in this paper to make the speech of a source speaker sound like uttered by a target speaker. Speaker individuality transformation is achieved by altering characteristics of the speech spectrum and the supersegmental information such as fundamental pitch frequency. The main advantage of this scheme lies in the aspect of not only having considered the statistical property of both the source and target speech spectrum but also the relationship between them under a cross correlational model. And to make sure that the transformed speech signals are perceptually closer to the target speaker, prosody modification is also involved. The proposed scheme is evaluated using both subjective and objective measures. The experimental results show that the transformation system put forward is capable of effectively transforming speaker identity whilst the converted speech maintains high quality. And the whole performance is evaluated to be superior to the conventional vector quantization (VQ) based method.

articleTitle: Does It Pay to Get to the Top? Contextual Factors of Branding in Search Engine Marketing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Branding effect in search engine result pages (SERPs) is a critical yet unsolved issue in search engine marketing. Building on contextual branding literature, this research identifies key contextual factors conducive for brand building in SERPs. Using four experiments, the authors establish that Internet users possess a schema about the meaning of search engine rankings; and that their recognition of a lesser known brand will be higher when the brand is displayed before well- known brands in SERPs. The authors also discover that under conditions of priming, users with low Internet search skills tend to evaluate the lesser known brand more favorably along the primed attribute. The research has both theoretical and practical implications for building brands in the SERP setting.

articleTitle: The Probe Into Reflection Model of Large-Scale Fading
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Reflection is one of the three basic factors which impact a mobile communication system. Reflection occurs when the electromagnetic wave meets an object that is much larger than the wavelength of electromagnetic wave. Received power (or its reciprocal, path loss) is generally the most important parameter predicted by large-scale propagation models based on the physics of reflection. We in this paper deduce a conclusion which is different from the authority publishings. The trigonometric vectors resultant vector E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TOT</sub>(d), the received power can be come out.

articleTitle: A Data Link Layer Protocol Based on Wireless Industrial Control Network Model-Visual Token Control Protocol WICN-Z
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at the problems in general MAC protocol, we designed a network protocol called WICN-Z which can satisfy the real time requirement of industrial wireless network. A layered data link layer mechanism is proposed. The under layer adopts the conventional protocol CSMA. It is compatible with the CSMA mechanism. The upper layer applies the virtual token protocol to manage the connected mechanism of wireless nodes. It can control and reduce the collision. We also regulate the setting up and recovering process of Token-Ring and the control methods to handling the entering and removing of mobile stations. And five related frame structures are defined. It is likely to become a protocol of the standard and practical wireless network of industrial control.

articleTitle: Wavelet-Based Subspace Method for Blind Estimation of Time-Varying Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel linear algorithm is proposed in this paper for estimating time-varying channels only relying on second order statistics. The proposed methods are applicable to channels where time-varying impulse response can be described as a linear combination of a finite number of wavelet basis functions. It is shown that the estimation of the wavelet expansion coefficients is equivalent to estimating the second-order parameters of an unobservable single input many output process, which are directly computed from the observation data. By exploiting this equivalence, blind subspace methods are applicable. Some illustrative simulations are presented.

articleTitle: Web Services Based Knowledge Management in Aerospace Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on the technology, knowledge, standard necessary to the standardization process in the aerospace industry. A new transformation mechanism is proposed to convert the proprietary technology in companies into industrial, national and international width standard. Then a kind of architecture of knowledge management system based on Web Services technology in aerospace companies is presented. With the research involving the platform-free and interoperability of heterogeneous systems, we further discuss the analytic system (AS) in the knowledge management system to provide an opened unified integrated environment with Web Service for the knowledge management system.

articleTitle: Transportation Disruptions in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper research on how a chlorine transportation provider optimal transportation solution supposed transportation disruptions (i.e. releasing of chlorine) may happen on the process of transportation. If the government attaches much importance to environment protection and pushes severe punishment on environment pollution, the chlorine transportation provider should consider two goals together: minimizing the individual transportation cost and minimizing the social transportation cost. Then this paper develops a multi- objective linear programming model which contains two goals for the problem. Which goal is important will affect the objective function of this model. Through discussion on importance compare of two goals, this paper believes that government policy is very important to inspirit transportation providers complying with laws and protecting environment.

articleTitle: The Discussion to Supply Chain Management of Venture Capital
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The idea of venture capital supply chain management is a fire-new and more advanced management concept philosophy. Paper mainly discusses structure and the characteristics of it, raises this idea, and set up a qualitative model for it.

articleTitle: Game Analysis in a Supply Chain Under Lexicographic Allocation Mechanism with Asymmetric Cost
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we consider a distribution system with one supplier and two retailers who face a same oligopolistic market. The two retailers have different selling price which decreases with the total quantity of the two retailers allocated and their handling cost, respectively. We derive their optimal ordering strategies under Lexicographic Allocation Mechanism (LAM) where the supplier allocates the quantity to one retailer first and then to the other. We investigate how the two retailers compete for the supplier's limited capacity [inventory] in order to maximize their own profits, and gain Nash Equilibria in different interval about the wholesale price.

articleTitle: Stock Replenishment Policies in a Distributed Supply Chain with Competing Retailers
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We investigate stock-replenishment problem in a distributed one-warehouse-n-retailer supply chain, in which warehouse supplying single product to n competing retailers. Each retailer intends to maximize his payoff. The profit rate per unit at retailers depends on stock available at warehouse, which replenishes his inventory from an exterior resource with ample supply. At the beginning of each period, stock at warehouse is finite, ordering strategy of each retailer has impact on other retailers. We characterize coordination solution to this distributed system with a Nash equilibrium. That is : retailers are decision makers and warehouse acts as a supervisor. When retailers replenish their stock in a Nash equilibrium, each can maximize own profit while pondering other retailers. Mathematical model for this n-retailer game is constructed. And at last, we prove that there exist only one equilibrium in this game.

articleTitle: The Community Structure of Information Content in Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the mobile Internet, information users are facing with the conflict between the extensive information and the limited resources such as time, devices, and so on. To get the relative information content, we used the community structure theory about complex network to analyze the k-clique information content, and reduce the retrieving range.

articleTitle: Better Risk Response Method Based on Neural Network and Framework Reasoning in Aircraft Assembly Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The expert judgment risks respond method used now in aircraft assembly project need to be improved for its subjectivity and complication. To make it more effective and reliable, we proposed an improved method that integrated neural network with framework reasoning. Firstly, basing on frame theory, we stored experts' experiences about risk response in the expert system repository by the rule that there were mapping relations between solutions and risk factors. Secondly, the neural network was trained to obtain the knowledge in the form of weight. When using, we got the response solution for the risk by reasoning and matching the output of the neural network with the knowledge in repository. It gives attention to the coupling of all risk factors to avoid the loss of information and also can simulate the expert thinking exactly to advance the project management ology level of aircraft assembly. This method had been replied in a certain airplane design project, the application illustrated the feasibility and validity of our method.

articleTitle: Designing a RFID Program for Improved Supplier Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to design and implement a successful RFID program has been at heart of RFID adoptions, especially when industry reports have found mixed results of RFID programs. In this paper, we study RFID adoption in the context of supplier management, and develop an incentive mechanism that outlines the optimal structure of the RFID program under various scenarios. We find that a successful design of a RFID program is dependent on the cost of mismatched supplier, the prior probability of the supplier's type, and the supplier's own diffusion level. The higher cost of mismatched suppliers motivates the retailer to offer higher compensation to the supplier in developing the RFID program. When the diffusion level of the RFID within the supplier is high the retailer needs to offer high compensation to the supplier to induce great effort in the RFID program. Finally, the prior probability of the supplier influences the retailer's compensation and the success of the program in different ways dependent on the interaction of the cost of mismatched low and high suppliers. Managerial implications and further research directions are also discussed.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Model of Hierarchical Sensor Uncertainty Coordination Based on MAS and RST
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, focusing on the idea of establishing a more coherent and robust sensor uncertainty management framework, we first suggest that different levels of sensor data uncertainties need to be evaluated and organized into a hierarchy. In particular, in consideration of the potential of distributed coordination among sensor nodes due to the inherent association between wireless sensor networks and multi-agent systems, also in a rough set technique sense under imprecision and partial truth, we further present an adaptive model of hierarchical sensor uncertainty coordination, which includes local data fusion, global and rational decision, along with conflict resolution. Experimental results of an example case study of our proposed approach demonstrate the practical application to the certainty improvement of noisy sensor readings.

articleTitle: Phase Rotation Modulation Technique for MISO OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to the time variation and frequency offset of mobile radio channels of the OFDM system, the orthogonality between sub-carriers will be destroyed. In this paper, a novel phase rotation technique is proposed in MISO OFDM system, which can suppress the inter-carrier interference (ICI) efficiently. This new method can get the minimum of sub-carrier interference in frequency domain by rotating the phase properly on different transmit antenna at each sub-carrier. Simulation results are given to show the performance of this new scheme.

articleTitle: Study on Product Quality Cooperation Control of Remote Manufacturing Based on Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the network manufacture, it makes more difficult and complex for the product quality control of remote manufacturing because of the diversity of product, the universality of information and the higher requirement of user to the product, especially the diversity of accessories which compose of the product. This paper discuss the necessity of the product quality coordination control and the remote manufacture, bring forward the exchange manner about the quality information of the product quality coordination control system. User interface and the system structure of the quality coordination control and also discuss the realization technology of this system. This method provides a control mode and design of the product quality of remote manufacturing.

articleTitle: Symbol Error Rate of MPSK with Multihop Regenerative Relays
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we investigate multihop communication systems with regenerative relays over Nakagami fading channels and propose a simple approach for performance evaluation. Relaying terminals and destination terminal are assumed to adopt coherent detection. Based on the characteristic of M-ary Phase-Shift Keying (MPSK) constellation modulation signals, symbol error rate (SER) expressions are derived for N hops. Near-Optimal power allocation (N-OPA) strategy is also analyzed to further improve performance for multihop with single antenna per terminal. Then, we extend single terminal to multiple terminals in each relaying tier to form virtual antenna arrays (VAAs). Hence, distributed space-time block codes can be deployed in multihop wireless networks. Finally, some numerical results are provided to prove our theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Approach for Quality Prediction in Yarn Manufacture
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although many works have been done to construct prediction models on yarn processing quality, the relation between spinning variables and yarn properties has not been established conclusively so far. Support vector machines (SVMs), based on statistical learning theory, are gaining applications in the areas of machine learning and pattern recognition because of the high accuracy and good generalization capability. This study briefly introduces the SVM regression algorithms, and presents the SVM based system architecture for predicting yarn properties. Model selection which amounts to search in hyper- parameter space is performed for study of suitable parameters with grid-research method. Experimental results have been compared with those of ANN models. The investigation indicates that in the small data sets and real-life production, SVM models are capable of remaining the stability of predictive accuracy, and more suitable for noisy and dynamic spinning process.

articleTitle: Recruitment's Support to Innovation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Inspection on job seekers' challenging spirit and aptitude - innovation can help to screen out innovative talents. Kuck curve and Katz curve suggest that dismissing all is more innovative for internal recruitment. While external recruitment favors new and fresh techniques to attract & gather innovative talents, i.e. mutual attraction between new ones. Then prosperous situation of innovation would be formed. This paper also proposed systematic basic model of upper growth limit through recruitment, pointing out that recruitment efficacy's complete release requires other management measure' assistance.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Evolution Model of Service Firms Based on Hotelling Competition
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to find the dynamic evolution process and its affecting factors, this paper set up a dynamic evolution model of two firms. We find that the market share of each firm is not only decided by its own price, waiting time and quality initially, but also by its competitor's price, waiting time, quality and the consumer's satisfactory degree. We also tested the model's validity through simulation by an example. In the end we draw some conclusion and give some advice to the service firm.

articleTitle: Pulse Shaping for Ultra-Wideband Communications
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to enable ultra-wideband (UWB) spectral mask compatibility and provide simple hardware implementation, novel pulse shaping methods based on orthonormal Hermite functions are proposed to enable the pulses to fulfill given spectral mask. Simulation results show that the proposed method can be used to obtain pulses that fulfill the FCC spectral mask, optimize transmission power spectrum, and realize simple hardware implementation as well.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement of Grey Relation Analysis Method Based on Ideal Points
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the traditional grey relation analysis method, the relational grade between two sequences can be expressed by dividing the relational coefficient by its average value, But this is not rational, because each sequence does not have the same value, different factors may have different levels of significance. So the varied weights are considered when calculating the grey relational grades instead of using the same weights for all factors in some papers , But this is also not rational ,because this method does not consider ideal point of the grey relational grade .In this paper, ideal point method VIKOR is used to grey relation analysis, the concept of closeness level of ideal point method VIKOR and relating level of grey system theory is adopted to compute the distance of each comparative factor with the ideal point and negative ideal point. The relevance between comparative factor and reference sequences is evaluated. The weight of VIKOR algorithm is determined by AHP. At last, This GRA based on ideal point methods is applied to a municipal wastewater treatment plant. Case study results indicate that this method is scientific.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Safety Strategy for Power Electricity-Driven Equipment on Vessels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyses the practical faults existing in large power electricity-driven equipment of vessels, and discusses safety strategy and driven control system optimization. The reliability is designed both in hardware and software respectively. It is of high effect that the fault tolerant is used as the non-key fault control. Moreover, the embedded system is succeeded in vessel's control system, which also involves EMI prevent method and trouble diagnosis technology. Finally the investigated technology has applied on real control systems of the vessels successfully.

articleTitle: Option Pricing Procedure for Venture Investment Projects in Case of Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Presently, many fruitful researches have been conducted in the field of venture capital investment. A great variety of writings can be found on valuation indicator system of venture projects, venture investment project pricing, and game issues arising from the venture capital investment process, etc. However, there are seldom researches which introduce the incomplete-information-game thinking to venture investment project pricing. Therefore, this paper presents an assessment indicator system of venture investment project including several critical indicators, based on which a real option pricing model is introduced. And then the incomplete-information-game theory is adopted so as to construct a procedure system for venture investment project pricing in case of incomplete information. Ultimately, the results are obtained and interpreted, and issues to be covered in further researches are suggested.

articleTitle: Two Iterative Algorithms for Nondata_aided Channel Estimation in DS_UWB System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, two iterative algorithms for NDA (nondata_aided) channel estimation are introduced to the DSJJWB system. The two iterative algorithms are named MMSE (minimum-mean-square-error) iterative algorithm and NMMSE(nonminimum-mean-square-error) iterative algorithm. The BER performances of the MRC Rake receiver with the two iterative algorithms are verified and compared via simulations. The simulation results show that the MMSE iterative algorithm performs better than NMMSE iterative algorithm for NDA channel estimation.

articleTitle: Soft Systems Methodology Based on Decision Making Knowledge Integration
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Checkland's soft systems methodology (SSM) has been successfully employed to solve organizational semi-structured and unstructured problems. It is faced with the challenges of cognitive biases, misused mental models and frames. After analyzing the features of the decision making theories based on normative and descriptive paradigms, this paper builds up an integrated decision making knowledge system to provide full support to decision process and then put forward an improved SSM.

articleTitle: Novel Blind Equalization Algorithm for Sparse Digital Wireless Communication Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sparse channels are often encountered in many highspeed digital wireless communication applications. In this paper, a novel blind equalization algorithm is proposed that exploits the sparseness nature of the channel, leading to considerable computational savings. The proposed equalizer based on the mechanism of sparse processing belongs to the family of recursive super-exponential equalizers, which has the superiority in good convergence performance to the desired solution. As a result, both less complexity and faster convergence rate are achieved by this approach. The performance of the new algorithm is tested in Computer simulation, and the simulation result shows its efficiency.

articleTitle: A Study on the Signaling Mechanism of Corporate Reputation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The asymmetric information universally exists in the market, especially for consumers' complex purchase behavior, the difficulty of comprehending the intrinsic attributes of the product would induce "adverse select" behavior. As the accumulative asset of a company, the formation of reputation is path-dependent, so reputation can represent the consistent quality of the product, and help consumers make right decision on product quality with lower searching costs under information asymmetry condition. Based on an empirical investigation in the notebook market, this paper would analyze the signaling mechanism and the impact on consumer's behavior of corporate reputation, and then provide advice to corporate reputation management. In the end the paper would summarize the future research.

articleTitle: Real Option Exercise Games Under Different Information and Market Structures
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the firm's optimal preemption timing and its perfect Bayesian investment equilibrium. The research shows that the optimal investment is between NPV threshold and the monopoly's optimal strategy; the value of real options can be eroded by competition white the introduction of incomplete information weakens the erosion, which indicates waiting is valuable even in very drastic preemption competition.

articleTitle: A Manager Framework of Supply Chain Operational Reference Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is very necessary for supply chain operational managers to adopt robust and practicable design and evaluation tools. Many researchers focused on high level strategic aspects of supply chain design whose results are usually generic guidelines for business executives rather than specific tools for operational managers. In this paper, a decision-based framework for supply chain operational managers is presented and can be used to select suppliers, and so on. The methodology combines the techniques of analytic hierarchy process and preemptive goal programming. The performance metrics based on supply chain operational reference model level I are incorporated into the proposed model as the decision criteria. Additionally, a set of performance metrics is developed to evaluate the overall supply chain effectiveness, allowing direct comparison of different supply chain designs for operational managers.

articleTitle: On the Capacity of Linear Precoder and Decoder in Semi-Correlated MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: MIMO system has been proven to provide more capacity than conventional SISO system, which is linear increase with the number of minimum transmit and receive antennas. But it is true only in independent conditions, when the spatial fading correlation exists, the capacity may be different. Linear precoder and decoder enable optimal allocation of power and bits over the spatial and temporal domain, depend on the channel conditions. Based on the two criterions, Maximum information rate and Minimum Mean Square Error, the optimal MIMO capacity is deduced and shown that the optimum linear precoder and decoder diagonalize the MIMO channel into eigen subchannels. Effect of the correlation on the capacity of both MIMO and linear precoder is also analyzed. Simulation shows that the linear precoder is more robust than that of MIMO system with no preceding.

articleTitle: Organizational Learning and Knowledge Conversion in the Heavy-Weight Teams
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The "heavy-weight team" organization is effective for key projects, and has already been widely used both at home and abroad, especially for the R&D key projects. During the executing process, a pivotal issue of the "heavy-weight team" is how the tacit knowledge could be quickly and successfully diffused and learnt among the team. This paper takes the projects that used the "heavy-weight team" organization (including the largest R&D projects at CNPC until now - GeoEast) of China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) as an example, discusses the conversion process of tacit knowledge and explicit knowledge as well as the organizational learning in the project management and the knowledge management when finishing the project. Finally, the new pattern of organization learning of the "heavy-weight team" is brought forward.

articleTitle: Secure and Efficient Membership Control for Ad Hoc Groups
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The group membership dynamics and the lack of online trusted dealer make the secure membership control become an open challenge in ad hoc groups. The paper proposes a secure and efficient ID-based membership control scheme, which is non-interactive and verifiable in GMC issuance. Compared with other proposed solutions, the verifiability is only achieved in schemes using threshold DSA signature before, but which is interactive. The simulation results show the performance of proposed scheme is better than other solutions, especially in the hostile environment.

articleTitle: The Design of Registry Service for Remote Sensing Data Processing Software Based on Grid Computing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Grid computing can create a computing environment handling PetaBytes of distributed data, tens of thousands of heterogeneous computing resources and thousands of simultaneous users from many research institutions. Developing new remote sensing data processing software based on grid computing (RSDPS-G) has been a trend. The registry service is an essential component in RSDPS-G for sharing and interoperating huge volume distributed remote sensing data, as well as publishing and querying services. The registry service is also a key component for workflow-based virtual remote sensing data products. We propose to build a registry service based on monitoring & discovery system (MDS4) which is a module of globus toolkit (GT4). It can be integrated seamlessly with the services in GT4 and make it easy for geospatial Web services/remote sensing data and services registered into the grid.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Bidding with Base Price in Construction Projects
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In China, the bidding mechanism with base price is still widely used in construction projects nowadays. The aim of this paper, with help of game theory, is to analyze the bidding which has the base price and regards the inviter as one of the participants in construction projects. Firstly, a brief description of the bidding process based on game theory is presented. The paper then deeply analyzes bidding decisions according to two different circumstances: on condition that costs of bidders become common knowledge and on condition that bidders can only get incomplete information. It is found that, in the former circumstance, bidders need to consider costs and should make an estimate of the base price when there is no significant difference among their costs. However, in the latter circumstance, if bidders' costs are estimated lower than the base price, they could decide the equilibrium bidding strategies themselves. Finally, the paper closes with recommendations and applicative conditions of the bidding strategies.

articleTitle: Study on Comparisons between Information Grid and Knowledge Grid
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information/knowledge flowing, spreading and sharing gain increasing concerns among crossover disciplines. With the promotion of technology and hardware for Internet and World Wide Web, especially the appearance of grid technology, information/knowledge flowing and island become a key issue of informatics research. How to reasonably use information or knowledge resources in distributed systems or environments, how to reduce information or knowledge redundancy, and how to eliminate information or knowledge asymmetry become the focus of information service development research. This paper introduces basic concepts and literature reviews of Information Grid (IG) and knowledge grid (KG), explores key protocols and models in IG and KG, compares IG with KG, and prospects the future of IG and KG development.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Provincial TV Station Device Management System Based on Sub Domain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on sub domain management, a new system for management of multi-channel radios and television devices is designed and implemented by Radio and TV Group of Zhejiang province. And this system realizes every business connection and guarantees standardization and high efficiency of management for every flow of program. And it provides powerful safeguard on cost accounting, resources configuration and assisting the leaders to make decisions. Through performance analysis of the system, the device realizes cost-management of seventeen channels and one department with higher efficiency and lower cost compared to the other management systems.

articleTitle: Effect of Administrative Culture on Performance of E-Government
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We construct and test a theoretical model to investigate correlation between administrative culture and e-government performance. The hypothesis was tested using survey data from governments that have implemented e-government more successfully. Result from canonical correlation analysis suggests that administrative culture is related strongly with performance of e-government. So we conclude that administrative culture is one of the most notable factors influencing e-government result.

articleTitle: Alamouti Multiuser MIMO OSUC Detection and Antenna Selection
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The existing uplink multi-user detection algorithm based on maximizing signal-to-noise-plus-interference-ratio (SINR) doesn't take full advantage of the system diversity benefit. A new order successive user cancellation (OSUC) detection algorithm is presented in this paper. However, OSUC suffers from error propagation especially with few receive antennas (RF chains). antenna selection (AS) technology is introduced into OSUC detection for the low hardware cost. Simulations show OSUC detection algorithm outperforms the existing detection algorithm. For OSUC detection with receive AS, it achieves almost all the diversity benefit of a full complexity system utilizing all receive antennas when the number of selected antennas is not under 2(P - 1) +1.

articleTitle: Link Adaptive Techniques of OFDM-Based Wireless System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the channel's fading characteristics, power control, adaptive modulation and coding (AMC), and auto request retransmission (ARQ) techniques for link adaptive are systematically studied for OFDM-based wireless systems in this paper. Furthermore, simulations and analyses are performed by combing these link adaptive techniques with PF scheduling algorithm. It is shown that there are sufficient performance improvements for system throughput and time delay when these link adaptive techniques are applied.

articleTitle: Frequent Subtree Based Indexing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Frequent patterns in a database can provide information on how to build efficient indexing structures for the databases. A new indexing method, called discriminative, frequent subtree_based indexing, first generates all frequent subtrees, and select discriminative subtrees among them as indexing features, then translates subtrees in the feature set into sequences, and holds them in a prefix tree. Frequent substructure explore the intrinsic characteristics of the data and are relatively stable to database updates. Discriminative, frequent subtree_based indexing can improve dramatically the performance of subtree search.

articleTitle: Implementing E-Supply Chain Management in Enterprises: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: E-supply chain management (e-SCM) realizes the optimum of information flow, capital flow and logistics. This paper focuses on the strategies for enterprises to implement e-SCM and a specific case study is provided which highlight how eCommerce, and specifically the E-supply chain management, have become central to a number of activities in enterprises.

articleTitle: Accurate Union-Bound for LDPC Block Codes Concatenated with Linear Dispersion Block Codes
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The use of turbo-like codes, such as LDPC or turbo codes, over the MIMO channel has recently gained significant interests. In this paper, a computationally efficient maximum- likelihood union-bound framework is proposed for the analysis of the concatenated coding scheme. Our method provides efficient and fast union bound analysis framework.

articleTitle: A Study on Evaluation of Consumer Credit's Risks of Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Consumer credit plays an important role in pulling the growth of economy, improving living standard of the people, as well as increasing profits of commercial banks. But the studies on the management of consumer credit's risks are still in the exploring phase. In order to provide some references for banks, this paper is composed. Firstly, credit risk is analyzed and identified, 12 indexes as the main influencing factors are chosen and quantified, and evaluating model is established through weighted average. Then, British commercial banks' historical data of the ratio of bad debts are used for reference to form the testing model of connecting credit grade scores with expectation ratio of bad debts. Finally, based this testing model, evaluating model of credit risk is tested and adjusted.

articleTitle: Cross-Layer Design with Opportunistic Scheduling in Multi-Service Cooperative Transmission Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A cross-layer scheduling mechanism with opportunistic consideration is proposed for the multi-service cooperative transmission networks, in which the multiple idle nodes act as relays to facilitate the active link communication. In the proposed scheme, the scheduler in the MAC layer of the access point not only exploits the multi-user diversity based on the channel condition feedback from each node, but also considers the priority of various services and the fairness of the individual links. The simulation results explicitly verify our expectation that the proposed scheme can meet the diverse quality-of-service (QoS) requirements of the different types of services without compromising the overall network efficiency and fairness.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Performance Appraisal and Organizational Citizenship Behavior: The Mediating Role of Organizational Commitment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The authors in this paper developed and tested a structural model in which organizational commitment mediates between performance appraisal and organizational citizenship behavior. The main findings are as follows. Firstly, performance appraisal including system and process facets had significant effect on organizational commitment. Secondly, organizational commitment leads to organizational citizenship behavior. Thirdly, organizational commitment plays fully mediating role between performance appraisal system and organizational citizenship behavior, and plays partially mediating role between performance appraisal process and organizational citizenship behavior.

articleTitle: Innovation of Managerial Organization Based on e-Commerce Environment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays, after human turn into 21st century, electronic commerce has gradually become one of the main internationally new styles of economic activities and it will bring great important influences to China's economic development and the innovation of managerial organization. This paper introduces the contents and characters of electronic commerce. It also analyzes the main mode of the innovation of managerial organization based on electronic commerce environment and discusses the principles that the innovation of managerial organization must be followed.

articleTitle: Cement/Formation Interface System and its Effect on the Petroleum Engineering
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The cementation quality of cement/formation interface system (CFIS) is one of the most urgent problem, which need to be resolved in petroleum engineering. The structure and compositions of the CFIS are analyzed, and the status change model and dynamic damage model of the CFIS are established. At two aspects of the oil field exploitation and fluid migration, the effects of the isolation invalidity of the CFIS are studied, and the importance of the solution to the problems is discussed. The study revealed that must be set about at systematic angles, and the bond problems of the CFIS can be to resolved fundamentality. Otherwise, the complex issue is insistent with the cementing field for a long period.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Feedback Control Scheme for Resource Allocation in Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel control-theoretic scheme is presented for resource allocation in wireless ad hoc networks based on virtual price. The degree of congestion on a wireless link can be symbolized an aggregate virtual price along a route, which depends mostly on the wireless node's queue occupancy. This approach adopts an adaptive approach to control the transmission rate at the source, named ASR controller. The object is to optimize the resource allocation dynamically through the transmission rate adjustment and stabilized the queue size of wireless links. The basic control theory approach for the algorithm is been presented, specifically z-transmission and Jury stability are used to achieve the stability. The performance of simulation indicates that the proposed scheme can achieve the goal of optimal channel capacity sharing among multi-hop flows and sharing bandwidth fairly.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing for Multi-Products in E-Retailing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the use of Q-learning approach to the problem of determining dynamic prices for multi-products in an e-retailing setting. In particularly, this article is concerned with the representation and generalization of large state spaces in Q-learning problems. We proposed a Q-learning model that is based on the self-organizing map, and validate our approach in simulated test.

articleTitle: Symmetrical Bernstein Copula and the Empirical Analysis of Foreign Exchange
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the foreign exchange data whose dependence structure is approximate symmetry, such as Euro/Pound (euro/pound) and Dollar/Pound ($/pound). It fits their dependence structure by symmetrical Bernstein Copula, and estimates the marginal densities through Kernel density. Under the triangular no-arbitrage condition, the univariate distribution of Dollar / Euro ($/euro) exchange rate implied by the bivariate distribution of these two exchange rates is consistent with the univariate distribution which is estimated by the Kernel density.

articleTitle: Process-Based Supply Chain Resources Descriptive Model and Knowledge Representation Based on XML
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to realize the integration and sharing of the enterprise resources information in supply chain, and improve the synthesis competition of the whole supply chain. This paper analyzes the supply chain resources in terms of process, sets up the process-based supply chain resources descriptive model, and applies to XML to form a knowledge representation model. In the end, we set up a process-based supply chain resources information management system, and make research on the structural frame, function modules and the key technology for this system. It not only realizes the integration and sharing of the enterprise resources information in supply chain, but also establishes a basis for the supply chain to respond to the market in time.

articleTitle: Interaction Between Strategic Commitment to Price and Downstream Innovation in Time Sensitive Markets
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we examine the interaction between strategic commitment to price and downstream innovation, and the relatively downstream innovation, pricing, and the optimal quoted delivery time for the channel operates in a make-to-order fashion. We use this analysis to show how the performances of the time-sensitive channel are affected by the interaction between full commitment and full flexibility.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Resource Allocation Algorithm Based On MIMO-OFDM Frame Structure
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: By applying the effective bandwidth theory of wireline network on wireless domain, a cross-layer resource allocation algorithm based on MIMO-OFDM time-frequency frame structure is introduced. This algorithm not only concerns the channel state information in the physical layer, but also pays attention to priority, fairness and delay quality of service (QoS) at the date link layer, which would be more effective compared to the conventional layered structure. From statistic point of view in this paper, the relationship among delay QoS, channel state information, resource allocation is researched, and the complete description step is put forward. Simulation results show that this algorithm can improve the spectrum efficiency, and the complication is well situated. It is a feasible scheme.

articleTitle: On the Reduction of Broadcast Traffic in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Many mobile ad hoc network protocols use simple flooding, in order to adapt to changes in time varying network topology. Most of the times, a network-wide flood results in redundant packets and increases network congestion, probability of packet collision, low utilization of available bandwidth, and most important, higher power consumption. In this paper, we propose a new cross-layer broadcast scheme to minimize broadcast traffic in mobile ad hoc networks. Our scheme is based on use of received signal strength indicator, RSSI, value to reduce the number of broadcast packets. The effectiveness of the proposed technique is verified using simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Authorization in Workflow of Virtual Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Virtual Enterprise has features of distribution and dynamic, which bring some problems of information security. It is an important research subject for access control of data in virtual enterprise workflow management system. Based the traditional ORBAC (organization and role based access control) model, the authorization strategy is introduced to realize synchronization between authorization flow and workflow. It presents the types of authorization constraint and collision detecting rules avoiding the execution-interruption problem brought by constraint collision.

articleTitle: Research on Locating Unit Initial Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Getting location information of an unknown mobile node is a key point of locating service in the ubiquitous computing environment. The errors due to locating an triangular domain is studied. And the following fact was found: the locating accuracy can be greatly improved by taking equilateral triangles as the fundamental locating unit. Based on the finding, a new physical property parameter of coverage, coverage base, is defined and introduced for the first time. And, the distribution issue between locating units is also studied, as a result, the theorem of coverage base about distribution of locating unit is proposed in minimum error condition. The simulation tests indicate that the locating unit initial sensitivity theorem (LUIS) can meet the requirement of ubiquitous terminal's real-time localization and possesses the preferable localization precision.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of the Initial Emission Permits Allocation on Market Power
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper offers an analytical model of emission permit markets in which a large number of regulated emitter participate, and derives formulae that shows the entire dependence of the emergence of market power on the permit initial distribution as well as the existence of a threshold for effective market power. Furthermore, the model we derived yields formulae that estimate how much permit prices in such distorted markets depart from competitive levels. These findings not only show the significance of initial emission permits but also are available for emission trading.

articleTitle: An Efficient Detection Algorithm for Algebraic Coded V-BLAST Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The V-BLAST multiple antenna architecture is a well- known method for achieving high spectral efficiency over a rich-scattering environment. In V-BLAST systems, detection is performed layer by layer in a successive way. However, due to error propagation, the system performance is largely constrained by the accuracy of the lower layers detected first. In order to improve the performance of the low layers, in this paper, we give an algebraic coded V-BLAST scheme, which employs algebraic code in the lower layers of V-BLAST systems. At the receiver, an efficient detection algorithm which combines list sphere decoder and sorted QR decomposition successive interference cancellation is proposed. Simulation results show that the new detection method significantly outperforms the conventional ZF-VBLAST and MMSE-VBLAST schemes.

articleTitle: A New Technique for Improving the Performance of OFDM Systems with Residual Carrier Frequency Offset
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) is a promising transmission technique for future wireless communication systems. However, OFDM is very sensitive to carrier frequency offset (CFO). And for an OFDM system with CFO estimation and compensation, the residual CFO will always degrade the system performance. To alleviate this problem, in this paper, a new technique is proposed to estimate and compensate the residual CFO in single OFDM symbol, so as to improve the system performance. Furthermore, since the proposed technique is based on the utilizing of the cycle prefix (CP) in single OFDM symbol, it will not cause additional loss of spectrum efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Choice of Patent Strategy in Chinese Enterprises' Independent Innovation Process
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article studies the choice of patent strategy along with the process of independent innovation in Chinese enterprises. Starting with the introduction of the background of independent innovation, it analyzes its meaning for Chinese enterprises, establishes a four-phase process model for it, and then discusses the particularity of independent innovation process for Chinese enterprises. Meanwhile, with a summary of the concept and content of enterprise patent strategy, this article works on the significance of independent innovation for enterprise patent strategy, and as well proposes choice principles and candidate matrix in this process of independent innovation.

articleTitle: Study on Cost Control of Enterprise Reverse Logistics Based on the Analysis of Cost Drivers
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the prosperity of reverse logistics recent years, the cost control of the reverse logistics is to be more and more valued by enterprise's managers. In this paper, the authors firstly analyze the status of reverse logistics nowadays as an explanation why reverse logistics should be valued. Then, through the discussion on the relevant factors resulting in high reverse logistics cost, and the main reasons why it is difficult to control, the authors establish an optimized cost model of reverse logistics to show which steps should be paid more attention.

articleTitle: Error Probability Computation for Orthogonal STBC Over Correlated Rayleigh Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Orthogonal space-time block coding (STBC) is a useful means to combat multi-path fading in wireless communications, whose performance analysis has been done by a lot of articles. This paper first proposes a simple algorithm to calculate the probability density function of the equivalent signal to noise ratio for orthogonal STBC over correlated Rayleigh fading channels. Then the closed-form expressions for symbol error rate of linear modulation are derived. Compared with the conventional Monte Carlo experiments, the new method can significantly reduce the simulation time.

articleTitle: The Research of Coverage Control and Clusters Optimizing Based on Grid in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The research of coverage control in wireless sensor network is one of the most important problems. In this paper, we have proposed the key-points in coverage control, and analyzed mainly the coverage control and clusters-optimizing of WSN based on grid. By analyzing the coverage probability, we have obtained any relationship between coverage probability, clusters and the loss of coverage-area in detecting-area of particular condition, so as to deploy the nodes. At the end experiment results are given to display our application.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study of Inter-Organizational Relationship in Condition of Environmental Uncertainty: from View of Information Processing Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With changing of environmental uncertainty, inter-organizational coordination and IT support is becoming a trend. Basing on information processing theory (IPT) and empirical studies in 2 large-scale shipbuilding and 4 large-scale automobile companies, this paper explored relationship of environmental uncertainty, inter-organizational coordination, inter-organizational IT support and coordination effectiveness. Managerial implications of the IPT and inter-organizational information systems are also discussed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An Analysis on Influential Factors of Service Economy Development in Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Frequency-Domain Channel Estimation and Tracking Schemes for Space-Time Coded OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Two channel estimation and tracking schemes for space-time coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems are proposed in frequency domain. Since the processing are all made in frequency domain, the computational complexity of the proposed schemes is reduced dramatically compared with the time-domain scheme. The two proposed schemes both use STBC-pattern training symbols during the training period. During the data transmission period, the first proposed scheme use the decision-directed tracking algorithm, and the second proposed scheme use an iterative algorithm to track the channel variation. The two schemes both can improve the system performance, and the second scheme can bring more performance gain even with small iteration times. The performances of the proposed schemes are demonstrated by computer simulation in the typical indoor channel.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Agent Based SC Production Planning Decomposition Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper sums up the character of production planning based on SCM, and these characters are: distribution, autonomy, cooperation and synchronization. Then, the paper introduces the conception of agent and multi-agent, and also analyses the feasibility and necessity of applying multi-agent technology to SC production planning system. Based on the analysis, a new production management organization model based on multi-agent is proposed, and the decomposition of SC production planning is also studied in the end.

articleTitle: Identification of Feedback Logic for m-Sequence Based on Competitive Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A method was proposed to identify the triple-correlation function (TCF) of an m-sequence by competitive network, thus to get its feedback logic. The method avoids possible error caused by identifying code element one by one in noise surroundings. First, get the TCF of an m-sequence. Then, input it into a competitive network to get the winning. The output of the victorious neuron remembers the primitive polynomial by the memorial network. That is the feedback logic of the resequence. Finally, computer simulation was made to identify resequences of different signal-noise-ratio (SNR). The simulation results proved the method to have strong-noise immunity.

articleTitle: A Study of Two-Dimensional Reservation MAC Protocol for Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The efficiency of slotted-ALOHA scheme is upper limited by 37%. However, it is very easy to implement. To increase system efficiency, code division multiple accessing (CDMA) technique can be adopted in ALOHA scheme. This paper studies a medium access scheme, utilizing two dimensional reservations: time dimension and code dimension. The reservation rate and collision rate are analyzed theoretically. Simulation results are given under ideal channel condition and noisy single-path Rayleigh channel condition. Theoretical analysis and simulation results demonstrate that the reservation rate is increased and collision rate is reduced due to the anti-collision advantage of CDMA code.

articleTitle: Process Capability Evaluation in Skew Distributed Processes Based on SWV Method
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Process capability analysis is an important quality tools in 6Sigma management. The calculating methods of standard capability indices in process capability assessment are based on the hypothesis that the distributions of process output are normal or approximate normal. There is a lot of practice cases in which the output isn't normal. Because the forms of these distributions are unknown, the results of evaluation may be misleading to a judgment about the processes. When the distribution is on the skew, the clements method is used after estimating the form of distribution by a lot of data from process output. With the not truly known distribution, there is big gap in the assessment result. Based on Scaled weighted variance method, some process capability indices formulas, which can be used in skew distribution, are established in the paper. The simulation study was done for comparison between the WV-based and SWV-based PCI.

articleTitle: Pilot Embedded Channel Estimation for OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we investigated both first-order statistics (FOS) and second-order statistics (SOS)-based channel estimators for PE-OFDM system, and proposed a novel channel estimator, which joint the FOS and SOS to estimate channel state information. Numerical simulation illustrate that the FOS-based approach outperforms the SOS-based approach, and the proposed joint estimator has better MSE and BER performance compared with the previous schemes which only use the first-order statistics or the second-order statistics.

articleTitle: Research on Strategic Behavior of Real Estate Firms Based on Option Game Under Asymmetric Competition Interaction
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper illustrates the use of real options valuation and game theory principles to analyze strategic behavior of the real estate firms under asymmetric competition interaction. Symmetrical option game model assumes the leader and the follower share market equally. So the demands and profits flow are equal for competitors. In fact, due to the competitive advantages and negative externality, the interaction between competitors is unequal. That is to say, the competitors won't share markets equally under asymmetric competition interaction. It brings the leaders positive or negative effects. In order to analyze the asymmetrical competition interaction, this paper introduces a demand coefficient to change the demands when the real estate firm preempting. It makes the demands and profits flow unequal. Then we discuss its effect on the threshold and option value of leaders and followers. From the numerical analysis, we can see, to real estate firms, the more competitive advantages the firm has, the earlier it will invest. It also brings more negative externalities and lowers the follower's investment threshold.

articleTitle: Combined Threshold Analysis of Safety Factors in Petrol-Refining Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Safety management is an eternal theme for petrol-refining enterprises. By the research of producing characteristics, safety management actuality and safety evaluation index system of petro-refining enterprises, safety evaluation model was put forward. Based of the model, each safety factor was quantified. According to the request of producing safety rank and each factor's single threshold, safety factors' combined threshold range were educed, which provide a safety decision making basis for petro-refining enterprises.

articleTitle: Dynamic Evaluation of Business Distress Risk Using Hazard Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Using non-paired sample, this paper applies logistic discrete-time hazard model to dynamically evaluate risk of company's business distress within the context of its industry. The results show sigma of company's stock returns, ownership concentration, company's size and assets-liabilities ratio are significantly related to business distress risk. By comparing the distressed company group and the healthy company group, we find among them, there exit significant difference in the dynamic behavior of survival rate and hazard rate. This graph display method can be used to predict "the likely time to distress".

articleTitle: QoS Based Media Access Control in a Class of Networked Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In some networked control systems (NCSs), the core computer roles the whole system, processes and schedules all the data transferred from the network nodes. Control networks construct the infrastructures of the NCSs. And, the working efficiency of the network communication is the key element of the entire system. The paper presents a novel media access control (MAC) approach with variable priority token passing based quality of service (QoS), in order to deal with the MAC issues in the NCSs. The mathematical analysis and experiments suggested that the presented approach has more efficiency and advantages than the CSMACD and standard token-passing manners.

articleTitle: Telecommunication Development and Regulatory Reforms in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: China has shown tremendous progress in the telecommunication industry in recent few years. In last decade teledensity has jumped from 6 to 66 till April 2007. China became the largest country of the world with maximum subscribers both in fixed and cellular sector. Cellular sector increased rapidly and an exponential increase has been seen in it. With all these achievements there are too much reforms to be needed in this sector, while new telecommunication Law has been drafted and is being debated. Recent developments in telecommunication industry of china are discussed and important reforms are suggested in this paper.

articleTitle: Online-Trade's Analysis of Decentralized Network Based on Cybermediary: A Case Study of Taobao.com
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The role and influence that cybermediaries play in transforming various market places is an important area for research. This paper presents an analysis of transaction cost during three important stages associated with online trading, and the benefits of a cybermediary (an intermediary) in open decentralized market models compared to direct exchanges. The TaoBao.com's practice is used to demonstrate that decentralized network models with cybermediary can be effective to reduce uncertainty, trade risk and recessive cost for e-commerce trading.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Managing Customer Services: Entrepreneurship in Hospitality Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Mismatched Detection of Turbo Block DFE Using Parallel Concatenated Scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A turbo-type scheme that uses parallel concatenation and turbo block decision feedback equalization (TBDFE) is proposed for transmission over linear intersymbol interference channels. The scheme can offer significant improvement in performance. The performance gain is even higher when the detector uses an imperfect channel estimate. In the case of SNR mismatch, both TBDFE and the conventional iterative block-based DFE (IBDFE) algorithms are more sensitive to SNR overestimation than underestimation.

articleTitle: The Influence of Network Externality on Technology Diffusion
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Network externality is one of the most important characteristics of information technology. The development of information technology is very fast, but not each technology innovation gets widely used because of the network externality. In this article, a utility model was constructed and analyzed based on network externality. And it was discussed which factors are important in the diffusion of technology innovation and how they influence the diffusion.

articleTitle: Research on Supply Chain Inventory Optimization and Benefit Coordination with Controllable Lead Time
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supply chain inventory optimization model with controllable lead time is proposed with considering the extra crashing cost of buyer and supplier caused by shortening lead time. The optimal economic lot size and lead time with and without cooperation are gained, and the algorithms for finding the optimal policy is developed. Shapely value and MCRS method are used to coordinate both parties' benefits, and the feasibility and efficiency of these models are manifested by numerical test.

articleTitle: The Influence of Product Knowledge on Online Purchase Intention on Creative Products: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since the explosion and popularity of online purchasing, understanding which consumers use this new distribution channel to buy creative product (e.g. clothing) is an important question for e-commerce managers and consumer theorists. Based on the empirical literature, a new model was established by using product knowledge as the outside factor of technology acceptance model (TAM). We focused on the validity of model and interrelations and influences between the variables. Conclusion and implications were discussed.

articleTitle: Study on the Network Relation Factors of Hi-Tech Enterprise's Location Choice
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the network relation factors that hi-tech enterprises concern in the choice of location. Using factor analysis to analyze the network relation factors, it gets 4 common factors; and using ANOVA to compare different enterprises' evaluations on network relation factors, the result shows that there is the significant difference on the evaluations of network relation factor.

articleTitle: Mining Customer preferences with ANN-DT
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the early stage of product design, mining customer preference is the key issue to the development of satisfactory products. This paper builds a preference model from a set of historical transaction to catch what customer wants in mass customization. An artificial neural-network decision tree algorithm (ANN-DT) is employed to model customer preference on different product families. It is able to extract with rules of customer preference with high fidelity. To illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, a case study of personal computers is reported.

articleTitle: Design of Variable Geocasting Based on Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile Ad-hoc networks have recently attracted a lot of attention in the research community as well as in industry. Although the previous research mainly focused on several of Ad-hoc in routing, we consider, in this paper, how to efficiently support applications such as variable Goocasting based on Ad-hoc networks. The goal of a geocasting protocol is deliver data packets to a group of nodes that are located within a specified geocasting region. Previous research that support geocast service in mobile computing based on Ad-hoc have the non-optimization problem of data delivery path, overhead by frequent reconstruction of the geocast tree, and service disruption problem. In this paper, we propose the mobility pattern based geocast technique using variable service range according to the mobility of destination node and resource reservation to solve this problem. The experimental results show that our proposed mechanism has improved performance of Accessibility & Network Overhead than previous research.

articleTitle: Key Information Systems Management Issues in China and USA: A Comparative Perspective
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, many western scholars and professional organizations such as SIM conducted numerous studies about the key issues that CIO's face currently or will be facing in the next three to five years. However, such issues have not been the focus in mainland China. The survey conducted recently by Li et al identified the key issues confronting the Chinese CIOs. This paper analyzes those survey results and compares them with other related surveys conducted by the SIM in 2004 and 2005. We concluded that the key issues in China today appear to be similar with those in the U.S. in 1990s. This paper also predicted the trends of the key issues of Information Systems in Mainland China in the next three to five years.

articleTitle: Automatic Business Coordination in Supply Chains Using Semantic Web Service Composition
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
