In simulations with speech signals degraded by noises, the proposed method shows improved performance over the traditional DCT method for a number of objective and subjective measures.

articleTitle: Positioning In a New Dynamic E-Commerce Business Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article develops a brand-new dynamic framework of e-commerce business models. Firstly the authors generalize three basic business modes based upon longitudinal perspective to business operations. Then, three strategic benefits of e-business were drawn out from many acknowledged studies. Finally, using two dimensions---Business Mode and Effect of Electronization, the authors identified seven basic e-commerce business models and revealed the way they may evolve along in a new dynamic framework. This is the key contribution of this article. By referring to the features of each E-commerce business model, a company can identify its position in the framework and find the right way to go further in choosing e-business models.

articleTitle: Interest Earliest Arrival First Directed Diffusion in WSNs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In directed diffusion a sensor node finds the next hop node from its neighbor nodes randomly in proportion to the gradients being created during interest diffusion. However, some alternative paths may contain redundant nodes, leading to energy waste. This paper proposes a simple approach to reinforce the path without redundant node. A node always selects the neighbor from which it first received Interest as the next hop node. And a dynamic energy threshold is adopted to balance nodes energy consuming by keeping the nodes with lower energy from being selected. Simulation results show this approach can achieve better performance in terms of energy saving and reliability in both single-sink-single-event and multi-sink-multi-event scenarios, respectively.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of the DoS Attack in Internet Service
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We develop a queueing model to study the system performance under the most prevalent SYN-flooding attack, with reference different parameters and different situations, such as arrival rate, traffic rate, and timeout period, the maximum capacity of system, the standard deviation and the distribution of the service time. By simulation, we obtain some effective quantitative measurements (e.g. loss probability of regular request, utility for regular request or attack, and utility for whole server) and analyze the performances of the server under various conditions.

articleTitle: Simulation for Correlated Rayleigh Fading Channels by FIR Pulse-Shaping Filtering
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper addresses a method for the generation of the correlated Raleigh distributed fast fading by FIR pulse- shaping filtering. The coefficients of FIR filter equal to the samples of the square root of the well-known U-shaped Power Spectral Density (PSD). An analysis of the statistical properties of FIR-based method for correlated sample generation is presented in detail. Simulation shows the approach is higher efficient and more straightforward than other correlated Rayleigh generation methods e.g. the well- known improved Jakes' Model proposed by Pop and Beaulieu.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Nodes-Cooperation Transmission in Unreliable Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to provide reliable transmission over unreliable wireless sensor links meanwhile keep energy efficiency is an interest challenge. In this paper, a novel nodes cooperation strategy in network layer for energy-efficient reliable transmission over unreliable-links is studied. The energy efficiency of sensor networks and its optimization with new transmission strategy are analyzed theoretically. The key idea of the proposed strategy is using multi nodes to receive packets simultaneously and relay packets competitively. Further theoretical and experimental analysis gives us some insights on the improvements in reliable transmission and energy efficiency that cooperation can bring to networks.

articleTitle: A Trace-Orthogonal Multi-User Space-Time Coding
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a trace-orthogonal space-time coding (TD-STC) for multi-user systems. Based on the flexibility of linear dispersive codes (LDC), we apply it to broadcast channels in multi-user systems. According to the transmission rates of user's, we adaptively construct the transmitting space-time coding matrix. At the same time, we give the design criterion of the space time coding for multi-user systems. At the receiver, exploiting the characteristic of trace orthogonal, the complexity of decoder based on MMSE criterion will not increase apparently. Compared with orthogonal space-time coding (OSTC), our proposed TD-STC can greatly decrease the complexity of ML decoding instead of little performance loss. When in the lower SNR, the proposed scheme is better than the scheme when applying orthogonal space-time coding.

articleTitle: Government Acquisition Risk Evaluation Based on BP Neural Networks and Fuzzy Synthetic Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the basis of construction of government acquisition risk evaluation system, a risk evaluation model, which is based on BP artificial neural networks and fuzzy synthetic evaluation, is established, trained and simulated. The animation analysis indicates that the established model can be used to perform risk evaluation more directly and objectively. Thus, the results provide more reliable foundation for government acquisition risk evaluation.

articleTitle: Data Management of Aero Engine Turbine Design Integration System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the features of more computational efforts and high memory in the complicated design process of aero-engine turbine, a data management solution based on C/S network structure is presented. The version management of design data is completed by four components. COM technology is adopted in the functional implementation of each component. Incremental data storage is used in every design module, which minimizes data redundancy and maximizes data connectivity. In the scheme data management, three-layered version identification is designed and version combination based on restraint is presented. Large amount of data produced in the design process is managed effectively. Data reusability is enhanced and quality of design is improved.

articleTitle: Career Path and Ladder: Planning Career Development for Employees
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The emergence of "career plateau" phenomenon, along with the flattening of the enterprise hierarchy, correlates with the idea and mechanism of career development. It's the effective way of preventing and solving the problem of "career plateau" to construct the three-dimensional (3D) model of career development, to choose the rational career management target and management center, to design width, length and frequent ness of career ladder.

articleTitle: Analysis and Implementation of Adaptive Modem for SDR
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Software defined radio (SDR) is the future trend for mobile communication design. As the hardware merges into software gradually in communication system. A SDR is supposed to facilitate high speed multimedia application for future mobile standards. Adaptive modem forms an integral part of SDR system with robust and high data rate capability. In this paper we have analyzed adaptive modulation scheme and their performance in changing channel condition. The modulation scheme studied and analyzed for adaptive modem are BPSK, QPSK 16QAM 64 QAM. We have simulated a simplex communication for transmitting images consisting of adaptive modulation scheme to study the effect of adaptive modulation on system transmitting image. The analysis and implementation of the proposed system is done using MATLAB7 simulation tool.

articleTitle: Providing QoS Guarantee for Real-Time Service in Wireless OFDM Networks with Effective Capacity Method
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Most of the QoS guarantee algorithms in wireless OFDM network are confined to a single layer optimization of the network protocol stack, which leads to an inefficient computational performance. In this paper, a novel QoS provision algorithm is proposed. It evolves effective capacity model which captures the effect of channel fading on the queuing behavior of the link, realizing a computationally simple way in QoS provisioning mechanism. Also different scheduling performance varies in such model. Numerical results will show that desired QoS constraints can be explicitly enforced, by utilizing the concept of effective capacity.

articleTitle: A Sector-Based Location Management Scheme for PCS Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on the problem of location update and terminal paging. In order to save the limited wireless channel resource, mobile terminals should not update their location information whenever they crossing the boundaries of adjacent cells. Similarly, network should not page every cell one by one when an incoming call arrives. In this paper, a sector-based location management scheme (SLMS) is proposed. In SLMS, we use sector-based location update scheme and sector-paging scheme. An analytical model is developed to calculate the cost and we compare the cost of SLMS with that of existing scheme. The numerical results show that our SLMS has a good performance when the number of incoming calls is high.

articleTitle: Determinants of E-Government Service Adoption: An Innovation Diffusion Perspective
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ranking the world's top E-Government Readiness in 2002, 2004, and 2005, Taiwan's experience in promoting e- government could provide worldwide governors a practical knowledge for planning and implementation. Further, given the e-government services, e.g. tax e-filing system (TEFS) can be seen as an innovation for taxpayers to adopt, Taiwan's experience has also become a sensible example in innovation marketing. This study used three diffusion models, i.e. external, internal, and mixed influence models, to reveal whether the diffusion of TEFS in Taiwan was affected by mass media advertising, interactions among acquaintances, or a combination of both. Findings indicated that the mixed influence model is the best fit, but acquaintances influence is the dominant factor. The authors therefore argue that governors should consider "Source-Strategy Fit", i.e. it is essential to understand TEFS' features and its influential sources when promoting the G2C e-government services. Only when the adequate marketing strategies are developed, the huge investments in building e-government infrastructure can bring about citizens' convenient digital life and government efficiency to the full.

articleTitle: A Study on Risk Measurements Exceeding VaR: TCE, CVaR and ES
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Because of VaR's limitations, three new risk measurements exceeding VaR were put forward, which are TCE, CVaR and ES. However, there is confusion about definitions of TCE, CVaR and ES and relationship between them. This article redefines TCE, CVaR and ES using terms system of return distribution, significance level and upper-quantile, and studies the relationship between them based on new definitions. The conclusion is that CVaR and ES are equivalent in any cases; TCE, CVaR and ES are equivalent when distributions of returns on risky securities are continuous.

articleTitle: Synergetic Development Analysis: between Logistics Service Providers and Manufacturing Clusters
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The synergetic development relationship between logistics service providers and manufacturing clusters is discussed in this paper based on the potential function of profit. The data analysis of the Shaoxing textile enterprise cluster's case is made to prove that both the cluster and logistic service providers can improve their production efficiency and profits through synergy, and the overall competition capability of the regional economy can also be promoted.

articleTitle: A Validation of End-User Computing Satisfaction Instrument in Group Decision Support Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The end-user computing satisfaction (EUCS) instrument developed by Doll and Torkzadeh is commonly used to evaluate the effectiveness of information systems. This instrument had been validated in different types of information systems before. It is a good tradition and practice to validate the EUCS instrument again before it is used for an invalidated type of information system. Group decision support systems (GDSS) have a potential to support and augment group decision making performance for business organizations. End-user satisfaction is one of the key factors influencing the adoption and diffusion of GDSS in organization. As a result, EUCS is one of the most important dependent variables that are being considered in GDSS research and practice. However, the EUCS instrument has not been specifically validated in GDSS. Therefore, this paper intends to bridge this gap by validating the EUCS instrument in GDSS.

articleTitle: The Model of Evolutionary Interleavers for IDMA Communication System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents the model of interleavers for the interleave-division multiple-access (IDMA) based on evolutionary algorithm. In all the previous works, interleavers are all generated independently and randomly which is simple but with good performance. Considered the difference between the model of interleavers and the traveling salesman problem(TSP), a specific fitness function based on covariance matrix is given and the optimum interleavers are computed by evolutionary algorithm. The simulation results show that the bit error ratio(BER) performance of the evolutionary interleavers(EI) is much better than other unrandom interleavers. The BER performance of independent and random interleavers is near to EI, it is a proof that EI is the theoretical optimum interleavers for IDMA.

articleTitle: A Framework of Knowledge Transfer Process in Expert System Development
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper offers a qualitative study on the process of knowledge transfer that focuses on the expert system development. Inter-disciplinary approach is applied to review, analyse and develop a framework for the process. A framework of knowledge transfer process is proposed as having: (1) interactive transfer process: knowledge acquisition, representation, assimilation and dissemination; and (2) a dynamic knowledge conversion and creation process for the explicit and tacit knowledge. A case study demonstrating the development of a group of aquaculture disease diagnosis systems is empirically studied for the verification of the process. As a result of the study's findings, the framework is proposed with its validity. The related implications and limitations of the study are also given.

articleTitle: Optimization of Knowledge Sharing & Transfer Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge sharing & transfer is a critical step for successful knowledge management, and constructing knowledge sharing & transfer network is an important approach to enhance the efficiency of knowledge sharing & transfer. Because of different sharing & transfer patterns of explicit knowledge and tacit knowledge, the methods to improve efficiency of knowledge sharing and transfer are different. This paper constructs knowledge sharing & transfer network in view of behaviors, analyzes mutual relations between network members and calculates the optimal knowledge transfer path. The general algorithm for shortest path - "Floyd" algorithm is used to optimize transfer path for explicit knowledge; social network analysis (SNA) is applied to analyze and optimize transfer path for tacit knowledge.

articleTitle: An Optimization Design for a Half-Closed-Loop Logistics Network with Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A two-echelon half-closed-loop logistics network system is founded for the issue of manufacturing logistics network design, including supply and return channels. Considering the integration of the uncertainty and cycle time of the demand quantities of products and the return rates of used products, sites selection of potential logistics centers, plants and recycling plants, and transshipment problem, a stochastic, multi-time-step, capacitated mixed integer linear programming model is presented, the objective function makes total costs including fixed costs, transportation costs and storage costs in logistics centers minimize. Since such network design problems belong to a class of NP hard problems, a genetic algorithm approach-based heuristic to this model is presented. Finally a numerical example is used to prove the model and genetic algorithm validity.

articleTitle: A BP Neural Network Approach on Risk Evaluation of Ventures in China Customs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the application of China's customs management information system (MIS), a great deal of data that reflects the activities of import and export ventures has been stored in the database. However, the risk management of ventures in China customs still depends on the personal analysis of customs staff, which lacks the necessary decision support information. On the basis of the data warehouse of risk management system, a BP neural network model, combined with Levengberg-Marquardt algorithm, is adopted and implemented by Matlab 7.0 for the ventures risk evaluation in China Customs. The simulation analysis of the evaluation model demonstrates that the algorithm can work effectively to perfect the quality of risk controlled by the customs.

articleTitle: Transmitter Design for MIMO Downlink System Using Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In a multi-user MIMO downlink system, due to the limitation on the number of transmit antennas, we consider employing zero-forcing beamforming (ZFBF) and oblique projection beamforming (OPBF) as the spatial multiplexing strategies when there are many users to be supported simultaneously. Based on the analysis of ZFBF and OPBF, we show these various linear transmitter designs that offer low complexity and high performance for the practical application, mitigating co-channel interference.

articleTitle: Posted Price Model Based on GRS and Its Optimization Using in Grid Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Grid computing is a promising technology for future computing platforms. Economy model is a different approach to realize resource allocation in grid computing. In the economy model of grid resource allocation such as commodity or posted price model, sharing resource is based on negotiating about the flat fee, usage duration or time, QoS and some other items between the provider and the consumer of grid resource. But it is impossible task for there is a great deal of grid resources and users in grid even in a virtual organization, and it will be unsatisfactory for its sharing efficiency. In this paper, the idea of GRS (grid resource supermarket) and its pricing strategy are introduced. An improvement of posted price model based on GRS and optimization based on MOGAP (multi-objects generalized assignment problem) are proposed. Our scheme can help to solve the problem in the previous description. In the end an example is given to show the feasibility of this scheme.

articleTitle: Spatial Dynamic Spectrum Allocation and Population Density
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a summary of some results on spatial dynamic spectrum allocation (DSA), in a flexible spectrum licensing environment. A realistic population density distribution scenario in conjunction with the spatial DSA is taken into account, to mitigate the spectrum wastage in terms of extra guard band. For the insertion of the extra guard band, an efficient strategy based on self assessment is applied by the each victim cell individually and independently. Consequently, it is no more required to spread the extra guard band over the whole DSA region. Simulation results show improvement for both the considered UMTS and DVB-T networks.

articleTitle: Technical Efficiency in Small Irrigation Project Management: An Empirical Analysis from Xinjiang Province in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the investigation data from 29 villages in Xinjiang of China, stochastic frontier production function is used to estimate the technical efficiency in small irrigation project management, and linear inefficient regression models are applied to explain the factors influencing the technical efficiency. The results showed that the technical efficiency in small irrigation project management in the province have yet to be improved to a large extent. The level of the technical efficiency differs in different economic & geographic regions as well as adopting different management modes. Increasing non-collective property, establishing water charge system and improving farmer's participation could contribute to improving the efficiency.

articleTitle: An Extended Dominance-Based Rough Set Approach to Group Decision
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we present a rough set approach to group decisions making. To deal with decision of multiple decision makers we extend dominance-based rough set by introducing specific concepts related to dominance with respect to minimal profiles of evaluations given by multiple decision makers. Our approach differs from existing group decision approaches for we characterize conditions for a consensus attainable by multiple decision makers considered as a whole. Such a perspective permits to handle interactions between decision makers.

articleTitle: TAMPA: Tabu Search-Based Multiple Queries Optimization for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we address one of the wireless sensor network query processing issues posed due to the lack of support for multiple sensor network queries. The objective of the paper is to provide efficient and effective support to multiple queries so that the set of queries are pre-processed before disseminating them into the sensor network. It is very important that only necessary works will be assigned to the sensor network by virtue of strict energy constraint. The problem is modeled by minimum set cover, which is one of the NP-complete problems. We propose an optimization scheme called TAMPA - a tabu search-based multiple queries optimization to find an optimal merge order. The final set of queries to be sent into the network then can be derived from that merge order. We evaluate the proposed algorithm by conducting extensive simulation studies. The results show that energy can be significantly saved while the overall workload still satisfies the user requirements.

articleTitle: A Reassignment Code Allocation Scheme for Multirate Services on OVSF CDMA Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In downlink of OVSF CDMA system, such as WCDMA, Orthogonal Variable spreading factor (OVSF) codes are used as channelization codes to distinguish different physical channels in order to support variable bit rate services. So the allocation scheme of OVSF codes affects the utilization of downlink bandwidth and the performance of the whole network In this paper, we propose a reassignment code allocation scheme which can increase the utilization of downlink bandwidth and decrease the code fragments on the OVSF code tree. The simulation results show that this scheme can reduce the impact of reassignment process to system efficiently and maintain low call blocking ratio at the same time.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation for QoS Oriented Cross Layer Optimization in OFDMA Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Utility based cross layer optimization is a promising tool for wireless resource management in next generation wireless networks, which has been recently studied extensively. Numerous types of utility functions have been proposed and examined in the corresponding literature. However, the majority of the known utility functions only take a fixed mathematical form or are just based on simple combining, which can not fully exploit available network information. In this paper, we focus on a framework of QoS oriented cross layer optimization based on Adaptively Weighted Utility Functions (AWUF) in OFDMA networks. Under this framework, a sub-optimal solution is proposed, which has a potential ability to update control parameters in real-time and accommodate instantaneous QoS constrains. The simulation results revealed that the AUWF based algorithm not only achieved higher throughput, but also simultaneously reduced average queue length and packet delay under unsymmetrical traffic loads among multiple users.

articleTitle: Multi-Mode Multi-Project Scheduling Problem for Mould Production in MC Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: These based on the analysis of features of mould production in MC enterprise including one shot, single piece, random arrival of order and technology diversity, the paper proposed to schedule mould production plan by using scheduling method in project management field, so that MC enterprise can achieve production target with the lowest cost in limited time. Meanwhile, based on the analysis of classic multi-mode project scheduling problem model, the paper constructed mould production scheduling model in MC enterprise and solved it though ant colony algorithm. Finally, the paper realized the solution progress by programming the algorithm in language C++ and experiments were done through instances in LIBPSP. Above 70% instances can obtained optimal results. Average deviation of various instances ranges from 5% to 9%. The result indicates that parameters selection of ant colony algorithm effects performance greatly, besides, optimal parameters various with the activity number.

articleTitle: Interactive Location-Based Services Combined with Natural Language
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Extending beyond today's geographical information system (GIS) applications and wireless positioning techniques, location-based services (LBS) have become a new compelling branch and supplied egocentric location information anywhere anytime. In order to speed up interactive location-based queries in moving or field environments effectively, the paper has given a valuable attempt on LBS with natural language and also achieved: (1) Natural language analysis for Geospatial relations; (2) Interactive LBS queries with natural language; (3) Chinese language segmentation and regulation into Geo-SQL; (4) an application framework from phonetic LBS requests to mobile terminal responses in textual message or graphic formats.

articleTitle: Knowledge Management in Supply Chain: Complexity and a Conceptual System Framework Based on MAS
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge management (KM) and supply chain management (SCM) has become the important success factors in this emerging era of information and competitive. This research discusses the sharing knowledge in SCM and presents a hierarchical model of it. The difficulties and complexity of KM in SCM are argued based on complexity theory and complex adaptive system theory. In the fourth section a knowledge management system framework based on multi-agents and Internet is proposed, which has the characteristics as intelligent, flexible, cross-platform and automatic etc.

articleTitle: TD-SCDMA and Ad Hoc Hybrid Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One aspect that is always important in mobile networks is the radio planning to ensure that there is coverage over the desired geographical area, without any "holes"; planning of coverage is also important in terms of network capacity and minimizing congestion. This paper considers one aspect of the problem: how to extend coverage beyond that of the base station by using ad hoc network techniques to allow the network to reach users by transiting the connection through a user on the boundary of coverage. An additional benefit is that the approach can "fill in" gaps in coverage within urban areas as well as extending coverage in rural ones. It does this for TD- SCDMA, the 3G network technology proposed for China.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: A Window Switching Algorithm for AVS Audio Coding
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a window switching algorithm employed in AVS (audio video coding standard of China) generic audio coding. The algorithm - energy and unpredictability measure based window switching decision (ENUPM-WSD) - achieves high performance to complexity ratio by taking the advantages of both the low complexity of energy based decision in time domain and the high accuracy of unpredictability based decision in frequency domain. It significantly improves encoded audio quality, especially those with large transient portions, while preserves low average computational complexity in AVS generic audio encoder. Due to the merits, it is accepted as a recommendation module of the AVS audio standard.

articleTitle: Second-Order Statistics of Improved Jakes Models' for Rayleigh Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently there are many different approaches to the modeling and simulation of mobile radio fading channels. In this paper, tow kinds of improved Jakes' simulators for Rayleigh fading channels are introduced and the second-order statistics of these improved Jakes' simulator are analyzed. On comparison of some importance statistical properties of the classical Jakes' simulator, it is proved that the second-order statistics of these improved simulators match the desired ones exactly even if the number of sinusoids is small. Moreover, the new improved simulator can be directly used to generate multiple uncorrelated fading waveforms.

articleTitle: Formal Ontology Model and its Application to Semantic Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Current information retrieval techniques either rely on an encoding process to describe a given item or perform a full-text analysis to search for user-specified words. Because an encoded description might reflect only part of the content, they can't guarantee content matching. Ontology is an explicit specification of conceptualizations, which can explicitly and formally express the semantic of the concepts and their relationship. So ontology is better for information retrieval in semantic level. This paper introduces the basic concept of ontology, and presents a formal ontological model using description logic. Then, an algorithm for checking subsumption relation between terms is given. At last, request mode and response mode are modeled. Based on the two modes, a new semantic-enabling information retrieval mechanism is discussed.

articleTitle: A New Approach for Fast Generalized Complex Sphere Decoding Algorithm in MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A fast generalized complex sphere decoder (GCSD) is proposed in this paper. This GCSD can be used to solve the under-determined MIMO systems. Moreover, it can handle not only the QAM and PSK constellations, but also the arbitrary complex constellations. The basic idea is to partition the transmitted signal vector into two sub-vectors. After some transformations, we can use a search scheme which is similar to sphere decoding and a conventional complex sphere decoder to solve these two sub-vectors respectively. Simulation results show that the complexity of our GSCD is significantly lower than the exhaustive search scheme on the under-determined part of the transmitted signal vectors.

articleTitle: Ownership, Board, Agency Costs and Financial Distress: Evidence from Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To empirically investigate the relationship between the corporate governance characteristics and the risk of financial distress for Chinese listed companies. Binary logistic analysis is used to test the effect of ownership structure characteristics on the probability of financial distress with a total sample of 384 listed companies. Logistic regression results show that: ownership concentration, state ownership, ultimate controller, independent directors and auditors' opinion turn out to be negatively associated with the probability of financial distress, while administrative expense ratio is positively related with the likelihood of financial distress. Managerial ownership, board size and CEO duality do not appear to be significant determinants.

articleTitle: The Research of MIMO-OFDM System in the Fourth Generation Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper refers to MIMO-OFDM (multiple input multiple output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing) system studies in the fourth generation mobile communication. We have designed two schemes, one is two transmit antennas and one receive antenna, and the other is two transmit and two receive antennas. In this system we use MPSK modulation, Alamouti space-time coding, RS coding in channel transmission. We analyze the system's error performance by simulation, and prove the design is feasible. The system not only provides highly frequency spectral efficiency but also has better error performance. The research is a promising approach used in the future communication and has tremendous potential.

articleTitle: Internet-Based Technology Adoption along Chinese Vegetable Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Rapid development of Internet-based technology has profoundly changed the operation and management activities in supply chains. This study discusses the adoption of Internet-based technology among vegetable enterprises along the supply chain and analyses the factors affecting the utilization of the technology along Chinese vegetable supply chain. The survey result shows that the technology has not widely used in vegetable enterprises, and the utilization level varies between different companies along the chain. Lack of funds, security and limited education are the main factors prohibiting the use of Internet. Managers also have no plan to adopt or extent the utilization level of Internet technology in the near future.

articleTitle: Cost at Risk in R&D Project Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The most popular tool used in the industry for project management is the earned value management (EVM). The major disadvantage of EVM is that it is a post-event method, and not very efficient in forecasting the exceeding cost during the project. In order to make EVM more efficient in pre-event exceeding cost risk recognition, the proportion of earned value over the budget has been suggested. The formula presented in Reference [10] has been modified in this paper, the example results show the modified formula's simplicity when underlying forecast during the project. The significant difference has been found out between normal distribution and beta distribution, it is further requested to improve this model by the selection of p and q .

articleTitle: Design a MIL-STD-188-220c Compatible Radio Digital Message Transfer Device Adapter
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The MIL-STD-188-220 protocol is the interconnection standard between DMTDs in battlefield of America DOD. It's the only standardized protocol in tactical mobile networks by now. The protocol models and performance simulations are widely discussed, but mostly based on software simulations and rarely in the implementation issues. This paper is mainly focused on the protocol implementations and system performance analysis. The implementation is a MIL-STD-220C compatible device, which completing the entire data link layer operation and a part of network layer operation in a single FPGA(field programmable gate array) chip to achieve minimum response time and stable performance. The communication adapter function diagram, working flowchart and performance figures are listed.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Opportunistic Scheduling in Multi-Service OFDMA Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel hierarchy scheduling mechanism is proposed for opportunistic scheduling in multi-service OFDMA network, where the services consist of delay-sensitive (DS) services and delay-insensitive (DIS) services. To implement opportunistic scheduling (OS), we design a hybrid QoS mechanism based on the channel condition feedback from each Mobile Station. In the MAC layer, scheduler performs hierarchically. First, it will dynamically assign the necessary subcarriers to guarantee the minimal reserved traffic rate and latency requirement for DS services. Second, a utility function is employed to achieve efficient bandwidth utilization for both unmet DS services and DIS services, exploiting multi-user diversity with fairness consideration. The simulation results explicitly verify our expectation that the proposed mechanism can meet the throughput requirements without compromising latency and fairness among services with diverse QoS requirements.

articleTitle: Group Fuzzy Multi-Criteria Decision Making in Supplier Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The natural complex and uncertain criteria of social problems can be adequately explored by joining fuzzy with multiple criteria decision making (MCDM). Royes and Bastos (2006) proposed a new methodology based on the manipulation of fuzzy sets which was applied to political forecasting. This method only described in a single expert. This study, therefore, extends to multiple experts based on this method and applies to supplier evaluation.

articleTitle: Business Model Innovation in China's Real Estate Industry: the Case of Shenzhen Vanke
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the survey done by IBM business consulting services in 2006, global CEOs stated that business model innovation will have a greater impact on operating margin growth, than product or service innovation. We also noticed that some enterprises in China's real estate industry have improved their business models for sustainable competitive advantage and surplus profit in recently years. Based on the case studies of Shenzhen Vanke, as well as literature review, a framework for business model innovation has been developed. The framework provides an integrated means of making sense of new business model. These include critical dimensions of new customer value propositions, technological innovation, collaboration of the business infrastructure and the economic feasibility of a new business model.

articleTitle: The Degradation of Bandwidth in QoS Scheme for 4G Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a bandwidth degradation QoS scheme for adaptive multimedia services in next generation wireless/mobile networks, and introduce it in mobile networks to improve the performance of channel allocation. The proposed schemes are the generic call admission control (CAC) algorithm and the admission policy to support multiple rates, multiple class traffic of next generation mobile network. Based on diverse QoS parameters be included in connection request, a two-stage bandwidth degradation QoS CAC algorithm is presented to satisfy the diverse QoS requirement and utilize the system resource efficiently. The simulation results show that the performance of our scheme is preferable to that of existing schemes.

articleTitle: BOX Models Based on MAS for the Reconfigurable ERP System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To meet the requirements of the reconfigurable ERP (RERP) system, the abstraction hierarchy of BOX (Bill of X) is designed based on MAS (multi-agent system), which is comprised of an enterprise structure model, an enterprise process model, an enterprise cost management model and a distributed decision-making model. The BOX models are established respectively in detail using UML (Unified Modeling Language). BOX models can fulfill the requirements of both enterprise business model reconfiguration and information system reconfiguration, and support both the intra-organizational and inter-organizational integration and reconfiguration of the enterprises.

articleTitle: Technology Spillover Mechanism and Industrial Cluster in China: Evidence from PC Industrial Cluster in Dongguan District
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The agglomeration economy which is represented by so called industrial cluster, plays a critical role in China's regional economic development. The objective of this article is to explore the technology spillover mechanism to analyze the ways through which technology or technological knowledge spilled over from advanced technology holder to recipient enterprises in China's industrial cluster. Data are draw from a straightforward quantitative and qualitative survey of PC industrial cluster in Dongguan district, China. The technology spillover mechanism will be analyzed on the perspectives of both vertical (interindustry) and horizontal (intraindustry) spillovers.

articleTitle: Evaluating Performance of Location Service Protocols of Ad-Hoc Wireless Network in Real-World Environment Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Position based routing has been an attractive area of research due to being scalable and efficient in packet routing in mobile ad-hoc and sensor networks. A source node willing to send a packet to destination uses location service that provides the destination's approximate location. Most of the location service schemes in literature focused only on making the services scalable on location maintenance and query, but little importance was given on their suitability to deploy in practical environment. Real world scenario is most likely to have various obstacles such as buildings, vegetations, fields and playground that may play a vital role in the performance of geographic routing protocols as well as location services since those areas may have no or very low node density available. No study has yet been done evaluating the influence of obstacles on location services' performance. In this paper, we investigated and analyzed the impact of obstacles on scalable location service measured in terms of widely used performance metrics. This study also reveals how transmission distance holds greater impact on performance when obstacles are present.

articleTitle: Analysis of Effects on Residents' Demand for Urban Public Eco-System Services Based on a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is always difficult to acquire the demand information of urban eco-system services due to its public goods characteristics. As an approximate measure of individual demand, contingent valuation method (CVM) employs a hypothetical market to extract the willingness to pay (WTP). In the present paper, CVM is applied to get residents' WTP for ecosystem restoration of a landscape river in Shanghai. Results from 496 in-person interviews show that the average WTP is RMB 160.2 Yuan per household per year. Then, main factors influencing the demand and their marginal effects on the WTP are investigated by regression of Log-linear parameter model. The result indicates that income gap, Huji factor and living duration along the river have negative correlation; while income level, education level and level of confidence on the government have positive correlation. The results are accordant with the general theoretical anticipation and specificity in the special stage of economic transformation in China.

articleTitle: A Reputation Management System Model for E-Commerce Community
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the limitations of reputation management system model for E-Commerce community at present, a model suit for B2B,B2C,C2C was put forward. In the model, it developed reputation management system in existence on the problems such as against ratings deception, then a reliability calculation method was proposed to implement just evaluate for trade entity reliability.

articleTitle: An Improved EZW Image Coding Method Based on Lifting Wavelet
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In view of the fact that the wavelet coefficients cannot be utilized completely with EZW method and that the encoding efficiency is reduced by too much encoding time consumed in the process of successive approximation quantization, an improved EZW image coding algorithm based on lifting wavelet transform is proposed. In this method lifting wavelet is used to improve the procedure of traditional wavelet transform. By modifying the scanning strategy of the wavelet coefficients and the quantization threshold the high and low frequency sub-bands are manipulated separately. The experiment results show that the improved method can improve the quality of the recovered image and the encoding efficiency.

articleTitle: Trade Credit Term Determination and Efficiency Invariant Revenue Sharing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper first proposes an approximation solution to the optimal payment time and credit term with new features of the supplier unit cost function by applying Schwartz's financing motive theory. Then we solve the problem of efficiency preserving allocating coordination surplus in DEA framework. An explicit formula of allocation is obtained. Two kinds of allocation schemes were contrasted in numerical experiments. Efficiency invariant allocation is proved to be more realistic than Aumann-Shapley schemes.

articleTitle: A Study on Fuzzy Evaluation Model Based on Non-Monetary Value of Human Resources
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Material capital and human resources are the main factors for modern economic growth as well as technology progress, especially with human society entering into knowledge economy times, cost and quantity of human resources which become medium of knowledge and technology along with intellectuality are made up of the main parts of national competitive power and enterprise core ability as well as wealthy degree of human resources. Affirmance and evaluation of recessive value of human resources are becoming one of the key problems that is to be solved. Based on academic level of measuring fuzzy method of human resources the indexes reflecting recessive value of human resources have been established with statistics for fuzzy evaluation and a sample analysis has been done with LiaoNing Institute of Science and Technology as an example.

articleTitle: Sustainable HFC Genetic Algorithms Based with Adaptive Migration Structure
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes two improved sustainable genetic algorithms based on hierarchical fair competition model (HFC)- the HFC algorithm with adaptive admission threshold (HFC-AMT) and the HFC algorithm with adaptive migration structure (HFC- AMS). These two HFC algorithms can adjust the admission threshold of every grade in HFC and allow dynamic movement such as two-way migration of individuals between certain grades, which share higher similarity to what happens in nature. Our benchmark experiment on the TSP (Traveling Salesman Problem) shows that the proposed adaptive HFC algorithms can not only maintain high diversity of the population and fair competition among individuals, but also assure the limitless search and sustainable evolution.

articleTitle: Fairness of QoS Degradation in Multimedia Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the fairness of QoS degradation for multi-class and multi-priority discrete adaptive multimedia applications is studied in wireless/mobile multimedia networks. The concept of degradation factor (DF) and its definition are presented. Then, we propose a generalized proportional fair degradation principle minimizing the weighted sum of DF's square (MWSDFS). This principle considers not only inter-class and intra-class priority but also user's QoS degradation degree. At last, quantum genetic algorithm based solution is given for the problem, and the experimental results further validate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Risk Management in Business Process
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on Trust Model Based on Field Theory in C2C Market
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: At present, there is some shortcoming at the online reputation mechanism for the C2C market, how to valuate the seller's credit level and provide trust evaluation service to the buyer is a hot study field. This paper, at first, presents a credit field model, which used the formula of Coulomb's law for reference, takes the key factors on evaluating trust to replace the factors in the formula of Coulomb's law, and constructs the trust field formula. The second, this paper presents a formula to calculate the trust strength about the seller, while the buyers would have trade with the seller. The end, the trust model base on field theory was verified by axioms of the trust knowledge.

articleTitle: Performance of a Reduced Complexity Algorithm for Diversity Combining
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper introduces a new diversity algorithm that uses real valued weights to reduce the complexity of coherent combining. The approach starts with Selection Diversity but allows any signal branch to contribute to the output by a simple real valued scaling operation. Channel estimation is performed only on the branch with the strongest signal and the rest of the combining weights are then computed directly from the received signals themselves. This simplifies the weight computation and the resulting real-valued weights allows for combining to be performed at the analog or RF/IF stage, reducing the need for multiple receive chains required by digital combining. Simulation results reveal that the performance of the proposed algorithm is just 0.7 dB and 1.6 dB below optimum for 2 and 4 antennas respectively in independent Rayleigh fading channels.

articleTitle: Design and Development of the Online Examination and Evaluation System Based on B/S Structure
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Examination system is one of important components of online education, yet now the technology of developing online examination system is still not satisfactory. In this paper, based on the practice experience, the authors will tentatively discuss the principle, functions, and advantages of the online examination and evaluation system based on B/S (browser/server) structure.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Algorithm for Accurate Stream Entropy Estimation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Entropy estimation plays an important role in many network tasks, in particular, anomaly detection. Accurate estimation of entropy demands large memory. In this paper, we propose a novel hybrid algorithm that processes items with different frequencies separately. For items with frequency higher than a given threshold, counters are used while for items with lower frequency, the technique introduced by Alon, Matias and Szegedy is applied. We analyze the error and variance bounds of the estimations generated by this hybrid algorithm, proved to be more accurate than the pure random algorithm, at the cost of no significant increase in space complexity. As demonstrated by experiments, this entropy estimation may be used to detect traffic anomaly resulted from different types of attacks.

articleTitle: Continuous Nearest Neighbor Query on Moving Objects Using the VDTPR-Tree
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the advances in mobile communication and position-finding technology for tracking the positions of continuously moving objects, there comes a kind of novel applications (e.g., traffic control, meteorology monitoring, mobile computing, etc.) in which the locations of moving objects need to be maintained and processed. In these applications, algorithms for efficiently answering queries involved in a great number of moving objects are becoming increasingly important. One such kind of queries is the continuous nearest neighbor queries. The TPR-tree is a popular indexing method for continuous nearest neighbor query processing, however, its query performance suffer a sharp decline with the increase of time. In this paper, we first present an extended TPR-tree: VDTPR-tree, which segments velocity domain into different velocity intervals, and then propose an efficient algorithm for continuous nearest neighbor query processing on moving objects using the VDTPR- tree.

articleTitle: The Optimization of DSR Protocol of Ad Hoc Network with Constrained Dynamic Query Localization Technique
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To resolve the routing overhead problem of the ad hoc network DSR protocol resulted from flooding, this paper puts forward the optimization of DSR protocol with constrained dynamic query localization technique called LDSR protocol. Based on original DSR protocol and constrained by two factors: (1) the maximum number of hops of query localization flooding determined by the small-world theory; (2) effective routing time determined by mobile critical transmitting range for connectivity in ad hoc network and the maximum mobile speed of node, the LDSR protocol uses dynamic choice mechanism to limit query to a small region and to complete flooding localization. Simulation results shown that the LDSR protocol can reduce routing overhead and average end-to-end delay notably, but packet delivery fraction decreased slightly compared with DSR protocol.

articleTitle: CMOS Low-Noise Amplifier with Small Variation of Group Delay for UWB Impulse Radio Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In UWB systems, a small group delay variation is desirable because this implies that all frequencies will be delayed by relatively the same amount while passing through the amplifier. The CMOS LNA for UWB communication applications covering frequency band from 3 to 5 GHz based on 0.18 mum CMOS technique is indicated. A low group delay variation is indicated in this work. The group delay variation of the proposed design is about 25 ps according to the simulated results which implies that small distortion of transmit pulses. The communication quality of UWB systems will be improved.

articleTitle: A Game-Theoretic Approach to Energy-Efficient Power Control and Adaptive Modulation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To regulate transmit-power and enhance the total throughput, a novel transmit-power control game (TPCG) algorithm and M-TPCG algorithm which combines adaptive modulation and transmit-power control based on STBC OFDM- CDMA system are designed. The simulation results show that TPCG algorithm can regulate their transmitter powers and enhance the total throughput effectively, otherwise, M-TPCG algorithm can achieve maximal system throughput. The performance of the cognitive radio system is thereby improved obviously.

articleTitle: Adaptive Transmission Probability for IEEE 802.11e MAC Enhancements
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose to enhance EDCA for IEEE 802.11 WLANs with a simple and effective scheme called PEDCA, which introduces the transmission probability to the basic EDCA. By dynamically adjusting the transmission probability of each priority class according to the network load, our scheme can offer an enhanced guarantee of QoS to high priority class at high traffic load conditions. The simulation results show that PEDCA outperforms EDCA in terms of throughput and average delay while providing good service differentiation.

articleTitle: A New Design of Voltage Controlled Oscillator
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper designed a new low phase noise voltage- controlled oscillator (VCO) with harmonic filtering resistor and source damping resistor. The author analyzed and modulated the results by the simulator of Mentor Graphics in a 0.35-um CMOS process, and achieved the optimization scheme in the end. The simulation result shows the VCO can reach a phase noise of - 124.9 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz offset while working at 4.6 GHz in a 3 mA excursion current. During the 0 to 3 controlled voltage the tuning range can reach 18.5%, and the power consumption is only 7.09 mW.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of A New Movement Detection and Address Configuration Method for supporting Seamless Mobile IPv6 Handover
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In mobile IP and its fast handover protocol, mobile node needs to configure temporal IP address after handed over from one access router to another. Movement detection, router discovery and duplicate address detection are procedures needed in the handover. We study the impact of those procedures on IP handover latency in this paper. Several methods to accelerate those procedures are investigated, but they still can not make the handover seamless. We present a new method: reserve one address per IP subnet at each neighboring access routers for mobile node, and mobile node couple each reserved address with identifiers that identify access points connected to the corresponding subnet, mobile node selects an address according the target access point's identifier while performing handover. The mathematical analysis of the new method is carried out and the result shows that our proposal can reduce handover latency significantly and achieve seamless handover.

articleTitle: Implemented Process of SD Algorithm for MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on basic principle and full implemented process of SD Algorithm, which are heuristic or direct to be used for MIMO systems in IEEE 802.16 protocol PHY. As to the all de-SM methods including direct inverse, SIC- ZF, SIC-MMSE, SD, MLD, although MLD has the highest computation load, its performance is much better than other methods (except SD). It is very obvious that receive diversity is more influential to system than transmit diversity. Simulations show that direct inverse method is the worst, and also has error floor. SIC-MMSE and SIC-ZF almost have the same performance and no error floor exists. However, the best one is ML and SD methods, which have about 4 dB better than SIC-MMSE and SIC-ZF in Rayleigh channel.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machines Based on Data Mining Technology in Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This system mines the historical daily loading which has the same meteorological category as the forecasting day in order to compose data sequence with highly similar meteorological features, with this method it can decrease SVM training data and overcome the disadvantage of very large data and slow processing speed when constructing SVM model. With the advantage of data mining technology in processing, it can reduce the large data and eliminate redundant information. Comparing with single SVM and BP neural network in short-term load forecasting, this new method can achieve greater forecasting accuracy. It is denoted that the SVM learning system has advantage when the information preprocessing based on data mining technology.

articleTitle: Improved Laplacian Factor Estimation for Noisy Speech Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Two novel approaches for Laplacian factor estimation are proposed for noisy speech enhancement employing Laplasian-Gaussian mixture model in discrete cosine transform domain. Based on the property of generalized Gaussian distribution model, the proposed approaches indirectly attain the estimation of Laplacian factor using its relationship with the variance of clean speech components under the Laplacian distribution assumption. The estimated results for Laplacian factor are accurate and uneffected by the noise energy, while keeping the resulting method simple. In simulations with speech signals degraded by different kinds of noise, the experimental results show the improved performance of the proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Low Cost IP Mobility Management for IP/LEO Satellite Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Existing terrestrial mobility management protocols manage the location of mobile nodes on the basis of the network topology. Applying such mechanisms in IP/LEO satellite networks will cause large number of binding update and ultimately affects the scalability of mobility management. And existing geographical mobility management protocols position the mobile node by satellite forwarding and paging schemes, which increase the cost of mobility management rapidly. This paper argues a low cost mobility management scheme for LEO satellite networks. It exploits geographical location and ground station information to decrease mobility management, reduce the number of update requests and paging cost. A detailed description of the actual implementation of the scheme is given. Through a mathematical analysis, the paper evaluates the required management cost and accordingly verifies the scalability of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Energy Aware Routing Algorithm for Target Region Monitoring in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel energy aware routing algorithm for target region monitoring in wireless sensor network. In our algorithm, a gathering node is chosen within target region based on energy metric and hops to sink to gather and aggregate data. Multiple paths are found between gathering node and sink, and each path is assigned a probability of being chosen, depending on the energy metric and communication cost. Our routing algorithm uses sub-optimal paths occasionally besides the minimum energy path from the gathering node to sink. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm saves energy consumption, decreases transmission delay compared with current schemes like directed diffusion algorithm.

articleTitle: The Prediction of Stock Index Based on Fuzzy Wavelet Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The prediction of financial time series is a puzzle question recognized by all over the world, the traditional methods using linear and complete rational equilibrium pattern have some shortcomings. The paper applies fuzzy set to wavelet analysis and provides a fuzzy wavelet membership function which makes the wavelet coefficients with smaller degree of membership equate zero and the bigger ones shrink toward zero. This kind of de-noising method reflects commendably the impreciseness existing in the system parameters, and thus has better effect of denoising. The method is used for support vector regression model(SVR) and the prediction of Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index illustrates its feasibility.

articleTitle: LDPC Coded Irregular Modulation Based on Degree Distribution
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel irregular low density parity check (LDPC) coded link adaptation technique is presented to achieve flexible spectral efficiency and various reliabilities with irregular modulation. The mapping rule between LDPC coded bits and signal constellations is optimized in terms of LDPC code degree distribution and inherent unequal error protection property of irregular modulation. Simulation results show that the combination of various modulations can achieve not only fine data rate adaptation, but also better bit error rate (BER) performance with optimized mapping rule. Convergence performance is also analyzed using extrinsic information transfer (EXIT) chart based on actual probability dense function of extrinsic information by Monte Carlo simulations.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Developing Measures of Customerization Capabilities for Value Co-Creation with Customers
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Supplier Hierarchical Structure Management Based on Markov Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is well known that maintaining stable stale supply chain is absolutely necessary for enterprises, so how to manage supplier hierarchical structure becomes an important content in SCM. In this paper, a model based on Markov chain is provided for supplier hierarchical structure management. The model focus on describing the change of supplier hierarchical structure, forecasting future supplier hierarchical structure, and seeking for strategy so as to achieve some ideal supplier hierarchical structure. At the same time, some academic conclusions are drawn to improve supplier hierarchical structure management.

articleTitle: A Framework for Knowledge Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge service platform provides a wide range of knowledge sources for knowledge service, knowledge tools, interactive tools and service means. On the basis of expounding the knowledge service's connotations, modes and requirements, this paper analyzes and defines the notions and functions of the knowledge service platform, proposes a concept model, gives a constructing structure of the knowledge service platform, and it discusses the key technologies to construct the system and the basic components of the knowledge service platform organizational environment.

articleTitle: Gaussian Approximation for LDPC Codes
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Today, LDPC codes have become one of the hottest topics in coding theory. Unlike many other classes of cods LDPC codes are already equipped with very fast (probabilistic) encoding and decoding algorithm. The decoding of LDPC codes are implemented through message-passing algorithm. Passed messages can be modeled as Gaussian variables. In this paper, the new approximate method for calculation of statistical parameters of these Gaussian variables is proposed. Based on proposed method, we can be able to estimate the threshold level of noise of regular LDPC codes over AWGN channels.

articleTitle: Research on Methods of Services-Oriented Integration for Supply Chain Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As an implementation of Services Oriented Architectures, Web Services ensure a loosely coupled integration model to allow flexible integration of heterogeneous systems in a variety of domains including business-to-consumer, business-to-business and enterprise application integration. In attempting to account for the integrated solution based on Web Services, the author specifies the concept and the integrated demands of Supply Chain. Next, the integrated concepts and theory of Web Services are illustrated, and the dynamic integration of Supply Chain is further studied with the focus on a typical integrated example. Finally a summary is given of the advantages of Web Services-based integrated architecture.

articleTitle: Research on the Sample Training of BP Neural Network in Effectiveness Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the WSEIAC (Weapon System Effectiveness Industry Advisory Committee) model, an index hierarchy of ground antiaircraft missile weapon system's effectiveness has been developed, and corresponding three hierarchy BP neural network was established. It is briefly concerned with the analysis of the BP algorithm, then through Delphi technique and the FAHP (fuzzy analytical hierarchy process), several groups of training samples are chosen to train the BP neural networks until the precision meet requirements. It is shown that this BP neural network limits the artificial factors when it is used to evaluate the ground antiaircraft missile weapon system's effectiveness. It was concluded that this method is scientific and creditable.

articleTitle: OFDM Peak-to-Average Power Ratio Reduction by Time-Frequency Processing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a direct peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) reduction approach for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems, termed time permutation and phase rotation (TPPR), which exploits the additional freedom degrees of time domain symbols in one timeslot to obtain additional PAPR reduction gains. This method divides OFDM symbols in frequency domain into subblocks and rotates each subblock phase with phase factors. Then these subblocks are transformed into time domain sequences by IDFT and permutations are performed among these subblocks in different symbols. For complexity reduction, two suboptimal schemes time shifting (TS-TPPR) and random selecting (RS-TPPR) are proposed. Simulation results show our methods can obtain significant PAPR reduction gains, and compared to multi-symbol SLM, RS-TPPR can provide better performance with the same complexity.

articleTitle: Analysis and Application of Perceptual Weighting for Avs-M Audio Coder
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Audio video coding standard (AVS) is the latest audio and video coding standard of China. AVS Part 7 (also known as AVS-M) audio coding tools target mobility applications where perceptual weighting is of great importance for subjective performance. This paper first briefly introduces the general concept of perceptual weighting. Then a candidate perceptual weighting scheme is proposed and testified on AVS-M audio coder. Further optimization on the candidate is illustrated thereafter. Subjective results of the optimized scheme provide hybrid audio quality comparable to the 3 GPP AMR-WB+.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Evolution Mechanism of Enterprise Strategic Alliances Based on Resources Perspective
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Maximum-Energy Shortest Path Tree for Data Aggregation in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A novel maximum-energy shortest path tree algorithm (MESPT), which is a two-phase algorithm, for data aggregation in wireless sensor networks was proposed. In the first phase, it constructs a maximum-energy path tree (MEPT) which balances the energy consumption among the sensor nodes. In the second phase, it restructures the tree by the shortest path algorithm based on MEPT trying to minimize the data aggregation latency. The simulation results show that the lifetime of sensor nodes in the monitored area can be extended significantly when data are aggregated using the MESPT algorithm.

articleTitle: Trust Build-Up in Online Transactions - Empirical Analysis of Taobao's Trust Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In building up trust in online transactions, Taobao's trust mechanism fulfils a practical function at three levels. Firstly, at the level of technology, the immediate communication tool - Taobao Wangwang facilitates online communications remarkably; the third party payment instrument - Zhifubao ensures the Internet payment security to a great degree. Secondly, at the level of institution, besides identity authentication system, the reputation evaluation institution and the newly released compensation-in-advance rule in customer security plan, guarantee online buyers' rights noticeably. Thirdly, at the level of psychology, research of Taobao's loving care project presents a close correlation between morality and transaction trust.

articleTitle: Interference Analysis of Microwave RFID and 802.11b WLAN
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The proliferation of IEEE 802.11 b WLAN (Wi-Fi), which occupies the 2.4-2.4835 GHz frequency bands, make the 2.4 GHz ISM unlicensed band more crowded. At the same time, the RFID technology emerged and will be widely deployed. RFID use diverse frequency bands from low frequency (LF) to microwave, including 2.4 GHz ISM bands too. Hence, when 2.45 GHz RFID systems collocate with 802.11 b, the mutual interference is inevitable and their performances will significantly degrade. The main goal of this paper is to evaluate the impact of mutual interferences on the performance of 2.45 GHz RFID and 802.11 b systems. A mathematical model is proposed to analyze the mutual interference, and packet error rate (PER) is used as the performance metric. The simulation results of 802.11 b's PER are illustrated, which compared with the theoretical results, to evaluate the performance degradation of the interference.

articleTitle: Research on Term Structure of Treasury Interest Rates Using a New Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
