abstract: Based on Chinese treasury market's characteristic and oversea methods for estimating term structure of interest rates, a new model for computing Chinese term structure is represented. The empirical research and comparison of this model with others are carried out using the data of Chinese treasury market. The results show that the model can significantly decrease the errors of forecasting yields to maturity. The new model is suitable to our national fact. Using this model, ten pieces of interest rates curves, representing Chinese treasure markets from 1996 to 2007, are offered and analyzed. From the ten yield curves, it is shown that: Firstly, the variation range of yield curves has still been restricted by deposit interest rates. Secondly, the variation range of long-term interest rates is smaller than that of short-term interest rates. Thirdly, in recent years, the long-term interest rates of Chinese treasure bonds are lower.

articleTitle: Gradient-Based Variable Forgetting Factor RLS Algorithm in MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a gradient-based variable forgetting factor RLS (GVFF-RLS) algorithm in MIMO-OFDM channel estimation. This GVFF-RLS algorithm is preferable to the traditional RLS algorithm, which is based on the fixed forgetting factor in tracking system variation in time-varying system. After simulation, we can draw a conclusion that in time- varying system, this algorithm has faster tracking ability, less MSE and better astringency.

articleTitle: Genetic-Feedback Algorithm Based Network Security Policy Framework
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the rapid increase of network security events, policy-based management is more and more widely used to monitor and manage the behavior of network. But the policies are created and deployed by the administrator, and can not automatically adjust without the involvement of human. This paper develops an evolutional network security policy framework based on genetic-feedback algorithm. Based on the historical security events, using genetic algorithm, we can generate a rule base. When a new network event comes, the analyzer judges whether the event is secure or not according to the rule base, and the policy system may give a policy decision too. Obviously, these two results may be different. So the policies can be automatically adjusted refer to the genetic calculated results. A brief overview of genetic algorithm is presented. The proposed framework and the evolution process are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: A Study on Dynamic Ontology for Information Integration in E-Governmental Virtual Organization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the research background is E- government virtual organization (EGVO). In order to provide users with the same interface for accessing to semantic data, and to realize knowledge share and reuse among various kinds of governmental resources, this paper brings ontology technology into EGVO information integration. Ontology solves the semantic heterogeneity problem of distributed, heterogeneous and autonomous data source; it can realize the semantic interoperability. However, the governmental objects in EGVO are highly dynamic and unpredictable. The information integration is changing along with the objects, thus the corresponding ontology also needs to be changed. This paper mainly discusses the changing process of dynamic ontology and the correlative methods.

articleTitle: A Scheduling Algorithm with One-Bit Feedback for Multi-User MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a scheduling algorithm to exploit multi-user diversity with one bit feedback information for multi-user MIMO system. Instead, the users in a cell only need feed back one-bit information about the comparison between the channel quality indicator and the defined threshold C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>, and then BS allocates the channel resource to one user experiencing favorable channel conditions. Specially, we solve this problem achieving the optimum threshold for multiple antennas systems in presence of transmit correlation. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme achieves better performance in terms of the average system spectral efficiency than round robin scheduling scheme.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Novel Grid-VO-enabled Compound Resource Tree Management Model in Multimedia Content Delivery Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Firstly, based on the analysis of hard problems of resource model in the CDN and computational grid, the paper gives a novel resource management model, VO-enabled compound resource tree model-VO-CRTM model, to organize resource and manage all kinds of resources in the content delivery environment. VO-CRTM organizes resource to form hierarchical tree architecture in lengthways according to native communication relationship among resources. At the same time, the resource hosts in the same depth can dynamically form virtual organization in widthways to cooperate for providing of content service and efficient locating of service. As part of this study, this paper illustrates a VO-CRTM model implementation scheme design in scenario of metropolitan content delivery networks. The scheme and experiment have verified the advantages of this model.

articleTitle: Continuous Data Collection in Wireless Sensor Networks through PNC and Distributed Storage
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks have been widely used for surveillance in harsh environments. In many such applications, the environmental data are continuously sensed, and data collection is performed synchronously. When a data collector cannot communicate with the sensors directly for some reason, continuous data collection becomes a challenging problem. In this paper, we present an effective way of solving such problems by combining partial network coding with distributed network storage. Specifically, we assume that there are k sources generating the data continuously and n>k storage nodes with limited memory which communicate with the sources. We want a data collector, who can appear anywhere around the storage nodes, to query any k or more storage nodes and be able to retrieve the data generated by the sources timely and continuously. Furthermore, through simulation, the relationship between the number of storage nodes connected by one source and the probability of successful reception of the data collector is found.

articleTitle: AOZDV: An Enhanced AODV Protocol based on Zone Routing in MANET
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In MANET, AODV is one of famous on-demand routing protocols, which uses the routing tables in the nodes if possible, or a RDP (route discovery process) is triggered to find a new route. However, in the large MANET, the network performance becomes worse because of the limitations of RDP. In this paper, we propose a novel routing protocol, named AOZDV (ad hoc on-demand zone and distance-vector routing), which enhances the AODV protocol through zone routing. AOZDV creates a zone with neighbor nodes of the source/destination using traffic and power information, and it utilizes a destination-vector table for internal-zone routing while it adopts the AODV protocol for outer-zone routing. Using simulations, we prove that AOZDV can reduce the rate of route loss rate and RDP caused by route loss compared with DSR and AODV.

articleTitle: Banking Operational Risk Management on DS Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Operational risk (oprisk) measure is one of the primary management in banks. Because of the uncertainty in oprisk assessing it's important to use the uncertainty reasoning theory to quantify the information from experts, owing to the key role of the experts' knowledge to the oprisk measurement. This paper used the DS evidence theory to establish the frame of discernment, collect the information from experts, and adopt 2 kinds of weight coefficients: weight of same group experts and weight between different groups, to modify the Dempster's combining formula to find the final assessment of oprisk. The paper it confirms the validity of this method through demonstration on 3 commercial banks in China.

articleTitle: Recommendation of Online auction Items Focusing Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The rapid development of e-commerce has promoted the growth of online auctions business based on C2C context. However, the ever-increasing customer size and auctioned goods cause the problem of information overload, and how to enhance the customer loyalty becomes a critical issue faced by most online auctions websites. One way to overcome the problem is to use recommender systems to provide personalized information services. Since there exist much difference between B2C and C2C context, it is a new challenge for us to apply recommender systems to the latter setting. This paper analyzes the customer behaviors on the auction website and constructs the customer preference model under the C2C context. Then the collaborative filtering technique is used to recommend auction items.

articleTitle: Cluster-Based Multi-Path Data Dissemination Scheme for Large Scale Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Acquiring critical events for mobile or static sinks poses great challenges for applications of wireless sensor network in emergency response and other surveillance scenarios. In this paper, a clustering-based multi-path data dissemination scheme (CMPDD) is proposed. The cluster head and several dissemination nodes in each cluster collaboratively process data and deliver data to multiple mobile/static sinks with good energy efficiency and lower delay. Adapting to varying number of source-sink pairs, one or multiple paths are set up for event dissemination between sinks and sources. Reliability is enhanced by backup mechanism among dissemination nodes. Simulation results show that this scheme outperforms TTDD in energy consumption, transmission delay and resilience to node failures.

articleTitle: Social Capital and Organizational Performance: Is Learning Orientation a Missing Link?
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we studied the relationship between social capital and organizational performance, and tried to confirm whether learning orientation is an important medi- variable. Through theory analysis, we built research framework and constructed Structural Equation Model, and then carried out an empirical research on 134 enterprises which come from the Peal River Delta, China.

articleTitle: On Wireless Sensors Covering and Movement Problem
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks will be widely deployed in the future for monitoring important environmental conditions, security, and health care. One of the most important challenges in the implementation of such networks is maximizing the area detected and minimizing energy dissipation in the movement. In this paper, we present some effective methodology for modeling the problem of maximum cover and minimizing energy dissipation by formulate the problem as matching of the bigraph and assignment problem. Our proposed methods determine optimal sensor position and minimize energy consumption due to sensor movement from the initial position to optimal position. The tool can also accommodate several constraints related to movement capabilities of sensor nodes. In addition, it can also work with objective functions other than minimizing movement energy.

articleTitle: A Combination Evaluation Method Based on FAHP and Entropy Weigh Method
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a new combination weight method which uses weight vectors minimum deviation square sum as object functions and solves the weight distribution problem based on object optimization model. The method combines subjective weight of FAHP with objective weight of entropy analysis method, and can sufficiently utilize objective evaluation information and meet the requirements of decision-makers. Finally, an example for real estate investment decision-making is presented to show the feasibility and effectiveness of the combination method.

articleTitle: The Research of Side-Band Acquisition for BOC-Modulated Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Binary Offset Carrier modulation has the special character of splitting spectrum, but usually each band of the spectrum has the information for demodulation, in a sense that each band is redundant to another, so the receiver can process only one of them. Because the correlation function is the most important for the acquisition stage of the receiver, so, as an example, The analytic formula of power spectral density function and autocorrelation function for BOC (8,4) are deduced at first in this paper, then base on them, the FFT algorithms is chosen for the side-band acquisition of the BOC-modulated signal, through the simulation and analytic, the feasibility of this acquisition scheme is validated at last.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of Subchannel Reassignment and Power Adaptation for Multicarrier Cooperative Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An amplify-and-forward multicarrier cooperative system is proposed in this paper. The optimal resource-allocation problem has been investigated in terms of improving data rate. An effective resource-allocation algorithm is proposed based on three techniques, adaptive modulation, subchannel reassignment design and transmit power adaptation. The designed subchannel reassignment not only increases the average data rate, but also raises the threshold of "water-filling" in optimizing power allocation that can further increase data rate. Since the power allocation is based on the designed subchannel reassignment, the complexity of the proposed algorithm is least. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm effectively increases the system's average data rate.

articleTitle: Establishing Trust Relationship in Mobile Ad-Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile ad-hoc network is a self-organized network made up of mobile devices that do not require any fixed infrastructure to communicate. Due to the temporary cooperation among nodes, and no enough knowledge between each node in advance, it is difficult to establish trust in ad hoc network. This paper presents a novel trust model in which trust is composed of basic trust and application trust. Resource- constrained trust negotiation (RCTN) is addressed to build initial basic trust, in which credential is exchanged only once between two strangers. Application trust relies on the specific context where and when users operate. This trust structure can explain well the dynamic characteristic of trust and can establish the initial trust relationship between strangers.

articleTitle: Improved CP-Based Carrier Frequency Offset Estimator for OFDM systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an improved carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimator using cyclic prefix (CP) for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems. The basic principle is to detect the sign of the CFO value firstly, which will facilitate the extension of the estimation range of the estimator. It is shown by simulation results that the proposed estimator can achieve a double CFO estimation range compared to van de Beek's method [5] and hence to improve the performance of fractional CFO estimation.

articleTitle: A Correctness Proof of WAPI Certificate Authentication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: WAPI certificate authentication protocol is the core and key component of WAPI security mechanism proposed by Chinese WLAN standard. This protocol adopts pubfic key cryptographic technique, ASUE (authentication supplicant entity) and AE (authenticator entity) implement the mutual identity authentication aided by their trusting third ASE (authentication security entity) to realize secure access and negotiate the corresponding BK. Using a formal logic of PCL, WAPI certificate authentication protocol is programmed and its security properties are proved. The results show that if all the entities involved in the protocol do not reveal their long-term keys or short-term keys, this protocol provides the properties of strong session authentication and key secrecy and achieves its predefined security goals.

articleTitle: A Study on the Measurement Model of Complexity of Information System Strategic Planning
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the constantly changing information technology and business environments, the capability to accurately assess information system strategic planning (ISSP) complexity appears to be a key factor in improving ISSP performance. The major aim of this paper is to develop conception frames and measurement models of the ISSP complexity. The measures developed provide a sound foundation for future research in ISSP complexity and also have important practical implications.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation and Selection of Partner in Knowledge Share between Logistics Enterprises Based on AHP-TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since information technologies has become global to address the needs of the global market, companies take advantage of advanced information technologies in achieving their global supply chain. Knowledge share is now recognized as a key, competitive advantage of logistics enterprises. In the global economy, cooperation and alliance-based knowledge are increasingly important as the way of sharing knowledge interorganizationally. Yet, research into interorganizational knowledge share has been underdeveloped. So the selection of knowledge share partners has become the most important and serious problem for the logistics enterprises to make decisions. Partners' performance decides the effectiveness of the knowledge share and can lead to the success and failure of knowledge share. The evaluation and selection of appropriate partner is a multi-objective and multi-layer comprehensive problem, and some evaluation factors are subjective. To evaluate the partners objectively, this paper establishes the index system of partners in knowledge share according to SCOR index model. In the process of evaluating and selecting partners based on AHP method, we import the TOPSIS method to standardize the evaluation result so that we can get more objective and effective evaluation result and get the final appropriate partner.

articleTitle: A PN-Based Channel Estimation Algorithm in MIMO-Single Carrier Frequency-Domain Equalization System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We propose in this paper a channel estimation algorithm in MIMO-Single Carrier Frequency-Domain Equalization (MIMO-SCFDE) system over frequency-selective fading channels. In this algorithm the Pseudo-Noise (PN) sequences are employed as the pilots to estimate the Channel Impulse Responses (CIR). Performance analysis and simulation results of the algorithm show that it not only achieves better channel estimation performance within 30 dB Signal-to-Noise power Ratio (SNR), but also has lower computational complexity than the existing channel estimation algorithms used in MIMO- SCFDE systems.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Based on Share Database Mobility Management Architecture in Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless network, the integration of heterogeneous networks' mobility management is necessary. It is really an opportunity and challenge to study in this area. The primary factor currently limiting progress in mobility management is not any specific technical challenges (though many remain, and deserve much further study) but is instead the lack of overall mobility management architecture. The contribution of this work is a proposal of mobility management architecture in heterogeneous networks. It is a bow-tie architecture and imports information into a logically centralized, two-tier database. It supports heterogeneous wireless networks such as UMTS, Ad hoc, and etc. Moreover, this paper also discusses the handoff scenarios of heterogeneous network and simulates them.

articleTitle: Double Dimension Control Method for Performance Measurement on R&D Process
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the research and development (R&D) process indeed is a kind of parallel and staggered activities between technology and marketing, and based on the research of Paul Schumann and Derek Ransley and Donna Prestwood (1995), this paper proposes the double dimension control method for performance measurement on R&D process. First, the dissertation introduces the advantage of this method. Then, it illustrates the principal and framework of the method. Finally, as the performance measurement generally needs the indicators to evaluate performance, it designs the performance indicators and management procedure for the application of this new approach.

articleTitle: Qos Performance Analysis for Grid Services Dynamic Scheduling System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: State space model based on the discrete events is given to describe the grid services dynamic scheduling system which processes a number of heterogeneous jobs concurrently. Algorithm of QoS(Quality of Services) performance parameters analysis, such as queue length, total job numbers, throughput of the system, response time of job request, are developed. Calculation shows that suitable scheduling policy can make the response time of the system within a controlled scope and the system throughput within a stable state.

articleTitle: Study of CAPP System Suited for Reconfigurable Manufacturing System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on analyzing the new characteristics of reconfigurable manufacturing system (RMS) and computer aided process planning (CAPP) system in RMS environment, this paper proposed a CAPP system structure suited for RMS, which has flexibility, opening and integration. Based on dynamic manufacturing resource, it studied part information description method of CAPP suited for RMS and relevant integration process ratiocination mechanism, proposed a strategy of dynamic decision of manufacturing resource using BP neural network, constructed dynamic resource customization platform, implemented combination and reuse of manufacturing resource and process knowledge according to user customization. This CAPP system can create optimum process scheme according to dynamic change of production and manufacturing resource, dispose emergencies in time, and make relevant process regulation.

articleTitle: A Data Storage Method Based on Multilevel Mapping Index in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Limited response time and energy are important metrics in the wireless sensor networks, and coexistence of ad hoc queries and periodical queries is also very important. This paper proposes a data storage method based on multi-level mapping index, and integrates responding time constraints of periodical queries and ad hoc query. It divides the whole network into levels, builds data index in every level, as the same time considers multi-attributes, and adopts different data storage methods in different levels. The experiments express that this multilevel mapping index data storage method can save a great deal of energy and satisfy the response time, and support the mixed query types.

articleTitle: Engineering Algorithm of the Atmospheric Attenuation in the Infrared Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The attenuation of infrared radiation in the atmosphere is one of the important constraint factors of infrared wireless communication and therefore the study on the attenuation rule of infrared radiation in the atmosphere has great significance on the infrared wireless communication. This paper analyzes the main reasons of the energy attenuation of infrared radiation in the atmosphere transmission, presents the engineering algorithm and basis of atmosphere transmission rate, thereby it provides the theoretical guidance for the design of infrared wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Research on a Manufacturing Cost Estimating Method Based on ABC for Aeronautic Product
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to estimate the manufacturing costs for aeronautic product by using activity-based costing (ABC) method and to calculate the aeronautic product cost with bill of material (BOM) accurately and flexibly. Based on the existing cost framework of aeronautic product, the cost objects, activities, and resources in aeronautic product are analyzed. Then, an ABC-based cost estimation method for aeronautic product is put forward, in which the activities are divided into direct activities and indirect activities. Furthermore, the process of the ABC-based cost estimation is introduced.

articleTitle: Tracking In-Transit RFID-Tagged Goods Using Multi-Agent Technology
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach integrating RFID and multi-agent technology to monitor in-transit goods status and its environmental information. RFID technology provides real-time access to the tagged goods in automatic fashion. Using multi-agent technology, collected raw data can be processed locally before they are sent out, which reduces the size and cost of data transfer. In addition, the filtered information is sent back to back-end enterprise application via short message system of mobile telecommunication platform, which is feasible even in outdoor communication environment. We finally implement a prototype system based on the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Computational Trust Model in Online Auctions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aimed at the limitation of traditional trust model in online auctions, considering the characteristic of online auctions, the paper presents five trust decisive factors; then the paper an improved trust model that combines these factors to measure the trustworthiness of participants in online auctions. The simulation results show that compared with the existing models, our model performs more robust and effective.

articleTitle: A Rate Control Scheme Based on MAD Weighted Model for H.264/AVC
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Under the network bandwidth and the delay constrained, the rate control has become a key technique for video coding in order to obtain consecutive and high quality reconstructive video picture. Rate control scheme of the basic unit in H.264/AVC mainly adopted the linear MAD predict model and the quadratic rate distortion model, in the process of implementing, after coding a macroblock, the parameters of the models will be updated, and then computes the quantization parameters of the current macroblock. So, its computation cost is very high, and its complexity is also very high. Through analyzing the rate control scheme of the H.264/AVC JVT G012rl, the paper proposed an improved low complexity the MAD weighted predict model, and make the accurate rate control in the macroblock layer, and carried out it in the JM98 platform of JVT reference software in H.264/AVC. Extensive experiment results show the complexity of this scheme is lower than the JVT-G012rl of H.264/AVC, and the average PSNR of the usually standard test sequences increased O.lldB, at the same time, its accuracy of the rate control of the QCIF sequences averagely improved 0.498 kpbs.

articleTitle: Research on AS/RS Simulation Modeling and Evaluating Based on Flexsim Software
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a series of models, methods, steps and procedure for building AS/RS simulation and evaluation system based on Flexsim software: building simulation model for independent ASRSVehicle limit output and entire integrated systemic; doing simulation experiment for single cycle storage/retrieve and integrated process; evaluating the system operating efficiency and performance, throughput, bottleneck and the key equipments utilization. A case study about an automobile parts factory AS/RS system simulation and evaluation are introduced, and some of customized programming arithmetic and tips by using Flexsim script in designing ASRSVehicle retrieving dispatch module are proposed.

articleTitle: Energy and Storage Efficient Directed-Diffusion for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose an energy and storage efficient directed diffusion (ESEDD) scheme for wireless sensor networks, where the interest-associated nodes stores only neighbor nodes in the gradient direction to the sink, and when transmitting the data only the nodes which have the most energy will be chosen for next-hop forwarding. The simulation results have shown that the proposed scheme is more storage and globally energy efficient, and can largely prolong the lifetime of network.

articleTitle: Supply Information Management System Based on Holonic Virtual Enterprise and Web Services
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Next generation of Web services aim at providing whole solution by composition of distributed services. This new characteristic meets the need of facilitating the operation of holonic virtual enterprise(HVE), a form of virtual enterprise, which organizes resources in form of holarchy to satisfy customers and meet market requirements. In this paper, holonic virtual enterprise(HVE), supply information management system(SIMS) and Web services are introduced. Based on HVE and Web services, the requirements for SIMS are analyzed. The infrastructure of SIMS is designed. By analysis of supply operation in HVE, the key Web services and their deployment on infrastructure are designed. Finally, the dynamic composition of Web services are illustrated and composition paradigm is concluded. With the results, we can implement a SIMS to support operation of HVE and manage the supply related information as needed.

articleTitle: Queueing Times in Geom(N)/G/1 Queue with Relative Priorities
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper considers the mean queueing times for a multi-class discrete-time Geom/G/1 queueing model with relative priorities. We have derived the mean remaining queueing times for a job given its class, starting from the service commencement of an arbitrary job and conditioning on the numbers of other jobs from all classes. Based on this result, we obtain the unconditional mean queueing times upon arrival, which are functions of traffic intensities and priority parameters of all classes. Finally, we also give some numerical analysis in order to observe the effects of traffic intensities and priority parameters on the mean queueing times of each class on condition that there are two classes of jobs in the queue.

articleTitle: On the Capacity and Outage Probability of an Air-Ground CDMA Cellular System with Imperfect Power Control
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Accurate power control is an essential requirement in the design of cellular code division multiple access (CDMA) systems. The performance analysis for the three-dimensional air-to-ground (AG) cellular system becomes an important issue. In this paper, assuming that the imperfect power control follows log-normal statistics, the capacity and outage probability of the aeronautical communication system are examined and quantified. The system capacity is calculated with a given outage probability and power control error. From the numerical results, it is shown that the system is rather sensitive to small power control errors.

articleTitle: The Effects of Organizational Structure on Technological Innovation: An Empirical Study in Chinese Automobile Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to be able to compete in the changing and intensify competitive environment, companies hold technological innovation(TI) to be an important factor for success in today's business environment. This paper examines the effects of organization structure (OS) variables on firm 's TI performance in Chinese automobile industry. Five key aspects of OS are considered. They are formalization, locus of decision-making, hierarchical layers, internal boundary, and external boundary. A contingency approach is taken by simultaneously examining the moderating effects of firm size. Regression results show that all dimensions of OS which mentioned above, but locus of decision-making by way of an exception, have significant influence on TI performance. Subgroup analysis reveals that these main effects are, for the most part, moderated by firm size. The results suggest that firms seeking to attain high TI performance should consider the important role played by OS, and the managers need concern themselves with firm size when they reforming the OS to match the desired level of TI performance.

articleTitle: Effect on Cooperative Innovation Performance from Knowledge Sharing Between Supply Chain Enterprises Based on Improving Innovation Ability
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cooperative innovation is one of the important drive factors of supply chain (SC), and knowledge sharing is the foundation of the cooperative innovation of SC enterprises. Knowledge sharing among nodal enterprises can produce greater profits and realize cooperative effect. The paper analyzes the effect of knowledge sharing on the cooperative innovation performance, expressed as profit-making level, through the Stackelberg game model. The paper finds that improvement of the knowledge sharing degree (KSD) will obviously improve profit-making level of nodal enterprises and the whole SC. Finally, the paper proposes two approaches, including establishment of SC system based on knowledge sharing and construction of knowledge sharing management system based on credit, to improve knowledge sharing degree and enhance cooperation performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Sensor Information Fusion and its Application
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The accuracy of original data processing is one of the primary causes that lead to low reliability in detecting system. In this paper Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) is studied in order to solve this problem. Aiming at the limitation of ANN theory in multi-sensor information fusion, we propose an improved ART algorithm and use it in environmental detecting system. The experiment shows that it not only improves the reliability of the system, but also optimizes the handling of correlated information and contradictory information.

articleTitle: Performance Effects of IT Capability and Customer Service: The Moderating Role of Service Process Innovation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The effect of information technology (IT) for firm performance is lasting paid much attention. The relationship between IT and firm performance requests intermedium through which IT may influence firm performance. However, there is limited academic investigation on how IT can create performance gains for firms through customer service. This study proposes that customer service in service delivery and service customization are significant mediators through which IT influences firm performance. We also argue that service process innovation is a critical organizational factor that moderates the relationship among IT, customer service (service delivery and service customization), and firm performance. The study examines how the IT capability of a firm should be managed and organized to enhance service delivery and service customization, in turn, whether and how service delivery and service customization influence firm performance. Furthermore, through our theorizing, we draw attention to a significant role of service process innovation as a critical moderator in contemporary firms.

articleTitle: A Projected Feature Selection Algorithm for Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In contrast to many popular feature selection algorithms that provide suboptimal solutions according to some criterion, the OCFS algorithm can ensure optimal solutions according to the orthogonal centroid criterion. Based on the properties of OCFS, this paper proposes a projected feature selection algorithm called projected OCFS (POCFS) for data classification. POCFS extends OCFS to select different features for each class pair individually rather than to select the same features for all the classes simultaneously. Thus, It can select more suitable features for classifier construction than OCFS. Experimental results on real data set KDD- CUP99 indicate that POCFS outperforms OCFS in terms of their effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Performance Simulation of OSTBC Over Rayleigh Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: OSTBC(orthogonal space-time block codes) is a new channel coding technology accompanying with the extensive application of wireless communication. It combines coding, modulation, transmit and receive diversity, and validly increases the anti-noise performance in fading channels. Based on typical channel model of the OSTBC in MIMO (multiple-in, multiple- out) wireless communication channels, a general expression of instant output SNR (signal-to-noise ratio ) and anti-noise performance for OSTBC over Rayleigh fading channel is deduced, and the simulation and the comparison and analysis of the BER(bit-error rate) results are implemented on several OSTBC systems, based on different modulations using Simulink.

articleTitle: Adaptive Cluster-Head Algorithm for Bluetooth Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ad hoc networks have brought many varieties of applications for mobile digital devices, such as body area multimedia environment, smart home networks, and sensor networks, etc. However, because batteries carried by each mobile node have limited power, energy efficiency becomes one of the most important issues of ad hoc networks. In this paper, we propose a novel adaptive cluster-head algorithm for ad hoc networks based on Bluetooth technology, which selects candidates for cluster-head by fuzzy logic algorithm and generates a flexible structure to share the power consumption and traffic load with the cluster-head dynamically. Simulation results show that the networking lifetime is increased substantially with respect to LMS and BlueMesh algorithms.

articleTitle: The Objective Evaluation of Road Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article discusses the concept of objective evaluation of road construction projects and confirms the estimator to evaluate, based on the formers' research on objective evaluation. We evaluate the target of road construction project at the owner's position, and constructively put forward a suit of indices using the logical framework approach on the objective evaluation of road construction. The course of evaluation is also involved briefly.

articleTitle: A Extended Web Feature Service Based Web 3D GIS Architecture
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Lacking of standard interpretable platform can be a significant reason to limit the development of 3D GIS, the same situation exist in web 3D GIS. This paper will investigate the possibilities to public a functional 3D geo Web services platform using OGC specifications for the Web feature service. To fulfill the requirement of Web feature service and to improve the interoperability of data, we choose a new data modal language - CityGML which is implemented as an application schema for the geography markup language 3 (GML3) to build 3D geo-data. Then present a web 3D GIS architecture based on Web feature service, and give out the key techniques and implementation method of this architecture, finally carry out a prototype environment, to prove the architecture can adequate for access to 3D geo-data.

articleTitle: Constructive Backtracking Heuristic for Hybrid Flowshop Scheduling with Limited Waiting Times
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper deals with the hybrid flowshop scheduling problem with limited waiting time constraint. The problem is to determine a schedule that minimizes the makespan for a given set of jobs over a finite planning horizon respecting the constraint that for each job the waiting time between two consecutive stages cannot be greater than a given upper bound. To solve the problem, a constructive backtracking heuristic algorithm is developed and experimentally analyzed. The proposed algorithm operates on the technique of so-called recursive backtracking which constructs a schedule from sequenced job the first to the last, and for each job from the first stage to the last, while respecting the limited waiting time constraint. Computational experiments show that the proposed algorithm performs well both in efficiency and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Comparison of Chinese Domestic Outsourcing Management with Western "Best Practice" a Multiple Case Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Modified Energy-Aware DSR Routing for Ad hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: DBF, DSDV, DSR and AODV are the shortest path protocols for Ad hoc network. According to energy, the shortest routing may be not the best routing. At present, most of energy-aware protocols only consider the transmitting-power of every hop, or the leaving-power of nodes. A new mechanism of energy-aware named EDSR for ad hoc is proposed in this paper, which is based on the classic DSR (the routing protocol on demand). In EDSR, the routing which spends less energy and owns larger capacity is synthetically analyzed and then selected, so it can save more energy and prolong the living of network.

articleTitle: Loss Temporal Dependency Tomography in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to the inherent stringent bandwidth and energy constraints, it is usually impractical to directly collect link loss statistical data from each node in sensor network. Here we consider the problem of inferring the internal link loss characteristics from end-to-end measurement. We use the Gilbert error model to model the sensor link losses, formulate the problem of link loss characteristics estimation as a Bayesian inference problem, and propose a MCMC algorithm to solve it. The simulation shows that the link loss performance parameters can be inferred accurately, and the proposed algorithm scales well according to the sensor network size.

articleTitle: A Successful ERP System Case Study Based on Comprehensive Analysis of Influencing Factors
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Focusing on the problems about the low success rate of IS and lack of comprehensive success and failure factors analysis, a IS conceptual framework on business perspective is applied for comprehensive analysis on a successfully implemented and applied ERP system case. It is shown that the foremost purpose in constructing IS is to obtain solutions to business challenges, the factors related to management, organization and technology have interactive influence on IS success or failure, and the key of IS success lies in if it combines effectively with management transformations and organization measures embedded in it.

articleTitle: A Bandwidth Scheduling Algorithm Based on Minimum Interference Traffic in Mesh Mode
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper has studied the impact of interference traffic on transmission performance in IEEE 802.16 Mesh network. A new routing algorithm based on minimum interference traffic is proposed. Based on the routing tree a corresponding collision-free scheduling procedure is discussed. Because the impact of interference traffic can be controlled effectively, the system throughput has improved greatly. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Large-Scale IP Traffic Matrix Estimation Based on Fratar Model and ART
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method of large-scale IP traffic matrix estimation, called FratarArt method by us, which is based on Fratar model and Algebraic Reconstruction Technique (ART). Firstly, we model OD flows as Fratar model and introduce the constrained relations between traffic matrix and link loads. At the same time, we consider the nonnegative constraints of traffic matrix. By Fratar model, we can get a good prior of network tomography. As a consequence, a good estimation of traffic matrix is attained with ART. Finally, we use the real data in true network Abilene to validate our method. The results show that our method can perform fast the accurate estimation of traffic matrix and track its dynamics. In contrast to TomoGravtiy (Zhang et al., 2003), our method improves remarkably and the estimation of traffic matrix is closer to real data.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for the Joint Replenishment Problem with Multiple Resource Constraints
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The deterministic joint replenishment problem with multiple resource constraints is presented and its mathematic model is set up. On the basis of that, a full analysis is given of the relationship between decision variables T (basic cycle time) and k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub> (replenishment frequency of item j), then bounds on T and k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">j</sub> are obtained. A modified simulated annealing algorithm is proposed to search the optimal value within a much tighter range and the problem is effectively solved. The results of the example indicate that the algorithm can get a good solution and is applicable to larger problems.

articleTitle: Study on Tradeoffs Between Weapon System Cost and Performance Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the weapon system development and design process, support vector machine was brought forward to implement the tradeoffs between system performance parameters and cost to effectively control system cost and enhance cost benefit. In current adopted methods, the analysis process of iterative methods is too complex, whereas small perturbation methods adopt excessive approximate means to assure the statistic linear relationship between performance parameters and cost, which is hard to be insured in the practical application. Support vector machine has a favorable adaptability to the modeling of nonlinear system and can disposal the small sample problem in weapon system cost analysis, which can solve some practical difficulties existing in cost analysis. According to the essence of tradeoffs between weapon system performance parameters and cost, this paper discussed the general process of tradeoff analyses and validated the practicability and effectivity of the adopted method through the application analysis on a case. Both theoretical analyses and practical applications show that the system identification model established by support vector machine has the satisfying accuracy and generalization capability, and the optimal performance parameters can be obtained by adopting Davidon least square methods (DLS). The results are satisfying.

articleTitle: The SIS-BD Model of Computer Virus Spreading on Internet
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article from a new view of the complex network, utilizes in the stochastic theory approaches of the non-equilibrium statistical theory, has studied computer viruses on Internet spreading. In the SIS model foundation, we derive the birth-death master equation of the computer virus to disseminate on Internet, namely SIS-BD model, use the generating function method, and obtain the infection density function along with the time distribution rule which approach more in the real process about computer virus to disseminate (survival) on Internet. It proved on a side that the network virus will be able to coexistent with the Internet in very long period of time, provided a new view and some deeper understanding for the computer virus spreading theory research, and benefited to study and utilize the new immunity strategy to maintain the security on Internet.

articleTitle: Key Technologies of Manufacturing Information System Management Supporting Networked Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to implement manufacturing information sharing among allied enterprises in networked manufacturing environment, and solve the information interaction problems of design, manufacturing, quality inspection and resource utilization, manufacturing information system was managed by a manufacturing information management system which had been realized in this paper. Manufacturing information system management was composed of manufacturing resource management, process design information management, manufacturing process management and quality information management. Several key technologies such as the access control strategy based on dynamic interfaces, the dynamic authorization assignment strategy based on task, role and time, the distribution technology of invocation conflicts and the weighted retrieval algorithmic based on dissimilarity were discussed in detail. These technologies were adopted to realize multi-user information interaction and ensure security and stability of the information. Feasibility and effectiveness of the system were verified by a case of enterprise application.

articleTitle: Hand-Around: A Handoff Evolution with Monami6
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We proposed a high density wireless integration network procedure - hand-around in this paper. We introduce Simultaneous Mobility Binding (SB-MIP) in IPv4 and Mobile Nodes and Multiple Interfaces in IPv6 (Monami6) for this network procedure. After comparing the advantage and disadvantage, we conclude that Monami6 is the proper layer 3 mechanism in hand-around processing environment. At last we simulate handoff latency and bandwidth exhaustion to confirm our discussion.

articleTitle: Measuring and Identifying Knowledge Sharing Capability of Organizations
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge sharing is the core of knowledge management in organizations, and how to measure and identify the knowledge sharing capability of organizations is an important issue in the knowledge sharing field. Firstly, the concept of knowledge sharing capability of organizations is proposed in this paper. Two dimensions, including technical and non-technical capability, which form the knowledge sharing capability of organizations, are analyzed. Then the measurement index system and method are given. Finally, a matrix model is established to identify the knowledge sharing capability of organizations and analyze the strength and causes of formation. At the same time, corresponding improvements are proposed.

articleTitle: Information Sharing and Coordination Mechanism for Supply Chain Management: A Case Study of the Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study aims to investigate the problems of uncertainty embedded in the automotive supply chain and design the coordination mechanism of supply chain management (SCM) to reduce the uncertainty disturbances. In order to understand the uncertainty that occurs in the interaction among supply chain participants, this study conducts an investigation on two levels - vehicle manufacturers (VM) and suppliers. The results of case studies suggest an increased level of customization, which will create more uncertainty to the extant supply chains. This can be translated into requirement for demand policy objective. To accompany with supply chain process redesign towards market mediation and supplier involvement, combining information sharing with coordination mechanism can reinforce the existing IT infrastructure of the automotive industry to achieve the policy objective of VM.

articleTitle: Study on Iterative Demodulation and Decoding for Short-Wave Frequency-Hopped OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the characteristic of short-wave frequency-hopped (FH) communication, an OFDM/FH system based on iterative demodulation and decoding is proposed. By combining the advantage of NSD technique and iterative demodulation and decoding, the method could compensate the SNR loss caused by differential modulation and improve the reliability of short-wave communication and improve the system reliability. Numeric simulation results show that the proposed method could effectively improve the system BER performance and reach good transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: The Correlated Vehicle Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a variant vehicle routing problem (VRP) to tackle the routes assignment in a lumpy demand environment, where the required capacity is affected by demand variability and the correction between the demands assigned to the routes. The correlated VRP is defined by a TSP-based formulation to minimize the distance traveled and the number of vehicles. A genetic algorithm approach is developed for solving practical problems. The computational results reveal that the correlation between the demand of customers should be evaluated and taken into consideration in the vehicle routing assigning process, which can prevent leading to either additional over or under capacity during the planning period.

articleTitle: UWB Pulse Design Method Based on Chebyshev Function Approximation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ultra Wideband radios will unavoidably face/cause severe interference from/to the existing narrowband systems nearby. To avoid interference, one of effective methods is to design appropriate pulse waveform. In this paper the problem of pulse design was equal to the problem of chebyshev function approximation and Remez algorithm was used to acquire the optimum pulse waveform. Matlab simulation results showed that the power spectrum density of the pulse based on chebyshev function approximation meets the power constraint of the objective spectral mask. The comparison were presented for the bit error rate performance analyses of the pulse position modulation time hopping ultra wideband impulse radio communication system employing the pulse and the second derivative Gaussian pulse in the additive white Gaussian noise channel. The performance of the pulse is better than the second derivative Gaussian pulse.

articleTitle: A Strategy for Self-Configuring Physical Carrier Sensing Threshold in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Physical carrier sensing plays an important role in collision avoidance, and the physical carrier sensing threshold is one of key parameters to wireless networks performance. With a view to the challenge of energy-efficiency in wireless sensor networks, this paper presents a strategy for self-configuring physical carrier sensing threshold based on estimation of the background noise. By the simulation results, it is verified that the physical carrier sensing threshold evaluated by this strategy can work well under the conditions of different background noise.

articleTitle: Systems Plan for Combating Identity Theft - A Theoretical Framework
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The incidences of identity theft have increased substantially in the Internet age. Increasing news reports of bank/credit cards theft, assumed identity for economical and criminal activities has created a growing concern for individuals, businesses, and governments. As a result, it's become an important and urgent task for organizations to find managerial and technical solutions to combat identity fraud and theft. Solutions to identity theft problem must deal with multiple parties and coordinated efforts must be made among concerned parties. This paper is to provide a comprehensive view of identity theft issue from system planner's perspective. The roles of identity owner, issuer, checker, and protector, are examined to provide a starting point for organizational and information systems design.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity PAPR Reduction Technique for STBC MIMO-OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Selective mapping algorithm is proposed to reduce the peak-to-average power ration (PAPR) in MIMO-OFDM system. It is proved that the conjugate symbols on two antennas have the same PAPR property with orthogonal space-time block coded (STBC). By using the characteristic, the computational complexity cost and the side information (SI) is significantly reduced compared with the concurrent SLM algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the performance of the proposed algorithm outperforms the conventional concurrent SLM algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on Indoor and Outdoor Environment for Mobile Ad Hoc Network Supported with Base Stations
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Most of MANET simulations based on random mobility models, e.g. random waypoint model, models insufficient to reflect the environmental constraints. In this paper, we evaluate an ad-hoc wireless network and investigate on performance issues in urban area. We have tried to simulate by adding base stations to adhoc architecture in urban area for wireless networks and compare their performance based on a number of factors. In this study we have used two type of mobility model (Manhattan mobility model and random waypoint mobility model). We have used ns-2 for all our simulations. In all our simulations, we have tried to quantify the effects of factors like routing protocols, mobility patterns and type of traffic, that affect the performance of ad hoc networks. Specifically, this paper evaluates the impact of these factors on the following performance metrics: throughput, packet delivery ratio and dropped packet.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection Based on Aggregated Network Behavior Metrics
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Network measurement is important to many network management tasks, including traffic anomaly detection. Aggregating packet header information is an effective and efficient way to collect network traffic statistics. We propose a set of aggregated network metrics that may be used to characterize the overall network behaviors. These metrics are generated from packet header based statistics and are stable to normal traffic while sensitive to anomaly. We further apply principal components analysis and information gain analysis to reduce data size. It is evaluated by experiments that the proposed detection system may generate satisfactory classification of network traffic.

articleTitle: Research on PKI-Based E-Commerce Security Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a new business model, E-Commerce provides a more convenient business mode and lower transaction cost for customers allover the world. The development of E-Commerce challenges to the business management ability and the information delivery technology. The establishment of the security architecture is the most important problem. And currently E-Commerce security is still an obstacle of the development of E-Commerce. So it has become a crucial step for E-Commerce to construct a safe and effective transaction environment. The paper puts forward a PKI-based E-Commerce security model utilizing PKI (Public Key Infrastructure), which is a generally adaptive secure infrastructure. Then the paper analyzes the application and security of the model, in order to make beneficial attempt in the field of E-Commerce security.

articleTitle: Joint Channel Assignment and Transmission Scheduling for Throughput Optimization in Wireless Mesh Networks - Further Study on a Partitioning Approach
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we extend the partitioning approach proposed in (Brzezinski et al., 2006), which considers jointly channel allocation and transmission scheduling under the primary interference constraint, into the more general model of wireless networks - the protocol model, and discuss the application of the approach in the physical model.

articleTitle: An Improved DM Algorithm Based on Rough Set Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The basic idea of an improved algorithm is outlined in this paper firstly, includes main steps and the advantages and disadvantages of CART algorithm; and then the definitions of attribute importance and the system comprehensive information entropy and the algorithm of maintaining maximum system comprehensive information entropy are presented. Compares to some disadvantages of CART algorithm such as low computation efficiency of extraction rules and long rule length, the improved algorithm has effect in the experimental result.

articleTitle: The Application of Information Collection System That Based on RFID Technology in Supply Chain Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper tries to solve the problem on existing supply chain management. The paper puts forward a novel information collection system that based on RFID technology. The paper discusses that how to build this system by bottom up mode. Also the paper describes that how to use the system on supply chain management and the change that bring from by using it. In the end it deeply analyses the advantages of this newly information collection system.

articleTitle: An Empirical Comparison of Weibull and Its Extended Models for New Product Trial Calibration and Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Weibull distribution is a convenient and flexible model for new product trial calibration and forecasting, however, the impacts of 'never triers' and heterogeneity in consumers are largely neglected in previous studies. In this study, we extend Weibull model by incorporating these two impacts, and make an empirical comparison across Weibull and its extended models. The results reveal that calibration and forecasting accuracy of the extended models are significant improved.

articleTitle: Effects of Information Asymmetry on Listed Companies' Debt Financing: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the pecking order theory, among the company's external financing channels, debt financing should be selected firstly. Based on financial market microstructure measuring method of information asymmetry and Fama- MacBeth regression technology, the study finds that Chinese listed companies' ratio of debt increases with information asymmetry. When listed companies' financial deficit is higher, the positive relationship between debt ratio and information asymmetry is significant.

articleTitle: The Research of the Logistic Enterprises' Competitiveness: Based on the View of Dynamic Capabilities Theory and Competitive Advantage Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recent years have witnessed a surge of interest in the notions of capabilities and competitive advantage as the important sources of the enterprises' competitiveness. In this paper, we construct an evaluation model for the competitiveness of the logistic enterprises based on the views of dynamic capabilities theory and competitive advantage theory. We analyze the external sources, internal sources, and methods of wealth creation and capture by logistic enterprises operating in environments for rapid technological change. We set up a competitiveness evaluation index system, employed SPSS statistical software, analyzed and compared the competitiveness of the logistic enterprises. Using a large sample of data from SSE and SZSE, we attempt to empirically study the importance of dynamic capabilities. The results and analyses were found to be useful for improving the competitiveness of the logistic enterprises.

articleTitle: A New Model to Evaluating the Investment Decision-Making of Water Saving Irrigation Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Through applying projection pursuit evaluation (PPE) model based on real coding based accelerating genetic algorithm (RAGA) in the investment decision-making of water saving irrigation project, this study turns multi-dimension data into low dimension space. So the optimum projection direction can stand for the best influence to the collectivity. Thus, the value of projection function can evaluate each item good or not. The PPE model can avoid jamming of weight matrix in the method of fuzzy synthesize judgment, and obtain better result. The authors want to provide a new method and thought for readers who engaged in investment decision-making of water saving irrigation and other relative study.

articleTitle: The Impact of Hidden Nodes on MAC Layer Performance of Multi-Hop Wireless Networks Using IEEE802.11e Protocol
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The IEEE802.11e network provides different with QoS (quality of service) guarantee for different traffic streams. The Enhanced Distributed Channel Access(EDCA) in IEEE802.11e MAC protocol is proposed to support prioritized QoS on the basis of the Distributed Coordination Function(DCF) in IEEE802.11. This is first paper which assesses the effectiveness of the IEEE802.11e access mechanism in multi-hop wireless networks by quantitative analysis and simulation. We build a new modeling analysis methodology for the 802.11e access mechanism in multi-hop environments with hidden nodes problem. By using M/G/1/K queuing model, we can analyze a few MAC layer performance metrics of multi- hop wireless networks, such as MAC layer throughput, the mean packet delay and packet discard probability, and give better explanation to performance degradation in delay and throughput due to the impact of hidden nodes. The proposed model is calculated numerically and validated against simulation results, we observed a good match between the analytical model and simulation. Because the performance of 802.11e supporting class- based differentiated QoS degrades considerably in multi- hop environments, it is necessary to investigate the scheme which can resolve hidden nodes problem.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Program Management (PM) and Project Management in Enterprise Strategic Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A framework for application of project portfolio management (PPM), program management (PM) and project management is proposed for employment with enterprise strategic management (ESM). From corporate strategy, business strategy and functional strategy, the three level strategies, the framework illustrates the alignment between PPM, PM, project management and ESM. The theoretical evolution of project management area from traditional project management and then PM, to recently PPM is summarized. On the basis of Diamond-E model for strategic analysis, the paper analyzes the necessity and significance of application of PPM, PM and Project Management in ESM. The advertences of applying PPM, Program Management and Project Management in ESM are summarized as well.

articleTitle: A Novel Ray Tracing Acceleration Method for Radio Propagation Modeling Based on Prior Environment Processing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ray Tracing has been successfully used in prediction of wave propagation models in recent years. Although this method has its own obvious benefits, it suffers from a big problem: slow performance. In this paper, a novel method is proposed in which the main focus is on reducing the number of ray-facet intersections. It includes a light-weight pre-processing operation on the environment which is completely independent of the locations of source and target and is performed once for each environment. In this step, measures for the distances between entities in the environment are computed and saved. Later in the main procedure, theses data will come to help reduce the number of ray-facet intersection tests dramatically.

articleTitle: Route Optimization Solution Based on Extended Prefix Information Option for Nested Mobility Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: NEMO basic support protocol (Devarapalli et al., 2005) enables mobile networks preserve communication with other nodes, while changing their point of attachment to the Internet. But in nested mobile network, Pinball routing problem appears. In this paper, a route optimization solution for mobile networks based on extended prefix information option in RA message is proposed to solve the suboptimal routing, packet overhead and latency problems. By extending router advertisement message and modifying movement detection, the solution makes a difference between handover inside nested NEMO and outside nested NEMO. By using root MR's CoA as its own CoA, tunnel length is shortened and encapsulated level is reduced. Registration in nested NEMO makes handover latency as short as possible. And security and location privacy are considered in this solution too. So the solution can improve performance greatly for nested mobile networks, when a mobile network moves frequently and performs handover within nested mobile networks.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonious Management of Organization Knowledge Based on K-BLOG
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For resolving the paradox of knowledge sharing, this paper puts forward the concept of harmonious management of organization knowledge (HMOK) by introducing the "hexie " idea in ancient China, analyses the theoretical characteristics of the organization knowledge hexie and the ways to implement it. This paper also puts forward using K-blog to bring the HMOK into practice. On the basis of the analyses of the connotation and the merits of K-blog, this paper discusses the mechanism of K-blog facilitating organization knowledge hexie, and points out that the development strategies of K-blog oriented organization knowledge hexie should start from establishing the strategy of HMOK, constructing management system, building harmonious circumstances.

articleTitle: Using Extended Activity-Network Diagram to Design a Process Quality Control Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A complicated mechanical product to be manufactured always contains a series of procedures named processes or operations which form a complicated network diagram. In order to guarantee the process quality and the final quality of product, this paper presents a process quality control model by using the extended activity-network diagram technique. In this control model, task nodes correspond to processes or operations and arcs to relationship between two nodes. The functions of a task node are made up of event and status. The event refers to the activities of off-line or on-line quality control and fault diagnosis of a process or an operation while status to error status and its transmitting rule of a process or an operation. The proposed model can map and navigate the quality control procedure of multistage processes well.

articleTitle: A Conceptual Model of Manufacturing Quality Information Based on Product Structure Tree
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Quality information produced in manufacturing process is closely related to the decision of the objectives of product quality. However, manufacturing quality information is rarely taken into consideration by product and process designers. It is very difficult for designers to identify, capture and represent. Firstly, the characteristics of product structure tree as product information carrier are analyzed, and then the concept model of manufacturing quality information based on product structure tree is given. Secondly, in the light of ideas of object- oriented modeling, product information can be abstracted as product class, data class and relationship class. Manufacturing quality information belongs to data class. Data class can further be divided into attribute class and document class. Manufacturing quality information is abstracted as data object, and then can be added to product general structure tree. Finally, based on understanding the merits of combination between XML language and STEP standards in quality information representation, a three-layer framework of manufacturing quality information is proposed. It includes application layer, logical layer and physical layer.

articleTitle: Research on Time Period Characteristics of Information Communication Model of Unexpected Public Crisis
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, all kinds of unexpected public crises have brought danger to the stability and development of economy and society. Researches on information communication processes of unexpected public crisis (UPC) and management mechanism has attracted more and more attentions of various society organizations and government. In this paper, we will redefine and classify UPC. Then after summarizing some representative models on information communication, an information communication model of UPC based on information stream intensity is presented.
