We outline in this paper a dynamic service update framework for system wide online mixed version software upgrades by taking the advantages of inherent persistent queuing and state transition export mechanisms commonly in MOM implementations. Our goal is to demonstrate, through a real world application of proposed framework herein, that a service behavior oriented software upgrade methodology is in practical deployment superior to those that are either programming languages oriented, or runtime processes oriented focusing on inner software implementations.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for 4-D Parameters Jointly Estimating of Near-Field Sources
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Source localization is an important problem in array signal processing and it is used to estimate the direction of arrival (DOA) of multiple sources. In this paper, we present a four-order cumulant based ESPRIT like method for passive localization of near-field narrowband non-Gaussian sources using a centrosymmetric cross array. The proposed method uses the multiple-rotational invariance among certain cumulant-domain signal subspaces for 4D parameter (carrier frequency, elevation, bearing and range) estimation of multiple sources. The method does not require any spectral peak search, only needs 1D parameter pairing, and can be applied to additive Gaussian noise environment. The performance of the proposed method is verified by computer simulations.

articleTitle: A Reference Model for MIMO Mobile-to-Mobile Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a geometrical two-erose-ring scattering model under the assumption that both the transmitter and the receiver are moving. Derived from this model, a multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) mobile-to-mobile channel model is given. Here, we focus on the reference model, which is based on the assumption that the transmitter and the receiver are surrounded by an infinite number of local scatterers. From a wave model, the complex channel gains are derived. The procedure presented in our paper provides an important framework for designers of future mobile-to-mobile communication systems to develop their concepts.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load-Balanced Routing with Bandwidth Reservation in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An ad hoc wireless mobile network is an infrastructureless mobile network that has no permanent routing device. Any mobile host may have direct radio links with other hosts in its vicinity and could function as a relay station routing traffic to its final destination. Ad hoc networks significantly facilitate untethered communication as mobile devices can be connected dynamically in an arbitrary manner. However, an efficient routing protocol is crucially demanded in ad hoc networks environment due to the unpredictable topology changes caused by nodal movement or failure. To ensure uninterrupted communication, a dynamic load-balanced routing (DLBR) algorithm is presented in this paper. DLBR defines new metric for effective bandwidth reservation, which can adapt well to bandwidth-constrained scenarios. Efficient rerouting scheme is also addressed in DLBR to further improve packet delivery ratio. Simulation results show that DLBR can not only reduce packet drop rate while supporting more mobility, but also balance the load of the entire network and thus contribute to packets salvaging.

articleTitle: An Alternative Agent Approach for Managing Thermal Comfort in Office Buildings
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy consumption and the comfort of occupants are two import issues in office buildings. Various intelligent agent systems and other technologies thus have been proposed to co-ordinate these two issues in office buildings. However, none of these tools are effective. One possible reason is that these tools were developed based on the existing thermal comfort equation, which assumes that all occupants share the same comfortable skin temperature when performing the same activity. This assumption is questionable. In this study, a personalized thermal comfort equation is therefore proposed. Based on the personalized thermal comfort equation, an intelligent thermal comfort agent control system is proposed to optimize energy consumption and occupants comfort in office buildings.

articleTitle: The Empirical Study on Stylized Facts in Brent Crude Oil Price System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, based on the time series of Brent crude oil prices (daily spot), by introducing some functions to explore empirically the price dynamics and behaviors in crude oil prices, we investigate the information in price system and analyze the price behaviors especially the system memory mechanism of historical information, thus we discuss the long- term memory mechanism existed and analyze numerically the non-periodic cycles in the system; furthermore, we find nontrivial fractal features and multi-affine spectra in Brent price system; finally, we calculate the two-time autocorrelation functions and get exponential decay for small values. All numerical results support that there exist stylized facts in Brent crude oil price system.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Pair-Wise Key Establishment Protocols for Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Public-key cryptography protocols provide more scalability and security than symmetric-key protocols. It is assumed that public-key cryptography pair-wise key establishment protocols are not suitable for wireless sensor networks due to its high energy cost. This paper reports on the results of performance comparison of three typical pair-wise key establishment schemes that cover these protocols: SPINS, random key pre-distribution protocol and our public-key scheme, the former two protocols are based on symmetric-key cryptography. Our performance analysis shows that, public-key cryptography is suitable for modern wireless sensor networks if we carefully choose public-key algorithm, such as ECC-160. The analysis results are useful at key establishment protocol design in future.

articleTitle: Loan to Value to Newsvendor Based on Stock Document Mortgage
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In China, the bank is facing a challenging design problem of credit contract based on inventory financing. The paper studies credit contracts based on stock document mortgage with two risk-neutral gamers. Our model includes the case of a bank offering loan to a cooperative retailer who mortgages its inventory to the bank to finance more inventory. The retailer faces a random demand in a single sales season as in the classical newsvendor problem. By game theorem, we give the optimal loan to value to retailers with different initial capital. We show the wholesale price, the storage cost and the salvage price have influence to bankruptcy risk and loan to value, as well as the initial capital. Finally, based on our model analysis, we give some advices.

articleTitle: SERPVAL Construct Validation in Multi-Service Industries of Chinese Context
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Service personal values are key elements in consumers' cognitive structure, and have long been considered an important variable in understanding consumer purchasing behaviors. In this paper, we will validate SERPVAL scale by measuring the personal values that are associated with mobile service, banking, restaurant and retail in Chinese regional consumption context. The result shows that the data fit the first-order and higher-order model well, and the scale has a good validity.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Indoor Positioning Method Based on IEEE 802.11
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although many outdoor location techniques have been proposed, these techniques are ideal outdoors but they are generally not available indoors. With the increasing use of mobile computing devices and an expansion of wireless local area networks (WLAN), there is growing interest in an indoor wireless positioning systems based on WLAN infrastructure. This paper proposes a method that is based on IEEE 802.11 and uses the received signal strength (RSS) of WLAN transmissions from/to WLAN access points (AP) to determine the position of the mobile target; this paper also gives corresponding positioning algorithm. In the proposed method, the indoor environment is divided into several sub-spaces and a database of signal characteristics is created according to the characteristic point and signal transmission model in different sub-spaces, then we can achieve the purpose of indoor accuracy positioning.

articleTitle: A AQM Model with Multi-Priority and Multi-Receiver for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: AQM (Active Queue Management) is an effective scheme to enhance congestion control. Most of the mobile networks today use queue management to manage and improve network performance. In this paper, we deploy AQM mechanism in Mobile Ad Hoc networks to manage the packets queue in the network nodes. By modeling a node with multi-receiver in Ad Hoc networks, we develop an analytical model for a multi-server and finite capacity queuing system with AQM mechanisms under multi-classes of traffic. We consider multiple classes of traffic modeled by Poisson arrival and exponentially service processes. It deduced the performance metrics including the average queue length, system throughput, probability of drop packet and the average waiting time. Then, it illustrated the relationship between above metrics and the number of servers. Finally, by demonstrating the effective number of servers, it illuminate that we should deploy appropriate number of servers for a certain condition.

articleTitle: An Efficient Index for Moving Objects with Frequent Updates
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communications and positioning systems, tracking the positions of moving objects is becoming more and more important. The TPR-tree and its variants are the dominant choices for indexing the current and anticipated near-future positions of moving objects, but the TPR-tree exhibits lower performance in the condition of frequent updates. In this paper, we propose a novel TPR-tree based indexing technique, called the TPROM- tree that could decrease the cost of frequent updates. The TPROM-tree processes updates in a memory-based way that eliminates the necessity to delete the old data item from the index during an update. Performance experiments indicate that the memory-based strategy outperforms the top-down technique used in TPR-tree and leads to indices with better query performance.

articleTitle: Speckle Reduction for Remote Sensing Images Based on Nonsubsampled Contourlet
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Existing speckle reduction methods for remote sensing images such as SAR cannot capture image edge detail information and reduce noise effectively at the same time. The nonsubsampled contourlet (NSCT) is built upon nonsubsampled pyramids and nonsubsampled directional filter banks and provides a shift-invariant directional multiresolution image representation. Therefore, a speckle reduction model based on NSCT is presented. Firstly original image with speckle noise was transformed into with additive noise by means of homomorphism transform, and then the NSCT was implemented, finally threshold denoising method was adopted to separate the noise and signal. A comparison between the above NSCT denoising method and conventional methods was carried out on remote sensing images contaminated by multiplicative noise and SAR original image. The experimental results show that the performance of the NSCT is superior not only in speckle reduction but also in edge preservation.

articleTitle: Iteratative Soft Interference Cancellation for Uplink Turbo-Coded MIMO MC-CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A SISO iterative joint detection and decoding receiver structure is proposed in an uplink turbo-coded multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) multicarrier code division multiple access (MC-CDMA) system. The SISO detector is achieved by using soft interference cancellation V-BLAST detection and multiuser detection with minimum mean square error (MMSE) technique. And the soft interference cancellation is composed of the canceling of multiple-access interference and co-antenna interference (CAI). Simulation results show that the iterative cancellation receiver in turbo coded system can gain much better performance than conventional receiver in uncoded system. A low-complexity scheme is also presented.

articleTitle: Risk Management of Small and Medium Enterprise Cooperative Innovation based on Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Innovation is the impetus and source of small and medium enterprises (SME) development, because of the puniness of SME innovation strength, and the cooperative innovation is become the main innovation method. Because the objective reality nature of the risk of SME cooperatively technological innovation, it is necessary to take measure to prevent and indemnify the loss which the risk may bring. There does exist the complex non-linear function mechanism between the risk factors, so the non-linear method can be used to research the keeping way and controlling mechanism of cooperative innovation of SME, and this paper is just to do that. At first, this paper analyzed the seeking method of SME cooperative innovation risk, and then we put forward the concept of controlling risk regulation gradient of the cooperating technical innovation under network environment. At last, we bring forward a complete controlling risk model of the cooperating technical innovation under network environment, and this controlling risk model is based on the wavelet and nerve network.

articleTitle: Making Data Mining Relevant to Business
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Data mining is a tool for knowledge discovery. Recent discussions in this field state that data mining does not contribute to business in a large scale. This article discusses the important role of business insider centered knowledge development through data mining in making data mining relevant to business.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Cross Layer Design for Broadcast in Ad hoc Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Power is a precious resource in ad hoc wireless networks due to the limited battery capability. Broadcast is an important operation in ad hoc wireless networks. The broadcast algorithm must be designed carefully to avoid serious contention, collision, and congestion. Contention, collision and congestion of broadcast used up valuable resources in the ad hoc network such as power and bandwidth. Hence, it is important to design energy efficient broadcast algorithm to prolong the life span of ad hoc network and improve the performance for broadcast. Many literatures showed that a rigid layered structure does not work efficiently to preserve energy and broadcast in ad hoc networks. We develop energy efficient cross layer broadcast (CLBA) algorithm which jointly addresses the issues of transmitted power control and dynamic connected dominating set formation to improve performance of broadcasting in Ad hoc network. Simulation studies indicate that compared with flooding and TOP algorithms our algorithm has good performance in terms of reachability, average broadcast latency and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Synchronization for MIMO OFDM Systems with Loosely Synchronous (LS) Codes
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a time and frequency synchronization technique for MIMO OFDM system by employing the loosely synchronous (LS) codes as the training sequences. The auto-correlation functions of all LS codes are ideal, and there exists an interference-free window (IFW) or a zero correlation zone (ZCZ) in their cross-correlation functions of the LS codes around the origin. These properties of the LS codes make the synchronization of the MIMO OFDM system easily and more accurate. The synchronization process proposed in this paper can be viewed as the four stage process of 1) segmented matched filter based coarse time acquisition, 2) the coarse frequency offset estimation by the fast Fourier transform (FFT) technique with quadratic interpolation in the frequency domain, 3) fine time acquisition and channel estimation by LS code coherent detection, 4) phase rotation based fine frequency offset estimation. Through the simulation, the synchronization algorithm shows satisfactory performance even at a low SNR, high frequency offset and in a frequency selective channel.

articleTitle: GML Mapping Mechanism Based on Agent
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper points out the demerits of current schema mapping methods for geography spatial information interoperability. GML mapping mechanism based on agent is proposed in order to create the mapping relationship among the heterogeneous data sources and accomplish GML data transform. The implementing framework of schema mapping and the structure of knowledge base are also given.

articleTitle: A Framework for Architecture-Oriented Modeling and Analysis of Information Systems Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to avoid severe performance problems' emerging after implementation, architecture-oriented modeling and analysis of information systems performance (ISP) should be conducted in advance. In this paper, for solving deficiencies existing in model architecture, modeling and analysis process and modeling languages of current literatures, through analysis and synthesis, a framework for architecture-oriented modeling and analysis of ISP consisting of corresponding three components is proposed. Moreover, the framework was used in the architecture design phase of an online bookshop system.

articleTitle: Implementation of Adjustably Developable Surfaces Using Duality Between Point and Plane Geometries
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An explicit and efficient method of computer-aided design for adjustably developable surfaces is proposed. It is based on the important idea of duality between plane and point geometries. The shapes of developable surfaces can be adjusted using a control parameter. We show that the techniques for the geometric design of developable surfaces in this paper have all the characteristics of existing approaches for curves design. Further, we present a new method of displaying control planes and the generating plane at physically and geometrically meaningful location relative to the resulting surface. The new algorithm can not only overcome the difficulties in representation of developable surfaces utilizing traditional approaches, but also resolve the problems in adjusting and controlling the shape of developable surfaces that often faced in Engineering.

articleTitle: The Motivation Model of Science & Technology Talents Based on "Value-Oriented Man" Hypothesis
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper combines the "value-oriented man hypothesis with motivation mechanism according to the "value- oriented man" hypothesis of science & technology talents(S&T talents), and analyzes the characteristics of "value-oriented man": strong self-awareness, independent values and keen desire for value-actualization, desire for advancing self-value, desire for flow, loyalty to career., namely S,W,D,A,J. Then, this paper proposes value-oriented man's five kinds of needs corresponding to S, W, D, A, J., and establishes "value-oriented man" double- circle motivation model. Finally, from views of S, W, D, A, J, it puts forward tactics to motivate Chinese S&T talents for independent innovation.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a New Kind of UWB Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper is focused on the application of antijamming communications in the military. A new kind of UWB signal named multi-sub-channels multi-time direct sequence spread spectrum which applied in the ultra-short wave is promoted by analyzing and improving the UWB MC-DS-CDMA. The signal's generator model and format are given in the paper. The anti-jamming performance of this signal is analyzed by comparing it with that of UWB MC-DS-CDMA. Then the simulation is carried out with the help of Advanced Designed System, which is a simulation software of Agilent, and the result shows that this new kind of UWB signal has greater antijamming performance.

articleTitle: Optimal Waveform Design for UWB Communication Based on Gaussian Derivatives
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Ultra-wideband (UWB) radios have attracted great interest for their potential application in short-range high-data- rate wireless communications. High received signal noise ratio and compliance with the FCC spectral mask call for judicious design of UWB pulse shapers. In this paper, even and odd order derivatives of Gaussian pulse are used respectively as base waveforms to produce two synthesized pulses. Our method can realize high efficiency of spectral utilization in terms of normalized effective signal power (NESP). The waveform design problem can be converted into linear programming problem, which can be efficiently solved. The waveform based on even order derivatives is orthogonal with the one based on odd order derivatives.

articleTitle: An Improved Wireless Location Algorithm Based on Chaos Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Chaos optimization algorithm (COA) can get the global optimization as ergodicity merit in chaos orbit. We improve the chaos optimization algorithm (ICOA) for wireless location, which is designed to get the initial value for the Taylor location algorithm. Considering the convergence problem in Taylor algorithm and the statistical property of chaotic sequence of Logistic mapping and Kent mapping, an improved hybrid Kent-Logistic mapping model is developed and applied for location. As MS is very close to the serving BS, the MS location can be realized directly by Kent-Logistic model. The performance of the algorithm shows better accuracy than the conventional approaches based on TDOA.

articleTitle: The Study of the Knowledge Increment of Team Study and the Study-Time Validity
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we suggest that the knowledge increment contains two parts which are the increase of the total knowledge and the increase of knowledge innovation, and the total study time is made up of the ineffective study time, the knowledge- searching time, the waste thinking time and the effective thinking time. The preceding three kinds of time have negative effect for the knowledge increment of team study, and the last one is positive. We also think that the effective thinking time contains the thinking-innovative time and the iterative knowledge - memory time. Compared with the iterative knowledge -memory time, the thinking-innovative time has more positive effect. Then we offer a math model to show the influence relationship of the knowledge increment and the study time. At last after analyzing a great variety of factors which can influence the study-time validity, we also offer a math model to quantify the relationship between those factors and the study-time validity. Further more, we use a practical case - the study of team train of China Executive Leadership Academy, PuDong to validate our conclusions.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of Financing Plan for Real Estate Development Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Detection Algorithm for MIMO-OFDM Beamforming System With Feedback Delay
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The traditional beamforming in MIMO-OFDM systems uses the subcarriers characterized by the largest eigenvalues to transmit the OFDM block symbols. In contrast to the previous one, the optimal beamforming in MIMO-OFDM systems use the N best subchannels in all optional orthogonal subchannels. But when feedback from receiver delays, the optimal beamforming in MIMO-OFDM will appear self- interference in the subcarriers that have more than one subchannels. The self-interference will impact the performance severely especially when the normalized Doppler frequency is large. In this paper, we proposed two novel detection algorithms to reduce the self-interference. Both of them use the instantaneous and last OFDM symbol's channel coefficients to compute the self-interference and depress it before demodulation. Simulation results reveal that when feedback delays, the optimal beamforming will be impacted severely and sometimes even degrade worse than the traditional beamforming. After adopting the proposed detection algorithms, the performance will be improved.

articleTitle: Elimination of Interference Non-Reciprocity in TDD MIMO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless communications systems with time-division duplex (TDD) deployment, channel reciprocity and symmetric interference between transmitter and receiver sides are two widely-adopted assumptions for the design of optimal adaptation transmission mode. However, in practice, there is an undesirable but non-negligible effect, namely the asymmetric interference, that makes the assumptions no longer valid. In such a case, the downlink modulation/coding parameters assigned based on the uplink measurements may lead to excessively high frame error rate (FER). In this paper, a simple closed-loop feedback method of compensating interference asymmetry in TDD multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems is proposed, which makes the transmit side estimated interference tracks the instantaneous receive side interference dynamically. The proposed method maintains constant FER by adopting adaptive modulation coding (AMC) and power loading. The final simulations have verified the effectiveness of the new method.

articleTitle: Resource Reciprocal Strategies for Cellular and Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, resource reciprocal strategies (RRS) for cellular and ad hoc networks are proposed. Unlike the unified cellular and ad hoc networks (UCAN), we consider some device convergence schemes between cellular and mobile ad hoc networks (MANET). Especially, an additional router (AR), a MANET database (MDB) and a MANET management system (MNMS) are added on cellular access device, which will substitute for some routing function on ad hoc terminals. Mobile terminals submit position information to MNMS when they make a registration or when they update position information. Based on the information, AR creates a temporary routing for terminals in the coverage range of access device. Finally, routing table is sent back to terminals which will set up an ad hoc connection via cellular radio access technology. Reciprocally, the coverage range and capacity of cellular network is improved by the help of ad hoc networks. Among resource reciprocal strategies, we create a suited air interface scheduling policy and a position-based routing protocol. These reciprocal strategies bring some new opportunity in convergence evolution of cellular and ad hoc networks.

articleTitle: MTDS: A Multicast Tree Dynamic Switching Approach Based on Rate
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Shared tree needs less state information stored in routers, but RP (rezendous point) can bring congestion easily. Source tree is in favor of balancing network traffic, but the cost of constructing the tree is relatively high in light traffic. A multicast tree dynamic switching approach based on rate, which takes advantages of both source and shared trees is proposed to promote multicast QoS in MPLS networks. At most time shared tree is adopted to optimize network resource assignments. When the total arriving rate at RP or some sources' transmitting rates exceed respective maximum threshold, some high rate sources are switched to source tree to avoid the congestion at RP. If the rates decrease, they can be switched back to shared tree. The simulation results show that the packet loss rate and end-to-end delay is improved by deploying the switching approach in MPLS networks.

articleTitle: Capacity and Optimization of Alamouti Coded OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In time-varying multipath Rayleigh fading channels, Alamouti coded orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems suffer from time selectivity of the channels. Recently, the uncoded bit error rate performance of Alamouti coded OFDM systems with several detection schemes have been investigated. In this paper, another important system performance criterion, i.e., the achievable capacity, is addressed for Alamouti coded OFDM systems. Based on the effective signal-to-noise ratio, the bound of ergodic and outage capacities are derived analytically. Numerical results show that these bounds are tight enough and can be used to predict the system performance. Furthermore, based on these bounds, we observed that there exists an optimal value of the number of OFDM subcarriers from the point of view of maximal capacity, which can be obtained through simple numerical computation.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonious Mechanism of Infrastructure Investment Projects Choosing and Deciding
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is obvious that infrastructure is very important to the healthy development of town economy and society. Moreover, because that infrastructure investment needs enormous amount fund, so projects choosing and deciding has become the key factor that related to infrastructure investment effect. This paper tried to establish harmonious mechanism of infrastructure investment projects choosing and deciding in macro level by using "HeXie" Management Theory. Here, "HeXie" Management Theory that put forward by Xi You-min is just the theory about harmonious management. On the basis of analyzing the forming mechanism of harmonious mechanism, the harmonious running mechanism of infrastructure investment projects choosing and deciding was established; furthermore the harmonious controlling mechanism with the abilities of adapting and adjusting dynamically was established too. We hope the research will benefit the practice.

articleTitle: Distributed Spatial Data Collaborative Production Architecture in Grid Environment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Spatial data production and update is a systematic project which is costly and involves significant resources. But traditional spatial data production architecture is difficult to share resources and collaborate among organizations. So in this paper, a distributed spatial data collaborative production architecture in grid environment is proposed, which make advantage of grid technology to organically integrate existing spatial data production resources into a whole, and achieve the object of distributed spatial data collaborative production. This paper analyzed the collaborative architecture and the virtual organizations firstly, and then studied every core components of the architecture. Ultimately, for validating the architecture presented in this paper, we provide a collaborative production prototype system.

articleTitle: The Bidding Strategy Analysis of Power Suppliers Based on the Risk Assessment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To maximize the expected profit, the power suppliers may plan bidding strategy in different markets and in different periods. In the planning, the bidding risk is the key factor that the power suppliers must consider. The optimal bidding strategy model is put forward, in which the conditional value at risk (CVaR) is taken as the risk measurement and the object function, and the expected profit is taken as the restriction condition. The model explains the optimal bidding strategy in multi-period combination markets at a certain significant level. This method of using the CVaR as the objective function overcomes the shortcomings of VaR which can't meet the consistency risk measurement when the payoff satisfies the abnormal distribution, furthermore, this method can distinguish the factors which should not be taken as the risk when the return is higher than the mean value. Finally, the validity of this optimal bidding strategy is presented by an example.

articleTitle: Topology-Based and Power-Adaptive Routing Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For Wireless Sensor Network, energy efficient routing algorithm is critical to maximize its system life-time. To achieve this goal, a multi-hop routing path is favorable because it avoids direct transmission to the BS. In this paper, a Topology-Based and Power-Adaptive Routing (TBPAR) algorithm is proposed with emphasis on exploiting the topology matrix of wireless sensor network. In this algorithm, each node adapts its transmitting power according to its remaining energy and connection is established only on "Strong" link between each node. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm increased the life-time of whole network and reduced the difference in life-time between each node.

articleTitle: Multicast Routing Based on Ant Algorithm with Multiple Constraints
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We present an efficient QoS multicast routing algorithm based on ant algorithm. It considers multiple QoS metrics, e.g., bandwidth, delay, delay jittter. Our approach of constructing a multicast tree is to find the shortest paths from the source to each destination separately by ant algorithm and then merge the resulting paths to form a multicast tree. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can find the optimal or near-optimal solution quickly.

articleTitle: A Multiuser Detection Scheme for SFHMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a multiuser detection (MUD) scheme based on co-channel interference cancellation for a slow frequency-hopping multiple-access system. The error performance of the SFHMA system with the proposed MUD scheme is investigated over the interference-only channel. Both analytical and simulation results are presented, and it is shown that the MUD algorithm can improve system performance considerably.

articleTitle: A Trust Framework for Pervasive Computing Environments
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to the uncertainty and mobility of pervasive computing environments, trust modeling has been regarded as an important problem. At present, there are lots of researches on trust model for pervasive computing. In this paper, a novel trust framework for pervasive computing is presented. The hybrid framework is based on a trust model, a security model, and a risk model. From the framework presented, uncertainty problem in pervasive computing environments can be solved well. Moreover, from the simulation results, we can see that the framework is dynamic and lightweight enough to be applicable to in pervasive computing environments.

articleTitle: Lifetime Maximization in Wireless Sensor Networks with Network Coding
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The lifetime is a critical parameter for wireless sensor networks, which is defined as the maximum time of delivering certain data to the sink node before sensor node runs out of energy under an initial energy is given. In this paper, we propose a distributed algorithm for data gathering in wireless sensor networks with the assistance of network coding, such that the network lifetime is maximized. We prove rigorously that the proposed algorithm converge to the optimal solution of regularized problem.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Risk Management in Chinese Process Industries
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Process industries are important component of Chinese economy. While supply chain risks are going up rapidly under globalization, it affects process industries to operate continuously and safely. Thus it is necessary to research on how to manage risks in process industries supply chain effectively. In this paper, we identify supply chain risks underlying Chinese process industries and present some mitigation strategies. However, the application of mitigation strategies costs much, and different mitigation strategy has different effect on risk reduction. In order to select optimal mitigation strategies effectively without exceeding the expenses budget, we develop a 0-1 ILP model. In the case study, we draw out the needed data after interviewing with managers and operation workers of a chemical company in Shanghai. Moreover, we use software LINDO 6.1.to achieve the optimal solution. Finally we discuss how the change of model parameter affects the optimal solution and present future works.

articleTitle: Evaluate and Compare Chinese Internet Search Engines Based on Users' Experience
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The performance and capabilities of Web search engines is an important and significant area of research. Millions of Chinese people use Web search engines every day. This paper describes the evaluation of three Chinese search engines based on human judgments. As a case study, three popular Chinese search engines are examined. We develop an online tool to assist human evaluation. The evaluation takes the relevancy aspects as well as the subjectivity of the search engines users into account. This study provides the results show that there is small degree of differences between them. It also provides the evidence suggests that there are some factors indeed influence the experience of search engine users. The report may be useful supplements to other studies of compare search engines that are being tried by search engine researchers.

articleTitle: BER Performance Of Complex Parallel Combinatory Spread Spectrum Communication System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a novel composite parallel combinatory spread spectrum (CPC/SS) communication system. CPC/SS system can be designed to have more higher data transmission capability than spread spectrum (SS) communication system, even several times on Gaussian channels compared to ordinary parallel combinatory spread spectrum (PC/SS) system. In the proposed system, modulation of position code and state are applied to each simultaneously transmitting PN sequences. The symbol error rate and average bit error rate are analyzed to evaluate the performance of the proposed systems. Furthermore, CPC/SS system has excellent secret property than PC/SS and CDMA communication systems.

articleTitle: An Area and Power Efficient FFT Processor for UWB Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a novel 128-point Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) processor for practical Ultra-wideband (UWB) applications. The pipeline FFT processor based on the proposed non-Cooley-Tukey radix-8 unit can provide high throughput rate and has low hardware complexity. The radix-8 unit's hardware cost can save up to 20% compared with Radix-2 Single path Delay Feedback (R2SDF) architecture. Furthermore, both the input and output are in nature order. A 128-point FFT processor has been designed and implemented with SMIC 0.18 mum CMOS process based on the proposed architecture. The throughput rate of proposed FFT processor is up to 409.6 Msample/s, which can meet the specification of UWB systems.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Multi-Party Fair Exchange Protocols
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Fair multi-party exchange protocol is a new focus of research. We have made some researches for the modeling and analysis of multi-party fair exchange protocols recently. We use alternating transition systems, a game based model, to model protocols and alternating temporal logic, a game based logic, to express requirements that the protocols must ensure. This method is automated by using the model-checker MOCHA, a model-checker that supports the alternating transition systems and the alternating temporal logic. Fairness of multi-party exchange protocols are analyzed by using MOCHA.

articleTitle: Dynamic Zone Based Multicast Routing Protocol for Mobile Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: ODMRP protocol is a typical Mesh-based multicast protocol with high performance for MANET, but its poor scalability limits the application of it in large scale networks. To overcome this limitation, a dynamic zone based multicast routing protocol (DZBMP) for MANET is proposed. In DZBMP, the network is divided into overlapped zones dynamically which are mesh-based. Mesh structures inside each zone provide good adaptability to network topology changes. Dynamic zone-based routing serves good scalability. The proposed DZBMP protocol is simulated and compared with ODMRP on OPNET. Simulation results show that DZBMP performs better than ODMRP on the aspects of communication overhead and forwarding efficiency when the size of multicast group grows up.

articleTitle: Research on Project Risk Evaluation Method Based on Markov Process
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The risk management is always an important point and tough subject in the project management. However, the proposal of the general project risk analysis theory provides a new idea to solve the project risk In this paper, Markov chain in absorbable state is used in the project risk management. According to "non-aftereffect" of Markov process, a state transmission probability matrix is built to analyze and predict the project future development state. It also provides a quantitatively feasible method to analyze the project risk. In the end of this paper, a construction company project risk evaluation example is applied to testify the validity of this method.

articleTitle: Solving Multi-Objective and Fuzzy Multi-Attributive Integrated Technique for QoS-Aware Web Service Selection
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper focuses on developing a new multiple criteria decision-making (MCDM) methodology for global web services selection based on QoS criteria, which integrates the multi-objective optimization with a fuzzy multi-attributive group decision-making (FMAGDM) technique. The study concentrates on the task of finding and then evaluating (or ranking) the finite number of pareto-optimal design alternatives (PODAs). A genetic algorithm based multi-objective optimization technique is employed for optimization purpose in terms of experts' opinions. Subjective attribute based aggregation technique for homogeneous and heterogeneous groups of experts is employed and used for dealing with the fuzzy opinion aggregation. Finally, we will discuss the integrated technique for Web services selection on global QoS optimization.

articleTitle: Cooperative Opportunistic Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents CORP (cooperative opportunistic routing protocol) for WSN (Wireless Sensor Networks), providing robustness to the random variations in network connectivity while ensuring better data's forwarding efficiency in an energy efficient manner. Based on Realistic link layer, we combine the region-based routing, rendezvous scheme, sleep discipline and cooperative communication to model the data's forwarding by cross layer design in WSN. Simulation results show that COPR performs better than Non-cooperative opportunistic routing from perspectives of adaptation of variations in network connectivity and satisfying application QoS requirements.

articleTitle: A Simple Subspace-Based Semi-Blind Channel Estimator for Precoded OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a simple subspace based semi-blind channel estimator is developed for precoded OFDM systems. This channel estimator relies on redundant linear preceding. With this proposed channel estimator, the channel identifiability is guaranteed up to one scalar ambiguity, regardless of the channel zero locations and the underlying signal constellations. The ambiguity can be resolved with the known pilots inserted in the transmitted sequences. Computer simulations are conducted to support our analysis. The simulation results show that, compared with the well known LS estimator, the proposed estimator achieves higher estimation accuracy and is capable of tracking slow channel variations.

articleTitle: The Methodology of Post-Evaluation of River Basin Harnessing Project for Sustainable Development Based on Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In Chinese major basins, remarkable achievements have been made in river basin harnessing projects which focus on flood control since 1998. Evaluating the projects on view of sustainable development is necessary for project managers to guide their water conservancy investments. In this paper, (1) a post-evaluation (PE) methodology to comprehensive evaluate the economic, social and environmental benefits of the project is suggested; (2) optimal selection of ordnance engineering project based on entropy weight multi-objection decision-making is presented; and (3) the case unfolded in post-evaluation of Hunan province's river basin harnessing project, is given. The results provide the project's operational state, and also systematically evaluate these abilities which can support the national socioeconomic development.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of MIMO Channel Sounder Architecture in Between TDM scheme and FDM scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A conventional channel sounder for measuring MIMO radio channel is based on time division multiplexing (TDM) using pseudo-random binary sequence (PRBS) as a pilot sequence and can measure the MIMO channel accurately in slow fading environment. However this sounder has a big drawback that the accuracy of channel measurement is degraded largely in fast fading environment. To overcome this limitation, channel sounding architecture based on frequency division multiplexing (FDM)[1] has already proposed, but the performance comparison between novel FDM scheme and conventional TDM scheme was not presented. In this paper, channel sounding performance between conventional TDM scheme and proposed FDM scheme is compared by mean square error (MSE) and angular spread error (ASE) through simulation. As a result, it is shown that the FDM sounding architecture measures MIMO channel more accurately than TDM sounding architecture with regard to MSE and ASE.

articleTitle: Adaptive Power Allocation for Cooperative Relaying System in Fading Wireless Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Cooperative relaying technique is a promising technique to provide high rate data transmission. In this paper, optimal power adaptation which maximizes the capacity of relaying system in time-variant wireless channel is addressed. Different from the existing power adaptation methods, where the total instantaneous transmit power of the source terminal and the relay terminal is fixed, the total transmit power is allowed to vary with the channel fading state. We develop an equivalent channel gain model for both the amplify-and- forward and the decode-and-forward relaying mode, based on the optimal power adaptation between the source and the relay. Using the equivalent channel gain model, the relaying channel is modeled as an equivalent direct transmission channel. Then, the optimal power adaptation is found by the time domain water- filling approach. With the time-varying nature of wireless fading channel exploited, our approach is capable of achieving higher channel capacity than the existing power adaptation methods.

articleTitle: QoS Performance Improvement for WLAN Using Priority Random Early Detection
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this article, we pay attention to the qualities of service (QoS) on wireless LAN. We proposed a Priority Random Early Detection (PRED) algorithm, which integrated random early detection (RED) with IEEE 802.11e EDCF so that QoS performance can be improved for WLAN. Under heavy traffic load condition, the performance of channel accessing will be inefficient due to collisions. PRED provides good differentiation among different access categories (AC). Compared with the usage of the traditional first-in-first-out (FIFO) queuing strategy with different priorities in a node, PRED supports higher throughput for high priority packets.

articleTitle: A Collaborative Tagging System for Personalized Recommendation in B2C Electronic Commerce
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, the B2C e-commerce achieved a rapid development on a global scope; more and more people began to use the Internet for shopping. However, the exponentially increasing information provided by Internet enterprises causes the problem of overloaded information, and this inevitably reduces the customer's satisfaction and loyalty. One way to overcome such problem is to build personalized recommender systems to retrieve product information that really interests the customers. The rapid development of Web 2.0 provides new ideas for personalized recommendation. In this paper we introduce the collaborative filtering, knowledge-based approaches and hybrid approaches in building recommender systems and discuss the strengths and weaknesses of each approach, we propose a collaborative tagging system to provide personalized product information to customers in B2C e-commerce websites and describe the system's architecture and point the system's advantage.

articleTitle: A Study of Information Technology Adoption for Small and Medium Sized Enterprises Strategic Competitiveness
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information technology is one of the key factor affects the enterprises' competitiveness in a modern economy. After reviewing the characteristics, value of strategies on SMEs information technology adoption and the relationship between the competitiveness and IT, this paper analyzed the connections between the IT adoption strategies and SMEs growth in the competitive world. It also addressed the management efficiency improvement, innovation strategies and E-business development as effective strategic methods for companies' future expansion.

articleTitle: Critical Success Factors of Infrastructure Projects under PPP Model in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In recent years, a large number of PPP infrastructure projects have emerged in China. But various reasons have led to a low success rate of these projects. The aim of this paper is to establish critical success factors model for infrastructure projects under PPP mode and to identify the links between these factors. So this research is of important practical significance to improve the success rate of PPP projects. On the basis of reviewing relevant researches of project critical success factors, this paper proposed forty-five success factors of infrastructure projects under PPP mode and found out twenty-one critical success factors among them through questionnaire survey and statistical analysis. Then the relationship between these twenty-one factors was analyzed by applying system engineering method and an interpretative structural model with six layer of recursive structure was established. The practical study in the last part showed that five factors can affect the realization of other success factors and are of especial importance. And these five factors should be the focus of future research.

articleTitle: Architecture on a Hybrid Business Process Design and Verification System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently business process management system (BPMS) has become one of the hottest research topics related to enterprise information systems. Based on some requirements in the emerging BPMS, this paper proposes an original architecture on a hybrid business process design and verification system (BPDVS). This architecture attempts to build a system that integrates the informal and formal approaches in the BPM related fields. In this way it can obtain practicability and robustness, which are presently strengths separately from the informal and formal approaches. The industrial standard - XPDL - is used as the informal process description language while a logic language - situation calculus - is employed as the underlying formalism to precisely specify a process. The hybrid BPDVS will integrate these two different process models and attempts to provide a more integrative and dynamic design environment for business processes.

articleTitle: A Further Study on Safety of Series and Parallel Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In safety-critical systems, there are both dangerous and safe failure states. This paper presents different models of safety-critical systems including series and parallel systems whose lifetime distributions are general forms. Also the reliability aspects are derived such as the probabilities that the system is in working state, fail-safe state and fail-dangerous state, the mean times for the system working, fail-safe and fail-dangerous. Finally some numerical examples are presented to illustrate the results obtained in this paper. These indexes have practical and theoretical meanings for the systems. The derived formulas are new results and can be used regardless of the forms of component lifetime distributions and have significant meaning for evaluating the system safety performance and can also be used to improve the safety design of systems.

articleTitle: A New Simple and Fast Algorithm for the Position Estimation Based on TOA
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile station position have been receiving more and more attention in recently years. Positioning via time of arrival is a kind of key technology. A simple and fast algorithm based on time of arrival technology is proposed in this paper. Through the first step estimation, we can easily get the rough value by changing the coordinate origin. And the precise value will be got through the second step estimation. The simulation results show that the estimation based on this method has excellent ability approached to CRLB.

articleTitle: A Parallel Multi-Agent Simulation Planning Approach to Complex Logistics System with Genetic Optimization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The importance and significance of planning of logistics system is analyzed. The logistics system operational diagram is depicted in general perspective. The mufti-agent system model is introduced and applied to design the planning model of logistics system. The parallel simulation technology is used to improve the efficiency. The genetic optimization is adopted to produce the better planning result in automatic mode, which overcomes the manual evaluation fault of system simulation. The software for the planning approach is developed with the support of swarm simulation package. An application case is demonstrated in the fast part.

articleTitle: Priority-Based Resource Allocation for RT and NRT Traffics in OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of adaptive radio resource allocation and QoS provisioning for real-time (RT) and non-real-time (NRT) services in OFDMA systems. The proposed algorithm tightly couples the subchannel allocation and packet scheduling together through an integrated cross-layer approach in which each packet is assigned a priority value by taking both the instantaneous channel condition and the QoS requirements into account. An efficient suboptimal algorithm with low computational complexity is proposed to solve the linear optimization problem. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can greatly improve the system performance in terms of high spectral efficiency and low outage probability compared to the traditional TDMA algorithm, thus is very suitable for the downlink of current OFDMA systems.

articleTitle: On the Cascading Data Collection Mechanism in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Inspired by the idea of network coding, we propose a cascading data collection (CDC) mechanism to reliably gather sensor data without any structural information. In order to send data back to the sink in the CDC mechanism, sensor nodes wait cascadingly based on their hops to the sink. The intermediate node stores the innovative received data from its farther neighboring nodes and sends out a packet carrying the received information as much as possible when its forwarding timer expires. Simulation results show the effects of various network parameters on the performance of the CDC mechanism and we find it can lead to a much lower energy costs and send data reliably compared with similar mechanisms.

articleTitle: A High Efficiency Algorithm of Power and Bit Allocation for OFDMA Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a high efficiency algorithm of power and bit allocation for orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) system, in which the allocation procedure is divided into three parts: linear water-filling power allocation, bit allocation and power and bit adjustment. It can quickly achieve the power and bit allocation on the user's sub-carrier level with a good fairness performance. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can obviously decrease the operation complexity and slightly descended system throughput contrast to other algorithms. It is a promising algorithm to be used in a practical system for radio resource allocation.

articleTitle: The Effects of Information Overload on the Outcomes of On-Line Consumption Behavior
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Traditionally, it is believed that more information leads to better buying decisions for consumers. However, as the amount of information increases beyond a threshold, consumers' subjective states towards decisions might adversely become worse. An experiment was used to examine these effects in the Internet shopping environment. The results reveal that cognitive involvement and self-efficacy moderate the relationship between information load and subjective state toward decision. However, the direct effects of information load are not significant.

articleTitle: A Design of Low-Cost Low-Bandwidth Mobile Video Surveillance System Based on DM6446
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Facing, challenges of bandwidth limitation, high realtime and high computing, we propose a novel design of mobile digital video surveillance system (MDVS) in virtue of hardware-software co-design approach and TI DaVinci technology. GPRS is adopted as communication network without infrastructure installation. The hardware based on dual-core DM6446 and software design based on H.264 tackle bandwidth and real-time challenges excellently. With other peripherals, the design implements a wide range of MDVS functionalities such as motion detection, PTZ control, etc. The merits of low cost, low bandwidth, high flexibility, ease installation, convenient operation make the application can be applied in a variety of scenarios.

articleTitle: Robust Time Delay Estimation Method Based on Fractional Lower Order Cyclic Statistics
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the presence of additive impulsive noise, the cyclic correlation and other second cyclic statistics degenerate and the cyclostationary information about desired signals is lost. To combat this effect this paper proposes a novel cyclic correlation which is well-behaved in the presence of alpha stable noise. Based on the proposed definition a new adaptive time delay estimation method based on fractional lower order cyclic statistics is developed. Simulations show that the performance of the proposed algorithm is robust both in Gaussian noise environment and alpha stable distributed noise environment compared to the traditional second cyclic statistics based time delay estimation method and another typical LMP method.

articleTitle: Exact BER Analysis of Hierarchical M-QAM in Spatially Correlated MIMO Nakagami Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We derive closed-form expressions for the exact average bit error rate (BER) of hierarchical square M-ary quadrature amplitude modulations (M-QAMs), when these modulation schemes are used along with orthogonal space-time block coding (STBC) over correlated multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) Nakagami-m fading channels with arbitrary fading parameters. The derived formulae can be used to assess the effects of spatial correlation on the BER performance of hierarchical M-Q AM.

articleTitle: SL-R Distributed Localization Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Localization is one of the supporting technologies in wireless sensor networks. In this paper, a novel SL-R distributed algorithm is formally described, designed, implemented and evaluated. The algorithm includes two stages. In first stage, sampling is carrying out based on received anchor information and the initial position estimate of sensor node comes into being. In second stage, the initial node position is refined. The performance of SL-R algorithm is evaluated from different aspect. Simulation results show SL-R algorithm is convergent under a few refinement times and achieves high localization accuracy in low sample size threshold. It also gets high localization coverage when anchor ratio is less. Comparing with similar methods, SL-R obtains higher localization accuracy.

articleTitle: Determinants of Knowledge Transfer in the Process of University-Industrial Cooperation: An Empirical Study in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper explores determinants of knowledge transfer in the process of university-industry cooperation. This paper constructs knowledge transfer theory model from five aspects: university transferring knowledge factors, firm receiving knowledge factors, knowledge ambiguity, mutual technology matching and interactive factors (i.e. trust and communication). To test the proposed model, we collect data from 169 research project groups in China, and conduct empirical research. Through statistical analysis, it is found that, from the view of university knowledge transfer factors, distinct positive correlative elements to knowledge transfer effect are university knowledge transfer ability and experience. From the view of firm receiving knowledge factors, distinct positive correlative element to knowledge transfer effect is firm's knowledge receiving experience. Knowledge ambiguity is distinct negative corrective element to knowledge transfer effect, and mutual technology matching is weakly positive corrective element to knowledge transfer effect. From the view of interactive factors, trust and communication are distinct positive correlative elements to knowledge transfer effect.

articleTitle: Timing Tracking Algorithms for Impulse Radio (IR) Based Ultra Wideband (UWB) Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recently, we have proposed low power transceiver architectures for impulse radio (IR) based ultra wideband (UWB) systems. Low power consumption is achieved thanks to the low duty cycle of UWB-IR signals, which allows to switch on the radio front-ends only for the instants where UWB pulses must be transmitted or received. Therefore, accurate synchronization of the receiver's timing reference with the incoming UWB signal's timing is critical in this context to avoid dramatic performance loss. Before data demodulation, the receiver's timing reference is usually aligned with the incoming signal's timing by using timing acquisition algorithms that rely on a known preamble. However, during data demodulation that is after timing acquisition algorithms, the offset between the crystal oscillators used at the transmitter and receiver still causes the receiver's timing reference to gradually drift away from the incoming signal's timing. In this paper, we first show that this problem causes dramatic performance degradation if not addressed. We then propose three low-complexity algorithms that allow tracking and compensating for the timing drift in our low duty-cycle context. Our simulation results show that the proposed algorithms are able to cope with the offset corresponding to the accuracy of typical crystal oscillators with minimal performance degradation. Moreover, one of the proposed algorithms is able to partially compensate for potential errors of timing acquisition algorithms that result in misalignments of the incoming UWB signal's timing and receiver's timing reference at the start of data demodulation.

articleTitle: An Incentive Model of IS Outsourcing Contract
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An approach to analyze incentive schemes and structuring IS outsourcing contracts for the mutual gain is presented in this paper. Outsourcing contract is critical to the management of the IS outsourcing relationship because improperly or incompletely written contracts can have significant negative implications for the firms. A linear principal-agent model based on EVA (economic value added) for constructing incentive contracts in IS outsourcing is developed. Incentive management literature relative to linear principal-agent model has focused on determining the proportion of agent's profit to principal's profit to receive maximum economic returns from agent's action. In fact, the validity of incentive is decided by the positive correlation between the variable of agent's performance and outsourcing output. Arguing the feasibility of using EVA to evaluate the outsourcing vendor's performance in IS outsourcing, a linear principal-agent model based on EVA is devised for improving IS outsourcing vendors' performance and the advantage and disadvantage of this model was discussed.

articleTitle: Transmission Control Solutions Using Interval Estimation Method for EPC C1G2 RFID Tag Identification
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Three framed-ALOHA-based transmission control solutions and interval estimation method (IEM) are proposed for EPCglobal Class 1 Generation 2 ( EPC C1G2) RFID system. The presented transmission control solutions build on earlier work on dynamic framed-ALOHA protocol, but have been adapted to address characteristics of EPC C1G2 RFID system. The proposed IEM selects directly optimal frame size from a table without calculating out the concrete number of backlog which is used in conventional tag estimation method (TEM). The three proposed schemes by IEM are compared with those by conventional TEM using simulation. Based on the simulation results, it can be seen that the performance of optimal interval transmission control solution (OITCS) using IEM is better than that of OITCS using TEM and those of the other two solutions using IEM or TEM regardless of the number of tags.

articleTitle: An Ant-Based On-Demand Energy Routing Protocol for Ad Hoc Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, an improved ant-based on-demand energy routing (AOER) protocol for ad hoc networks is presented. Based on the positive and negative reinforcements and distributed search of ant colony optimization (ACO), the information obtained by ants is stored in an inversed pheromone table which simplifies the data structures of routing packets. The remaining energies of nodes, the energy path cost and hop count are adopted as the metrics to evaluate paths and normalized with an exponent function, the pheromone table is updated with the normalized metrics and nodes with higher pheromone trail values will be selected as the next hop with higher probabilities. Experimental results on NS-2 show that AOER performs well especially in high traffic loads on energy conservation. Paths with more remain energies, less energy costs and less hop count will be selected as routings, therefore the lifetime of network will be extended compared with AODV.

articleTitle: Joint Frame Synchronization and Channel Estimation Scheme Using Regression Method in OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a joint frame synchronization and channel estimation scheme is proposed. Based on an OFDM frame format with adding the pseudo-noise code, the frame timing and the channel impulse response could be obtained by the regression method at the OFDM receiver. The performances with the proposed frame and channel estimation scheme are evaluated by the miss probability of frame start and estimator mean-square-error, individually. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme performs better than other frame synchronization schemes and channel estimation schemes.

articleTitle: Application of Support Vector Machine and Genetic Algorithm to Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Intrusion detection is actually a classification problem. It is very important to increase the classification accuracy. Support Vector Machine (SVM) is a powerful tool to solve classification problems. Many works have been done in intrusion detection based on SVM, and the detection accuracy is relatively high. But how to get a higher accuracy is a new question. In this paper, we apply SVM and Genetic Algorithm (GA) to intrusion detection to solve this problem. We first use GA for feature selection and optimization, and then use SVM model to detect intrusions. In order to verify our approach, we tested our proposal with KDD Cup99 dataset, and analyzed its performance. The experimental results show that the proposed approach is an efficient way in network intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Application of Entropy Coefficient Optimization Model of Multi-Criteria Decision in Post-Evaluation of Urban Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The post-evaluation of urban rail transit (URT) pays attention to the satisfaction degree of URT project to the social, economic and environmental benefit after its operation for some time. This paper uses some method system and practical efforts of project post-evaluation of URT for reference, connects it to practices of URT in China. It suggests that the objective entropy coefficient of post-evaluation criterion combine to the subjective weights of its importance in order to avoid incertitude and arbitrariness of the traditional way evaluating according to the expert's marking. It also gives the influence post-evaluation of URT utilizing the entropy coefficient optimization model of the multi-criteria decision and gets scientific and rational result, and so provides scientific reference for the project post-evaluation work of URT.

articleTitle: Extended Kalman Filter Location and Tracking Method Using Single Base Station in Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A location and tracking method utilizing extended Kalman filter (EKF) using single base station in cellular networks is proposed in this paper. The location method utilizing the AOA and the variance ratio of AOA is introduced. The paper also compares EKF and linear Kalman filter. The simulation result is illustrated to explain the location and tracking efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: SIP for Mobile Networks and Security Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: SIP is a powerful and useful signaling protocol supporting mobility multimedia services, however it is susceptible to various attacks due to its inherent weaknesses and vulnerability. In this paper, the threats and security mechanisms are analyzed and classified into different types. We establish a model of SIP network based on colored Petri net for the security issues. Through the simulation result, the detailed behaviors of SIP protocol are present, which is helpful to analyzing the threats and protecting the system.

articleTitle: Effect of Imperfect Channel Estimation on Multi-Branch Cooperative Links in Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The distributed cooperative diversity techniques are attracting a lot of attention as a means of advancing error performance and capacity. Transmit diversity is created when the selected stations assist a sender by relaying its information signal to the destination. The average symbol error rate (SER) of the distributed spatial diversity wireless cooperative system with L amplifying relays in Rayleigh fading and receiver maximum ratio combining (MRC) in the presence of channel estimation error is studied. Subsequently, we derive closed-form expressions for the SER of MRC in terms of the signal-to-noise (SNR) and the cross-correlation coefficient of the channel gain for the proposed cooperative amplify-and forward scheme. The SER and MSE formulas allow us clearly illustrate the imperfect channel state information on the performance of the distributed diversity system in fading environment. The loss of system performance is simulated in the presence of channel coefficient estimation error.

articleTitle: An Efficient Heuristics Search for Binary Sequences with Good Aperiodic Autocorrelations
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a memtic algorithm (MA) search for binary sequences with good aperiodic autocorrelation properties. The MA consists of an evolutionary programming framework and a local improvement procedure. The evolutionary programming searches the space of feasible, locally optimal solutions only.
