This paper designs the dynamic model of leaders' performance according to the order of time, quantitatively analyzes vary degrees of which main crucial factors in organizational system affect leaders' performance, depends on changes of cost utilization and organizational performance with keeping the stable state of action performance, regards optimum leaders' performance as the developing goal, adopts the method of marginal analysis and the technology of optimal control. In organizational system, the best way of improving and perfecting leaders' performance should be sought continuously.

articleTitle: Broadband Adaptive Beamforming Using UIA-MVDR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Broadband adaptive beamforming is considered in this paper with a view to avoid the signal cancellation caused by signal-correlated interferences. The classic approach of spectral averaging is applied. However, the proposed approach, referred to as unitarily interpolated array minimum variance distortionless response (UIA-MVDR), is distinguished by imposing a unitary constraint on the transform matrix. It releases the restriction on the order of Bessel function expansion so that very accurate array manifold approximation can be achieved even in the case of small or middle arrays. Compared with many related approaches, UIA-MVDR destroys the correlation more completely and then achieves better performance. Its excellent performance is confirmed via a number of numerical examples.

articleTitle: Channel Aware Scheduling in MU-DCF WLANs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multiple input-multiple output (MIMO) stands for a wide set of multiple antenna technologies, which significantly increase the capacity of wireless networks, without additional bandwidth or transmission power. They are widely recognized as methods that can meet the ever growing network capacity requirements. With a MIMO physical layer (PHY), the transmission channel gets a layered structure, which gives another degree of freedom when scheduling transmissions. Support from higher layers with a cross-layer approach that provides efficient management of the channels spatial layers, can significantly increase the networks performance on both link and system level. A multiple access control (MAC) protocol with the support for multi-user (MU)-MIMO transmissions in ad-hoc WLANs - multi-user-DCF (MU-DCF), has been previously presented. In this paper we introduce channel aware scheduling for opportunistic channel usage and exploiting MU diversity. We evaluate the benefits of the channel aware scheduling with respect to the produced overhead for signaling, channel estimation and channel quality Information (CQI) feedback.

articleTitle: Transmission Characteristics of Ultra-Wide Band Impulse Signals
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A simplified analytic solution for UWB impulse signal transmitting through a finitely conducting slab is proposed in this paper. To obtain the impulsive transmitting field, either for vertical or horizontal polarization, approximations to the refraction coefficients and propagation loss are made. Thereby, it permits simplified closed-form expressions in the time domain for both terms. The resulting transient response for the transmitting impulse field is then given by convolution of the time domain refraction coefficients and time domain propagation loss. The simulations of incident monocycle transmitting through slabs of different materials and thickness are presented by applying the simplified time domain analytic solution to illustrate the characteristics of transmission and give some results in simplification of transmission field analysis in indoor channel modeling.

articleTitle: A Network Traffic Model Based on Fractal
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The study on the model of traffic flow is one of the research hotshots in computer network. Employing fractal theory, we set up a mathematical model of traffic flow whose properties depending on the parameters like the ratio distribution of the traffic flow and corresponding time intervals. The self-similar or multifractal traffic can be simulated when the parameters are in different certain ranges. Furthermore, some numerical experiments are shown in this paper to verify the effectiveness of the traffic mathematical model.

articleTitle: Business Performance of Set-Based Use of IT for Major Logistics Providers
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: International logistics providers are constantly seeking to improve their competitiveness through the use of information systems. Most of the existing literature on the logistics sector's use of information systems focuses on the use of a single IT system at a time rather than looking at this issue from a set-based perspective. Taking a unique look at how major logistics firms use their information systems, this study investigates the IT sets of different information sub-systems in place at logistics firms and their effects on these companies' performances. Market Basket Analysis is used first to identify the most frequently used combinations of information systems, and is then followed by a statistical analysis based on t-testing to evaluate the organizational performance of logistics firms.

articleTitle: A Customer Life-Cycle Value Model in Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The customer relationship management (CRM) is a popular field in marketing research, and the customer life-cycle management (CLM) & customer life-cycle value (CLV) are basic and kernel problems. The automotive industry in China has experienced a fast but short develop phases, and now it is facing a situation with tough competition. This paper analyzes the characters of automotive sales and after-sales service market, and introduces a model to calculate the CLV.

articleTitle: A Logistics Processes Integration Model Based on Web Services
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Today's competitive business environment has resulted in increasing cooperation among individual enterprises as members of a supply chain. For the enterprise, how to integrate heterogeneous logistics-related software becomes a key challenge in the whole lifecycle of logistics processes. This paper presents such a framework called SCLPIF for supply logistics processes integration based on Web services via steps (1) logistics service abilities describing, (2) logistics service abilities publishing; and (3) logistics service abilities discovery mechanism. This framework can be adopted as a new supply chain logistics service model which uses a design pattern and solution templates. The implement processes of SCLPIF are illuminated. By means of SCLPIF, each engaged logistics service provider can creates new Web services and leverages exiting ones.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of the Impact of FDI on China's Balance of Payments
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the paper, we use the data of some variables affecting current account, capital and financial account from 1983 to 2005 to make positive analysis. We emphasized the Granger causality test and impulse response function to analyze the dynamic influence of FDI to balance of payments. The results suggest that FDI has a negative effect on current account and a positive affect on capital and financial account.

articleTitle: Study on Supplier Pricing Model Based on Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we study the supplier pricing model based on Stackelberg game with stochastic demand. First we describe the problem concerned and construct the pricing model Then we propose analysis and discussion, and study the impact of demand fluctuation on Stackelberg equilibrium. A series of characters and principles are drawn.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A Comprehensive Analysis of Strategic Factors for the Start-Up of New Business Based on PSED
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Performances and Limits of an Experimental Implementation of Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks Using Standardized Protocols
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper aims to present the work done to benchmark 802.11 mobile ad hoc NET networks over the CNAM Campus in Paris, France. First this article presents the context of ad hoc networks and the technical choices adopted during this work mainly using OLSR as an ad hoc IP protocol. The context presents the different limitations of ad hoc networks such as IBSS split, grey zones, RTS/CTS mechanisms which this works will try to emphasize. The second part of this article presents the results of the simulations using OPNET Modeler with the ad-hoc IP protocols, those simulations had been done on different sizes of networks. Finally this article puts the stress on the key issues of the experimental set-up results in comparison with the prior simulations done.

articleTitle: Perishable Product's Supply Chain Coordination with Option Contract Under Two Production and Ordering Modes
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Through incorporating option mechanism, quantity flexible strategy and quick respond strategy into perishable products' supply chain, this paper establishes the gamble models of retailer's initial order, option purchase and manufacturer production under two production and ordering modes. If manufacturer and retailer share products demand information, manufacturer can decide first period's proper production through retailer's initial order and option purchase in order to make his own profit and the whole supply chain optimization. Comparing with two flexible production modes without option mechanism, retailer may get higher expected profit and reduce his managing risk in the condition of the whole supply chain's optimal expected profit without changed; comparing with two period production modes having option mechanism and only one ordering opportunity, retailer will purchase less option and may get higher expected profit and manufacturer may also get higher expected profit.

articleTitle: Novel Blind Detection of LSB Steganography Based on Kernel FDA
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With rapid progress of watermarking steganalysis becomes urgent to prevent transmission of dangerous information. A novel method to detect the existence of LSB steganography blindly is proposed. Image segmentation is employed firstly to utilize local properties. According to the segmentation method used, the formation of one component is also the formation of its minimum spanning tree (MST). By graph theory the difference of MST's node degree of corresponding components in clean and stego images is presented. Considering that information is usually hidden in complex textures and obscure region image complexity is defined on many parameters related to the essence of image. Kernel fisher discriminant analysis (FDA) is employed to decide whether LSB steganography information exists or not. Simulation results show that the proposed method performs much better than RS method at different embed-ing rate and false positive rate.

articleTitle: Error-Resilient Video Compression via Forecast of Error Concealment Modes Based on Multiple State Streams and Even-Odd Filed
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces the forecast of error concealment modes (FOECM) using in the error resilient coding scheme based on multiple state streams and even-odd field. The forecast of error concealment modes makes it extremely easy and flexible to obtain the best performance of error concealment at the decoder, which is obtained by the pre-evaluation of the error concealment modes at the encoder. Multiple states coding (MSC) based on even-odd filed presents error concealment modes of many dimensions, which provide improved error concealment and fast state recovery for the lost stream. In addition, we present three novelty algorithms: approximate parallel field projection (APFP) and rank edge line average (RELA) and bidirectional best neighborhood matching (BBNM). Simulations show that this approach has excellent performance. Moreover, the method proposed can be implemented in many source codes (e.g., H263, MPEG4, H264).

articleTitle: SER Performance Improvement for MC-CDMA with TO by DAR
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Timing offset (TO) would introduce the misaligned interference which can influence the symbol error rate (SER) performance of the symbol detection. We extend joint detection (JD) to systems with TO, where the misaligned interference will be considered as noise and thus merged into the additive noise. However, the SER performance will also be degraded when the misaligned interference increases. In this paper, we propose an iterative technique, decision-aided reconstruction (DAR) to improve the SER performance. The proposed technique can mitigate the interference by making the symbol decision in the frequency domain and then converting the symbol back to the time domain. Simulation results show that DAR can improve the SER performance for MC-CDMA uplink with TO.

articleTitle: A Tree Partition-Based Overlay Multicast in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nodes mobility brings flinty challenges to multicast in mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs). To track nodes mobility, flooding messages are widely used for data delivery structure construction and maintenance in many multicast protocols. These periodic flooding messages significantly increase network control overhead. To release data delivery structure maintenance onus, a number of stateless multicast protocols have been proposed, where a destination list is encapsulated into each data packet for data packet orientation. However, due to data packet length limitation, this destination encapsulation-oriented strategy restricts protocol scalability. In this paper, we propose a multicast protocol named scalable location-aided overlay multicast (SLAOM) for MANETs. There is no periodic flooding message for data delivery structure construction and maintenance and no destination list encapsulated in each data packet. Thus SLAOM can significantly reduce overhead.

articleTitle: The State Location Method of IC Card Terminal Device Based on Two Stage Index Strategy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The state of terminal device is critical to IC card system which consists of different kinds of terminal device. The paper introduce the structure of terminal device table and present a state location of IC Card terminal device based on two stage index strategy. As a keyword, the device number is a compressed four bit BCD code. The device number is divided into two parts, the previous two-bit and last two-bit correspond two index. The device state information can be located according to the index information in a fast way.

articleTitle: E-Government: Engine or Obstacle of the Establishing Social Information Justice
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We are witnessing enormously the development of e-government, which taking great changes at the establishment of social information justice. At the same time, with the development of modern democracy, information justice has evolved the major social problem which would be dependent on advanced information technology to solve; therefore, e-government has offered both a realistic idea and way to match all kinds of conditions for the establishment of information justice. This study examines the relationship between e-government and social information justice, pointing out that the development of e- government has provided an open and convenient environment for the emergence of social information justice, meanwhile, the maintenance of the latter must rely on e-government from technology to management. It also lists new problems of social information justice brought by abroad spread of e-government, and then deduce the inner identity of both development requirement in the future, putting forward some feasible suggestions.

articleTitle: The Analysis, Diagnosis and Improvement to Production Logistics in CD Section of Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Taking the production logistics of CD section as research object, this paper researches, analyzes, and diagnoses the three parts, namely plastic component stock logistics, packaging material fittings stock logistics, and warehousing operation logistics, and then improves the irrational part. After the optimization, the transport distance and the total operation quantity of production logistics in CD section are reduced. The improvement of logistics makes the production operation more fluency and efficient.

articleTitle: Fuzzy DEA Effective Re-Assessment Method Based on Optimal Frontier for Technology Intermediary Organization's Service Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Through technology intermediary organization's performance assessment, sanitation administration department and technology intermediary organizations can comprehend the management and operation situation of the technology intermediary organization, and provide corresponding countermeasures for problems exist. The assessment information is very important to improve the quality of service of the technology intermediary organization. The application of DEA method in technology intermediary organization performance assessment has solved the difficult problem on relevant effective comparison among different organizations. Fuzzy DEA based on optimal frontier re-assessment method overcomes the limitation of re-assessment in DEA based on weight and estimation principle, and makes the result of technology intermediary organization's assessment more objective.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Capital Structure and Private Benefits of Control of Chinese Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We estimate private benefits of control and analyze effects of capital structure on private benefits of chinese listed companies at overall and matching levels. According to the results, on average private benefits of control in China is about 18%, which is near to that in emerging market countries but much higher than that in developed countries. We also find that debt financing proportion, current liability proportion and other block share proportion have negative impacts on private benefits while controlling share proportion and tradable share proportion have positive effects on private benefits of control.

articleTitle: A Study on the Measurement Model of Flexibility of Information System Strategic Planning
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the constantly changing information technology and business environments, the capability to accurately assess information system strategic planning (ISSP) flexibility appears to be a key factor in improving ISSP performance. The major aim of this paper is to develop conception frames and measurement models of the ISSP flexibility. The measures developed provide a sound foundation for future research in ISSP flexibility and also have important practical implications.

articleTitle: Study on the Integrated Framework of Supply Chain Performance Evaluation System Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article reviews the relative theories of supply chain performance evaluation system. The integrated framework of system evaluation based on multi-agent is established and the amalgamation of five integrated factors including interactive agent, management agent, qualitative evaluation agent, quantitative evaluation agent and comprehensive evaluation agent is emphasized. Also, the structure and function of this integrated framework are analyzed.

articleTitle: Signal Constellations for Orthogonal Space-Time Block Codes
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Orthogonal space-time block codes (OSTBCs) have recently attracted considerable attention due to their properties of full diversity and low implementation complexity. However, most works in this area simply employ classic phase-shift keying (PSK) or quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) constellations, which are not necessarily optimal for OSTBCs. In this paper, we consider the problem of designing signal constellations for communication systems using OSTBCs, where the channel state information (CSI) available at the receiver is an estimate of the time variant channel gains with a specific estimation error. We perform an asymptotic symbol error probability (SEP) analysis and derive a criteria to design constellations that match well with the level of the channel estimation error. New signal constellations are found by means of a gradient search over a continuous alphabet. Simulation results show that the obtained constellations outperform not only the conventional QAM constellation, but also other well-known constellations used for efficient data communications.

articleTitle: A Novel Cross Layer BPR Algorithm Based on Neural Fuzzy Connection Admission Controller in Hybrid Multimedia Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The special scenario of the topology in the hybrid multimedia Ad Hoc networks was analyzed and a novel cross layer Biomimetic Pattern Recognition (BPR) algorithm based on Neural Fuzzy Connection Admission Controller (NFCAC) was proposed. The novel algorithm integrated the attributes both of NFC AC and the topology space in special scenario. The topology and the power consumption of each node can all be optimized due to the minimum link occupation with the help of the algorithm. Simulation results shown that the novel algorithm can give more BPR guarantee to the networks in the variable node loads and transmitting powers, and make the node more stable to support multi-hops at the same time.

articleTitle: A Clustering Routing Protocol Based on Monte Carlo Localization in WSNs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recent advances in wireless sensor networks have led to many new protocols specifically designed for sensor networks where energy awareness is an essential consideration. Most of the attention, however, has been given to the routing protocols. The paper presents a new clustering scheme named WCMC based on improved Monte-Carlo Localization algorithm MCBR. We also exploit Multi-hop scheme between clusters to increase the energy efficiency of the protocol. The results show that our approach distributes the energy dissipation more evenly than other clustering schemes, reduces overall energy consumption and improves network lifetime.

articleTitle: Design and Application Research of Team Creation Support System for New Product Development
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In many industries, the survival of firms is increasingly determined by their success in new product development. At the same time, new product development is a risk and complex process. The main method of new product development that has been used by organizations for many years is team creation. At present, new product development teams are lack of effective ways to support creation. From the mid-1990s on, the infusion of information and communication technologies in product development has raised the importance of information technology in new product development. IT-enabled product development now has the potential to redefine the processes and outcomes of new product development. In this paper, we analyze the supports needed by new product development. Based on the requirement analysis, we design and realize the team creation support system for new product development. Moreover, the process of team creation support system application in new product development is analyzed.

articleTitle: Fast Square-Root Detection Algorithm for V-BLAST
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A fast square-root detection algorithm for V-BLAST is proposed to improve the high complexities when conventional square-root detection algorithm detects in MIMO receivers. It simplifies the computing process of conventional square-root detection algorithm and proposes a parallel processing algorithm of decided signal's feedback and received signal's interference cancellation. The detection complexities of the algorithm are reduced 38.24% and 16% compared to the conventional and improved square-root detection algorithm, while the detection performances retain. Under the environment of multiple scattering wireless communication, the simulation experiment results show that compared to the conventional square-root detection algorithm, the detection complexities of the proposed algorithm reduces while the detection performances retain.

articleTitle: A Multi-Objective Fuzzy Model of QFD Product Planning Model Considering Nonlinear Relationship
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In conventional quality function deployment (QFD) model, the constant coefficient is employed to present the relationship between "What matrix" and "How matrix" and among "How matrix". However, in practice the relationships are usually non-linear. This paper employs an integrative approach to represent non-linear relationship into QFD planning. A multi-objective fuzzy model is proposed to reconcile the tradeoff between customer satisfaction and cost. An example is presented to illustrate the applicability of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Technology Convergence of Electronic Industry under FDI Environment in China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The electronics industry is a representative example of technological convergence-the process by which different industries come to share similar technological bases. Utilizing patent data, index of RTA and method of scoring, technology convergence in Chinese electronic industry under FDI environment is analyzed. It is found that foreign MNCs are driving the process of inter-industry technology convergence in Chinese electronic industry while Chinese firms generally presenting technology diversity among the industries TEM, EEM and CTM. Further, specific technological fields representing different phases of technology convergence process in Electronic Industry are identified.

articleTitle: Blind Adaptive Kalman Filter-Based Multiuser Detector in Multipath CDMA Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A blind adaptive multiuser detector for signal demodulation in multipath code-division multiple-access (CDMA) communication channels is proposed. This detector is based on a modified constrained Kalman filtering Algorithm. In order to facilitate the application of a blind linear filter-optimization technique to robust inference suppression, a new canonical representation for Kalman filter is developed first, and then an efficient iterative implementation that provides very fast convergence under this representation is proposed. The proposed algorithm is low in computation complexity, especially suitable for fast optimization of filter vector with short data samples. And also it has a better tracking capability under a dynamic environment where the number of users will change frequently with time. Computer simulation results, along with some analytical convergence results, confirm that the proposed algorithm is effective in multipath fading channels and achieves very satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Recognizing the Patten of Beta Based on Rough Sets and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Beta is calculated by linear analysis between the closing prices of stocks and the security index of stock market. However, many studies have showed there are strong relationships between beta and financial information. Since the traditional statistical techniques have many limitations in disposing deficient and high noisy data, the past studies rested on proving the relationships between financial information and systematic risk. In this study, the hybrid system of rough sets and support vector machine (SVM) was employed to dispose the problem of pattern recognizing, in which rough sets were used for accelerating or simplifying the process of training SVM by eliminating the redundant data from database. Therefore, this paper used the hybrid system to recognize the clusters of beta with financial information. At last the effectiveness of our approach was verified by testing the hybrid system with the companies which listed on Shenzhen stock market.

articleTitle: Research on Efficiency of China's Regional Knowledge-Based Economy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bused on analyzing the kernel of knowledge-based economy, by using the DEA model it is evaluated the knowledge-based economy efficiency of every province or city in China. The results reveal that all provinces or cities in China have higher scale efficiency and lower pure technical efficiency, and as a whole are in the stage of increasing returns to scale. The middle areas have a small distance behind the east areas in efficiency, and the west areas are remarkably dropped behind. From regulation of investment elements, capital efficiency and information resource efficiency are relatively higher, but labor efficiency is relatively lower. The optimal production function (Cobb-Douglas function), obtained from the estimation based on provinces or cities with higher technical efficiency, shows capital elasticity is highest, information resource elasticity is higher and labor is relatively inelastic, and China economy as a whole is now in the stage of increasing returns to scale. There is still great space for elevating knowledge-based economy efficiency, and primary ways are to increase technical efficiency and to better use of information resource.

articleTitle: An Integration and Empirical Examination of Entrepreneurial Orientation, Market Orientation and Firm Performance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper intends to shed some light on the impact of entrepreneurial orientation (EO), market orientation (MO) on firm performance in Chinese context. Utilizing regression and hierarchical regression analysis, we test our hypotheses using a sample of 106 firms. The result shows that EO and MO are respectively positively associated with financial performance and innovative performance. EO is positively associated with MO. The theoretical and managerial implications are discussed.

articleTitle: Synchronous Recognition of PN-BPSK Signal for Reconnaissance Receiver
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A method for PN code recognition and parameter estimation of PN-BPSK signal which is received by reconnaissance receiver, is presented based on synchronous demodulation. At present, methods for PN codes recognition or parameter estimation have limitations, so, to develop a method which doesn't depend on priori information has theoretical and practical value. In the paper, characteristics of PN-BPSK signal are analyzed firstly. Base on the mathematical model analysis of PN-BPSK signal, the principles of synchronous demodulation for PN codes recognition is demonstrated and the algorithm of parameter estimation is given. In the end, computer simulation under two different conditions is carried out. The results of computer simulation prove correctness and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: An Improved Rough Decision-Making Model Based on Equivalent Hierarchical Cluster and It's Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper gives a new improved model in decision-making based on rough sets theory and hierarchical cluster analysis. In the view of the phenomenon that people can only obtain the information table but can't get the decision table when dealing with problems in practical applications, we use the hierarchical cluster analysis as a tool to improve the traditional rough sets theory and construct the equivalence relation to expand the information table into decision table. Then we do the empirical study, which can validate the rationality and validity of our method.

articleTitle: Stepping Optimal Controlling of a Rucklidge-Like Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new Rucklidge-like system was proposed with the condition of systematic parameters under exterior corruption, and according to Vanecek-Celikovsky classification criteria and pertinent references, one generalized parameter-target stepping optimal controlling algorithm was introduced to stabilize the parameter- corrupted system firstly and then drive the stabilized system to the previously-set target region. By the means, the whole adaptive optimal controlling problem was then evolved into solving the twin subordinate construction issues. The following simulations proved the efficiency and availability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on Economic Architecture for Resource Management for MG Based on Beneficial Drive
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper has a discussion and research on building a new economics architecture for Resource management for manufacturing grid (MG) based on beneficial drive. It firstly inducts the economics roles into manufacturing gird to express the economic attributes of resources of MG. Then it analyses the relationship between different roles. And paper adopts the MGeQoS to the WSDL expression to describe MGeQoS attributes and puts forward the matching service negotiation mechanism of economics model to realize the selection of economics model and do the management and scheduling of resource via the user MGeQoS. Finally paper gives a resource bargain economic model for MG based on negotiation. It is a effective resource management method of economic model of MG.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Institutional Ownership on Capital Structure of China Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the recent years' development, institutional investors have played a more important role in corporate governance and operational decisions of China listed companies. However, the empirical research on the influence of institutional ownership on capital structure is rare. Based on the principle of minimizing financing cost, this paper constructs a dynamic optimizing model of capital structure from the angle of institutional ownership. We also use panel data of 568 China listed companies of manufacturing industry from 2002 to 2004 to make regression of fixed effects model. The evidences indicate that the percentage of institutional stockholdings has positive relation with capital structure, which means the debt ratio increases when the percentage of institutional stockholdings increases. We also find that the decentralized degree of institutional ownership is negatively related to capital structure, that is, a more decentralized degree of institutional ownership causes a lower debt ratio.

articleTitle: An Improved Timing Offset Estimation for OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As an efficient data transmission technique, orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) can realize high data rate transmission and resist multi-path fading. The timing offset estimation is very important for OFDM systems, but the synchronization algorithm proposed by Schmidle has some shortcomings, to overcome the shortcomings, this paper presents a symbol timing estimation algorithm which uses a special training sequence. Performance of the algorithm is analyzed, and the simulation results show the method is preciser, so it is a useful algorithm.

articleTitle: Studies on Selecting Partners of Enterprise Dynamic Alliance Based on Evolutionary Multi-Agent Techniques
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Selecting partners of the manufacturing enterprise dynamic alliance is a problem of multi-objective optimization. There are some difficulties when traditional algorithm is used to solve multi-objective optimization. Therefore, a newly developed multi-agent technique was introduced to solve multi-objective optimization, and is combined with genetic algorithm to form evolutional multi-agent. The problem of multi-objective optimization of the selecting partners was solved by using evolutional multi-agent technique.

articleTitle: Evaluation Indexes Selection of Stocks' Investment Value Based on Fuzzy Clustering
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mature of China's stock market makes value investing theory's application in China possible. The paper aims to decide evaluation indexes set about stocks' investment value in order to serve value investing theory's application in China. Firstly, the paper analyses several influential factors about stocks' investment value thoroughly. Secondly, taking non-financial listed firms in Shanghai and Shenzhen stock markets as the sample, the paper clusters the above factors by fuzzy clustering. Thirdly, the paper selects the kin factors according to correlation indexes. Finally, the paper provides a scientific and operable evaluation indexes set about stocks' investment value. The indexes set almost embraces all effective information about investment value. The study also suggests that describing stocks' investment value by multidimensional array is applicable.

articleTitle: Research on Optimum Pricing of Professional Sale-Driven Distribution Center under Uncertain Conditions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper studies the optimum pricing of the professional sale-driven distribution center of which the demand and supply are stochastic. A model is set up to reflect the dynamic inventory of the distribution center. The term to avoid bankruptcy is analysis. (Conditions to avoid bankruptcy is analyzed) The optimistic margin of the professional sale-driven distribution center is studied when the inventory level keeps stable. And the conclusion is that there exist the P*a - P*b which make the expected yield of the professional sale-driven distribution center maximum, and that the value of optimistic margin is fixed, it is only decided by the highest sending price which the center can bear and the lowest price that supplier would like to sell goods.

articleTitle: Research on Knowledge Flows and Innovation Networks Evolution: The Business Incubation Network Development
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a model of 'collective innovation' built upon the business incubation network formation formalism. In our model, incubator and incubatee localized on a circle benefit from knowledge flows from other agents with whom they are directly or indirectly connected They support costs for direct connections which are linearly increasing with geographic distance by incubator. The dynamic process of business incubation network formation exhibits preferential meeting for close agents (in the relational network and in the geographic metrics). We show how the set of business incubation networks selected in the long run is affected by the degree of knowledge transferability. We find critical values of this parameter for which Incubation networks are dynamically selected.

articleTitle: Formulation Control of Embankment Compaction Quality
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The formulation control technique of highway embankment compaction quality is discussed based on the construction practice. Using compactor pass, loose laying depth, water content, and degree of compaction as the compaction quality control indices to set down the experiment plot, the regression equation between compactor pass and loose laying depth, water content, degree of compaction is fitted according to experimental data in field. While the indices, such as compactor pass, loose laying depth, and water content, are detected, the compactness can be calculated by the regression equation. Meanwhile, comparing the calculated values of compactness with that of test in field indicates that the computed values are coherent to that of field test. The feasibility and reasonability are verified in construction. By means of calculation of the regression equation can give quantitative indices to organize construction of filling soil. So, the method by means of formulation calculation is feasible and effective in controlling embankment compaction quality.

articleTitle: A New Secure Data Forwarding Protocol with Fault Detection for Wireless Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless ad hoc networks, the route discovery process or the data forwarding process is vulnerable to attackers. In this paper, we address the data forwarding security problem and propose a light-weight secure data forwarding protocol, which utilizes one-way hash chains to achieve the message integrity, where the intermediate nodes can effectively detect the fault link and the source node of the packet can correctly judge whether the peer-to-peer data transfer is successful.

articleTitle: Ocean Solid Monitoring Temporal and Spatial Data Organization, Management and Application
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the ocean dynamical environment real-time solid monitoring system of Taiwan Strait and adjacent maritime region, multiple monitoring data including remote sensing data, structured data is produced by the solid monitoring net from airspace, ocean surface and under ocean surface. The storage, management, online analysis service of the monitoring temporal and spatial data is key part of the whole system. Aiming to resolve the data organization and integrated analysis service of the monitoring data, this paper studies the characteristics, design and application of the temporal and spatial data warehouse of ocean solid monitoring information. Firstly, the characteristics and application model of the data warehouse of ocean solid monitoring information is introduced from the aspects of spatial, temporal, subject-oriented, multiple resource and decision-making oriented. Then the subject classification, design of concept module of the data warehouse of ocean solid monitoring information is introduced. The star schema is used to demonstrate the multi-dimension character of the ocean monitoring information. At last, the data warehouse of ocean solid monitoring data based application in shipwreck salvation decision-making support system of Taiwan Strait is realized.

articleTitle: PCNM: A New Platform for Cellular Networks Measurements and Optimization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present PCNM, a new mobile platform for cellular networks measurements. PCNM is based on a set of techniques that tailors theoretical calculations and simulations to the real cellular network environment. It includes: (a) modules that measure different parameters of a base station such as localization, cell identification, time advance information, reception level and quality, (b) a new protocol that optimizes the task of network measurement by monitoring a set of mobile nodes and finally (c) the ability to extend an existing cellular network by adding new base stations. We evaluate our genetic algorithm used to reduce node mobility and optimize the measurement extraction of N base stations using k mobile sensors (k ges 1). We show how connecting real measurements (using mobile sensors in a collaborative way) to theoretical and prediction methods is of high benefit for cellular networks maintenance, extension and performance evaluation.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm Based on Matrix for Mining Inter-Transaction Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The traditional studies on mining association rules are on mining intra-transaction associations. In this study, we extend scope of mining association rules from traditional intra- transaction associations to inter-transaction associations. Mining inter-transaction associations poses more challenges on efficient processing than mining intra-transaction associations because the number of potential association rules becomes extremely large. In this study, we introduce the notion of inter- transaction association rule, define its measurements: support and confidence, then we design a new matrix data structure, called Co-Occurrence Matrix, in short COM, to store the data information instead of directly using the transactional database and develop an efficient algorithm MMIT(an acronym for "Matrix Mining Inter-transaction") based on COM, for mining inter-transaction associations. We compare MMIT with FITI the best algorithms presented by other researchers in previous studies and demonstrate MMIT is more efficient than FITI.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Customer-Oriented Service Quality on Self-Adaptive RBFNN and UDM
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Evaluation of customer-oriented service quality (ECSQ) is an important practical measure to increase enterprises' competition capacity. In this article, a performance evaluation indexes system is established. UDM and fussy-mathematics are used to generate enough samples to train self-adaptive RBFNN. The instances of applying RBFNN to do ECSQ shows that its generalization capacity is more powerful than general RBFNN. Meanwhile, the randomicity of former fussy-comprehensive evaluation and man-made uncertainty are conquered.

articleTitle: Simulation Performance of MMSE-BLE-SD Detector in the Downlink of TD-SCDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Time division - synchronization code division multiple access (TD-SCDMA) is one of the international protocols for the 3rd generation mobile communication systems. One of its key features is the so-called joint detection (JD), which is adopted to combat the serious multiple access interference (MAI) and inter- symbol interference (ISI) caused by multipath propagation in the case of a short spreading factor (SF). The normally used JD algorithm in TD-SCDMA receiver is zero-forcing block linear equalizer (ZF-BLE), which is a little complex to implement. In this paper, a new candidate algorithm, i.e. MMSE-BLE-SD (minimum mean squared error block linear equalizer for single user detection), which could be implemented with Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), is considered and performance analyzed in the TD- SCDMA linklevel simulation platform. The results show that this less complex detector could provide improved performance than the current used ZF-BLE in the case of 12.2k bit/s voice traffic.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Protocol Independent Distributed Message Copying Multicast Scheme for the Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Base station multicast is an important enabling service for the current and future Internet. With the explosive growth of the Internet, a challenging issue facing Base Station multicast is scalability, in particular, the problem of multicast forwarding state and control explosion. In this paper, we propose a new methodology to address the multicast scalability problem for backbone domains - distributed message copying multicast (DMCM). This multicast scheme is designed for the wireless network, and is independent of any underlying intra-domain multicast protocols. The feasibility and performance of our algorithm is demonstrated through analysis and simulations.

articleTitle: Transposing Zipf's Law and its Application to the Rank of Scientific and Technical Articles of 30 Economies
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The general Zipf's law studies the influence relation that frequency is suffered by rank, where rank is equivalent to the independent variable and frequency can be looked upon as the dependent variable. But after transposing these two variables, what this paper study is how rank influences frequency, where frequency matches the independent variable and rank can be regarded as the dependent variable. Besides putting forward the transposing Zipf's law, this paper discusses the rank of scientific and technical articles of 30 economies (countries and regions). The research results show that the rank effect and the inverse power function are exactly in existence. The empirical analysis of continuous 3 years indicates that the inverse power function takes place really between the rank and the number of papers. This transposing Zipf's law will obviously cause the rank effect: when rank is top, it is very difficult to be raised again; when rank is low, it is comparatively easy to be changed.

articleTitle: A Fast Algorithm for Predicting the Exhaustion and Occupation of Cell Bandwidth Based on Integrated Poisson Mode
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bandwidth is an important parameter in communication field and there have been many estimation algorithms on the bandwidth occupation which gave support to some applications such as bandwidth allocation and resource management. Yet, a parameter, bandwidth exhaustion time, which is so important for administrator to make adjustment in advance when the bandwidth occupation is fluctuating too much, is always neglected by those algorithms. In this article, a new prediction model on cell bandwidth occupation is proposed and corresponding theoretic prediction formula is derived, and further more, a fast dynamic prediction algorithm is introduced. Simulation result shows that the prediction result is precise.

articleTitle: Commonality-Oriented Product Design Management Method and its Application
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mass-customization as an important manufacturing mode, has already brought huge chance and challenge for enterprise in 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century. Under the circumstances, a new commonality-oriented product design management method is put forth, and then one of its related prototype system schemes is developed based on Hangzhou Turbine Ltd. (China) (HTL). In the light of two application instances of the prototype system, which has processed all of the data (40GB or so) of 3-serial industrial turbine in HTL during 28 years up to now, the method's importance and practical value were validated.

articleTitle: Two ANN-Based Models for a Real MVAC System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A systematic approach is presented in paper to develop artificial neural network (ANN) models to predict the performance of a heat exchanger operating in real mechanical ventilation and air-conditioning (MVAC) system. Two approaches were attempted and presented. Every detailed components of the MVAC system have been considered and we attempt to model each of them by one ANN. This study used the neural network technique to obtain a static and a dynamic model for a heat exchanger mounted in an air handler unit (AHU), which is the key component of the MVAC system. It has been verified that almost all of the predicted values of the ANN model were within 95% - 105% of the measured values, with a consistent mean relative error (MRE) smaller than 2.5%. The paper details our experiences in using ANNs, especially those with back-propagation (BP) structures. The results can be served as good reference for readers to deal with their own situations.

articleTitle: A Transmit Preprocessing Technique for Downlink Multi-User MIMO System Using Subspace Decomposition Approach
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the research on architecture of multi-user MIMO channel, we introduce the concept of accompanying subspace of the channel, and conclude several linear methods into the problem that how to produce preceding matrix on this subspace. And we provide an iterative algorithm to get optimal solution on this subspace based on the criterion of maximum channel capacity. By computer simulation, we analyze the performance of our algorithm and compare it with other methods. Results show that our method has good performance: (1) Compared with channel inversion and block diagonalization, it greatly increases outage capacity, especially when Pout is small; (2) Ergodic capacity grows linearly with the increase of the number of transmitting antennas, and is much bigger than that of other methods; (3) It can better deal with near-far effect and keep spatial division multiplexing gain.

articleTitle: Availability Based Spare Optimization Using Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A spare optimization model for systems with components in series where the failure time of components follow any general distribution is presented. The availability of the system at any time is obtained through renewal process theory. The objective of the optimization problem is to maximize the availability of the system satisfying constraints on cost and volume. Genetic algorithms are used to find the optimal amount of spares for each component. Finally, an illustrative example is given.

articleTitle: Optimum Structure for the Combination of Tx Diversity and Beamforming
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper derives an optimal combination of the transmit diversity and beamforming for wireless communication systems. It is known that the requirements of transmit diversity and beamforming are absolutely opposite, such as antenna distance. Therefore, the tradeoff between the transmit diversity and beamforming is necessary. The optimum configuration of multiple antennas for getting the maximum performance is derived under the condition that the total number of antennas is fixed and the total power of transmitter is fixed. Using it, we can easily combine the transmit diversity (Tx diversity) and beamforming for any multiple antenna systems with the optimal group-divided method.

articleTitle: A Knowledge Based Production Line Development Management System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A knowledge based production line development management system framework for planning car body production line was presented through a careful analysis of planning features alone all the main stages. Product model, manufacturing resource model and process knowledge model based on product data management (PDM) theory were established respectively. The three models carried out the process information management of the product, manufacturing resource and process knowledge. Composed of the three models, a process relation model with an operation core was established to represent the production factors and their relations synthetically. Application of the process relation model shows that the planning framework fulfills the requirements of process information management and the reuse of process planning knowledge for car body production line planning, which definitely helps to improve the innovativity of domestic car manufacturers.

articleTitle: Collaborative Quality Management IDSS Based on CBR and MAS
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the network manufacturing, due to the complexity of manufacturing systems, product diversity, the breadth of information and users higher demands of products, particularly the differences of the parts which compose of the product, make remote product quality control more difficult and complicated. In order to solve the above problem, this paper organically combines case-based retrieval technology, database technology, on-line analysis and multi-agent system technology and decision support systems and uses them for network for remote product manufacturing synergies quality management, bring forward IDSS model structure based on the CBR and MAS and its key technical problems were analyzed.

articleTitle: A Data Acquisition Algorithm Based on Time Slot and Circular Queue
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multi-sources data acquisition under unattended condition is a representative problem in data acquisition. An intelligent data acquisition algorithm based on time slot and circular queue is brought forward, which is achieved in identity recognition and auto-weight with nobody on duty. It utilizes the timer interaction principle in Visual Basic and the character of data store and access in circular queue. On the basis of analyzing the system flow and data transportation protocols, the key parameters for the algorithm such as the length of time-block, the size of queue and the correlative algorithms of the circular queue are discussed, the relevant flow diagram is described, at last the running instance is given. Implement results in the garbage measurement project for Wuhan city administrative bureau have illustrated that the algorithm is effective and reliable.

articleTitle: Study on the Strategic Readiness Evaluation of the Human Capitals
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Human resource can play the same important role as the tangible asserts to implement the enterprise's strategy. They are the keys of the strategy management whether the employee can understand and accept the mission, vision and core values of a organization, whether the status of the human capitals can meet the requirement of the strategy development and how the intangible assert can be assessed such as human resource. This essay constructs a framework of human capital readiness, and builds a mathematic method of AHP approach to assess the human capital readiness, to weigh the degree that the intangible asserts harmonize with the enterprise's strategy, give a direction of human resource development and management.

articleTitle: Neighbor Collaboration Detection in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we explore two important issues for distributed target detection in wireless sensor network (WSN): (1) How to increase efficient-energy for each sensor; (2) How to improve the detection precision about whether a target is occurring in the event region. We present a neighbor collaboration detection (NCD) scheme that introduces a clustered fusion into target detection process. Based on MAP decision criterion, we propose an optimal fusion decision. We mathematically show that the NCD Scheme vastly improves the target detection precision, when the number of neighbor sensor is large.

articleTitle: Application of the Integrated SPC/PI Strategy in Discrete Manufacturing Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to improve the ability of on-time deliveries, the PI (proportional integral) control algorithm is put forward in discrete manufacturing systems so as to maintain lower and steadier WIP (work-in-progress ). For long-term process improvement, the integrated strategy of SPC/PI (statistical process control, SPC) is further proposed. To evaluate the control effects of this kind of integrated scheme, an implementation and monitoring model are proposed, based on which, a case study is carried out in the production line of certain motorbike engines' crankcases. Shewhart control chart is used to evaluate the control effects of unique PI and integrated SPC/PI when both drift/shift errors exist in WIP mean. Simulation results indicate that the integrated SPC/PI outperforms unique PI with regard to WIP control in discrete manufacturing systems.

articleTitle: Information Decision Model Based On Information Ethics
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information ethics is fundamental to information decision. This paper discusses three main ethical dimensions of information decision, analyzes six main ethical factors affecting information decision, and brings forward a general ethical decision model based on information ethics with an application in management experiments.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Framework of Asset-Backed Securitization for Public Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Performance Research and Simulation on Space-Time Block Code in Frequency-Selective Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: STBC (space-time block codes) is a new channel coding technology accompanying with the extensive application of wireless communication. It organically combines coding, modulation, transmit and receive diversity, and validly increases the signal transmission performance in fading channels. The performance of STBC in small-scale fading channels such as FSF (frequency-selective fading channels), particularly, in the slow- fading channels and time-varying fading channels is studied, and combining typical system model of STTD (space-time transmission diversity), the anti-noise performance simulation result and its analysis are presented.

articleTitle: A Study of Chinese Private Passenger Cars Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study employs BP neural network to simulate the development of Chinese private passenger cars. Considering the uncertain and complex environment for the development of private passenger cars, indicators of economy, population, price, infrastructure, income, energy and some other fields which have major impacts on it are selected at first. The network is proved to be operable to simulate the progress of chinese private passenger cars after modeling, training and generalization test. Based on the BP neural network model, sensitivity analysis of each indicator is carried on and shows that the sensitivity coefficients of fuel price change suddenly. This special phenomenon reveals that the development of Chinese private passenger cars may be seriously affected by the recent high fuel price. This finding is also consistent with facts and figures.

articleTitle: PAPR Reduction Iterative Algorithm via Adding Weights to Amplitudes and Phases of OFDM Subcarriers
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel and effective peak- to-average power ratio (PAPR) reduction algorithm for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signals that uses a group of appropriate weights in both amplitude and phases fixed on subcarriers in the frequency domain. Also we deduce a iterative formula to compute the weights. Compared with partial transmit sequence (PTS) and selected mapping (SLM) algorithms, the proposed algorithm shows its better performance on PAPR reduction. Bit error rate (BER) analysis indicates that the amplitude of the weights has a great impact on the BER performance of the system. Appropriate restriction on the amplitude can get good performance in both PAPR and BER. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is better than PTS and SLM algorithm in PAPR reduction performance, while satisfying BER performance, for example, PAPR reduction can be up to 2.5 dB decrease when dividing the subcarriers into 4 subgroups.

articleTitle: Combining Stock Market Volatility Forecasts Using an EWMA Technique
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Forecasting, stock market volatility is an important and challenging task for both academic researchers and business practitioners. The recent trend to improve the prediction accuracy is to combine individual forecasts using a simple average or weighted average where the weight reflects the inverse of the prediction error. In the existing combining methods, however, the errors between actual and predicted values are equally reflected in the weights regardless of the time order in a forecasting horizon. In this paper, we present a new approach where the forecasting results of the generalized autoregressive conditional heteroscedastic (GARCH), the exponential generalized autoregressive conditional heteroscedastic(EGARCH), and random walk models are combined based on a weight that reflects the inverse of the exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) of the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of each individual prediction model. The results of an empirical study indicate that the proposed method has a better accuracy than the generalized autoregressive conditional heteroscedastic (GARCH), exponential generalized autoregressive conditional heteroscedastic (EGARCH) and random walk models, and also combining methods based on using the MAPE for the weight.

articleTitle: Orchestrate Legacy Programs in Grid
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the development of Grid Technologies, Many researches and projects have done to deploy and integrate legacy programs into service-oriented Grid architecture. However, the legacy programs orchestration is still scarce of good approaches. In this paper, we overviews the architecture and legacy program execution mechanism of CGSP, presents an abstract workflow specification named ChinaGrid Workflow Description Language (CGWDL) which can be transformed into BPEL, and depicts the life cycle of legacy programs orchestration based on CGSP. An image processing application is used to validate the feasibility and efficiency of our solution.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Wireless Multimedia Data Share Mechanism Over HSDPA
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The wireless multimedia data services over HSDPA (high speed downlink packet share) is still limited in traditional point to point type. Wireless resource is precious, but the income per bit from data services is much less than traditional voice. It becomes a bottleneck of wireless multimedia data services day by day. We attempt to analysis Shapley Nucleolus's super allocation based on Nash-Harsanyi model, through minimum ratio and non separable gap (NSCG) methods, establish multi dimension related targets of three typical wireless multimedia data services. At last the share mechanism over HSDPA is preliminary established. The simulation result is optimistic.

articleTitle: Messaging Media Perceptions and Preferences: A Pilot Study in Two Distinct Cultures
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study empirically examines university students' perceptions and their views of when they adopt instant messaging (IM) and short messaging service (SMS) and how they perceive and prefer these two media, in conjunction with other media (face-to-face, telephone, and email), in their university learning activities across two different cultural contexts: Australian university and Chinese university. The overall results of this study support some aspects of media richness theory. Although IM is perceived to be richer than email, it is not perceived to be the most popular medium for any situation. Data also demonstrate cultural differences in media perceptions of and preferences for new media. Specifically, Australian students have higher preference for email than their Chinese counterparts and Australian students also perceive SMS as leaner in terms of medium richness and have less preference for SMS than their Chinese counterparts.

articleTitle: Convergence and Technological Innovations in ICT Industry: Trends and Strategies for Operators
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Technological innovations and market demands are radically changing the structure of the ICT industry. The convergence of devices, services and networks is resulting in the convergence of the industries. This paper describes the impact of technological innovations on the structure of ICT industry and discusses new trends and strategies for operators to face the challenges of the converged world by examining the layer model of the ICT industry. The IP-based new generation networks (NGN), wireless technologies, and broadband access is rapidly becoming the choices for the operators and making it possible for them to enter the other domains. The incumbent operators and other big giants are adopting the strategy of vertical integration while new entrants are mainly focusing on some particular segments of the industry. The future horizontal networks are demanding re-evaluation of strategies and business models from the operators.

articleTitle: Research of Radar Signal Processor Based on the Software Defined Radio
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper addressed how to design the software radar signal processor based on the software defined radio structure, and discussed the reasons for using the DSP+FPGA and offered an insight into fix on the important parameters of software radio. Attention is concentrated on the construction of algorithm model, simulation the algorithm by Simulink, and some methods for algorithm and architecture mapping were discussed. The computer simulation of hardware model is provided; it changes the structure of hardware, and realizes the new function through the promotion or update of software. So the design and implementation of a velocity & distance-measuring radar signal processor based on the SR structure were studied. Evidences have shown that it especially suits the design of radar because of the similar structure and SR.

articleTitle: Research on the Connotation and the Framework of Knowledge Management based on Complex Adaptive System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge management (KM) is a newly emerging management mode, which now needs to solve its sustainable development for promoting the learning and the innovation of organizational knowledge in the complex environment. Complex adaptive system (CAS) can help to explain the complexity connotation of KM and integrate all processes of KM for making KM adapt the changeful environment. This paper explores the connotation of KM from the perspective of CAS and then proposes the suitable developing framework of KM based on CAS.lt hopes to provide the way to promote the sustainable development of KM by using the theory of CAS.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Effect Mechanism of Knowledge Management on New Product Development in Aviation Industry
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: New product development is one of the most knowledge intensive processes in business and is itself constantly creating new knowledge. This study proposes a hypothesis test and theoretical model of the correlation among knowledge management, organizational factors and new product development performance. Surveys collected from Chinese aviation enterprises and scientific research institutions were analyzed and tested. The following results are obtained: (1) There is a positive effect on new product development performance for those companies that strongly implement knowledge management method. (2) Knowledge management method and new product development performance are affected by structure and culture factors. But IT factor is negatively related with knowledge management method. (3) Knowledge management method moderately mediates the effects of Organizational structure and culture factors on new product development performance. The managerial implication is that organizational structure and culture could better improve new product development performance in the context of knowledge management processes.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Extremal Dependence in Chinese Futures Market
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the database of daily copper futures contracts on Chinese market, extremal dependence between futures market and spot market is calculated using the extreme value theory and copula function. It is found that asymmetric behavior in the left and right tails of the joint marginal extreme distribution, that is, correlation increases in bear markets, but not in bull markets. Hedgers who hold short positions therefore benefit more than those who hold long positions. Empirical results also show the weakness of the function of price discovery when markets are bearish. It is hard to be used to hedge spot price volatility in such situation.

articleTitle: A Simple Authentication and Key Distribution Protocol in Wireless Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Plenty of applications and services for personal communications in wireless mobile networks (WMN) are brought up recently, such as mobile commerce applications and teleconference applications. So the end-to-end security requirements are necessary. Nevertheless WMN don't offer end- to-end confidentiality and integrity mechanism for personal communications. The linchpin of end-to-end security is the authentication of users. Considering the limited wireless bands and the limited computing ability of mobile devices, we present a simple authentication and key distribution protocol (SAKDP) for end-to-end secure communications. Based on symmetric cryptography and one-way function techniques, SAKDP is satisfied with secure requirements of wireless end-to-end secure communication, also enables dynamic secure communications. The proposed scheme also has identity anonymity and encryption key renewal mechanism, its computation cost and transmission cost are smaller.

articleTitle: Study of Consumer Acceptance in E-Commerce by Integrating Technology Acceptance Model with Task-Technology Fit Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The study of consumer acceptance in e-commerce is imperative to the success of e-commerce. This paper treats consumer e-commerce as a technology adoption process and evaluates two famous adoption model : TAM and TTF model. First gives an overview of the two models on e-commerce, and discusses the advancements of the integrating of the two models. Suggestions for future research on integrating TAM and TTF are finally given.

articleTitle: Workflow-Based Testing Process Management of Software Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Testing is a natural and primary step for obtaining high-quality software. However, the relevant process management about testing activity has usually been neglected. In this paper, we introduce workflow to describe the activities in the course of software testing.
