The process definition is viewed as workflow engine to describe the control relation of each activity, and business form (i.e. B_form) has also been detailedly discussed as the information flow. The whole testing process has been divided into testing planning, testing design, testing execution and faults correction, and each sub-process is modeled through the typical workflow net (WF_net). Finally, these four steps are all integrated into a complete testing process management framework, which can direct the construction of testing workflow management system.

articleTitle: Application of CMMI in Innovation Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we look through innovation management in small project-based firm, such as software engineering and construction companies, which are service firms that conduct projects for their clients. This research is trying to introduce the technology of Capability Maturity Modelreg Integration (CMMI), which is a process improvement approach that provides organizations with the essential elements of effective processes. Take ABC Software Company as a case study, we compared the performance before and after the introduction of CMMI in the firm and figured out quite a few positive results. To conclude, small project-based firms will benefit a lot if they take CMMI into their process of innovation management, particularly for those R&D firms, since the implementation of CMMI leads them to a promising future with higher efficiency and better effects. This study provides a starting point for the community in considering this important issue.

articleTitle: Research on CPFR and Warehousing Management: A Method to Enhance Supply Chain Visibility
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Lack of visibility in a supply chain will cause the uncertainty of demand. Usually, the suppliers at upstream always carry much higher inventory level than the actual demand. However, the strategy of CPFR provides a way to reduce the huge loss led by bullwhip effect by scientifically forecasting the customer's demand and reasonably replenishing the inventory. This paper discusses the way to realize CPFR by demand forecast with time series analysis and push/pull integrated inventory management system, and brings out a demand forecast and pre-alarm integrated quick response warehousing system design in the end.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Forward Error Correction Method for TDM Over Ethernet
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: It is of necessity to transport time division multiplexing (TDM) traffic over packet network such as Ethernet. When TDM traffic is carried over Ethernet, it is necessary to improve end-to-end performance of Ethernet network. Based on frame structure defined in IETF RFC3985 and MEF 8, a kind of frame structure that comprises forward error correction (FEC) contents is presented, and a FEC method based on the frame structure is brought forward. The method includes functions of regenerating lost packets functions as well as a mechanism that detects end-to-end performance and adaptively adjusts the FEC configuration. A device using the FEC method can interwork with an ordinary non-FEC device. Analysis for the FEC method is specified too. A kind of network device that realizes the FEC functions is designed and a test network topology is set up to test and evaluate the FEC method.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Wireless Local Area Network MAC Access Mechanism in Oil Field
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we introduce different types of access mechanism which contains distributed coordination function (DCF) and point coordination function (PCF) in Media Access Control (MAC) layer of Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN). In order to analyze the influence to the performance of WLAN, we take a part of oil field as a background to establish WLAN model based on OPNET software. After simulation, different results which could evaluate the performance of WLAN are obtained by comparison of DCF and DCF/PCF access mechanism. The results of simulations illustrate that performance of PCF access mode is stabilized relatively when there is a large scale of network At the same time, using DCF/PCF can combine the advantages of two different access mechanism.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of General Rectangular QAM with MRC Diversity Over Nakagami-m Fading Channels with Arbitrary Fading Parameters
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Exact average symbol error probability (SEP) of the general order rectangular quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) with maximum ratio combining (MRC) diversity over L independent Nakagami-m fading channels with arbitrary fading parameters is derived in this paper. The obtained exact expression is presented in terms of the Lauricella multiple hypergeometric functions, which can be evaluated numerically using its integral or converging series representation. The new result can be used to study the impact of diversity reception on the performance of general rectangular QAM. Finally, it is shown that the derived expression reduces to some specific cases previously published.

articleTitle: An Immune Genetic Routing Algorithm for Mesh Network with QoS Constraints
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article presents a novel immune & genetic hybrid routings algorithm for mesh network with QoS constraints in order to supply multimedia transmission with high quality of services (QoS). Inspired by immune mechanism, the algorithm clones the predominant routings, restrains same or close routings in immune shape-space and evaluates the affinity of routings in two aspects, QoS metrics and distance between routings to improve the diversity. Genetic operators are used to evolve the routings. The algorithm utilizes linkage matrix and neighbor vector to restrict the routing conform to specific network topology, routing repair is also used after each evolution. QoS constraints are considered, involving the delay, bandwidth, jitter and loss ratio. Simulation experiments show that the algorithm achieves global random searching effect with perfect diversity and less iterations than ants and GA algorithms, better real-time performance for dynamic mesh network and gains load balance with multi-candidate routings.

articleTitle: Study on Heterogeneous Data Integration Issues in Web Environments
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In web environments, data might be integrated form remote, distributed, autonomous and heterogeneous data sources into a central data collection. The heterogeneity of data sources has two aspects, model heterogeneity and schema heterogeneity. This paper investigates an architecture of data integration, presents data integration processes, and discusses data integration approaches in web environments.

articleTitle: An Improved JPEG Compression Algorithm Based on Sloped-Facet Model of Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed an improved JPEG compression algorithm based on Haralick sloped-facet model. Different areas after segmentation were taken into account in this algorithm and different areas are compressed in different proportion. The experiment results show that the quality of reconstructed images is better than the traditional JPEG compression algorithm at the same bit rate about 0.3 dB.

articleTitle: WSM: Introduction, Design and Case Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Simulation is always the hot spot in the research and development of networks. However, it's hard for many existing simulation tools to simulate wireless sensor networks (WSN) well due to its features, like the extremely large number of nodes, the need for environment sensing, as well as the volatile topology of the model, etc. On the other hand, the natures of these tools prevent them, more or less, from performing effectively. In this paper, a generic WSN simulator named WSM, working with OMNET++, has been presented. The design of WSM would be highlighted here. Meanwhile, a novel method comprised of UML-RT and colored Petri net is introduced in this paper to formalize the definition and development. The result on WSM's capability and performance are provided through a Zigbee related case.

articleTitle: Transmission Power Control for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Power control in wireless networks is important to maintain reliable communication links between base stations and nodes, and to maximize the battery life. An energy aware connectivity set based transmission power control protocol is presented in this paper. We augment our distributed protocol with a heuristic that considers energy cost information when making power control decisions. Compared to traditional protocol, our protocol can improve energy efficiency and prolong network lifetime significantly, while networks connectivity is still maintained in extreme scenarios. Simulation results demonstrate our conclusion.

articleTitle: Market Analysis of Competition in US Local Telephony
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the effects of Telecommunication Act 1996 on US telecommunication market. The focus is on local telephony market segment which was subjected to strict monopoly controls before the Act. The Act was considered as a milestone in the history of US telecommunications as it tried to move all telecom markets towards competition. The Act envisioned telecom network as a network of interconnected networks, where competition is possible not only at element level but also at final service level An other goal of the Act was to increase investment in local infrastructure by creating competition. Despite all efforts, the pace of competition has been very slow. Even after 10 years questions are still raised about the success of the Act. This paper tries to determine quantitatively whether the Act has failed or not by examining the state of competition in local telephony markets. For this purpose Market conditions are examined to judge the success or failure of the Act.

articleTitle: A Service System Theory Frame Based on Ecosystem Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Rudimentary scientific understanding of modern service system not fits service development trend, and service science is proposed to resolve this problem. Socialized division of labor and information technology transforms traditional service into a cooperative, distributed and social system. The relationships between multi-partners and operation mechanism of service system are familiar with ecosystem. Based on ecosystem theory, new service system theory frame is proposed to study service system. Borrowed concepts of population and community from ecosystem, two new concepts: s-population and s-community are proposed to study the composition and static structure of service system. Corresponding with food chain and community succession, value net and service system succession are used to show service system's dynamic mechanism, and a new method ordination of service system is also discussed to analysis service system and service succession. This paper is to provide an essential theoretical framework for service system.

articleTitle: Industrial WLAN Real-Time and Reliability Improvement via Topology Design
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A genetic algorithm based topology optimization algorithm is developed to improve the real-time and reliability performance of industrial wireless network. The multi-rate characteristic of wireless channel is considered, together with the access point's (AP) capability. The topology design is considered as multi-objective optimization problem, which should minimize the aggregate inner-subnet transmission time, inter-subnet transmission time and balance inner-subnet transmission time evenly.

articleTitle: Analysis and Empirical Research on the Long-Memory Property of Exchange Rate Time Series
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper applies the Rescaled Range Analysis(R/S), Log Period-gram Estimation(GPH) and Gaussian Semi-parametric Estimation(GSP) on eighteen time series, including daily, weekly and monthly of six exchange rates. The results tell us there does be the "Long-Memory" in exchange rates. It doesn't only help us for knowing exchange rates better with ARFIMA, but also for forecasting and National Bank's intervening.

articleTitle: Broad Band-Pass Sampling and its Application in Multi-Carrier Digital IF Receiver
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Band-pass sampling is one of the most important technologies in software radio. This paper analyzes the band-pass signal sampling theorem carefully. Considering the engineering implementation, it proposes an associated method for the selection of IF frequency and sampling frequency, which can achieve the optimal performance. It also introduces a design scheme about CDMA2000 multi-carrier digital IF receiver system. At last it applies the method to the design of CDMA2000 multi-carrier digital IF receiver, which validates the optimal method effective and feasible.

articleTitle: The Effect of Social Network in Social Entrepreneurship: An Empirical Chinese Case Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Social entrepreneurship is emerging as an innovative approach for dealing with complex social needs and provide social service with non-profit social mission. The success of social entrepreneurship relies not only on the relocation of resources but also on the personality and social network of social entrepreneurs. This paper studies whether and how personal social networks of entrepreneurs take effects in social entrepreneurship process. Through case analysis, this paper draws two conclusions: the persons who could provide real help for social entrepreneur give him (the social entrepreneur) the highest level of trust; the "bridge" man who provides information, connection and potential contribution is as important as the final help provider.

articleTitle: Investigation of Real-Time Wave Height Measurement Using X-Band Navigation Radar
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to meet the warship's needs of real-time wave height measurement, a method using X-band navigation radar to measure wave height is presented. In this paper, the principle of wave height measurement based on X-band navigation radar is also introduced, the mathematical model of wave height measurement using X-band navigation radar is given. According to the X-band radar-image sequences collected from East Sea in China, the wave heights are retrieved based on mathematical model. The retrieved wave heights are validated by comparison of the radar-derived significant wave heights with the significant wave heights acquired from in-situ buoy sensors. It is shown that the accuracy of the radar-retrieved significant wave height is consistent with the accuracy of the in-situ buoy sensors. Therefore, to some extent, the reliability of the mathematical model is verified, to measure the wave height using X-band navigation radar is available in warship.

articleTitle: WBIPS: A Lightweight WTLS-Based Intrusion Prevention Scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Now the rapid proliferation of wireless networks and mobile computing applications has changed the landscape of network security. The common Intrusion Detection System is not always sufficient and effective for wireless environment. Intrusion Prevention System (IPS) in wireless network need be developed. But because of some characteristics of wireless network, it is not so convenient to build an IPS in wireless environment as in wire environment. To address this problem, we explorer a novel scheme: WBIPS (WTLS-Based IPS) model. In this mode, a logical sole path is built between every wireless terminal and its destination, so an IPS engine can detect and prevent the traffics of user. We will describe the architecture of WBIPS in detail. WTLS (Wireless Transport Layer Security) is introduced firstly and then, we explore a solution of wireless intrusion prevention. Finally, An experiment about performance of WBIPS will be displayed to approve "lightweight" of this model.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Decision Model for Deteriorating Goods with Stock-Dependent Demand Rate
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To analyze effects of supply chain coordination for deteriorating goods with stock-dependent demand rate, this paper presents decision models for order quantity and ordering cycle under two scenarios (decentralized supply chain, centralized supply chain). Numerical study is carried out to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed models, and to analyze the impact of supply chain coordination on supply chain profit. Sensitivity analysis is performed to study the impact of different parameters associated with the model, such as the rate of deterioration, the retailer's purchase cost, the manufacturer's production cost, the retailer's and manufacturer's holding cost on the supply chain profit increase percentages generated by the supply chain coordination.

articleTitle: A Game Model of Time-of-Use Electricity Pricing and its Simulation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a fulcrum in the power market, electricity price affects the reliability and security of the power system indirectly. The time-of-use (TOU) pricing is one of the important ways to safeguard the stability of the power system. The TOU pricing must consider the stakeholders of the government, the power company, and the consumer. With the prerequisite of price-fixing level by the government, the power company is allowed to adjust the power price to realize the goal of power load control. Based on this, a TOU pricing model - price-fixing by the government, pricing by the power company, and electricity-consumption by the consumer - is established with game theory. The model simulation is carried out with the Matlab software, the result of which indicates that the model is practicable for the power load control.

articleTitle: Analysis and Comparison of Different SC-FDMA Schemes for 3GPP LTE
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Single-carrier FDMA (SC-FDMA) is a new kind of FDMA system which was proposed in recent years. It has the same PAPR as single-carrier system and its resource scheduling is as flexible as multi-carrier system. For comparison, the 3GPP LTE uplink scheme DFT-S-OFDM, and our new scheme DFT-S-GMC which is based on DFT and General Multi-Carrier (GMQ are analyzed and discussed in detail. Analysis and simulation results show that DFT-S-GMC is better than DFT-S-OFDM in Multiple Address Interference (MAI) performance. And the complexity of DFT-S-GMC is also reduced by using multi-band filter-banks.

articleTitle: A Novel Rate Control Algorithm for AVS Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Any video coding standard can't live without rate- control algorithm which plays an important role in video coding. In this paper, we present a new rate control method based on p domain rate distortion model for AVS (Advanced Audio and Video Coding Standard) and realize it in its test model. The experimental results show that our method performs better than Joint Video Team (JVT) rate control method.

articleTitle: Business Models and Implementations of M-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper explores business model of m- commerce, based on a comprehensive literature review. Case study is used to illustrate successful m-commerce implementation in practice. Main problems as well as future research issues are presented and discussed finally.

articleTitle: Channel and Queue Aware Scheduling for Mixed Service in Multiuser MIMO OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In MIMO OFDMA system, multiuser diversity gain can be achieved both in spatial and frequency domain by channel aware scheduling. For real time (RT) service, the data rate and the packet delay should be guaranteed. But for none-real time (NRT) service, larger packet delay is acceptable and multiuser diversity gain can be exploited more to improve the system throughput. In this paper, by exploiting the queue status information and channel status information, a novel framework of unified scheduling for mixed RT and NRT services is proposed for MIMO OFDMA system, and two novel joint spatial-frequency scheduler based on Modified Proportional Fairness (MPF) and Quality Guaranteed (QG) priority function are proposed. From the simulation results, QG&MPF has much better performance than M2PF. For 2times4 MIMO case, QG&MPF can support 40 RT user and 40 NRT users in 10 MHz bandwidth simultaneously, and the system throughput of QG&MPF can approach 32 Mbps; while M2PF can only support 15 RT users and 15 NRT users, and the system throughput is about 11.5 Mbps.

articleTitle: Modified Cross-Correlated Back Projection for UWB Through-Wall Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents a modified cross-correlated back projection (CBP) algorithm for ultra-wideband (UWB) through-wall surveillance (TWS). Various effects of the wall on through-wall radar imaging, such as wave refraction and change in velocity, result in longer propagation time for a given set of transmitter, pixel and receiver locations. These effects are incorporated into the proposed algorithm. By cross-correlating the outputs of UWB array elements with that of a reference channel located far away from the array center, the presented algorithm can improve the cross-range resolution of the radar images. The capability of the modified CBP algorithm to provide through-wall surveillance is verified using the computed finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) data. Simulation results show that hidden targets behind the wall can be accurately identified in both the range and the direction by using the proposed approach. In comparison to standard BP, this scheme produces images of superior quality with better cross-range resolution and smaller sidelobe levels.

articleTitle: Research on the Content-Based Billing of Mobile Data Service for 3G
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Lots of facts prove that the technique advantage does not mean the market advantage. Therefore we should pay more attention to the market strategies rather than the blind expansion on 3G (3rd Generation, International Mobile Telecommunications-2000) network. Based on the theory of surplus value, this paper raises a settlement standard calculation model to achieve the content-based billing of mobile data service for 3G. This paper is organized as follows, firstly, it defines the conception of content-based billing; secondly it analyzes the existing billing mode, and illustrates content-based billing would greatly facilitate the development of data service in the age of 3G; finally it puts forward a settlement standard calculation model based on the theory of surplus value to implement the content-based billing.

articleTitle: REECP: A Reliable Protocol with Early-Warning Scheme in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The cluster-based communication protocol in wireless sensor networks can decrease the energy consumption effectively. Since the reliability of the sensing task is seldom analyzed and the data-centric sensing task focuses more on the data reliability, the RBD (reliability block diagram) is used to model the data reliability of wireless sensor networks. Then the malfunctioning node is defined and researched. The scheme of annulling its potential detrimental effects of disrupting the data reliability is proposed, which combined with the modified cluster formation scheme serves as the core functions of REECP (reliable energy-efficient cluster-based protocol). Compared with classical LEACH and SEP, simulation results show it can either prolong the effective lifetime of the network, or mitigate the error propagation in data aggregation. The reliability of wireless sensor networks based on the cluster-based communication protocol is thereby reinforced.

articleTitle: Activity Flow Optimization and Risk Evaluation of Complex Project
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to effectively control the schedule and cost of complex project, this paper proposes an algorithm for optimizing activity sequences and a model for evaluating schedule/cost risks based on dependency structural matrix (DSM) theory. The activity optimization algorithm aims to reduce unnecessary activity rework by arranging activity execution order properly. Risk evaluation model also takes account of the uncertainties of project activities as well as learning effects. The simulation result indicates that our optimization algorithm can effectively reduce cost and compress schedule for complex projects.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Non-Orthogonal Cooperation Scheme Based on Channel Quality Information
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We consider cooperative relay communication in a wireless network composed of three nodes and limited by the half-duplex and total power constrained. Here we focused on the non-orthogonal transmission of relay node to achieve higher spectrum efficiency. Based on the channel quality information (CQI) at the relay node, an adaptive non- orthogonal cooperative scheme is proposed which combines the benefit of the amplify-and-forward and decode-and- forward strategies. The relay node adoptively chooses one of these two strategies to cooperate in order to obtain larger average mutual information between the source and destination node. When the CQI is available at the source node, the power allocation is utilized to improve the performance of the adaptive cooperation scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Modes of Knowledge Management and Methods for Implementing of Knowledge Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper researches the definition of knowledge management in theory, and puts forward the modes of knowledge management and the methods for implementing of knowledge management.

articleTitle: Adaptively Varying Modulus Blind Equalization Algorithm Using Fractionally-Spaced Equalizer
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new blind equalization scheme for QAM systems is proposed, which is referred to adaptively varying modulus algorithm based on SCA (A VSCA). The A VSCA changes the SCA from single modulus to multi-modulus for the characteristics of the QAM systems and then adapts the zero- error contours adaptively according to the decision of the equalizer output. Simulation using a fractionally-spaced equalizer for a typical voice-band communication channel and a practical microwave channel is evaluated to compare the proposed algorithm with the CMA, GSA and SCA. Theoretical analysis and simulation results demonstrate that A VSCA improves equalization performance by increasing the convergence speed and decreasing the residual inter-symbol interference.

articleTitle: A New CMA Algorithm Based on Modified Conjugate Gradient
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new CMA adaptive beamforming algorithm based on modified conjugate gradient method is proposed. This algorithm focuses on a new technique for data block modification method with conjugate gradient, and overcomes the shortcoming of traditional CMA algorithms, which has slow convergence speed or vast complexity. Computer simulations show that the algorithm has better convergence performance and better SINR capability than other kinds of CMA algorithms.

articleTitle: A Distributed Probabilistic-Coverage Node Scheduling Scheme for Large Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, coverage configuration is an important issue which can prolong the system lifetime significantly. Most of current literatures are based on physical coverage, i.e. deterministic detection model, which is inconsistent with the realistic application of wireless sensor networks. A distributed probabilistic coverage configuration protocol (DPCCP) is proposed in this paper. It adopts Neyman-Peason probabilistic detection model to decide whether nodes can be off or not. Our DPCCP guarantees that the system detection probability is maintained after turning off lots of unnecessary nodes. We extend LEACH by embedding DPCCP into LEACH (namely LEACHE) seamlessly without any modification of the original workflow. Simulation results show that DPCCP can effectively reduce the number of active sensor nodes, and LEACHE outperforms LEACH in terms of system lifetime and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Throughput Range Based on Concurrent Transmission in Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper seek to devise a new scalable and efficient solution to the problem of determining the throughput range using concurrent transmission in wireless mesh networks. After consideration of the conditions for the concurrent transmission scheduling, an easy and efficient algorithm in greedy mode is developed for scenario construction based on the analysis of the interference relationship. Simulation experiments show the improvement of the achievable throughput in wireless mesh networks and provide a helpful method for the decision of network size.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Model for the High-Tech Brand Risk
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzed the development risk factors of high-tech brand systematically, established the evaluation index system of the development risk of high tech brand and then built the comprehensive evaluation model of the risk of high tech brand applying analytical hierarchy process (AHP) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation methods. Finally, a practice of comprehensive evaluation on a certain brand was given based on the model established.

articleTitle: Construction of the Community Health Management and Service System Based on Spatial Information Grid
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper has discussed the community health management and service from its informatization aspect to its grid aspect, and has designed the overall structure of the grid-based community health management and service system. We have already achieved the specific functions of it. In this paper, the functions of the community health management and service system such as real time supervision, service flow and sophisticated management by using real example have been developed, which have validated the foundational service function of spatial information grid, and have proved the spatial information grid is a practical way for medical professional service.

articleTitle: Research of Remote Fault Diagnosis System Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The technology of intelligent multi-agents is applied to design remote fault diagnosis system based on Internet. The system owns the kernel of the remote fault diagnosis platform, (RFDP) and the members of manufacturers and enterprise client. It is a distributed, remote monitoring and on-line diagnosis system. The system has overcome the function limitations of 2 kinds of traditional client/server architecture, equipment client-end remote diagnostic mode and manufacturer-end remote diagnostic mode. The platform has a rapid diagnosis response and makes it easy to realize information transmitting timely between platform and diagnosis members. For this reason, RFDP which holds a great ability for enabling on-line monitoring, general fault diagnosis, repairing service and updating knowledge base rapidly, can give a good service for remote distributed multi- equipments and multi-manufactures. As a common diagnosis platform, the system can be applied to various remote mechanical and electronic equipment diagnosis areas such as CNC and press machine diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Novel MAC Approach to Combating Fading Channel for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Networking together hundreds or thousands of small and cheap wireless sensor nodes requires highly energy-aware communication protocols at each layer, and much research work has been done to address this issue. However, the time-varying nature of the wireless channel also has a significant influence on the communication energy consumption, and this has long been ignored in most existing state-of-the-art energy saving protocols, thus resulting in unnecessary waste of precious battery energy. Due to this, to judiciously handle the energy management, we propose a channel adaptive energy management protocol, namely, CAEM, that can exploit this time-varying property of the wireless link, by leveraging on the synergistically cross-layer interaction between physical and MAC layers. Specifically, in CAEM, by using a previously proposed adaptive channel coding and modulation scheme, which allows a sensor terminal to dynamically adjust the data throughput via changing the amount of error protection incorporated, sensor node can intelligently access the wireless medium, according the current wireless link quality, estimated available bandwidth, and the traffic load, to realize an efficient utilization of the energy. Thus through a jointly cross layer design across the MAC layer and physical layer, CAEM can reduce the energy consumption as much as 30%, compared with traditional protocols without channel adaptation. Moreover, extensive simulation shows that CAEM is more efficient in channel utilization, in that higher network throughput is realized under heavy traffic load.

articleTitle: Improvement of Particle Swarm Optimization Based on Neighborhood Cognizance and Swarm Decision
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The original PSO usually converges prematurely, and falls into the local optimal solution. Aimed at the shortcoming of PSO, this paper put forward Improved PSO based on neighborhood cognizance (NCPSO) and improved NCPSO based on Swarm Decision (SDNCPSO). These two improved PSO can reduce the possibility of converging prematurely. The results of experiment prove that these two improved PSO can improve the performance of global convergence in PSO and make PSO converge to global optimal solution faster.

articleTitle: Research on Two Novel Channel Estimation Algorithms for Block Transmission Systems with Two Transmit Antennas Over Frequency-Selective Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents two novel channel estimation algorithms for block transmission systems with two transmit antennas over frequency-selective fading channels: time-domain-processing-based algorithm (TDPBA) and frequency-domain-processing-based algorithm (FDPBA). Performance analysis of the two novel algorithms and simulation results show that both can achieve good channel estimation performance at low and middle Signal-to-Noise Power Ratios (SNRs), but TDPBA's computational complexity is lower than that of FDPBA, while the "flat-roof effect" which appears in TDPBA at high SNRs can be avoided in FDPBA.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study of Logistics Operations at an Air Cargo Terminal
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The air cargo industry has grown rapidly in china recently. A simulation model is developed by use of the software eM-Plant<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">TM</sup> to study the logistics activities of the international cargo terminal. Besides the description of the model structure and main modules, issues about model validation and analysis for inputs and outputs are also covered. The simulation model is used to analyze the bottleneck resources in the air cargo operations and evaluate the efficiency of the existing strategy for resource allocation. Improvement suggestions have been proposed for resource allocation based on the analysis of different scenarios.

articleTitle: A Priority Method Based on Induced Trapezoidal Fuzzy Ordered Weighted Averaging (ITFOWA) Operator for Fuzzy Linguistic Decision-Making Problems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a fuzzy linguistic scale, which is characterized by trapezoidal fuzzy numbers, for the comparison between two alternatives, we introduce a possibility degree formula for comparing trapezoidal fuzzy numbers. We utilize the fuzzy linguistic scale to construct a linguistic preference matrix, and propose an induced trapezoidal fuzzy ordered weighted averaging (ITFOWA) operator to aggregate linguistic preference information. A priority method based on the fuzzy linguistic scale and ITFOWA operator for decision making problems is presented. Finally, an illustrative example is given to verify the developed method and demonstrate its feasibility and practicality.

articleTitle: End-to-End Joint Power Allocation Strategy in Multihop Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper deals with decode-and-forward (DF) relaying scheme in multihop wireless networks. Through making full use of end-to-end system outage probability requirement in multihop route, an efficient optimal power allocation (OPA) scheme that minimizing the aggregate power consumption is proposed. Theory analysis and numerical simulation indicate that compared with the traditional power allocation (PA) scheme, the proposed OPA scheme has superior performance in view of minimizing the power consumption on the condition of the same system outage guarantee.

articleTitle: Channel Estimation and Equalization for OFDM Wireless System with Medium Doppler Spread
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new channel estimator ML+SOPI is proposed for medium time-variant wireless channel, where ML denotes maximum likelihood used to estimate the CIR of pilot sequence (PS) whereas second-order polynomial (SOP) interpolation (SOPI) is to compute channel matrix of each symbol by these estimated CIRs. Then, three schemes are formed as follows: scheme A , an union of ML+SOPI and one-tap equalizer (OTE), where interpolation is based on symbol level and CIR viewed as constant; scheme B, a combination of ML+SOPI and zero- forcing equalizer (ZFE), where interpolation is conducted on sampling-point level and CIR approximated as linear; scheme C, an union of ML+SOPI and Jeon equalizer with the same assumptions as scheme B. The complexity of ZFE in scheme B is reduced by Neumann expansion and IFFT/FFT, which has far lower complexity than Jeon equalizer for long cyclic prefix(>10). The simulated results in mobile channel are as follows: when normalized Doppler spread (NDS) approaches 0.1, schemes B and C realize approximately the same BER performance, and perform far better than scheme A.Thus, scheme B is preferred for practical applications.

articleTitle: Universal Study on Parametric Models in Equipment System Cost Estimation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Currently, in equipment system cost estimation, parametric models are applied widely. In this paper, on the base of the concrete analysis on the adopted cost estimation model, the discussion was given on the universal analytical procedure in equipment system cost estimation, and the establishment of objective functions and the determination of model parameters were analyzed in parametric models and a sort of modeling method was brought forward considering the fitting accuracy and generalization capability, finally a practical modeling problem was transformed into a nonlinear system optimization problem and particle swarm optimization (PSO) was adopted to obtain the model parameters aim at the complicated optimization objective function. All of those were analyzed through a case. Theoretical researches and computational analyses show that the proposed method has essentially solved the problems of model establishment and parameter optimization in parametric methods, has the good universality and strong generalization capability, and can be used as the appraisal standard of parameter cost estimation models and the basic of self-adapting modeling of parametric cost estimation.

articleTitle: Business Process Reengineering Based on Improving Mental Models of Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The shortage of guidance of perfect mental models is one important reason of failure of business process reengineering (BPR) in enterprises. First of all, the importance of mental model to BPR is discussed based on exploring about both BPR reasons and influencing factors and the framework model of the relationship between mental model and BPR is constructed. Then the defect of mental model in the enterprises which need BPR is analyzed. Finally, some methods of improving the mental models are proposed in order to increase the success rate of BPR from the viewpoint of optimizing mental models of enterprises.

articleTitle: Improved Suppression Algorithm of Digital Narrowband Interference in FFT Domain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An adaptive FFT method for suppressing digital narrowband interferences based on double threshold is proposed in DSSS communications. The proposed algorithm utilized the threshold parameter of consecutive mean exciser (CME) to set a high and low threshold. First, the lower threshold groups the adjacent samples above the lower threshold into the same group, called as a cluster. The largest element of a cluster is compared with the upper threshold. If the largest element exceeds the upper threshold, it is decided that the cluster corresponds to a NB signal, while if the largest sample is below the upper threshold, the cluster corresponds to the noise and possible desired signal. Theoretical analysis shows the importance of the double threshold, which avoids the BER performance degrades at low JSRs. Numerical simulations show the exactness of the theoretical analysis and the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Modeling Research of Short-Life-Cycle Product Supply Chain Based on Composite Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper puts forward the concept of supply chain in short-life-cycle products and analyses the character of this type of supply chain. Then previous researches on short-life-cycle product supply chain are reviewed, and the management problems that exist in supply chain modeling are discussed. According to the character of this supply chain and on the basis of research review on supply chain modeling, a composite modeling technique for simulation with the virtue of Petri net and Object-oriented modeling is proposed. Following the modeling steps, major processes on each level of the supply chain system are set out, and finally a composite model for the system level is established as an example. The result can be used to simulate the short-life-cycle product supply chain, optimize the performance and enhance the speed of supply chain response. At last, the paper gives proposal for model solution.

articleTitle: Estimate on the Ecological and Economic Benefits of Rural Household Biogas Construction Project in Loess Hilly Region,China
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy is the most basal material demand for exist and development of human being. Due to poverty in economy, eco-environment and shortage of rural household energy and excessive consumption of biofuel becomes the important factor driving eco-environment degeneration in Loess Hilly Region of Gansu province. Data about household energy using was obtained by questionnaires in this research, environmental and economic benefits of rural household biogas Construction project were estimated by the quantitative model. Results show that biogas digesters can effectively improve the rural energy consumption structure, improve the quality of family life, cut down the total cost of energy usage. The ecological and economic benefit created by one biogas digester is 650.12 Yuan.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Inventory Control Model Based on Returned Products Permitted
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With the growth of environment concerns, the reuse of used products has received increasing attention so that a new field--"Reverse Logistics" emerged. Inventory management is one of its important areas. Assuming independent Poisson demand and returns process, an inventory control model based on returned products permitted is presented. An optimal control policy is derived. Results indicate that the rates of returned products have distinct influence on order quantities and profits of seller. The results suggest that seller should adopt efficiency measures to decrease the rates of returned products.

articleTitle: Application of System Dynamics to Project Management in Old Urban Redevelopment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Old urban redevelopment project management, compared with traditional project management, features multi- objectives, multi-feedback loops and complex nonlinear. In this paper, system dynamics approach is introduced into the project management in old urban redevelopment, and the characteristics of system dynamics in old urban redevelopment management are discussed and highlighted by studying on the interactions and responses among the three subsystems through feedback analyzing of the systemic behaviors. Systemic controlling and system dynamics modeling are described to demonstrate the project dynamics. Using a case study by computer simulation, effective countermeasures of systemic controlling are represented in old urban redevelopment project management on the whole.

articleTitle: A Modified Strong Proxy Signature Scheme For Privacy Protection
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Now most of the proxy signature scheme can't protect original signer's privacy efficiently. Based on the current situation, as we cryptanalyzes the existing digital proxy signature scheme for privacy protection in this paper, we find a lack of security in the former ones and put forward a new modified scheme, which resolves security problem in original scheme. The improvement is much more perfect and adaptable. The modified scheme can completely prevent the forgery attack by original signer in the process of proxy signature and resist all known attack.

articleTitle: A Blind Separation Method for Mixed FSK and QPSK Signals Based on ICA
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a important component of communication electronic warfare, signal separation has the great effect increasingly. Although there are many kinds of technologies based on time-frequency could be used to separate signal, it is difficult to apply them to complex electromagnetism circumstance on field, for the sake of disadvantage-need to get the prior information to object signal. This paper provides a separation method for mixed modulation signals. The simulation shows it is efficient while SNR is above 5 dB.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Integrated Business Change - A Viewpoint of BPR
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Lotka-Volterra Model: New Perspectives in the Study of Homogeneity Among Internet Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper intends to interpret the causes of homogenization among Internet enterprises through establishing the competition model of two enterprises based on Lotka-Volterra model. The research shows that homogenization is the result of rational choice on the part of an enterprise. The characteristics of network technologies and network products/services constitute a sufficient condition under which homogenization can be fulfilled. The positive network externality of network economy is the precondition of the intensification of homogeneity. The competitive advantages of large Internet enterprises come from the differentiation based on the homogeneity.

articleTitle: Information Systems Outsourcing Vendor Selection Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An ever-increasing trend in today's firms is to exploit outsourcing for those information systems (IS) functions deemed to be outside the company's core competence. One of the most critical steps in outsourcing is vendor selection, which is a strategic decision. We model the vendor selection problem as a multi-objective optimization problem. Given the multi-attribute nature of IS outsourcing decision, this paper argues that five factors, including cost, quality, project, certification and delivery performance, should be considered for outsourcing vendor selection, and proposes the use of analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method in making IS outsourcing vendor selection. The AHP is used to analyze the structure of the outsourcing problem and determine weights of the criteria and make the selection. It shows by means of a case that the method is very well suited as a vendor-selection tool for the IS outsourcing. Finally, potential issues for future research are presented.

articleTitle: A Direction Finding Algorithm for Noncircular Signals Based on Higher-Order Cumulants
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Noncircular signals (e.g. BPSK signals) are widely used in communication systems. The NC-2q-MUSIC algorithm proposed in this paper is an extension of the 2q-MUSIC algorithm to noncircular applications. The performance of NC- 2q-MUSIC algorithm for noncircular signals is better than 2q- MUSIC algorithm due to the utilization of noncircular information of signals. The resolution and robustness to modeling errors of NC-2q- MUSIC algorithm become better with the increase of the value of q. The computational complexity of the NC-2q- MUSIC algorithm is analyzed in this paper and the NC- 2q- MUSIC algorithm for uniform linear array (ULA) called NC- 2q-MUSIC/ULA which needs much less computation is also proposed. Simulation results show the better performance of NC- 2q-MUSIC algorithm than 2q-MUSIC and validate other conclusions about NC-2q-MUSIC.

articleTitle: An Alternative Means for Delivering Web Documents to Mobile Phones
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a framework, Doc2Mms, for adapting some existing Web documents with special file type to MMS so that these contents can be rendered on small screen mobile phones. Doc2Mms integrates functions of ICAP proxy, content adaptation proxy and MMS sender. It provides an alternative means to retrieve Web content for mobile terminals and overcomes the deficiency in presenting Web documents with special file type such as .pdf, .doc and .rtf on mobile communication terminals. Being designed based on the de-facto standards, the framework has great extensibility.

articleTitle: A Workflow Frequent Pattern Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To improve workflow for adapting to the uncertainty of business environments, workflow frequent patterns are used. First, the frequent pattern discovery problem is defined, and a frequent pattern-mining algorithm based on Apriori algorithm is proposed. Frequent patterns can quantify the strength of logical relations between activities and trend forecast and crucial business decision-making can be supported by frequent patterns in key activities.

articleTitle: Automatic Competitive Intelligence Collection Based on Semantic Web Mining
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Accuracy and relativity of information accessed by search engine are not so satisfied. In order to enhance efficiency of information retrieval, semantic Web mining technology is suggested to discovery knowledge hidden in Web information resources and a semantic Web mining framework is constructed. Then its architecture and pivotal technologies are also discussed.

articleTitle: High Energy-Efficient Mobile Agent Based Information Aggregation in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we develop an improved energy-efficient mobile agent (EMA) paradigm for information aggregation in wireless sensor networks (WSNs). In EMA, destination node in each agent hopping keeps an instance of the arrival mobile agent's processing code. The following mobile agent, if the same information aggregation algorithm is required, carries only much short size executable script instead of large size full processing code. Simulation results show that EMA brings more than 10% percent energy saving compared to normal mobile agent method when the size ratio of full processing code and script is greater than 25, which shows that this EMA is particularly energy efficient when big size sophisticated information aggregation algorithm is implemented. Our method can also provide energy efficient flexible in-network processing for adaptive on-demand applications in WSNs.

articleTitle: Channel Quality Indication (CQI) Application in HSDPA Simulation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: ICQI is the key indicator for HSDPA downlink channel quality. UE reports CQI and HARQ-ACK feedback info to Node-B through uplink channel HS-DPCCH. UE estimates the CQI value through an iterative algorithm taking the measurements of HS-PDSCHSIR and CPICH_Ec/No into account. Besides this the UE probes with varying parameter values for TB size, modulation type, a reference power setting for HS-PDSCH and an possible power adjustment value to obtain a CQI value. This paper gives the methods how to determine SIR of PDSCH channel, received HS-PDSCH power, the Measurement Power Offset etc. This is very important for every HSDPA sub-frame in HSDPA simulations.

articleTitle: Pricing Network Resources: A New Perspective
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We consider I users sending elastic traffic into a service provider's (SP's) network. Each user has a contract to transmit data at a nominal rate. However, a user is free to transmit at a higher rate if she wishes. For each user, we assume a realistic traffic model. A user alternates between two phases over time. In the limited data phase, a user's transmission rate is capped at some value below her contracted rate. This happens because the user does not have enough data to send. In the unlimited data phase, a user has enough data to sustain any rate. At time ti, a (possibly empty) set Si of users is in the limited data phase. This leaves unutilized resources in the network that ought to be exploited by others. At time t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> > t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, users in Si are back in the unlimited data phase. Now it should be possible for these users to reclaim their contracted rates at the expense of "overusers." We show that under certain conditions, a very simple pricing scheme can ensure fair and efficient operation in the above sense. A SP needs just one price for all the users.

articleTitle: The Role of Relational Characteristics in Information Seeking for Opportunity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Opportunity recognition (OpR) has long been accepted as a key aspect of the entrepreneurial process. Discovering entrepreneurial opportunities requires individuals to seek information from many sources. The existing research on information seeking and OpR has examined the information seekers' personality traits and the attributes of the information source, however, we know little about the relational characteristics of social interaction that facilitate information seeking in OpR. So this paper studies how different characteristics of individuals' relationships with others influence their perception of information about opportunities. We focus on four relational characteristics, that is, (1) knowing, (2) emotional support, (3) legitimacy, and (4) trust. We build the model and collected empirical data from loan managers of a bank in China. Then we use quadratic assignment procedure (QAP) to test the model statistically. Our analyses show that all characteristics except legitimacy influence the entrepreneurs' acquisition of information in their opportunity recognition significantly.

articleTitle: An Improved Decoding Method for LDPC Codes in SC-FDE System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Single carrier transmission with cyclic prefix (SC-CP or SC-FDE), has been adopted in wireless applications as an alternative technique to orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM). In this paper, an improved decoding method for regular low density parity check (LDPC) codes is proposed to compensate for the loss in signal-to-noise (SNR) due to the CP insertion. According to our research, the algorithm to select suitable CP plays an important role in decoding. The performance of the uncoded case is well analyzed. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme is effective under both AWGN and Rayleigh fading channels.

articleTitle: Delay Performance Analyses for GBN-ARQ and SR-ARQ Protocols
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Automatic repeat request (ARQ) is an important error-control protocol in wireless communication. In this paper, by analyzing the transmission mechanism of ARQ protocols and the existent literatures, the queuing models for both GBN-ARQ protocol and SR-ARQ protocol are established sententiously based on Equivalent Service delay, in which the packet length, the propagation delay and procession delay of the date link and the receiver feedback delay are considered. Also, the expression formulations of the packet mean waiting delay and packet mean service delay of the both protocols are obtained, which also can be used to control the sliding windows, and both protocols' delay performances versus the sliding windows length and the packet length are analyzed and compared by simulation. The models can be extended to analyze other types of ARQ protocols.

articleTitle: Study on Decision Support System of Flood Disaster Based on the Overall Process Emergency Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The emergency management of flood disaster should run through the overall process: pre-flood disaster phase, flood disaster phase, post-flood disaster phase, not only for the emergency response of flood. This paper studies the necessity and feasibility of the emergency management decision support system (DSS) of flood disaster, puts forward the systematic framework of overall process emergency management, and finally expounds the function design of each application subsystem.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Mobile Agent-Based Network Management System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile agent has mobile and intelligent features, if applied to network management, the flexibility and expansibility of system can be greatly enhanced. Meanwhile, its independent nature of platform can be easily used to cross-platform network management. In this paper, a framework has been given, in which network management system was based on mobile agent. The network topology search algorithm has been discussed, the implementation of mobile agent-based network management system has been presented.

articleTitle: The Evaluation of Power Supply Enterprises' Service Recovery Quality Based on Improved Fuzzy AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The customer-centered transformation is taking place among China's power supply enterprises, which are changing towards service-oriented type. And for this type of enterprises, service recovery is inevitable. However, there hasn't been such research into the effect or evaluation of this service recovery, neither theoretically nor applicative. In this paper, the index system of supply enterprise's service recovery quality is established, and the weight of each index is made clear using improved AHP method, so that the customer's perceptive of service recovery quality is measured, and the uncertainty of thinking is taken into consideration at the same time. Moreover, this evaluation is classified according to the characteristic of power consumer. After these, demonstration is carried out, the result of which is discussed, and advises are given to supply enterprises on their service recovery strategy.

articleTitle: What Have Caused Consumer Fraud in Auction Website?
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper focuses on consumer fraud in auction website, and finds out why consumers may cheat sellers. At present, practitioners and scholars from home and abroad lay more emphasis on how to cope with website fraud, while less attention has been put on the consumer fraud. Based on the current situation of auction website, five key factors that have impact on consumer fraud have been put forward: consumer characteristics, e-commerce technology, virtual network, e-commerce law and punishment mechanism of faith-breaking. By means of factor analysis, four factors have been extracted, and the correlations between those factors and consumer fraud behavior have been researched.

articleTitle: Adaptive MMSE Receiver Based DS-UWB Indoor Transmission Scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In ultra-wideband (UWB) indoor dense multi-path transmission environments, traditional coherent Rake receiver requires estimation of channel parameters. Moreover, in order to collect enough signal energy from dense multi-path components, the number of Rake fingers must be large enough. Consequently, the receiver structure is too complex to be implemented in practice. However, we know that adaptive signal detection performs well in DS-CDMA systems due to its simple algorithm and robustness of anti-interference. In this paper, we propose an indoor high data rate wireless link scheme based on adaptive minimum mean square error (MMSE) receiver for DS-UWB transmission. Its bit error rate (BER) performance is analyzed under the newly proposed IEEE 802.15.3a UWB indoor channel model. Simulation results show that, nearly without loss of BER performance compared with the traditional Rake receiver scheme, the proposed scheme requires no channel estimation and, therefore, is simpler in structure and easier for implementation.

articleTitle: Energy Conservation in Large-Scale Sensor Networks through Wakeup Mechanism and Clustering Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To lengthen the lifetime of the sensor network significantly, a node should turn off its radio most of the time, expect when it has to participate in data forwarding. We propose an asynchronous wakeup mechanism, which efficiently wakes up nodes while transmission or monitoring the channels based on the concept of the grid-based quorum (GQMA). Next, we consider a simplified clustering mode for a sensor network integrated GQMA. All the nodes are in the power-saving modes following the wakeup mechanism discussed above except getting the TDMA schedule from a clusterhead (CH). Compared with other hierarchical clustering algorithms, our protocol can achieve more power conservation on the phases of cluster formation and routing tree setup by reducing idle listening time and does not demand clock synchronization between the nodes. Simulation results show that the proposed protocols have good performances in the aspects of energy conservation and efficiency.

articleTitle: Applying Semantic Web Technologies to E-Learning
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper advocate the use of ontologies to explicitly specify all learning designs, learning objects and the relations between them to increase the level of reusability and presents an ontology-based approach to integrate learning designs and learning object content. In this paper we first define a conceptual model that introduces an intermediary level between learning design and learning objects called the reusability context. Then, we use ontologies to represent these concepts. At last, we conclude by analyzing the potential usability of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Cluster-Based Double Bounce MIMO Channel Model and Capacity Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The spatial and temporal correlation is investigated at both transmitter and receiver. A cluster-based double bounce MIMO channel model is presented. The model can be used for nonselective Rice fading MIMO channels, and the expressions for correlation coefficient and channel capacity are derived. The correlation coefficient is the function of antennas spacing, angular spread, power angular spectrum, mean angle-of-arrival, Doppler spread and delay spread. In space domain, the capacity increases with antenna spacing and angular spread. For multiple clusters incidence wave, the correlation coefficient and capacity will oscillate with increasing antenna spacing. The capacity will decrease with increasing Rician factor. In time domain, the capacity gets higher with increasing Doppler and delay spread. When the frame length is larger than coherent time, the capacity will get to the independent capacity asymptotically. Two typical scenarios are simulated for indoor and outdoor environments.

articleTitle: MIMO Packet-by-Packet Generalized Processor Sharing: MPGPS
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The problem of allocating network resources to the users of a cellular network with multiple antennas in a fair way is investigated. We propose a packet scheduler called MIMO packet-by-packet generalized processor sharing (MPGPS). The scheduler can provide fair access to the channels for users and is work conserving. It also compensates lagging users and decreases the average delay of users. Comparisons with a couple of scheduling algorithms considering traffic characteristics and the mobility of users demonstrate the superior performance of our scheduler.

articleTitle: A Fractal-Based Simulation Scheme for Multipath Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a nonlinear dynamical model for multipath fading channel is established on the basis of the study on the nonlinear dynamical properties of wireless mobile communication channel by using chaos and fractal theory. The phase space of the multipath fading time serials is reconstructed and the correlation dimension is analyzed, which indicate that the dynamical system has finite degree of freedom and a positive maximum Lyapunov exponent. The chaotic characteristic of the multipath fading is demonstrated and the nonlinear evolution mechanism is observed. Finally, the multipath signals are reconstructed by using fractal interpolation algorithm and gaining reasonably accurate replications. The results indicate that the nonlinear dynamical system could be a more suitable model than the classic stochastic models for describing multipath fading phenomenon.

articleTitle: Revenue Sharing Contract Design in Supply Chain under Asymmetric Information
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The problem of supply chain coordination with revenue sharing contract is studied under asymmetric information. Since the first best coordinating contract under complete information leads to distortion of low cost retailer's order quantity in the setting of asymmetric information, the supplier and the supply chain may incur profit loss. The impact of asymmetric information is analyzed using the analytical framework of contract theory. The second best revenue sharing contract is proposed. It increases the supplier's expected profit and the efficiency of the supply chain by paying some information rent to the low cost retailer. The conclusion is confirmed by the numerical analysis.

articleTitle: Getting to Know Websites through Uncertainty Reduction Strategies: Which Strategies Are Used More, and Which Are Better? An Empirical Study of First-Time Visitors
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Uncertainty reduction is an important precondition for various facilitators of Internet shopping behaviors, visitors dealing with an online store will require sufficient information so as to reduce their uncertainty of the Web site. Uncertainty reduction theory has identified four strategies for the visitors to lower their uncertainty. Since different Internet strategies have different efficiency and effectiveness at conveying different levels of information, and not all tasks have the same information need, the relative effectiveness of these technologies at supporting these strategies to reduce uncertainty is still unclear. This research designs two laboratory experiments to investigate how the initial visitors will use different types of uncertainty-reducing technological support, how different task types and different levels of presented information would lead to greater uncertainty reduction. The results would inform practitioners on how these strategies could be useful to reduce uncertainty surrounding new online stores, and ultimately to promote Internet commerce.

articleTitle: Research on Quality Control Technology in Manufacturing Process Based on Flexibility of Production Capability
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to meet multiple demands in market, on the preconditions of product planning designed for customer's requirements, enterprises must have some flexibility in manufacturing process and offer eligible product in delivery date in order to get more profit. Therefore the paper produces the concept of capacity flexibility and its three indices which incarnate flexibility: quality, cost and scheduling. It primarily differentiates the relation between capacity flexibility and quality control, and thinks that enhancing quality control in manufacturing process benefits the enhancement of its capacity flexibility; and brings forward that we infiltrate lean production into integrated control strategy between quality prevention control and six sigma management to realize the combination of high quality, low cost and high speed, and to synthetically enhance capacity flexibility of manufacturing process.

articleTitle: Innovation Capabilities Evaluation Approach for Chinese Automobile Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There is a large consensus among academics and practitioners that innovation capability is the key of the development of automobile enterprises. Considering the traits of independent innovation, the author presents an original approach for the evaluation of innovation capabilities of Chinese automobile enterprises. The approach is based on the assumption of a relationship between specific resources managed by automotive firms and their innovation capabilities, and highlights the sustainable capabilities and long-term stratagem of innovation. After indicator system was proposed, a model for the qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis of innovation capabilities is derived from the D-S Evidence Theory. On accounting of applying D-S Evidence Theory, the model can handle uncertain fact and subjective evaluation effectively, and combine the evaluation results from multi-layer efficiently.

articleTitle: The Impact of Transformational Leadership on Individual and Team Performance: Evidence from Knowledge Work Teams
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The current study explored the effect of transformational leadership of knowledge work team leaders on team members' individual performance, which included both in-role behavior and organizational citizenship behavior(OCB), and team performance. Survey data was collected from a sample of 54 knowledge work teams in high-tech organizations in four cities of China. The results of hierarchical regression showed that relationship-oriented transformational leadership behaviors had a significant effect on team members' OCB with leader-member exchange(LMX) as the mediator, and task-oriented transformational leadership behaviors had a significant effect on team members' in-role behavior. Team- level OCB mediated the relationship between transformational leadership and team performance.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Objective Dynamic Priority Request Scheduling of Business Web System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The general target of request scheduling is to maximize throughput and minimize response time under the condition that existing system resource is in full use. But for a busy business Web system with the goal of revenue generation, it is crucial to increase the completion rate of transaction related requests and requests from VIP. Aiming at the multi-objective of request scheduling for business web system, the multi-objective dynamic priority optimization scheduling mechanism and algorithm is proposed based on reward-driven multi-dimension criterion for request classification and one-step-ahead overload estimation. Simulation experiment shows the validity of this scheduling algorithm.

articleTitle: A Cumulative Satisfaction Measure Model Based on Dynamic Customer Expectation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Customer cumulative satisfaction is crucial indicator of performance in the industries of continuously provided service, and the dynamic nature of expectation is especially important in this kind of satisfaction. In this paper, we establish a cumulative satisfaction measure model (CSM) based on dynamic customer expectation, which is considered as function of "adaptation" and "social comparison". We also discuss the application of CSM through optimizing the distribution of promoting resource.
