In this paper, firstly, we maximized the cost function to construct the relationship between the inverse equalizer output and the input sequences, and then we used particle swarm algorithm to get the parameters and iteratively extract the MIMO (multiple-input multiple-output) system channel impulse response function .Computer simulation examples illustrate that the proposed algorithm can achieve higher performance when using less output samples to estimate the function parameters; even when we used lots of output samples ,the proposed algorithm also can get better performance than the subspace algorithm and the inverse filter algorithm.

articleTitle: Antenna Selection for Spatial Multiplexing Systems Based on Complex Householder QR Factorization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a novel antenna selection algorithm based on complex Householder QR factorization is proposed in wireless multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems. It avoids the shortcoming of previous methods which need a mass of search over all possible subsets, has lower computation complexity and better performance. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed antenna selection algorithm achieves excellent performance with linear receivers over fading channels.

articleTitle: Voice Conversion Without Parallel Speech Corpus Based on Mixtures of Linear Transform
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm for voice conversion based on mixtures of linear transform (Ms-LT) which avoids the need for parallel training data inherent in conventional approaches. In maximum likelihood framework, the EM algorithm is used to compute the parameters of the conversion function. And the chirp z-transform is utilized to enhance the averaged spectral envelop due to the linear weighting. The proposed voice conversion system is evaluated using both objective and subjective measures. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach is capable of effectively transforming speaker identity and can achieve comparable results of the conventional methods where a parallel corpus exists.

articleTitle: E-Enterprise and E-Management Concept and Process Model Research
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: E-management is an idea that emerges as the rapid development of Internet and e-business environment. E-management is an effective method for the enterprise to win competitive advantages or core competence. An e-enterprise is the goal and the result of a successful e-management. To implement e-management successfully, we should take e-technology as precondition and e-source as foundation, in an operation mode of e-service, with the guarantee of e-speed, to achieve a goal of e-organization. In this paper, the connotations of related e-concepts are described in detail; the operation process model of e-enterprise and conceptual model of e-management are also built.

articleTitle: Analysis on Technological Progress Contribution Rate to Economic Growth of Six Central China Provinces
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Technological progress is one of the main powers to economic growth. This paper uses the method of Solow Residual to estimate technological progress contribution rate to economic growth of six central China provinces from 1990 to 2005, and comes to a conclusion: its average of technological progress contribution rates is only 34.81% from 1990 to 2005, which is below the average level of China. Then it analyzes the reasons, which course the low rates. Finally it puts forward some suggestions to improve technological progress contribution rate in central China, which are enlarging sci-tech input, promoting industry-university-institute collaboration research and accelerating sci-tech production industrialization.

articleTitle: Content Extraction from Web Pages Based on Chinese Punctuation Number
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Extracting main content from Web page is the preprocessing of Web information system. The content extraction approach based on wrapper is limited to one specific information source, and greatly depends on Web page structure. It is seldom employed in practice. A new content extraction method is thus proposed in this paper, which can discover Web page content according to the number of Chinese punctuations and the ratio of non-hyperlink character number to character number that hyperlinks contain. It can eliminate noise and extract main content blocks from web page effectively. Experimental results show that this approach is accurate and suitable for most Chinese Web sites.

articleTitle: Mobility-Sensitive Clustering Algorithm to Balance Power Consumption for Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy efficiency is very important in mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs). Most clustering algorithms save energy by limiting the maximum size of the cluster, by reducing control overhead for maintaining clusters, or by reducing power consumption of intra-cluster communication. These algorithms usually update the intra-cluster routing information and maintain clusters by periodically sending out beacons. This paper proposes to save energy not only by reducing the unnecessary flooding used to update the intra-cluster routing information, but also by balancing power consumption among nodes and clusters throughout the network. We first propose a method to assess the mobility rate of the nodes by sensing the difference in node ID records in a CH between two successive beacons. The beacons will then be adaptively sent out to update the intra-cluster routing information according to these assessed mobility rates, so that the unnecessary flooding is significantly reduced, thereby, resulting in higher energy efficiency. Furthermore, the cluster sizes are adaptively maintained between the maximum and the minimum sizes according to the mobility rates to better balance power consumption among the clusters. Preliminary simulation results show that the proposed algorithm indeed sends out beacon messages adaptively and balances power consumption among clusters.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Stated En-Route Switching Behavior Under Various Information Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Providing more applicable information contents in terms of drivers' opinions can effectively stimulate drivers' en- route switching behavior. This study applied the ordered probit model (OPM) to analyze various information scenarios that may affect drivers' en-route switching behavior with considering latent variables. Empirical findings indicate that the drivers' perceived value and usage attitude toward received information would positively motivate their switching willingness, while their switching barrier and congestion tolerability would negatively restrict them. Drivers would unlikely comply with diversion suggestion due to their negative latent variables toward immature information contents, therefore, several hypothetical information scenarios are proposed to enhance their switching intention. The results showed that the freeway drivers' en-route switching behavior in Taiwan has increased while providing more detailed information both on the regular and alternative routes.

articleTitle: Risk Evaluation of Communication Network of Electric Power Based on Restriction Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: According to the structural feature and development presently of the electric power communications network, one of its risk evaluation methods based on improved FAHP is proposed. The significance and situation of risk evaluation of the electric power communications network are briefly presented. One new method of fuzzy taxis, called restriction coefficient, is proposed, while explaining its advantages and proposing a method confirming index power weight using triangular fuzzy number and limited digit coefficient. One risk evaluation method of the electric power communications network based on limited digit coefficient is advanced while showing its idiographic assessment process and it is validated through some electric power communications network in some place and gets the collectivity risk rank and index taxis. The result shows that this evaluation method's calculation is simple, and according with fact while having better stability of taxis.

articleTitle: New Parallel Interference Cancellation for DS/CDMA Systems Over Rayleigh Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper firstly investigates an optimal parallel interference cancellation (PIC) scheme for DS/CDMA system. Secondly, to reduce the high implementation complexity encountered by the optimal PIC, we propose a reduced-complexity PIC. The performance of the reduced-complexity PIC over Rayleigh fading channel is analyzed and compared to the optimal PIC and conventional PIC, respectively. The simulation results show that the reduced-complexity PIC shows a performance comparable to the optimal PIC and dominantly outperforms the conventional PIC. It is also shown that the reduced-complexity PIC with one interference cancellation (IC) stage is superior to the conventional PIC with two IC stages in performance, which is of practical value because PIC with fewer IC stages can bring shorter processing delay.

articleTitle: The "Small-World" Characteristic of Author Co-Words Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The co-words network of the author key words is a knowledge network mapped according to the co-occurrence phenomenon of key words in a number of papers. It reflects the relation among multiple vocabulary conceptions and also represents the structure of scientific research. With the social network analysis technology, the structural analysis of co-words network shows that the average distance is 2.814 and the clustering coefficient is 0.735, demonstrating the obvious existence of small-world characteristic.

articleTitle: An Improved Frequency Estimator for Single Sinusoid Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An improved frequency estimator (CFI-Kay) is proposed. The estimator improves Kay's algorithm by autocorrelation, FFT and interpolation, digital heterodyne, decimation, linear prediction... The estimator has a significantly reduced threshold relative to the existing methods and mean-squared error (MSE) close to that of maximum likelihood estimation (MLE). In addition, the MSE is within 0.2 dB of the Cramer-Rao bound (CRB) at signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) above threshold. The performance of CFI-Kay algorithm is uniform across a frequency range of -pi to pi. Moreover, the increased computational complexity of the new estimator is acceptable.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient AODV for Low Mobility Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The improved energy-efficient AODV for low mobility ad hoc networks is studied in this paper because nodes in an ad hoc network operate with limited energy. To extend the lifetime of the low mobility ad hoc networks, the node energy consumption of the overall network is reduced by dynamically controlling the transmission power while maintaining all nodes balanced power use by utilizing a novel proposed route cost metric. The passive route refreshing scheme and RREQ broadcast controlling is designed to further balance the energy consumption among nodes. According to the low mobility character, the location information is fully utilized in our improvement scheme. What's more, the average residual energy estimation algorithm improved and brought it in our energy- efficient AODV. The simulation results show that the improved AODV could extent the network lifetime by 37% at most, while keeping other network performance standards undamaged or improved.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Multi-Path Characteristics of Acoustic Propagation in Shallow Water Wireless Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Multi-path interference due to boundary reflection in shallow water acoustic communication poses the major obstacle to reliable, high-speed underwater communication system. Based on the typical sound speed profiles of Taiwan Strait, this paper adopt fast-field program to simulate the delay time and amplitude fluctuation of multi-path under different channel conditions. Simulation results reveal the relationships between delay, amplitude and typical channel parameters, such as sound- speed gradient, distance, channel depth, which provides a valuable guide for the practical design of shallow-water wireless acoustic communication system.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Mobile IPv6 and Its Extensions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile IPv6 (MIPv6) and its proposed enhancements, fast MIPv6 (FMIPv6), hierarchical MIPv6 (HMIPv6), buffer management, link layer trigger (L2T) and a hybrid MIPv6 scheme (i.e. IMIPv6), are introduced. The average handover delay, throughput and handover signaling load of MIPv6, FMIPv6, HMIPv6 and IMIPv6 are simulated and analyzed with MIRAI-SF. The simulation results show that IMIPv6 can effectively solve TCP sequence disruption, lessen handover delay and control signaling load, and thus reduce network load of MIPv6 network.

articleTitle: A Middleware Framework Based on the IEEE 1451 Standards
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The following paper will provide a middleware architecture integrating common methodologies (XML based data format, functional models and Web-service platforms) in order to facilitate the development of IEEE 1451 standards. A distinct separation exists within the 1451 standards based on an internal complex structure (such as internal methods/functions contained in the software interfaces of 1451 standards) and an external service demand (user would only interest in the sensor data regardless of any standard). This work will entail in the development of a software/user-services based models which can ensconce internal mechanism of 1451 standards to local/remote HMI (human machine interface). An XML data representation is adopted to achieve this goal.

articleTitle: An Ants Intelligent Routing Protocol for Wireless Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For lack of suitable routing protocol, wireless mesh network as a next generation network uses the ad hoc's instead. This paper proposes an ants intelligence routing (AIR) protocol for wireless mesh network by establishing ants agent on each wireless router. AIR agent maintains status of local links by exchanging Hello messages periodically, dispatches ant packets to search for routings on-demand and reverse back to the originator to obtain routings. AIR selects and updates routings based on concept of ants pheromone which is related to real time property of wireless links. Compared with AODV and OLSR, simulation experiments show that AIR has lower overhead, good throughput, acceptable delay and packet delivery ratio, is suitable for WMN with self-organized, self-adaptive characteristics.

articleTitle: An Empirical Research on Tail Dependence in China Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article defines coefficient of upper-lower tail dependence and coefficient of lower-upper tail dependence based on coefficient of upper tail dependence and coefficient of lower tail dependence and does an empirical research on tail dependence in China stock market. A mixed Copula that can well describe dependence structure between Shanghai Exchange Composite Index(SHECI) and Shenzhen Exchange Component Index(SZECI) is found by empirical analysis firstly, and is used to calculate coefficients of tail dependence. The results show that there are strong upper tail dependence and lower tail dependence, but no upper-lower tail dependence and lower-upper tail dependence between daily returns of SHECI and SZECI.

articleTitle: Ontology-Based Expertise Matching System Within Academia
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The knowledge and expertise of researchers and professors is the major asset that universities hold. In order to make use of this asset, it is necessary to share expertise between staff as well as transfer expertise to industry. Expertise matching - locating experts with the specific expertise is receiving more and more attention since it facilitates people connection to each other. This paper proposes an ontology-based approach for expertise matching within an academic research environment. In our approach an expert ontology is used to integrate multiple expertise indications from heterogeneous data sources and domain ontology is used to replace keyword-based expertise profile to concept based expertise profile. An analysis of the prototype system indicates that ontology-based expertise matching supports users browsing and searching expertise more efficiently and effectively.

articleTitle: Cost Prediction of Equipment System Using LS-SVM with PSO
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Considering the shortcomings of conventional cost prediction methods, least squares support vector machine (LS-SVM) was adopted to establish the cost prediction model of equipment system, which could efficiently solve the problems on the determination of network structure and the phenomena of over-fitting in neural network methods. And due to the importance of parameters optimization in LS-SVM model, particle swarm optimization (PSO) was used to optimize the model parameters. The experiment results show that PSO can quickly obtain the optimal parameters satisfying the precision requirement with a simple calculation, which solves the problem of complex calculation and empiricism in conventional methods. The evaluation on the testing cases shows the LS-SVM model with PSO has a good generalization performance and can be popularized in cost prediction. At last, the experiment on an independent testing case shows the model optimized by PSO has a better prediction performance than by grid search.

articleTitle: Research on the Shipbuilding Agile Supply Chain Management System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Along with the prominent development of modern science and technology and the elevated requirement of ship products, shipbuilding mode is becoming increasingly advanced and consummated, which, based on mass customization, turns into an inevitable trend. Modern management technology needs to fit for this development. Researching on the traditional agile supply chain, this paper discusses theories and methods of the shipbuilding agile supply chain management, and puts forward the systems architecture, and finally analyzes properly. The system is provided with great application values for developing the modern shipbuilding mode and constructing the agile supply chain in shipbuilding enterprises.

articleTitle: Some New Results on Parameter Estimation of Alpha-Stable Distribution
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Since alpha-stable distribution was introduced as a generalization of Gaussian distribution, it has been applied widely in wireless communication field, such as designing filter, modeling impulsive noises and so on. In this paper, parameter estimation methods of alpha-stable distribution are classified into five types and a classic method in each type is studied based on our analysis. Specially, two important results are presented: After sample number increases to 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>, precision of MLE based on FFT is not improved much; with alphararr2 , error of estimation for alpha in extreme value method is growing, which are neglected in the past researches. Finally, Monte-Carlo simulations are used to verify results.

Index Terms: Increase In The Number Of Samples

articleTitle: Outsourcing for Achieving Mass Customization in Service Operations: Lessons from the "Smaller Kitchen" Strategy in Chinese Catering Services
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper aimed to reveal key issues of outsourcing in service mass customization based on a case study in Chinese catering service industry. It firstly justified that outsourcing served as a an important facilitator in delivering mass customized services by increasing efficiency and reducing costs due to the expertise developed along the supply chain. It then pointed out the functions/business to be outsourced in mass customization which should be non-cored and helpful to utilize expertise and avoid risks. Moreover the impacts of the service feature of simultaneity on outsourcing were also discussed. Suggestions for future researches were finally presented.

articleTitle: Access Delay Analysis of ZigBee Protocol with Delay Line
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, the Zigbee protocol mode was studied and derive the expression of access delay with delay line operating under the IEEE standard 802.15.4 by statistic method, in the beacon enabled, saturation mode, considering the different number of nodes and length of packet. Article analyze the effect of delay line, and get some important conclusions regarding the implementation of 802.15.4 networks, and propose some corrections to the protocol in order to get better efficiency of the network.

articleTitle: Novel DS-CDMA Multiuser Detector Based on Step Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we present a new multiuser detection algorithm based on step ant colony optimization. This algorithm accelerates the process of search by setting the parameters of basic ant colony optimization appropriately and meanwhile introduces a strategy of jumping out of the local optimal solution, thus it can approach the minimum probability of error with great computation efficiency. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm converges rapidly and provides good BER performance for cases where basic ant colony algorithms perform poorly.

articleTitle: From Shannon-Weaver to Boisot: A Review on the Research of Knowledge Transfer Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Scholars always try to uncover the mechanism of KT (Knowledge Transfer) for it is an important part of Knowledge Management (KM). The complicated mechanism of KT can be described with the intuitionistic models. According to the development of the research work, the paper reviews 4 typical KT models brought forward by Shannon-Weaver, Szulanski, Nonaka & Takeuchi and Boisot. The paper analyzes the relationship between the 4 models and insists that the relationship is not of a line but of a network. The emphasis of the future research is to make the models more uniform and to do more empirical research.

articleTitle: An Ontology-Based Virtualization Access Control Framework for Grid Service
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper is mainly devoted to analyze the efficiency of security administration and assurance of virtual organization(VO) in autonomous domains. For grid applications, access control is usually implemented through mapping VO-space users to autonomous domains' local users, which reduces the efficiency of security administration and bears the risk of violating security policy of these domains applying RBAC model. A general authentication and access control architecture is proposed, which rarely has negative effect on security administration efficiency, and is compatible with autonomous domain's security policy. Based on this model, the study of ontology service in VO provides a sound basis for the dynamic, cooperative and multilevel characteristics for different resources.

articleTitle: Flow-Aware Based Integrated Admission Control Scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Admission control for multi-service flows, which based on single link state respectively, separates the correlation among different flows. It also neglects the affection between two type flows. These disadvantages degrade the performance of admission control scheme. The network can be reacted to the damage, but there is delay to adjust the network status. Proposed admission control scheme combines the congestion metrics of two type flows to several decision spaces. The scheme makes a decision based on fuzzy link state according to integrated decision space and can overcome the shortest of single information decision. Performance of two schemes will be compared by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Architecture of Transportation Monitor Management System Based on Event Driven Theory
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The aim of this paper is to defining the application architecture of monitor system for transportation process from the viewpoint of the third party logistic service provider. Recently with the advent of the information technology and the wide spread use of the Internet, new user oriented production and logistic systems, such as the logistic management system, have been required in order to cope with the drastic and continuous changes on the markets and users' preferences. To achieve this purpose, the third party logistic service providers need to mutually monitor their transportation process with heterogeneous requirements. Monitor service for transportation process is proposed as system architecture in order to realize assurance when distributed database systems with heterogeneous requirements have to coexist in a common environment without violating each other characteristics. In this system architecture, a loose consistency management technology is proposed in order to let each domain to autonomously conduct its own actions while preserving the consistency of the total system.

articleTitle: A Flexible Business Alliance Model for the Emerging UMTS Network Operators
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With UMTS network being rolled out, there exist more and more applications, content providers and value-added services providers in the mobile market. And then value chain will be more complex, which requires reconsideration of business models and partnerships. In this paper, we provided detailed analyses about the movement of mobile market from 2G to 3G and proposed a compatible and flexible business model to upcoming 3G market for the network operators. The key idea is to introduce an entity (trusted third party), which is capable of handling efficiently subscription management, as well as charging, billing and accounting for value added services.

articleTitle: LAS-OFDM System Over Frequency Selective Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With spectrum spreaded by LAS multiple access codes and orthogonal subcarriers being utilized, LAS-OFDM system bring the merits of both technologies into play. By suitably designing the spread spectrum codes and keeping the guard period enough long, inter-symbol interference and multiple access interference are eliminated, which is due to the good correlation property of LAS codes. For the transmitted signal that is subject to frequency selective fading, the decision variable is figured out. As the performance is good enough for high bit rate transmission, LAS-OFDM system is very useful in wireless or mobile communications.

articleTitle: Research on Competitive Adaptation in an Evolutionary Industrial Environment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper employs DEA methods to disclose the competitive adaptation in automobile-component-manufacturing industry in Great Wuhan Economic Circle. Through the research, the authors intend to set up a general model to expose the status quo of the subsistence of the industry. Based on that, the authors attempt to discover the main factors which can increase firm's or industrial competitive adaptation; finally, we present some constructive suggestions to the healthy development of the industry.

articleTitle: The Research of Network Address Translation Traverse in Soft Switch System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: VoIP technology is becoming more and more popular. Because of the pinch of IP addresses in IPv4 environment, NAT is a popular way to solve this problem. But one of the is how to traverse NAT. This paper has made an exposition of the basic concept of NAT, listed some core problems that NAT has to face in VoIP technology, introduced two mainstream traverse plans: ALG and STUN and analyzed their principle and network topology, and their shortcomings. On the basis of ALG and STUN, the authors have worked out a revolutionary plan: SBC+MP, analyzed in detail its principle, network topology, its work flow and advantages compared with ALG and STUN. In the end, we have made a conclusion about NA T technology.

articleTitle: Selective Cost Effective JIT Optimization Measures for Low Volume Car Assemblers
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Low volume automotive plants, challenged in their search for leanness in producing quality throughput are pressured for more efficiency in reducing waste and more effective in achieving higher asset turnover. In essence these categories of plants need to deal with JIT philosophy by being insightful during implementation. From a practitioner perspective, this paper offers some cost effective measures to improve five key areas when optimizing JIT implementation. These are; not to overdo standard operating procedure, knowing what, where and when to trigger kanban, systematically replace unsuitable parts, empowering line control and make the lot traveler pull the system.

articleTitle: Intention to Participate in Web Surveys: An Extended TPB Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on TPB model, the paper proposes an extended model to explain the intentions of potential respondents' to participate in Web-based surveys. The chief objective of this paper is to obtain a more comprehensible picture of how intentions are formed. We empirically tested the research model with a sample 131 participants. Hierarchical regression and structural equation modeling were used and the results indicate that attitude of potential respondents, social norm, perceived behavioral control and PWI are determinants of unit nonresponse in Web-based surveys. The results testify the usefulness of TPB model to explain the intention of potential respondents to take part in Web-based surveys and on the other hand, the results also verify the importance role of the PWI in web-based survey.

articleTitle: A Joint Pricing and Capacity Allocation Model for BTO Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Traditional revenue management is equated with capacity control and assumes demand and selling price are exogenous. A joint pricing and capacity allocation model is formulated based on the characteristics for BTO manufacturing. Then, due to the demand uncertainty, a chance constrained programming method is proposed to transform the model. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and the application value of the revenue management model for BTO manufacturing are illustrated by numerical examples.

articleTitle: An Efficient Algorithm for Reduction of Attribute in Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An efficient algorithm for reduction of attribute in information systems is put forward, whose time complexity is max{O((|C|+|D|) |U|),O(|C|<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>|U|))}. Compared with those existing heuristic algorithms, its flexibility has been increased because calculating the important value of unimportant attribute repeatedly can be avoided by removing unimportant attributes gradually from the search space. The theoretical analysis and experimental results show that this algorithm is much less time complexity than those existed algorithms; and a real example demonstrates its feasibility and effectiveness, respectively.

articleTitle: A New Way Based on Relative Forward Delay to Improve TCP Performance Over Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To improve the performance of TCP over heterogeneous (wired and wireless) networks, this paper proposes a novel end-to-end congestion control mechanism called: TCP- BCRFD (TCP-Based on Computing Relative Forward Delay). It monitors the forward network congestion condition and uses it to determine the reasons of packets loss. Specially: The receiver computes the relative delay on the forward links, analyzes them with two statistical methods (PCT and PDT), determines the forward network congestion condition and tells the condition to the sender. Then the sender determines whether packet losses are due to congestion or link errors and takes appropriate congestion control. The experimental results show the throughput performance of TCP-BCRFD is better than TCP-Reno and other improved protocols of the same kind.

articleTitle: Research on Intellectual Property Right (IPR) Protection Tactics in Inter-Enterprise Cooperative Innovation: Perspective of Knowledge Transfer
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Knowledge transfer in cooperative innovation between enterprises has the possibility of infringing intellectual property right (IPR). The paper analyzes the tactics choice of IPR management organizations and enterprises using the evolutionary game theory, and explains the tactics choice of IPR owner and its partner through simplified game tree analysis. Strengthening IPR management in cooperative innovation needs propaganda, legislation, organization, and other behaviors of government's IPR management organizations on one hand, on the other hand, IPR owner should protect IPR through perfect cooperative contracts, improving prospective cooperation earnings, enhancing cooperation process control and other measures.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Coordination with Market Scale and Price Sensitivity Coefficient Disruptions under Nonlinear Demand Function
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper studies the coordination problem of a supply chain with one supplier and one retailer under demand disruption. When the market scale and price-sensitive coefficient are disrupted in the planning horizon, where price-demand relationship is nonlinear, the optimal emergency strategies about adjusting price and production quantity is proposed under the centralized model. For the decentralized model, it is proved that the supply chain can be fully coordinated by adjusting the revenue sharing contract when disruption occurs. Finally, a numerical analysis is given to illustrate the analysis approach.

articleTitle: Social Factors Affecting Users' Intrinsic Motivation to Explore Enterprise Systems' Features and Applications: An Exploratory Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To reap the purported benefits of enterprise systems (ES), adopting firms are required to integrate ES with their core business processes and create firm-specific tacit knowledge. It is well established that the generation of innovative ideas of technology applications relies on users, rather than the management or IT people. Therefore, research on how to encourage users to explore ES features and applications is of great significance. However, prior IS research has focused on users' passive acceptance of ES, rather than proactive exploration of these systems. As such, there is a lack of studies on salient factors that affect users' motivation to explore ES. The research-in-progress study reported in this paper aims to address this shortfall. Drawing upon theories in motivation, information systems, leader-member exchange and leadership, we derive our research model. In particular, we submit that the quality of a user's relationship with his/her immediate supervisor, effective interactions with IT staff, perceived human relation orientation of organizational climate and top management's leadership positively affect users' motivation to explore ES technology features and innovative applications. We will collect data with enterprise system users to test our research hypotheses. Potential theoretical contributions and managerial implications of this study are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on SUMO-Based Emergency Response Management Team Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The standardization of the structure for the emergency response management team (ERMT) is the foundation of efficiently handling all kinds of emergency. Basing on the work of other researchers, this paper used methodologies of ontology and UML to construct an ontology-based model for ERMT. It focused on the characteristics of ERMT. This ontology-based model facilitates the shared understanding for people from different domains. It maps the corresponding relationship between the positions in ERMT and the roles in government, in this way, strengthening the ability to manage and respond efficiently to the crisis. This paper is based on the actual requirements of enhancing emergency management, which is becoming more and more important after '911'. So it is very useful and has a wide application in practice. The model can be used to rapidly bring together various resources into rational ERMT according to types of unexpected events.

articleTitle: A Head Scheduling Scheme for Heterogeneous Clustered Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Organizing wireless sensor networks into clusters enables the efficient utilization of the limited energy resources of the deployed sensor nodes. If the network is organized into heterogeneous clusters, where some more powerful nodes take on the cluster head role to control network operation, it is important to ensure that energy dissipation of these cluster heads and "critical sensor nodes" is balanced. We propose a Cluster Head Scheduling scheme to determine which cluster head should be turned off or on. The proposed mechanism is based on the coverage information as well as residual battery power, which can lead to more uniform energy dissipation among cluster head nodes and critical sensor nodes, thus increasing network lifetime. Moreover, the proposed scheme strengthens the robustness of heterogeneous sensor networks<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">.</sup>

articleTitle: A Method of Performance Evaluation Index System for Enterprises' Technological Innovation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at the problems existing in the current performance evaluation system of enterprises' technological innovation, this paper combined the characteristics of technological innovation and the innovation practice in China's enterprises, innovatively developed the Balanced Scorecards and the new field of their applications, proposed the Enhanced Balanced Scorecards - Technological Innovation (EBSC-TI) regarding society environment and future development, and fully established the performance measurement indexes system for evaluating technological innovation performance synthetically from five aspects such as finance, customer, flow, development and society. It will provide enterprises with scientific theory direction and exercisable manual to know their own technological innovation conditions.

articleTitle: How to Facilitate Knowledge Diffusion through Different Innovation Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we first propose a computational model. Then on the basis of two virtual innovation networks constructed, we investigate how diverse connecting mechanisms between network A and B differentially influence the co- evolution of the knowledge levels of both networks. The simulation results indicate that knowledge diffusion through different innovation networks seems to be affected significantly by two factors, namely, the existence of collaboration among networks and the characteristics of the agents who build the knowledge connections across these networks.

articleTitle: Novel Algorithm for Frequency Estimation of CW Interference in DSSS Systems
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a new technique for frequency estimation of continuous wave (CW) interference, and hence, IIR notch filter is constructed to excise interference in direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) systems. The new estimator (Fourier interpolation estimator: FIE) only involves three Fourier components. Both analysis results and numerical simulation results show that the FIE outperforms the adaptive line enhancer (ALE) by comparison, especially in computational simplicity. The IIR notch filter constructed by FIE has better Signal-to-Noise ratio (SNR) improvement than both linear and nonlinear prediction filters.

articleTitle: O³-Based Linear Decorrelating Detector for Asynchronous UWB Systems Over Multipath Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a convenient signaling scheme, termed orthogonal on-off ultra-wideband (O<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>UWB), along with a simple one-shot linear decorrelating detector (LDD) and a Rake bank, is proposed. This scheme is useful for doing multi-user detection because temporally adjacent bits in receiver signals from different users are decoupled using on- off signaling. This mechanism also leads to one-shot detection that overcomes the main disadvantage, long detection delay, of the conventional LDD. Since multipath fading still significantly degrades UWB system performance, the Rake bank is included to recover multipath diversity gain. Numerical analysis and simulation results show that the O<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>UWB LDD-Rake receiver scheme indeed offers good near-far resistance and provides diversity gain in multipath fading UWB channels.

articleTitle: On the Evaluation of Traffic Scheduling and QoS for Wireless Multimedia Applications
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We evaluate traffic scheduling and QoS via a simulation model for wireless multimedia applications. This model utilizes a scheduling mechanism for performance assessment for different users carrying different applications. The scheduling mechanism is verified via simulations with a variety traffic characteristics and performance metrics. A toolbox for the model has been developed in MATLAB environment, where a traffic scheduler is implemented. The purpose of developing this model is to ease and generalise the concept of multimedia traffic scheduling so that it can be extended to simulate real applications, where a new set of QoS parameters may be defined.

articleTitle: A Cost-Revenue Knowledge Transaction Decision Model Based on Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As necessary participators in knowledge sharing within and across organizations, individual knowledge providers and recipients all contribute to the performance of knowledge transaction. However, few literatures have focused on knowledge sharing from the views of them. This paper argues that the enthusiasm of potential knowledge providers play an indispensable role in a successful knowledge sharing, and some incentive policies should be used to stimulate the enthusiasm of the knowledge providers. Based on the premise that the knowledge providers are absolutely rational, we analyze the costs they have to suffer and the revenues they receive in knowledge transaction. Then, taking the concept of risk into consideration, we establish a cost-revenue knowledge transaction decision model. With the help of this model, we analyze the provider's decision process in knowledge transaction. According to our finding, we make several suggestions about how to promote the enthusiasm of the potential knowledge providers in knowledge sharing.

articleTitle: A Multi-Nodes Set Transfer Strategy for Reducing Transmission Unreliability in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Recent empirical and theoretical studies have shown that the reliability is one of the inherent properties of low- power wireless links. In this paper, we propose a novel strategy using multi-nodes to realize reliable transmission. Meanwhile, it also can improve the energy efficiency and throughput of networks comparing multi-paths method. We analyze the performance of the strategy theoretically and experimentally. The result shows that it is a good balance between the reliability and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Response Analysis of RC Frame Structures Based on Viscoelastic Stochastic FEM
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the viscoelastic stochastic FEM, built with FEM in space and scatter method in time, this paper proposed the plane finite element model of response analysis of concrete frame structures, in which a linear three parameter viscoelastic model was adopted. The program of finite element was developed and used in analyzing the response of concrete frame structures and the creep law of concrete. The numerical results indicate that this method has high precision and efficiency, and adapt to operation of engineering.

articleTitle: Study of a Novel Key Feature in Non-Cooperative Modulation Automatic Recognition
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: For both analogue and digital modulation types, we proposed a general signal expression and studied the non-cooperative automatic recognition synthetically, which is more useful and universal than separate research. The proposal of a new key feature, i.e. the variance of normalized instantaneous amplitude, with the benefit of less computationally demanding and excellent correct classification rate in low SNR, can be used to discriminate between the signals that have amplitude information and that have no amplitude information. We concluded a set of the parameter's whole and accurate theoretical expressions for several signals, especially for the amplitude modulated signals with different modulation depths and audio modulated single side band signals. Illustrative simulation examples were provided at last.

articleTitle: Complex Networks Model for Residential Real Estate Markets
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To meet the challenges of the complexity of residential real estate markets and a dearth of large databases, we built a theoretical super-complex networks model, focusing on the statistical mechanics of network topology and dynamics. Nodes correspond to agents in the market (banks, house producers and house buyers). The directed edge represents the positive cash flow caused by any transaction between two agents. Power-law distributions consistent with Zipf's law characterize firm size and individual wealth. The probability function of a firm's death is given by a Pareto distribution. New links emerge by nodes reconnecting according to a preferential rule. We also simulated an evolving network in the Shanghai residential market during 2001-2005.

articleTitle: Board of Director Composition and Audit Opinions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper empirically examines the relation between board of director composition and audit opinions using paired t- test, Wilcoxon matched-pair sign-rank test, and conditional logistic regression model. Based on a cross-sectional sample of 94 listed Chinese firms, the results indicate that there are no significant differences in proportion of independent directors and existence of audit committee between 47 firms with modified opinions and 47 firms with clean opinions. This results may imply that the role of independent directors and audit committee on monitoring the financial reporting process is not effective in listed Chinese firms. In addition, the results also indicate that firms with good performance are less likely to receive modified opinions than firms with bad performance.

articleTitle: Using Fuzzy System to Establish Regional Economy Input-Output Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The relation of input factors and output in regional economy is complicated, this paper introduces the fuzzy system into the economic field, using the Sugeon fuzzy model to construct the mapping relation between production factors and economic output. Taking China as an example, firstly, selects capital asserts and human capital as economic input factors, GDP as economic output, and then establishes the system structure, finally determines the final parameters by BP algorithm. The case study shows that the fuzzy model has better performance than regression, and the fuzzy if-then rules can give valuable economic decision-making macroscopically.

articleTitle: The Comparison Investigation on Low-Frequency Measures of Liquidity
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This study examines 8 liquidity measures estimated from low-frequency data, taking high-frequency price impact as benchmark and making use of the tick data and daily data of the component stock of SH180 from CCER. The result shows that: among these low-frequency liquidity measures, the correlation of Hui-Heubel liquidity ratio with the benchmark is the best, and that of Martin index and the effective liquidate speed follow. This result also tell us that, in order to reflecting price variation, the information of highest and lowest price dominates that of open and close price; reflecting trade size, the information of turnover-rate in shares or in money dominates that of trading volume, when we design low-frequency liquidity measures. All coefficients of correlation are not high enough, especially linear coefficients of correlation. This shows that the low-frequency measures can be improved in a large extent.

articleTitle: Study on the Sustainability Mechanism of Self-Organized Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Supply chain plays a key role for the success of an enterprise in gaining competitive edge, markets demanding agility and quick market responsiveness, which represent complex phenomena in global competition. To discover the behavior and mechanism of organization, nowadays, more and more people have paid attention to the complexity theory such as self-organization, dissipative structure theory, synergetic theory, etc. The paper introduces the concept of self-organization theories and supply chain firstly. Then enlightened by the systematical methodology, the paper puts forward the concept of sustainability of organization on the basis of analyzing the characteristics of self-organized supply chain. A thorough analysis of the mechanism of supply chain sustainability has been made accordingly. Finally, the paper adopts the supply chain system of TCL Group as an example, indicating that the success of TCL Group is mostly due to its effective and efficient self-organized supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on Efficiency of Chinese Software Exports Based on Data Envelopment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Six software export cities such as Beijing, Shanghai, etc. have been chosen by Chinese government as software export bases since 2004 in order to accelerate software industry internationalization. However, the efficiency of the software cities has not yet been paid enough attention. This paper firstly overviews the history of Chinese software industry. Then it analyzes the correlation between software exports and the revenues of software industry. Thirdly, this paper estimates the efficiency of the main software export cities based on data envelopment analysis. Lastly, it gives some suggestions for improving efficiency of software export cities for local governments.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Dual-Channel Mechanism for Online Selling
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Many firms can sell identical products online using auctions and posted prices simultaneously. This paper develops a model of the key trade-offs sellers face in such a dual-channel setting, built about the optimal choice of the auction quantity, the auction duration, and the posted price. Our discussion is under the finite inventory of the seller. We model consumer choice of channels through a threshold type function based on the consumer's power exponential utility function, prove a unique auction-participation symmetric equilibrium exists, and demonstrate its properties. The model enables the seller to segment the market appropriately so that the two channels reinforce each other and cannibalization is mitigated.

articleTitle: Optimization of the ISC Bi-Level Distribution Network with Multi Psychology Accounts
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The researches on supply chain are mainly about the conjunction mechanism and efficiency in Integrated supply chain to enhance its competitiveness and the cooperation between its members. But most of those belong to the standard finance field, and few about the factors of human psychology. We studied the satisfaction degree models of customer with mental account based on the customer satisfaction degree (CSD) model and found they are simplified, not reasonable and inaccurate. This paper presents a CSD model based on artificial psychology, which quantify exact customer psychology using cognition and artificial psychology methods, and describes an optimization model of the ISC bi-level distribution network based on artificial psychology.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Scheduling a No-Wait Robotic Production System with Multi-Type Parts
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: An exact algorithm is proposed to solve a scheduling problem of a robotic production system in which multi-type parts are processed and parts are not allowed to wait on the machines. Finding an optimal schedule in such a production system is equivalent to finding two types of correlative sequences: parts input sequence and robot moves sequence. We show that the entering times of parts are the decision variables of the problem. We formulate our problem using the notion of prohibited intervals and solve it by enumerating intervals for linear functions of the decision variables, which is accomplished with a branch and bound procedure. Computational results on randomly generated test instances indicate that the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Parallel Sending Algorithm of Short Message Service
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The real-time sending of a batch of short messages service(SMS) is a typical application in value added service of mobile. In order to improve the sending efficiency and real-time performance of SMS, a short message real-time parallel sending algorithm based on thread is proposed in the paper. The algorithm builds on the data structure of data buffer and circular pointer technology, there are two methods is designed: getString and setString, they prevent the sharing data conflict, this algorithm is used in "family- school e-connection system " which is a value added service of mobile application. It ensures the short messages will be sent real-time and improves the efficiency of sending short messages.

articleTitle: Competition and the Reform of Incentive Schemes in the Regulated Electricity Sector
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Through applying performance based yardstick competition, regulator can obtain signals that have correlation with the transmission and distribution Enterprises' cost style. Using these signals, regulator is able to improve the scheme of incentive regulation. In order to analyze the effect of the improved regulation scheme on incentive level, a model is built. We consider the regulation problem with complete contracting in a principal-agent model with adverse selection and review within this model the channel by which external competition parameters affect incentives within the regulated enterprise. The conclusion of the model shows that effect of improved scheme isn't always positive. If the correlation between signal and cost style is strong enough, the new scheme of regulation can increase the lever of incentive to enterprises; if not, may decrease. An intuitionistic example confirms this conclusion. So, when regulator wants to use signals to reform the scheme of regulation, she must ensure the strong correlation between signal and cost style rather than cause negative incentive.

articleTitle: The Collection and Processing Platform of the People's Opinion Based on SMS and Internet
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The short message service(SMS) of mobile and Internet provided two convenient approaches for information transmission. This paper proposes a people's opinion collection and processing system(POCP) architecture integrated with SMS and Internet to support the information collection from different channel and centralized processing. The architecture includes an information processing center and four information collection channels , i.e. ,short message, telephone , email and website. The main objective of the system is provide a convenient information platform people can submit their advice or opinion to the government, the government can collect, process and feedback these information in time. As a widely used value added service of mobile, the dataflow and process of SMS based on CMPP is described in detail. This platform is a information bridge connect people and government.

articleTitle: Performance of a Multi-Access Interference Cancellation Algorithm for FDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposed a novel training pattern design algorithm for canceling multi-access interference (MAI) in the orthogonal frequency division multi-access (OFDM) system. This proposed algorithm firstly analyzed the MAI induce performance distortion in the carrier frequency offset (CFO) estimation using signal to interference ratio (SIR), then present a novel training sequence design algorithm to improve the SIR and CFO estimation performance. The numeric results show that the performance of CFO estimation for multi user or multi-access in the frequency selective fading channel based on OFDM uplink may decrease the inter-carrier interference ICI as well as single user case.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Marketing Effect and Revelation of the Price Catabolization of Premium Brand Product
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Traffic Accident Rescue Process Using GSPN
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Emergency management is one important issue recently. How to model the emergency management process, to identify weaknesses in response capability, and to optimize the rescue teams is one of the most important issues in real- world. We use GSPN (generalized stochastic Petri net) to model the traffic accident rescue process, analyze its structure, and obtain some important measures performances of the process.

articleTitle: A Satisfactory Coordination Solution of Multiple-Person Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the imputation set, a satisfactory coordination solution of multiple-person cooperative game, a new solution concept of multiple-person cooperative game, is proposed. The existence of the satisfactory coordination solution is proved and the sufficient and necessary condition to decide satisfactory coordination solution is been studied. Calculating method is introduced directly by using mathematical programming method and its validity is illustrated via a numerical example. A new way is provided while solving cooperative game problems by using the concept of satisfactory coordination solution and its solution method.

articleTitle: An Improved LSCM Algorithm for Blind Multiuser Detection in AWGN CDMA Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this letter, we combine the LSCMA(least square constant modulus algorithm) with the subspace approach and present a LSCM_SUB blind adaptive multiuser detection in AWGN CDMA channels. The poor performance of LSCMA in the low SNR will be improved by the LSCM_SUB algorithm. The performance of the proposed LSCM_SUB algorithm is compared with that of LSCMA. Simulation results show that the LSCM_SUB algorithm is superior to the LSCMA especially in the low SNR.

articleTitle: New Analysis of BAN-Yahalom Protocol by Strand Spaces and its Improvement
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: There're some security flaws in the improvement of Yahalom protocol by BAN. This paper makes a detailed analysis on such flaws from a new angle induced by strand spaces. First, the algebraic model of BAN-Yahalom protocol is established with the help of strand spaces. Subsequently, attackers' abilities are defined in an accurate math form. And then new improvement to this protocol is proposed in order to enhance the defensive ability of this protocol against potential attackers, which will make it more adaptable to practical environment. Future application of the improved protocol is also envisioned.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Association Rules Mining Using the Grouping Unrelated-Question Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Privacy preserving data mining algorithms have been intensively investigated since 2000. But almost all these approaches don't consider different privacy attitudes of different people. Some people are willing to provide their privacy data to investigators under almost any condition. Thus the privacy- preserving algorithm grouping informants will lead to higher accuracy of results. The Warner model, an important algorithm on collecting privacy data, limits the probability of randomized response and two questions in the model are closely related, which decreases informants' cooperation. Hence we propose the grouping unrelated-question model (GUQM) for the first time to solve the limits of the Warner model and to collect privacy data of people with different attitudes about privacy. Furthermore, we combine association rules mining with GUQM to solve the high time complexity in association rules mining. The paper analyzes the algorithm's validity, privacy protection and time complexity in theory. The experimental results show the effect of every parameter in our algorithm on the results of mining association rules.

articleTitle: Study on The Fuzzy Decision-Making Model Based on Rough Sets of M&A
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Due to the shortage of non-renewable resources, the resource-typed enterprises have become the targets of M&A of global capital. According to the characteristics of resource-typed enterprises and the selection decision-making system of the M&A's targets, this paper establishes an index system that can be utilized to evaluate the M&A's targets comprehensively and scientifically. Moreover, by using the basic theory of rough sets and gray system, this paper conducts a quantitative decision-making, presents a decision-making model to choose the optimum alternative for M&A's targets, and realizes the multi-object decision-making in M&A of the resource-typed enterprises.

articleTitle: Effective File Sharing Mechanism with Network Coding in Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper considers a file sharing system in a wireless Mesh network. To deal with, we apply opportunistic random linear network coding to develop an efficient file sharing mechanism. Within this mechanism, every node transmits random linear combination of its packets according to its priority which is computed in a distributed manner according to its possible contribution to other nodes. We show through extensive simulation that with our mechanism, the nodes can share the entire file, in the network, with minimum transmissions times and delay comparing to the current transmission process in wireless mesh network without random linear network.

articleTitle: Adaptive Resource Allocation with Adaptive Beamforming for MIMO-OFDMA System with a Priority User
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new resource allocation scheme for MIMO-OFDMA systems with a priority user. With the goal of minimizing the total transmission power and exploiting spatial diversity and multiuser diversity efficiently, the proposed algorithm firstly allocates the subcarrier to the priority user, and it selects the N relatively largest eigenvalues of all subcarriers and allocates the best subcarrier to the priority user adaptively until its data rate is fulfilled. Then the remaining subcarriers are dynamically allocated to the other users without considering their QoS requirements. Finally, the proposed algorithm reallocates some subcarriers from the satisfied users to the unsatisfied users to guarantee all users' QoS requirements and the additional power because of the subcarriers reallocation is also minimized. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: The Diversity and Adaptability of Contents and Approaches in Knowledge Transfer: Considering Whole IS Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the basis of previous researches on knowledge transfer, and according to information systems (IS) life cycle theory and feasible knowledge transfer approaches, this paper constructs a three-dimensional framework of knowledge transfer in whole IS life cycle. This framework is to explore the diversity of knowledge contents which need to be transferred and knowledge transfer approaches. The researches indicate that there existed adaptability problem of contents and approaches during knowledge transfer in the process of IS construction and application. This framework can be used to analyze knowledge transfer between IS users and external service organizations for external IS adopting mode, to guide the match of contents and approaches in knowledge transfer. This paper also gives a practical case to illustrate the application process of the framework.

articleTitle: Factors Contributing to Software Quality Practices - An Australian Case Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The literature on software quality research has shown a lack of empirical insight into the use of methods for achieving quality in a real context. We wanted to explore the key factors which impact software quality practices in a case study, by studying the perspectives of three key stakeholders - developers, managers and customers. The selected exemplary case is a small Australian based software company. A qualitative approach was adopted to conduct this exploratory study. Results were analyzed using the grounded theory approach to develop an initial framework. This framework provides a deeper understanding of the reasons and perceptions for the use of quality methods in practice.

articleTitle: A New Direct Decimation Algorithm for Digital Down-Conversion of GPS Satellite Signal
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to simplify satellite navigation receiver architecture, a down conversion method based on digital signal decimation is proposed. By using separating and accumulating method, direct down-conversion of a digitized carrier signal with relative high frequency is realized. This method has virtues of simpler structure, high speed and less calculation. Also it can well preserve navigation message and Doppler information, whereas it may degrade the S/N of signal and sensitivity of receiver. Analysis and simulation results show that it has no effect on positioning precision of receiver.

articleTitle: Research on Core Staff Evaluation Based on Niche
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper consults the theory and technology of niche evaluation of ecology, introduces the concept of human resource niche, establishes the indexes and model for human resource niche evaluation for core staff of the organization, and at last the application test of the model is made for core staff of Chinese enterprises .

articleTitle: Policy Based QoS Management Architecture in IEEE 802.11e Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: To support applications with quality of service (QoS) requirements, such as video, audio, voice over IP and other multimedia applications in wireless networks, the IEEE 802.lie protocol is designed to provide differentiated priority QoS in wireless networks. In order to integrate with wide area networks effective, policy based QoS management architecture in 802.11e networks, which could realize uniform QoS in whole network, worth researches. This paper presents an efficient policy based QoS management scheme, called Policy-based WLAN QoS Management, and related proportional delay differentiated algorithm, referred as Arbitrary Channel Reservation, for 802.lie networks. In the new scheme, a hybrid type of architecture, combining the outsourcing and provisioning models, is used, most closely meets the requirements of 802.lie networks.

articleTitle: Aviation Remaining Seats Marketing Decision Support System Based on Revenue Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper gives a definition about the remaining seats and constructs the framework of a revenue management and designs a revenue management decision support system for aviation remaining seats. Because of the characteristics of remaining seats, the paper considers the factors of marketing environment and combines the idea of marketing management with principles of revenue management. At last, an aviation remaining seats marketing decision support system is designed.

articleTitle: Application of Grid Technology in eBusiness
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Grids can span locations, machine architectures, and software applications to provide unlimited power, seamless collaboration, and wider information access. With the changing demands of the markets and the developments of the technology itself, grid computing is beginning to spill out over the boundaries of individual organizations. These partner grids create a collaboration environment to share computing resources, data and applications. OPGSA is a grid-based implementation of ebusiness solutions built upon commercial enterprise grid systems, and it makes use of Globus Toolkits 4 and DRAMA open standards. With this architecture, it is possible for the firms participating in a corporate supply chain to incorporate greater management capabilities and gain greater control over complex business processes.

articleTitle: The Effect and Strategy of Premium Brand Color TV Price Reduction to Its Profitability
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We find that using when premium brands using price strategy to compete with others, the effect is negative to the profitability of premium brands from the long run, as it reduces the profitability and premium ability of the brands that firms have built for a long time (Qiu et al. 2006). Then, how if the middle-level priced premium brand products reduce their prices and what will be the effect to the brand in the long run? We use color TV as an example and using the empirical research by interviewing customers and investigate the middle-level priced premium brand TVs price reduction effect on its profitability. Our results show that, the price reduction of middle-priced premium brand TVs, the effect is double-sided and the determinants of the direction of the effect is the price level in the group.

articleTitle: An Agent-Based Model of Traders' Interaction
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to investigate what induce the stylized facts in financial markets, we built an agent-based financial market model in which agents interacted with their nearest neighbors and can adjust their propensity to be influenced by their neighbors according to trading histories. Agents' actions are determined by their independent judgments, public news and neighbors' influence. Simulation results show that the model can reproduce the stylized facts of fat tail and volatility clustering.

articleTitle: Joint Rate-Adaptive and Backoff Waiting Admission Control for Differentiated Services in CDMA Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Call admission control should support different types of traffic with different quality of services (QoS) attributes in next generation wireless network. In the paper, we propose a novel call admission control working in conjunction with rate adaptation and backoff waiting schemes to improve the system performance. The transmission rates for multimedia calls can be adjusted to accommodate more calls while satisfying the minimum signal-to-interference ration(SIR) and transmission rate requirement. Also, binary exponential backoff algorithm for backoff waiting is introduced for rejected call to increase access opportunity, which only admits new calls for deferring in the system. Simulation results have demonstrated that the proposed adaptive CAC scheme achieves better performance when applied to realistic traffic conditions found in wireless multimedia networks.

articleTitle: A Distributed Bandwidth Reservation Protocol for QoS Routing in Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper proposes a distributed bandwidth reservation protocol (DBRP) for QoS routing in ad hoc networks. The protocol adopts a TDMA-based model, derives from AODV, refers to the idea of three slot states (I.Jawhar et al., 2004), and adopts two-time reservation and controlling-flooding scheme.
