The protocol takes both the hidden-terminal and exposed-terminal problems into account. And it can solve the simultaneous reservation of several paths. In addition, controlling-flooding method can effectively control routing overhead, and two-time reservation can improve request success rate. Simulation results show the new protocol has better performance in denser networks and heavier traffic conditions.

articleTitle: Tacit Knowledge Explicitation in Knowledge Management and Technologic Innovation Performance: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on sample data of some chinese enterprises in knowledge-intensive industry, we use structure equation modeling (SEM) to analyze how the information resource, system structure, situational system factors affect the tacit knowledge explicitation and subsequently enterprise's technologic innovation performance. We find: information resource, system structure, situational system factors have significantly positive impact on tacit knowledge explicitation; System structure factor has indirect impact on technologic innovation performance working through tacit knowledge explicitation, and information resource factor is distinctly correlated to situational system factor, presenting significant synergistic effect between them; Information resource factor, situational system factor, tacit knowledge explicitation have significantly positive impact on technologic innovation performance. Finally, we present research conclusion and limitation, moreover put forwards some proposals to promote tacit knowledge explicitation so as to improving technologic innovation performance of enterprise.

articleTitle: Study on the High-Tech Sale through Auctions
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper deals with the security voting structure in an auction mechanism used to sell an item of high-tech. The design of security voting structure allows the seller to choose between two objectives that are not mutually consistent. The security voting structure design trades off between sell all the shares and retain some shares to benefit from the future dividends generated by the winner. However, if the seller wants to maximize his revenue, he should retain some shares to benefit from the future dividends generated by the acquirer. On the other hand, if he wants to sell his high-tech to the most efficient candidate, he should sell all the shares.

articleTitle: The Architecture of Multiagent-Based Agile Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Agile supply chain comes into being with the development of supply chain and agile manufacturing. It is an effective method to use multiagent technology to support agile supply chain management. Based on the analysis on the characteristic of agile supply chain and multiagent technology, and to achieve the goal of quick response and dynamic reconstruction, this paper presents the architecture of multiagent-based agile supply chain, and analyzes the construction and the operation mechanism of enterprise agents and coordination agent in detail. Furthermore, taking CORBA (Common Object Request Broker Architecture) as the distributed standard, this paper discusses the design and the development of agile supply chain system.

articleTitle: Investigating Housing Reform In Shanghai: A System Dynamics Approach
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The housing affordability issue has aroused exceedingly heated discussion in Shanghai Since the late 1990s. The boom of the market, however, attracts frantic speculation that generates some serious problems, especially the severe inflation of house price. There are great concerns that commercial housing price is too high and beyond the affordability of the average urban households. This paper investigates the dynamic factors that could drive up the house price emerging house market. A system dynamics based model is developed to capture the underlying dynamic interactions among the different sectors involved in the real estate market. We study how they all together induce and exaggerate the affordability problem for local households. The model is used to test some policies, either currently applied or suggested by experts or existing literature, aiming to curb speculation fever, reduce house oversupply, dwarf cost inflation, and to solve the problem of affordability for local households.

articleTitle: An Analytical Comparison of Calling-Party-Paying Vs. Both-Party-Paying Methods in Mobile Communications
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The comparison of both-party-paying method vs. calling-party-pay in mobile communication has raised widespread concern in many countries. This paper performs an analytical comparison between the two charging methods and concludes that the both-party-paying method is superior to calling-party-pay arrangements for both consumers and mobile operators.

articleTitle: Adaptive Generation of Caching in Cellular Mobile Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: One of the important issues in the design of a mobile computing system is how to manage the real-time locations of mobile clients. In the existing commercial cellular mobile computing systems, a two-tier architecture is used. However, the two-tier architecture is not scalable and is not suitable to support the novel new mobile computing applications. Recently, a hierarchical database structure is proposed. The location databases of different cells are organized into a tree structure to facilitate the search of mobile clients. Although this architecture can distribute the update and searching workload among the location databases, it has the problem of heavy location update overhead and long search delay. This paper studies how to generate location caching for systems using tree-structured databases. An adaptive location caching generation method is proposed to calculate the optimal caching nodes to minimize the total location management cost. Simulation experiments have been conducted to justify that our proposed caching strategy can significantly reduce the location management cost.

articleTitle: Signal Code Modulation in MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Signal code modulation (SCM) is a mixed analogue-digital modulation technique proposed for relaying a digital communication signal over channels with different signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) and, in particular, provides an alternative method besides the conventional complete demodulation and remodulation (Demod/Remod). In this paper, we exploit SCM in MIMO systems and investigate the performance as well. Simulation results are presented to verify the performance analysis. Furthermore, the diversity gain for the analog signal is defined.

articleTitle: A Novel Cross-Layer Flow Control Scheme In Ad Hoc Network And its Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to improve performance of transport protocols in ad hoc network, a novel cross-layer flow control scheme is designed. This flow control technique integrates routing feedback of network layer, transport protocol and rate adaptive adjustment of application. By exchanging cross-layer information, applications can adjust its sending rate according to routing information fed back by network layer, and thus keeping network load at reasonable level to maximize network throughput. This cross-layer flow control scheme can be used for both UDP and TCP. This scheme is evaluated by using computer simulation and simulation results show that it can improve performance of UPD and TCP-based services, especially in case of low network load.

articleTitle: Application of PIP in the Construction Projects for Beijing Olympic Games
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information technology has played a more and more important role in Chinese construction industry, especially after the emergence of Project Information Portal (PIP) , which provides a Web-based project document management, communication and collaboration working environment for the participants. Taking PIP developed for the Construction Projects of Beijing 2008 Olympic Games as a case, this paper introduces its background, objectives, functions and developing process, in an attempt to provide reference for the use of PIP in large projects.

articleTitle: MYBUF: A High Performance Buffer Management Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a two-layer buffer management mechanism MYBUF, it is based on memory protected mode, has configurability, support static and dynamic allocation and backup operations, this mechanism which has high performance, simple and reliable characteristic meet the management requirement of embedded system. By using this MYBUF buffer management mechanism, data zero copy technology has been realized while transmit data through the embedded TCP/IP stack. Besides, the key data structure is only 10.8% of the size of traditional sk_buff which is used in Linux TCP/IP protocol stack The management mechanism has been successfully applied to the bidirectional system platform for HDTV (high definition television), which has DOCSIS(data-over-cable service interface specifications) MAC layer chip developed in our lab, and meets the demands of set top box and other embedded system network communications. The tests in real network conditions show that the system provides a good performance and reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Reverse Logistics System Base on Circular Economy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The theory of "circular economy" was put forward in 1990s. According to it, the production model based on consuming resources and people criticized polluting environment. The huge number of waster has brought serious pressure to the environment. Reverse logistics is a good way to carry out the idea of circular economy.Firstly, the concept of "circular economy" and "reverse logistics" and the relation of them are introduced. Then, drive factors of reverse logistic are explained. Generally, any node of supply chain will probably become the supplier of reverse logistics system. The entering cause is different by different supplier, which is lead to the complication of reverse logistics system. Finally, in order to establish and perfect the economy system fitting our country, a two-stage model was put forward to select the facility location and the conducting workflow was designed for returned products.

articleTitle: A Sustainable Growth Model with the Utilization of Renewable-Energy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The relations among economic growth, energy exhaustion and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions have become the major research topics. This paper proposed a solution of this triangle dilemma: developing renewable-energy and optimally investing in this new industry. With the conviction that the price of fossil products continues to maintain at the high level, a dynamically model of economic growth involves the fossil energy and the substitution of renewable-energy is developed. The impacts of the substitution on other elements in the economic system are investigated. Finally, assuming an anticipant substitution route is given, we obtain an optimal systemic project of investment in renewable energy industry based on the theory of cybernetics.

articleTitle: Efficient Cluster Flight Management Extends Airport Revenue Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper rationalized that an efficient air control management of cluster flights would attract new opportunities to extend its traditional revenue with new age technologies such as mobile corporate electronic business. The contention remained that its core business as a transport hub was still the key driver for supporting services. Maintaining air traffic control efficiency in crowded time band demonstrated confidence for more carriers to add the airport on their route. To this effect, a well managed crowded sky is the main factor to extend an airport's revenue.

articleTitle: Reverse Logistics Operation Management Based on Virtual Enterprises and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on analyzing the difficulties of reverse logistics operation management, considering the new environment as the economic society developing continuously and discussing the feasibility of virtual enterprise, an operation management mode for reverse logistics based on virtual enterprise is presented in this paper. Evaluation of virtual enterprises for reverse logistics operation is based on the firms' multi-criteria which are qualitative or quantitative. By using fuzzy AHP technique, the hierarchical and the multi-criteria decision making problems for virtual enterprise are considered and the optimized selection is presented.

articleTitle: Iterative Feedback Multipath Interference Cancellation Noise Variance Estimator Using Dedicated Pilot Sequence
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a new method of iterative feedback multipath interference cancellation is applied to estimate the background noise variance in TD-SCDMA receiver during the period of dedicated downlink pilot time slot (DwPTS). Applying this method, the background noise variance could be estimated fast and accurately in all the three testing channels recommended by 3GPP.

IEEE Keywords: Time division synchronous code division multiple access

articleTitle: Time-Frequency Well-Localized Pulse Shaping Filter Design for High Speed Data and Multi-Carrier System Based on DPSS
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The discrete prolate spheroidal sequences (DPSS) are used to design time-frequency well-localized pulse shaping filters for OFDM/OQAM systems. Compared with the rectangular filters of the OFDM multi-carrier systems, the filter we design can efficiently provide protection against frequency dispersion caused by Doppler spread. The optimized pulse shaping filters maximize the signal energy around the carrier frequencies, resulting in minimal spectral overlap between the adjacent sub-channels.

articleTitle: A Handoff Avoidance Scheduling for Elastic Data in Cellular Transmission
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Although the conventional way, which means shrinking the cover of each cell and increasing the density of base stations for sharing radio resources among more cells, can be adopted to relieve the urgent requirements for more capacity and adapt to the vulnerable propagation character of higher spectrum, frequent handoffs from cell to cell are becoming a great burden for wireless cellular system. This paper addresses an adaptive handoff-relieving scheduling algorithm for downlink transmission in a time-slotted shared wireless network that considering both the on-line channel condition and velocity information together. And simulation results indicate that this scheduling scheme can absolutely relieve the handoff overhead and create a good experience for the subscribers.

articleTitle: Research on the Comparative Appraisal Method of Intellectual Property Right Protection Based on the Theory of Evidence
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Appraising the present level of intellectual property right protection accurately is the important work for one country to design appropriate intellectual property right policy. The existing appraisal systems of intellectual property right protection have the problems of unreasonable index and appraisal method. This paper presents a comparative appraisal method based on expert evaluation. In this method, we appraise the level of intellectual property right protection through comparing it with one country's level of economy, science and technology development. But this comparative appraisal method is based on the subjective judge of experts, so there will be uncertainty in the appraisal course and results. In order to lest the subjectivity and uncertainty of experts' opinions and make the appraisal process and result more objective, the paper introduces the theory of evidence to synthesize the experts' opinions and studies the course of comparative appraisal of intellectual property right protection based on the theory of evidence.

articleTitle: The Research of Network Planning Risk Element Transmission Theory Model Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In order to solve the network planning problem considering risk elements efficaciously, we redefine the network planning in this paper and transform the classical network chart to the new network chart based on combining neural network theory. On this basis, a risk classification is listed for the construction project, and we give the evaluation activity indexes using the expert assessment. Then, a risk classification is listed for the construction project. In order to get the total risk degree of all the network routes, after setting a certain weight and threshold value, we regard the indexes as the neural network input vector and calculate the risk degree of various activities. Thus, the total risk degree of all the network routes can be got. Finally, the model algorithm is illustrated with a case study.

articleTitle: Research on Preference of Project Financing
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to choose a suitable financial instrument is very important for project financing. It can reflect the preference of investors. The article analyses the financial instrument of project financing. From the angle of liability financing and equity financing, the author discussed the preference between two financial instruments, and raised the preference zone between the two instruments. Meanwhile, it analyses the effective factors of financial instrument under venture equity capital.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Patent Attitude: Transferring from Supply-Orientation to Demand- Orientation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: LDPC Coded Link Adaptation Based on Irregular Modulation Integrated with Full Incremental Redundancy
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The irregular modulation (IM) technique was initially proposed in bit-interleaved coded modulation (BICM) for convolutional code and turbo code cases (Schreckenbach and Bauch, 2006), which apply different signal constellations and mappings within one codeword. The IM technique gives a simple method to improve flexibility of BICM, which can also provide an adaptive modulation with fine granularity. We combine the IM and low density parity check (LDPC) coded full incremental redundancy (FIR) hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ) to propose a novel link adaptation method-"IM_FIR". Simulation results show that the "IM_FIR" can not only achieve higher throughput efficiency but also significantly reduce transmission delay than the LDPC coded regular modulation with FIR schemes. Furthermore, an adaptive IM with FIR scheme is presented, which can adaptively select proper IM strategies to get highest throughput in accordance with variations of the channel conditions.

articleTitle: A Global Optimisation Algorithm for 802.11 WLAN Radio Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The wireless link is still the bottleneck in 802.11 WLAN systems, especially in a public WLAN deployment with high-demand users. The most common way of improving the system performance is by accurate site planning, but this still does not cope with dynamic demand from users, such as in hotspots at an airport where travellers with WLAN laptops tend to gather at different gates at different times. In this paper, a novel intelligent radio resource management system for WLANs with low-cost semi-smart antennas is proposed and evaluated. The access points can re-configure their radio coverage patterns to balance hot-spot traffic. Using a global optimisation algorithm, significant performance improvement is discovered over traditional configurations by simulations.

articleTitle: The Innovative Service Thinking to Face NHI - The Consumers' View on Self-Pay Service
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The purpose of the study is to probe the relationship of health information source, medical experience, demographic and perception of self-pay service. 604 structural questionnaires were issued, and we retrieved 602 valid samples. The degree that the people care about the relevant knowledge and information actively also influences the choice that the people are consuming the relevant services of self-pay items. In addition, people who have ever consumed self-pay services do require service quality. If the quality is fine, they tend to consume self-pay service even if the price is high. People who have never consumed self-pay services will considerate to consume self-pay service, if they identify that it is a future trend to be self-pay service, can enjoy better service, and self-pay service can offer follow-up care. All the results reflect people's many expectations on self-pay services, and administrators should well design excellent services to meet people's need and expectations.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of Human Resources Management in the CSCD Based on Agent
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As the rapid development of the economic globalization and the information technology, great changes have taken place in the enterprise environment. In order to satisfy the need of development in the new situation, the human resources management of enterprise must adopt the corresponding countermeasure. This paper presents a (HRMS) human resources management system frame in the CSCD (computer supported cooperative design) based on agent and develops a prototype system by using a widely accepted agent platform Java agent development platform (JADE). The prototype system has certain reference significance to modern enterprise human resources management.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Professional Management: The Future of Knowledge Worker Boundaryless Career Management
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A License Language Design and Analysis for E-Government
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a digital right management license language (called, PALL) for e-government and analyzes the advantage and potential application of it. Classical digital rights license languages applied to the electronic "downloading", payment and rendering(laying) of artistic works(for example music, literature readings and movies), we extend the concept of license to also cover work authorization in public government. The digital works are now public government documents. As digital rights license for artistic works seeks to safeguard against privacy and to ensure proper payments for the rights to render these works. Public government license language seeks to ensure transparent and professional "good governance".

articleTitle: A Study of the Effect of Organizational IQ on IT Investment and Productivity
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In response to the concern regarding IS development and initiatives, this study emphasizes the importance of the context where IS applications are applied. We focus on the organizational context as a principal aspect of this environment and evaluate firm specific characteristics by using organizational intelligence quotient (OIQ). We investigate the impact of OIQ on IT investment and labor productivity. The model is tested on small and medium Japanese enterprises from manufacturing sector. The evidence shows a positive association of OIQ with IT investment and labor productivity. We found that firms with higher levels of OIQ invest more in IT, as well as obtain higher levels of productivity than lower OIQ firms.

articleTitle: A Compensation Method of the Forward Power Control in Multi-Service Hierarchical CDMA System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The paper presents a power control compensation method in the forward channel for the higher system capacity of the future Multi-Service hierarchical CDMA system. This method is mainly based on the confidence level and the estimation theory. The estimation has two steps, the channel fading estimation and the Mobile Station (MS) traffic amount estimation. The simulating results prove that it is better than the traditional power control methods by the great reduction of outage probability about 15%.

articleTitle: Uniform Representation Model and Approximate Generation Algorithm of Mobile SVG
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Mobile SVG is adopted as the imaging standard of MMS by 3GPP - the partner of 3G. When generating mobile SVG on resource limited mobile devices, the memory space and computation capability become serious constrain which we should pay more attention. By analyzing the characteristics of mobile SVG basic shapes, this paper presents a uniform representation model based on path. Then this paper puts forward an approximate generation algorithm based on cubic Bezier curve, and figure out the approximate element K for curves. The experiments prove that the approximate degree of the algorithm is very high. The method is valuable for the mobile SVG representation.

articleTitle: Agent Based Negotiation Model for E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: E-commerce systems have become increasingly pervasive in the business world. Businesses and consumers are relying more and more on automated processes to handle the buying and selling of goods and services. Automated negotiation is a key issue for e-commerce. Agent is well suited for developing e-commerce systems. This paper proposed an e-commerce negotiation model based on agent, represented the communication language for agent, and implemented the negotiation process by elitist preserved genetic algorithm. The proposed model is verified by experiment.

articleTitle: Modulation and Demodulation Method for CDMA Communication System Based on Polyphase Orthogonal Sequence
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, an new modulation and demodulation method for polyphase orthogonal sequences is given and the correlation receiving property and anti-MAI property for this method are analyzed thoroughly. The CDMA system with polyphase orthogonal sequence using the modulation and demodulation method we proposed on Rayleigh Fading channel has been simulated and the BER has been got. The result shows that the performance of CDMA system based on polyphase orthogonal sequence to restrain multiple access interference is better than the CDMA system based on duality sequence.

articleTitle: Cognition-Based Perspective on Entrepreneur's Decision and Learning Processes in Firm's Entrepreneurial Stage
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Following the perspective of entrepreneur cognition, the paper combines the research of entrepreneurship and management cognition, aims to the deep understanding of the structure and process of entrepreneur cognition; the development of cognition through the decision and learning processes in the firm's entrepreneurial stage. In the paper, eight propositions from which specific hypotheses can be developed to test the influence in cognition in the venture creation, the relationship between cognition, decision making and learning in the two periods of the entrepreneurial stage. The paper has a potentially important impact in analyzing the relationship between cognition and new venture creation. It also explains the cognitive development among entrepreneurs through the learning processes in the entrepreneurial stage.

articleTitle: Study on Railway Transport Service Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Service quality is the decisive factor that service enterprises can use to create difference and obtain competitive advantages. Firstly, the study is based on SERVQUAL evaluation model and combines the actual situation of China's railway transport service to construct its evaluation indicators system. Empirical studies have simplified the indicators system and finalized the railway passenger service quality evaluation model. Furthermore, we have tested its reliability and validity. The study has shown that railway transport service quality has five dimensions, which are tangibility, reliability, communication, portability and relationship. Finally, the study applies the indicators system into practice to evaluate the railway transport service quality and make some suggestions for railway transport enterprises to improve their service, it also provide the profound academic and realistic basis for railway transport enterprises to improve their service.

articleTitle: The Application of a Simple Method in Vendor Selection
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Vendor selection problem (VSP) is a very important issue for most manufacturers. Lots of literatures about it have been emitted since the 1970s. However, most methods of them are either subjective or complicated. From the perspective of reducing these shortcomings, this paper proposes a linear optimization hierarchy process (LOHP) by combining the multi-criteria decision model (MCDM) in the work of Ng (2007) and the hierarchy thinking. The LOHP can not only reduce the subjectivity and complicacy efficiently, but also solve the special VSP easily which contains a large amount of criteria. Thus, the LOHP has high practical value in dealing with the VSP. At the end of this article, a realistic example is applied to demonstrate how the LOHP could be used.

articleTitle: A Cross-Layer Based Multipath Routing Protocol for IEEE802.11e Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper proposes a cross-layer design-based, multi-path routing protocol (CMRP) for mobile ad hoc networks. In combination of the upcoming IEEE802.11e standard in MAC sublayer, we determine that CMRP benefits from this new technology significantly. Performance evaluation of AODV in legacy 802.11 and CMRP in IEEE802.11e shows that, as a function of speed of node mobility, a tremendous reduction achieved, in metrics such as the average end-to-end delay, routing overheads, route discovery frequency and normalized routing load with CMRP - almost more than 80%, 40%, 40%, and 40%. In the case of varying number of sessions, the reduction for route discovery frequency, normalized routing load and average hopcounts of active routes are up to 70%, 80%, and 50%.

articleTitle: Group Signature Scheme with No Group Manager
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A group signature scheme with no group manager is proposed in this paper. The proposed scheme allows that any t or more group members collectively add new members or delete group members without the group manager. Furthermore, the length of a signature and the computational effort for signing and verifying do not depend on the number of the deleted group members. The scheme has many practical applications in full decentralized and lack centralized control environments.

articleTitle: IS Researcher Issues
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper reports on an international study of the key issues facing Information Systems researchers. A variant of the Delphi method was used to identify and rank the issues. The results identified a consistent and unified group of issues facing most researchers surveyed, regardless of location or research orientation. The results suggest that a reliable and valid instrument is available to measure key issues facing IS researchers. Further work to broaden the relevance to all regions is suggested.

articleTitle: Improvement on Production Cost Function of Micro Input-Output
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper introduces the three forms of cost function of micro input-output, and gives a summary and analysis. It points out that the micro-dynamic input-output function in the micro-environment of production systems only gives some research for longitudinal. At the base of the research this paper creates a new state matrix and analyses the production systems for horizontal in the micro-environment.

articleTitle: Scheduling Service Algorithms for Multimedia in IEEE802.16e OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Taking the traffic priority of real-time or non-real-time services into consideration, this paper proposes two scheduling algorithms for multimedia services based on the definitions of frame and subchannel in IEEE802.16e. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithms provide better performances of efficiency and fairness than conventional algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimizing components selection for configurable product using quality function deployment
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: A new method for optimizing components selection for configurable product is proposed based on quality function deployment (QFD) to minimize the difference between the customer's expectation and the selected product. The model is converted into an equivalent linear integer-programming model to facilitate the solving approach. An illustrative example from applying this method is presented to prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the model. The computation result shows that the mapping relations among the customer requirements, technical attributes and component attributes are developed by matrices of house of quality (HoQ), and the optimal solution corresponds with the customer's requirements reasonably.

articleTitle: Adaptive Scheduling with Fairness in IEEE 802.16e Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The IEEE 802.16e standard proposes a broadband wireless access network, which is aimed to serve a mixture of traffic types. As the standard leaves the data scheduling part open, we suggest a deficit-based scheduling scheme with an adaptive quantum for the network operating in TDD mode. Our scheme supports traffic in both downlink and uplink directions, with the guaranteed service amount defined by a minimum tolerable traffic rate, a standard QoS parameter. When traffic exceeds network resources, our scheme employs a fairness constraint to allocate bandwidth fairly. Simulation results prove that our scheme can improve fairness performance and provide equally low delay to traffic with diverse characteristics.

articleTitle: Link Failure Rate and Speed of Nodes in Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the simulation analysis of wireless network, the speed of nodes is an important property of mobility. The faster the nodes move, the more unstable the network is. Meanwhile, in theoretical analysis, link failure rate is widely used to modeling the stability of a wireless network. This paper presents an analysis of a simplified mobility model and shows that the link failure rate is positively correlated with the average speed of nodes in this model. Though this result is based on a mobility model with many restrictions, a simulation evaluation suggests that the result still holds in the popular random waypoint model and random direction model.

articleTitle: Assuring Information Quality in Knowledge Intensive Business Services
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to assure information quality in innovation interactions between knowledge intensive business services (KIBS) and their clients. Many real-life business cases show that the quality of information is a crucial and pervasive management problem in KIBS. Nevertheless, how to achieve high-quality information remain poorly studied, and assuring mechanism has rarely been considered. This article provides a framework for assuring information quality which consists of four major elements: sorts of information quality, assuring mechanism, information quality criteria and assuring principles.

articleTitle: Usability Evaluation of B2C Web Site
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Web site usability is a critical metric for assessing the quality of the B2C Web site. A measure of usability must not only provide a rating for a specific Web site, but also should it illuminate the specific strengths and weaknesses about site design. In this paper, the usability and usability evaluation of B2C Web site are described. A comprehensive set of usability guidelines developed by Microsoft (MUG) is revised and utilized. The index and sub index comprising these guidelines are present firstly. The weights of each indexes and sub indexes are decided by AHP(Analytical Hierarchy Process). Base on the investigation data, a mathematic arithmetic is proposed to calculate the grade of each B2C Web site. The illustrated example shows that the evaluation approach of this paper is very effective.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Clustering Protocol for Medium-Scale Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Energy efficiency is an essential design issue for wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Single-hop dynamic clustering proposed by LEACH (Low-Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy) is a simple and energy-efficient approach in WSNs. Due to the particular requirements of RF power of wireless sensors, LEACH may only be applicable to small-scale WSNs. In this paper, we propose an adaptive clustering protocol for medium-scale WSNs (ACPM) that could be applied to larger networks than LEACH. ACPM adopts the adaptive back-off scheme for cluster head selection to achieve its goal. Simulation results show that ACPM performs better than LEACH, especially in medium-scale WSNs.

articleTitle: Trust Evaluation Based Reliable Routing in Wireless Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The transmission reliability of wireless mesh network relies on the cooperative and the trusted between the network nodes. To reliable route and forward data packets, it is important to evaluate the trustworthiness of nodes in network But due to the nature of wireless mesh network, the sample space of evidence which is used to evaluate trust may be incomplete or unreliable. So the existing trust evaluation model could not apply to it unalterably. A novel trust evaluation based reliable routing scheme is proposed to solve this problem. It evaluates the trust value of nodes through a novel uncertainty measurement infinitesimal algorithm and discovers reliable routes according to the trust value of nodes. The simulation shows that the proposed model is able to evaluate the trustworthiness of nodes effectively and improve the transmission reliability of the network.

articleTitle: A Comparative Economic Analysis of different FTTH Architectures
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Bandwidth demand is rising sharply in the world. The ultimate solution is the substitution of copper with fiber in access networks. There are multiple architectures of implementing fiber and it is crucial to find one which is most cost effective. External factors like housing costs, area characteristics and labor cost play an important role in cost estimations. In this paper engineering cost method is employed to calculate the cost per subscriber of different architectures under different conditions. As sunk costs are very high so take rate (number of homes covered by the access network that subscribe to the service) plays a vital role. Feeder fiber length and maintenance costs are other important factors. The architectures utilizing the existing copper or cable distribution networks are most cost efficient but the ultimate solution will be fiber up to the home fulfilling all future bandwidth demands. The maintenance cost over the life is also lowest for all fiber networks. At present telecom companies are encouraged to employ fiber in their feeder networks.

articleTitle: Contact-Based Traceback in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Sensor nodes can be compromised by attackers to launch various attacks, one of which is false data injection attack The attacker injects large amount of bogus data through the compromised node. This will lead to network resources exhaustion. We propose a novel contact-based approach (CTrace) to traceback to the attack origins. In CTrace, each node maintains information of its neighbors in proximity of radius R hops. The node at R hops away is called contact. With certain probability, each node marks its identification information into an arriving packet. By collecting a few packets, each node is able to construct a partial attack path back to one of its contact. CTrace build the whole attack path using a series of REQ and PATHSEG message exchanges between a sensor node and its contact. CTrace requires only a small number of packets to track down the source node injecting false data.

articleTitle: Relay-Assisted MIMO Multiuser Precoding in Fixed Relay Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, downlink multiple input multiple output (MIMO) multiuser transmission using precoding in fixed relay networks is studied. We propose two relay-assisted MIMO multiuser precoding models. For the first model, multiuser precoding is performed at base station (BS). The fixed relay processes the received signal and forwards it, which is amplify- and-forward. While for the second model, the multiuser precoding is done at relay. Thus, detect-and-forward or decode- and-forward transmission can be used. Based on these models, some multiuser precoding algorithms are investigated. Our simulation results show that fixed relay offers significant gain. And our system architectures give the means on how to utilize fixed relay in MIMO multiuser system.

articleTitle: Design of RFID Reader Using Multi-Antenna with Difference Spatial Location
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Radio-frequency identification (RFID) is contactless automatic identification technology which is rapidly development lately. In order to intelligent management systems using RFID technology have the ability of location identification, design scheme of RFID reader using multi-antenna of difference spatial location is presented in this paper. It is a separated setting of reader and multi detecting antennas. The receiving information from tags contains antenna code and data in tag's IC. Hence the reader can indicate the tags position through different antenna code. The managing system of intelligent medicine-chest based RFID technology with reader presented in this paper not only can provide location identification, but also can reduce system cost. It will have wide application in future.

articleTitle: Investigation on the IP Flow Inter-Arrival Time in Large-Scale Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: This paper analyzes the IP flow inter-arrival time distribution and the inter-arrival time autocorrelations of the traces collected in different large-scale networks. It is found that the IP flow inter-arrival time distribution follows the Weibull distribution which has the parameter alpha close to 1.0 as the scale of network becomes larger, so the Weibull distribution degrades to the exponential distribution. It is also discovered that the autocorrelation decreases as the IP flows' length increases. According to the studies above, this paper deduces the conclusion as following: The IP flow inter-arrival time distribution fits to the Weibull distribution generally, when the IP flow length exceed a certain threshold, the IP flow inter-arrival time fits to the Poisson distribution.

articleTitle: VoIP Call Signaling Performance and Always-On Battery Consumption in HSDPA, WCDMA and WiFi
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless broadband enables the use of VoIP with handheld mobile deices. Likewise, multi radio terminals provide the user with ubiquitous access. Even though broadband access might be available in different locations, performance still depends on the wireless technology used. We study the main signaling delays that take place in a voice call (registration and voice call setup delays) and compare them for different wireless accesses: HSDPA, WCDMA and WiFi. Likewise, possible optimizations with always-on mode and their drawbacks are presented. Signaling delays and total battery lifetime affect the perceived end user experience directly, and thus are important items to consider in addition to the overall voice quality.

articleTitle: A Distributed Algorithm for DAG-Form Service Composition Over MANET
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Service Composition in MANETs may suffer from overburden when computing optimal composition for complex service requirement on one pervasive device. To address this challenge, the paper presents a fully decentralized framework for service composition in MANETs. Firstly, it arranges heterogeneous devices into a hierarchical service overlay network and forms a service graph in proactive manner upon the overlay. Secondly, it distributes processing load for one composition to multiple overlay nodes by splitting and merging request into multiple simpler sub request graph based on heuristic scheme. It can provide balanced load and high scalability when composition requirement is complex, while achieve approximate optimality of the composition result. Experimental results demonstrate that the effectiveness of our solution.

articleTitle: MA-Chord: A New Approach for Mobile Ad Hoc Network with DHT Based Unicast Scheme
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We put DHT (distributed hash table) based P2P (peer to peer) application - chord into MANET (mobile ad hoc network) in this paper. Then, we propose a new routing modified scheme MA-chord which bases on a unicast scheme with DHT. MA-chord can be efficiently used to not only provide indirect, key-based overlay routing, but also conventional direct routing. Our simulation implies that MA-chord can markedly outperform conventional reactive ad hoc routing (AODV). Therefore, MANET nodes can run MA-chord for application purpose, especially P2P applications.

articleTitle: CBPMAC/TFC: A Wireless Sensor Network MAC Protocol for Systems with Burst and Periodic Signals
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Aiming at the application scene with both burst signals and periodic signals, this paper proposes a cluster-based wireless sensor network MAC protocol combining TDMA, FDMA with CSMA/CA - CBPMAC/TFC(a cluster-based wireless sensor network MAC protocol for the system with burst and periodic signals/based on TDMA, FDMA, CSMA/CA). It adopts TDMA mechanism in the clusters, and assigns time-slots for periodic signals and burst signals respectively. In the periodic signal time- slot, only one child node sends its periodic signal, while in the burst signal time-slots, all the child nodes share the channel according to CSMA/CA mechanism. Among different clusters, FDMA mechanism is adopted. Different cluster works at different frequency channel, so they can work simultaneously. For the requirement of synchronization, a cluster-head-based relative time synchronization mechanism is proposed. In addition, the alternation strategy of cluster heads and the disposal strategy of malfunctions are introduced. Analysis and test results show that the protocol could meet the system requirements in reliability, real-time response and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: A P2P Network Based Architecture for Web Service
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: As a typical example of the SOA (service oriented architecture), Web service has been applied in e-business, e-government and many other fields as for its encapsulated, loosely coupled, dynamic binding, etc. mechanism. However, the mechanism of service publishing and discovery with centralized architecture, such as UDDI, restricts the reliability and scalability of the environment as the services and resources on the web are fast emerging. Using P2P technique is a good solution. This paper discusses an architecture of Web service publishing, discovery and invocation based on P2P, which makes the UDDI registry decentralized. Besides, a concept of WSB (Web service broker) is put forward to make the service invocation transparent between the two paradigms-Web service and P2P.

articleTitle: The Empirical Study on Dynamic Relationship Between Domestic and Global Steel Price
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: With an open view to research steel market, especially to study steel price which take as the steel market indicator, the paper tries to objectively reflect the impact of China's steel on global market by making the empirical analysis on the interaction and volatilities between International and China's steel market. The results indicated that China's steel price have one-side guide role on the global steel price, that is to say, Up and down of China's steel price will foreboding the global steel price. This shows that China's steel has "the right to speak" on the global market, Meanwhile, there are some questions on long-term sustainability open and development of our steel industry. It should followed development principles, which are sustained and stable development, promoting industrial restructuring and taking into account all interests.

articleTitle: Design of Secure and Low-Cost RFID Tag Baseband
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays, radio frequency identification (RFID) has been widely used in our everyday life, and has aroused increasing concerns about privacy and security. Cryptographic techniques can be used to protect privacy but are too expensive for low-cost RFID tags. This paper addresses the problem and proposes a new RFID system structure. In our system, the RFID tag sends only the hashed tag ID number to the reader, thus even if the communication data is intercepted, the adversary cannot retrieve any useful information. This paper also presents the RFID tag baseband design based on this new structure. Our design is implemented in an Altera FPGA. The experiment shows that the security of the baseband is largely enhanced compared to non-secure basic tags, while having less gate equivalents than some secure tags with other RFID system structures and cryptographic implementations.

articleTitle: Interaction and Social Presence in Technology-Mediated Learning: A Partial Least Squares Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Students may hesitate to enroll online courses when they perceive the difficulty of interaction in technology-mediated learning environment. This study investigated this important research issue by surveying online MBA program graduates on their perceptions on the interaction and social presence between students and instructors in technology-mediated learning. The research findings reported that oral-based interaction had a significant impact on social presence and social presence had a significant impact on e-Learning performance. Implications of the research findings were discussed.

articleTitle: On the Capacity of Cooperative Communication in Correlated Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: We investigate the performance of the protocols for cooperative communications, such as amplify-forward and decode-forward, in correlated fading channels. Our analytical and simulation results show that correlation can have varied effects on the capacity, compared to the uncorrelated cases. If the quality of the source-destination channel is better, in terms of the variances of the fading coefficients, than that of the source-relay channel, correlation may cause degradation in the capacity. Otherwise, cooperation between terminals in correlated fading channels could offer more capacity than in the uncorrelated scenarios.

articleTitle: A Low-Latency MAC Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, Energy efficiency is the most important performance target to prolong the networks lifetime. As the idle listening of sensor nodes result in primary energy waste, many typical MAC protocols are designed to save power by placing the radio in the low-power sleep mode, however, such schemes can lead to sleep latency problems in multi-hop transmissions. This paper analyses the sleep latency, and proposes a low- latency MAC protocol (LLMAC), which uses asynchrony message package for frame schedule between neighbor nodes instead of SYNC package in S-MAC, and brings in the stagger active schedule mechanism to maintain the data forwarding transmission. Simulation results show much better performance of the latency control compared with the existing schemes.

articleTitle: An Efficient Broadcast Algorithm in Distributed Hash Table Under Churn
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Broadcasting has become a basic service that adds to existing DHT systems the ability to search using arbitrary queries as well as disseminate/collection global information. However, the phenomenon of system churn, a continuous process of needs joining and leaving the networks, degrades the broadcast performance of DHT systems and adversely impact the performance of applications built on top of them. In this paper, we present an efficient algorithm for performing a broadcast operation in DHT systems under churn. It is suitable for most DHT systems such as Chord, Tapestry, etc. Through the proposed algorithm, nodes in DHT system could perform broadcast operation rapidly, and will not send any redundant message. Furthermore, it ensures full coverage of the nodes in the system even when the churn rate is high. The algorithm is validated and evaluated through simulations.

articleTitle: An Improved Directed Diffusion for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Directed diffusion (DD) is typical data-centric protocol for wireless sensor networks, all nodes in a directed diffusion- based network are application-aware, and this enables diffusion to achieve energy savings by selecting empirically good paths and by caching and processing data in-network. But at the beginning of routing being established, interest must be flooded throughout the network, it leads heavy traffic. For this reason, an improved directed diffusion (IDD) is proposed in this paper. IDD cluster all nodes into clusters, and select a few nodes as cluster heads the others as cluster members, interest is flooded only among cluster heads, cluster members sense data and transmit their sensing data to its cluster head, cluster head compresses and aggregates sensing data received from its cluster members and sends this sensing data to base station along a reinforcement path. Simulation results show that IDD has higher energy efficient than DD, it can reduce data transmission delay and prolong the lifetime of wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: A Novel Sensor Node Selection Method Based on Trust for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is drawing a lot of attention as a method for realizing a ubiquitous society, which needs more than one sensor to accomplish the task together. Malicious nodes are well disguised in a hostile military environment, so they can attack the whole network using the natural cooperations of WSNs. Therefore, how to choose one or more suitable sensor nodes to cooperate in a hostile environment and guarantee better system performance in the meantime is a difficult problem. To overcome this, we study trust mechanism in the human society and introduce it into a WSN. We also construct a trust model in accordance with the characteristics of a WSN. Based on trust model, we propose a novel sensor node selection algorithm. The simulation results show that our algorithm can improve the system stability of sensor networks, and efficiently defend against the attacks of malicious nodes and also prolong the lifetime of sensor networks.

articleTitle: An Extended Expectation Confirmation Model for Information Systems Continuance
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Initial adoption is an important indicator of information systems (IS) success, and IS continuance or post-adoption is more critical toward long-term IS performance. However, compared with much work done on initial IS adoption, little systematic theory-based models have been developed to provide deep insight into continued IS use over time. Additionally most studies on IS continuance only examine cognitive factors. This paper reviews the previous research on IS continuance, and examines the utility of the expectation confirmation model (ECM) from the consumer behavior literature. Then it suggests an expended ECT which is combined with the affective construct (perceived enjoyment) of individual users. Finally the proposed model was empirically validated with data collected from undergraduate students. The objective of this paper is to provide a perspective of combination of cognitive and affective factors for further research on IS continuance.

articleTitle: Compact Circularly Polarized Square Microstrip Fractal Antenna with Symmetrical T-Slits
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Based on the narrow-slit fractal method, a novel compact square microstrip fractal antenna with symmetrical T-slits to achieve circular polarization (CP) operation is proposed. By introducing two pairs of symmetrical T-slits, high cross-polarization is effectively suppressed. In addition, a patch size reduction as large as ~34.3% for the proposed antenna, compared to the conventional regular-size CP antenna without the symmetrical slits, has been obtained.

articleTitle: Intelligent Information Retrieval Model Based on Multi-Agents
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Information Retrieval in the World Wide Web (WWW) using the general search engines is still a difficult and time-consuming task, which creates a demand of new information search and retrieval techniques. An intelligent retrieval system model based on multi-agent is proposed which assists the user in finding interesting information in the WWW. This model searches through the popular and special Web search engines, filters their result, and lists to the user a reduced number of information with high probability of being relevant to him. This filtering is implemented by the agent analyzing the user's behavior on the Web based on user's search intent and preferences. The design, the architecture, the functional components and the workflow of the model are elaborated. The model is helpful to solve the shortcomings effectively of low precision and relevant document ranking behind in general search engine.

articleTitle: SRSN: Secure Routing Based on Sequence Number for MANETs
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Security of mobile ad hoc network (MANET) is very important when we deploy MANET in reality. A variety of attacks exist in MANET. Among them is black hole attack which uses higher sequence number of RREQ packet to provide false route information. To defend against black hole attack, this paper proposed a new method, SRSN (secure routing based on sequence number) , which based on the strict increment of sequence number of RREQ packet combined with reliable end to end acknowledgement to detect false route information. SRSN makes a little edition of DSR protocol and can defend against black hole attack without increasing much consumption of resource and payload. Simulation results show that SRSN still can maintain high packet delivery ratio while there is black hole attack malicious node in network.

articleTitle: Design of a Four-Layer Model Based on Danger Theory and AIS for IDS
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: After a decade of research into the classical self-non-self model for immune-based intrusion detection system (IDS), a new idea has been developed by immunologists recently, which is called danger theory. Based on this new viewpoint, we present a four-layer model of artificial immune system (AIS) . Also, a mechanism of reasoning with uncertainty is proposed to increase the detection accuracy. There are three merits of this novel model. First, danger theory provides a method of 'grounding' the immune response to reduce false alarms. Second, each layer of the model can work independently and interact with each other, so the efficiency of detecting is greatly improved. Last, the reasoning with uncertainty allows the model to dynamically adapt to real network traffic.

articleTitle: Design of Gradient and Node Remaining Energy Constrained Directed Diffusion Routing for WSN
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the conventional directed diffusion routing protocol (DD), the intermediate nodes retransmit the received interest message to all of the neighbor nodes by flooding, which can bring about great energy consumption to the network. In this paper, we propose an energy-efficient routing algorithm for wireless sensor networks called gradient and node remaining energy constrained directed diffusion routing (GRE-DD). By setting the maximum gradient diffusion depth, GRE-DD can help to reduce the times of retransmitting interest message at the interest propagation stage, leading to the reduction of transmitted data. By setting the minimum node remaining energy, GRE-DD help to increase the each node's probability of being selected to perform retransmission task, prolonging the node average working time and improving the network load balance. Simulation results indicate that GRE-DD greatly cuts down the average end-to-end delay, reduces energy consumption and extends the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Interference-Aware Load Balanced Routing in Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless mesh networks (WMNs) will play an important role in the next generation wireless communication systems because it can support broadband services with ubiquitous coverage by low transmission power. However, the question will be caused by using the shortest path routing protocol such as DSR and AODV in such multi-hop networks. Load unbalance of nodes will sharply degrade the traffic quality in WMNs. In this paper, we put forward a traffic load model considering the interference among wireless nodes. By using the probability of channel busy as the load of a node, we propose a load balanced routing scheme based on AODV. Simulation results show that interference-aware load balanced routing (IALBR) achieves significant traffic quality enhancement over basic IEEE 802.11 mesh networks.

articleTitle: CIVIC: An Power- and Context-Aware Routing Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Wireless sensor network presents a self-organizing, wireless, ad hoc communication network that trades lower data throughput and higher message latency for lower cost and lower power drain. Conventional wireless routing protocols generally cannot satisfy the particular requirements of WSN applications to build reliable and efficient communication links. CIVIC is a location-based hybrid routing protocol (proactive and reactive). This protocol is basing upon two mechanisms: FFCCC and DANKAB. The former provides a power-aware minimal distance competitive mechanism to select a best effective node for data forwarding. The latter adopts a directional area neighbor knowledge adaptive broadcast policy to constrain the number of transferring nodes. CIVIC is also a context-aware and security consideration protocol. Messages are classified into different security and priority levels according to data context. Furthermore, meta codebook technique is adopted to decrease network traffic and improve system security. In present, CIVIC has been simulated on NS2, evaluated on hardware platforms.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism Optimization of ZRP Cache Information Processing in Mobile Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In the research area of mobile ad hoc network, ZRP which integrates advantages of proactive routing protocols and on-demand routing protocols has been the crucial research now. In this paper, the principle and the cache mechanism of ZRP are analyzed. In allusion to the problems of late-deletion and early-deletion in ZRP, the optimized A-ZRP which associates the routing information priority with the latest access time is proposed. It improves information store format of cache in the routing table. Finally, the simulation experiment shows that A-ZRP shows advantages to ZRP in terms of the radius of routing zone, routing overhead, delivery fraction and packet delay based on the same transmission load and node movement. In A-ZRP, the processing of path discovery is reduced, the routing overhead is decrease and the performance of the delivery fraction and the packet delay are improved. The routing protocol performance of mobile ad hoc ZRP is improved.

articleTitle: Exact BER Expression for Alamouti Scheme with Joint Transmit and Receive Antenna Selection
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we propose a simple joint transmit and receive antenna selection algorithm based on maximizing the instantaneous signal to noise ratio (SNR) over uncorrelated Rayleigh fading channels in multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems. For a special case that two transmit antennas and one receive antenna are selected, while Alamouti scheme is employed, the exact bit error rate (BER) expression for binary phase shift keying (BPSK) is derived. The analytical results are exactly verified by the simulations.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Contractor Based on the Fuzzy Matter Element Model
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, a fuzzy matter-element model is provided for the appraisal and optimal choice of contractor. Based on the fuzzy matter-element theory, the model combined with the concept of the Euclid approach degree established the fuzzy matter element evaluating method. This method took the contractors as the matter elements, and constructed the model according to the relevant indexs and its corresponding fuzzy values. Through calculating Euclid approach degree between the fuzzy matter-element and the standard fuzzy matter- element, and adopting information entropy theory to calculate the weight coefficients of each evaluating indexs, the author actualized the comprehensive evaluation and selection of contractor in construction scheme.

articleTitle: A Security-Provable Authentication and Key Agreement Protocol in RFID System
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper we propose a two-way authentication and key agreement protocol which is used in the communication between RFID tag and reader. This protocol characterizes low computing complexity and is suitable for low-cost RFID tag. We extend Strand space and prove the security of the protocol. The result indicates this protocol has low computing complexity, high security and is appropriate for the RFID system.

articleTitle: Trusted Dynamic Source Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, we design a novel secure routing protocol for mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs), called trusted dynamic source routing (TDSR) which extends the widely used DSR routing protocol and employs the idea of trust network connect (TNC) to protect routing behaviors. In the TDSR, trust among nodes is represented by trust score, which consists of direct trust and indirect trust. Trust relationships and routing decisions are based on experienced, observed, or reported routing and forwarding behavior of other nodes. The detailed implementation of TDSR assumes that the network layer is based on DSR. We present a performance analysis of DSR fortified by TDSR and compare it to regular defenseless DSR. It shows that a network with TDSR and up to 60% of misbehaving nodes behaves almost as well as a benign network. All simulations have been implemented and performed in NS2.

articleTitle: Research on Lean, Agile and Leagile Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: On the basis of the definition of leanness and agility, the authors compared the two paradigms first, and then analyzed the similarities and differences between them. The article shows neither paradigm is better nor worse than the other, they should not be considered in a progression or in isolation. In some situations, they can be combined together to enable a total supply chain strategy, thus bringing together the best of both paradigms. In the end, this paper describes the customized "leagile" Dell model.

articleTitle: Space-Time Related Pairwise Key Predistribution Scheme for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Most of existing pairwise key predistribution schemes (PKPS) for wireless sensor networks (WSN) have a common security vulnerability that an illegitimate node can use the keying material of a compromised node to set up pairwise keys with any non-compromised nodes in the network. Using this vulnerability, we propose the clone attack against WSN. To our knowledge, by far no PKPS can defend against this attack We propose a polynomial based space-time related pairwise key predistribution scheme (PSPP), in which the keying material of a node can only works at its initial deployment location. Analysis shows that PSPP cannot only defend against the clone attack but also even baffle the execution of other attacks, e.g. sybile attack cannot work in PSPP. Finally, we propose the extended PSPP (EPSPP), which has better collusion resistance.

articleTitle: Modeling and Ameliorating of Frame Slotted Aloha Anti-Collision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: The frame slotted aloha algorithm used in RFID system possesses Markov trait. A Markov chain model was built to analyze it. The mathematic relationship was obtained among the number of tags, slot number and success- identification rate. It was found out that when the tag's number exceeded the slot's number, the success-identification rate would descend rapidly. Thus an amelioration algorithm based on subset-division and dynamic matching concept was proposed. The simulation result shows that when the number of tags exceeds the one of slots, the success-identification rate of amelioration algorithm is much higher than the ones of frame slotted aloha and fixed matching method. This work provides theoretic guidance for the analysis and design of RFID system.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Energy-Efficient and Low-Latency Mac Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive energy-efficient and low-latency MAC (L-MAC) protocol for wireless sensor networks is proposed. In this protocol, nodes have three modes-sleeping, receiving and sending. Each node goes to sleep periodically to save energy. L-MAC delays the receiving and sending period hop by hop, so that when one node is in sending mode, its lower-hop node is in receiving mode. After receiving a message from upper- hop node, each node can transmit it to lower-hop node in the sequent sending period. Therefore, the multi-hop end-to-end delay due to periodical sleeping is reduced greatly. Furthermore, an adaptive sleeping scheme which makes the nodes with lower traffic have longer time to sleep is adopted to save more energy. Simulation results show that L-MAC achieves lower energy consumption and latency than traditional contention-based protocols.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect of Information Sharing Strategy to Complex Supply Chain System Based on Multi-Dimension View by Simulation
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: How to share the information effectively is a very important area of SCM, it can reduce the effect that the instability bring to the supply chain. The dimension of the information sharing in supply chain, which including information extension, sharing level and time factor, and the effect of different information is put forward in this paper. The common process of information sharing analysis for complex supply chain system is concentrated, a model based on system dynamics is structured; the effect of information sharing strategy to the performance of sc under supplier competition mode is studied.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese C2C E-Business Institutional Trust Mechanism: Case Study on Taobao and Ebay(cn)
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: E-business developed rapidly in recent years in China, especially C2C online auction. But trust building is also a main problem faced with C2C auction sites. In this paper we focus on the institutional trust mechanism of C2C online auction. By case study on two main auction sites, eBay and Taobao, which share most of the market, we investigated the institutional trust mechanism of them from four aspects: rules and policy, registration and authorization, payment and escrow service, feedback systems. Both of them make great efforts to win trust from users and prevent fraud. However, there are also problems with these mechanisms. Based on comparison, a few problems are discussed and suggestions are proposed.

articleTitle: Study on Critical Success Factors for IT Outsourcing Lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2007 International Conference on Wireless Communications, Networking and Mobile Computing
abstract: Nowadays IT outsourcing has changed and become more complex. The management of IT outsourcing continues to challenge organizations today.
